qa.en: Measure the hole position on the 2.5D video measuring machine.
qa.zh: 用 2.5D 影像投影儀量測孔位。

words.definition: Asking "why" about five times until you reach the root cause, not just the symptom.

qa.en: Use the 5 Whys — the loose bolt is a symptom, not the root cause.
qa.zh: 用五問法追下去——螺絲鬆動只是症狀，不是根本原因。

qa.en: The supplier must submit an 8D report for the cracked squat rack welds within ten working days.
qa.zh: 供應商必須在十個工作天內提出深蹲架焊道龜裂的 8D 報告。

qa.en: What is the root cause, and when can you send us the 8D report?
qa.zh: 根本原因是什麼？8D 報告什麼時候可以給我們？

qa.en: We will provide the full 8D report within five working days.
qa.zh: 完整的 8D 五個工作天內給你們。

qa.en: When can you send us the 8D report?
qa.zh: 8D 報告什麼時候可以給我們？

qa.en: We will submit the 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 我們會在週五前提交 8D 報告。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

words.definition: A structured team problem-solving report with eight steps, from team formation to closure.
relating to the part of the body that contains the stomach.

general.en: My colleague had abdominal surgery and lost 20 kg.
general.zh: 我的同事做了腹部手術，瘦了 20 公斤。

qa.en: Cut the specimen with the abrasive cutting machine.
qa.zh: 用砂輪切割機切取試片。

qa.en: The AQL defines the acceptance criteria for each defect class in the sampling plan.
qa.zh: AQL 就是抽樣計畫裡每個缺點等級收不收的標準。

qa.en: We apply general inspection level II by default and switch to tightened inspection when the acceptance criteria are not met.
qa.zh: 預設用一般檢驗水準 II；沒過允收標準就轉加嚴檢驗。

qa.en: The lot is accepted when the number of defectives is equal to or less than the acceptance number.
qa.zh: 不良數沒超過允收數，這批就收。

qa.en: We apply AQL 0.65 for major defects and AQL 2.5 for minor defects, under general inspection level II. Critical defects are zero acceptance.
qa.zh: 一般檢驗水準 II，主要缺點用 AQL 0.65、輕微缺點用 AQL 2.5；嚴重缺點一件都不能收。

qa.en: Acceptance is decided strictly by the Ac / Re numbers of the sampling plan, so the judgement is consistent regardless of who inspects.
qa.zh: 收不收完全看抽樣計畫的 Ac／Re，所以不管誰檢，結果都一樣。

qa.en: The sampling plan for this lot is Ac 1 / Re 2. One defective is within the acceptance number, so the lot is accepted. We still record the defect and feed it back to the supplier.
qa.zh: 這批的抽樣計畫是 Ac 1／Re 2，1 件不良還在允收數內，所以收。不過這件不良我們還是會記下來，回饋給供應商。

words.definition: Ac is the maximum number of defectives that still allows the lot to be accepted; Re is the number at which the lot must be rejected.

qa.en: Coating adhesion is verified by cross-hatch testing with a class 5B acceptance criterion.
qa.zh: 附著力用百格驗，允收標準 5B。

qa.en: Each requirement needs a test method and an acceptance criterion.
qa.zh: 每一條要求都要有測法跟允收基準。

qa.en: Decision: do not sign a requirement you cannot verify. A requirement without an acceptance criterion is a future dispute, not a specification.
qa.zh: 決定：驗證不了的東西不要簽。沒有允收基準的要求不是規格，是以後吵架的題目。

qa.en: We cut a 100-square grid, apply the specified tape, and pull it off at a constant angle. The acceptance criterion is class 5B — no squares removed.
qa.zh: 劃 100 格、貼指定膠帶，固定角度撕掉。允收標準 5B，就是一格都不能掉。

qa.en: We use the cross-hatch adhesion test per ASTM D3359. The acceptance criterion is class 5B, meaning no coating is removed from any of the one hundred squares.
qa.zh: 我們照 ASTM D3359 做百格，允收標準 5B，就是 100 格都不能有塗層掉下來。

qa.en: We have reviewed it line by line. Most requirements are clear. Three lines do not yet have a test method or an acceptance criterion, so we cannot confirm compliance against them.
qa.zh: 我們已經一條一條看過了。大部分都很清楚，但有三條還沒有測試方法跟允收基準，這樣我們沒辦法確認做不做得到。

words.definition: To get or use information stored in a computer or online.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: The system buys access at the cost of time.
general.zh: 這套制度用時間為代價換來了看病的機會。

general.en: Yes. The access road has been flooded, and trucks have been blocked outside the gate.
general.zh: 對，聯外道路淹水了，卡車被困在大門外面。

general.en: I can't access the website; it's blocked at school.
general.zh: 我無法連上該網站；它在學校被封鎖了。

general.en: I can access the information anytime.
general.zh: 我隨時都能取得這些資料。

words.definition: Being willing to accept responsibility for what you do.

general.en: The company handled the crisis by applying principles of accountability.
general.zh: 公司以當責的原則來處理這次危機。

general.en: Never in public. Accountability means we take responsibility outside and sort out the details inside.
general.zh: 公開場合絕對不行。當責的意思是我們對外承擔責任，細節在內部處理。

qa.en: All test reports state the test standard, the conditions, the actual results, and the accreditation status of the laboratory.
qa.zh: 所有測試報告都寫清楚測試標準、條件、實測結果，還有實驗室的認證狀態。

qa.en: Confirm that your certification body's and your test labs' accreditation status is unaffected.
qa.zh: 確認驗證機構和委外實驗室的認證狀態沒受影響。

qa.en: Yes. Only the organisation's name changed. Our lab accreditation is still valid.
qa.zh: 有。只是組織名稱改了，我們實驗室的認證還是有效的。

qa.en: If an accreditation mark on an incoming test report changes, ask the supplier for a written explanation and file it with the report.
qa.zh: 進來的測試報告上認證標誌變了，就跟供應商要一份書面說明，跟報告放一起歸檔。

qa.en: Do not revise everything immediately — wait for your certification body and accreditation body to publish the new naming and mark-usage rules, then change once.
qa.zh: 先不要急著全部改版 —— 等驗證機構和認證機構公告新名稱和標誌怎麼用，再一次改完。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

qa.en: The accreditation body assesses the certification body, not the factory.
qa.zh: 認證機構評的是驗證機構，不是工廠。

qa.en: Check the scope document yourself on the accreditation body's website, and save a dated copy with the report — scopes change.
qa.zh: 自己上認證機構網站查認證範圍，存一份有日期的副本跟報告放一起 —— 認證範圍是會變的。

qa.en: Do not revise everything immediately — wait for your certification body and accreditation body to publish the new naming and mark-usage rules, then change once.
qa.zh: 先不要急著全部改版 —— 等驗證機構和認證機構公告新名稱和標誌怎麼用，再一次改完。

qa.en: The report carries an accreditation mark, but the salt spray method is not listed in the scope of accreditation we retrieved from the accreditation body's website.
qa.zh: 報告上有認證標誌，但我們從認證機構網站查到的認證範圍裡，沒有鹽霧這個方法。

qa.en: The merger changes the international accreditation body, not the accreditation of individual laboratories. Our laboratory remains accredited to ISO/IEC 17025 and its scope is unchanged.
qa.zh: 這次合併改的是國際認證組織，不是個別實驗室的認證。我們的實驗室還是 ISO/IEC 17025 認證，範圍沒變。

qa.en: The accreditation mark on the cover page does not cover every test in the report.
qa.zh: 封面那個認證標誌，不是報告裡每一項測試都涵蓋。

qa.en: If an accreditation mark on an incoming test report changes, ask the supplier for a written explanation and file it with the report.
qa.zh: 進來的測試報告上認證標誌變了，就跟供應商要一份書面說明，跟報告放一起歸檔。

qa.en: Decision: do not accept the report as accredited evidence. An accreditation mark on the cover is not the same as the test being in scope.
qa.zh: 決定：這份報告不能當「認證報告」收。封面有認證標誌，不代表這項測試在認證範圍內。

qa.en: The report carries an accreditation mark, but the salt spray method is not listed in the scope of accreditation we retrieved from the accreditation body's website.
qa.zh: 報告上有認證標誌，但我們從認證機構網站查到的認證範圍裡，沒有鹽霧這個方法。

words.definition: 沒有錯誤，完全正確地

general.en: I couldn't use the new words accurately at first.
general.zh: 一開始我無法準確地使用新單字。

general.en: My mother speaks English very accurately.
general.zh: 我媽媽講英文非常準確。（形容詞：accurate 準確的）

general.en: He answered all the questions accurately.
general.zh: 他準確地回答了所有問題。

general.en: I know the answer — I just can't say it accurately!
general.zh: 我知道答案——我只是無法準確地說出來！

general.en: She always writes answers accurately, so the teacher praises her.
general.zh: 她總是準確地寫出答案，所以老師稱讚她。

general.en: But at intermediate level, I made slower progress. There were so many new words and phrases, but also words that I could understand but couldn't use accurately. I think I was more aware of my mistakes, which was good – but also frustrating.
general.zh: 但在中級階段，我的進步變慢了。有好多新的單字和片語，也有很多我聽得懂卻無法準確使用的單字。我想我更加意識到自己的錯誤，這是件好事——但也令人感到挫折。

words.definition: Something good that you succeed in doing through effort.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Winning the game was a great achievement.
general.zh: 贏得比賽是個巨大的成就。

general.en: Cleaning my room gave me a sense of achievement.
general.zh: 打掃房間給了我成就感。

general.en: Exactly. For someone that shy, that's already an achievement.
general.zh: 就是說啊。以一個那麼害羞的人來說，那已經算是一項成就了。

general.en: This experience gave me a strong sense of achievement.
general.zh: 這次經驗讓我更有成就感。

general.en: In the corporate world, events serve as crucial milestones for celebrating achievements, fostering team spirit, and strengthening company culture.
general.zh: 在企業世界中，各種活動扮演著重要的里程碑角色，用來慶祝成就、培養團隊精神，以及強化公司文化。

general.en: My mom made me clean my room because it was messy. I didn't want to at first, but she insisted. Afterward, I felt a sense of achievement. It taught me to be more responsible.
general.zh: 我媽逼我打掃房間，因為太亂了。起初我不想，但她很堅持。之後，我感到一種成就感。這教會我要更負責任。

qa.en: Action: either add the control to the control plan, or re-score detection honestly and let the action priority rise.
qa.zh: 行動：要嘛把這道檢查加進管制計畫，要嘛老實重評偵測度，讓行動優先度升上來。

qa.en: With an honest detection score the action priority moves to high.
qa.zh: 偵測度老實打分之後，行動優先度就變高了。

qa.en: I would rather have a high action priority now than a warranty claim later.
qa.zh: 我寧可現在行動優先度高一點，也不要以後多一件保固客訴。

qa.en: The detection score of 2 assumes a control that is not in the control plan. Final inspection covers noise and belt speed only, so detection should be re-scored and the action priority reassessed.
qa.zh: 偵測度給 2，是假設有一道管制，但管制計畫上根本沒有。最終檢驗只查噪音跟跑帶速度，所以偵測度要重評，行動優先度也要跟著重算。

qa.en: Coating adhesion is verified by cross-hatch testing with a class 5B acceptance criterion.
qa.zh: 附著力用百格驗，允收標準 5B。

qa.en: Adhesion is checked on the first article of each color change and once per shift during the run.
qa.zh: 每次換色的首件要測附著力，量產中每班再測一次。

qa.en: Re-check film thickness and adhesion after the re-spray — a double coat is not the film you qualified.
qa.zh: 重噴後要重新確認膜厚跟附著力——疊上去的雙層膜，不是當初驗證過的那層膜。

qa.en: A second coat causes film thickness build-up, so we re-check adhesion.
qa.zh: 再噴一層會造成膜厚疊加，所以我們要重驗附著力。

qa.en: How do you check the paint adhesion?
qa.zh: 塗裝附著力你們怎麼檢查？

qa.en: We use the cross-hatch adhesion test per ASTM D3359. The acceptance criterion is class 5B, meaning no coating is removed from any of the one hundred squares.
qa.zh: 我們照 ASTM D3359 做百格，允收標準 5B，就是 100 格都不能有塗層掉下來。

words.definition: to change something slightly to make it fit or work better

general.en: We need to adjust the design to meet foreign safety standards.
general.zh: 我們需要調整設計，以符合國外的安全標準。

general.en: She decided to stay and adjust her spending.
general.zh: 她決定留下來，調整自己的開銷。

qa.en: The hole position is off; we need to adjust the die.
qa.zh: 孔位偏移，需要調整模具。

qa.en: The belt is too loose; please adjust it.
qa.zh: 皮帶太鬆，請調整。

words.definition: 對某事物產生作用或改變

general.en: Her choices today will affect her tomorrow.
general.zh: 她今天的選擇將會影響她的明天。

general.en: Cars in Vietnam constantly honk their horns, and the noise affects my sleep.
general.zh: 越南的車經常按喇叭，噪音影響我的睡眠。

general.en: Nomophobia affects teenagers and adults alike.
general.zh: 無手機恐懼症同樣影響青少年和成人。

general.en: No decision is made in a vacuum; every choice affects someone else.
general.zh: 沒有任何決定是在真空中做出的，每個選擇都會影響到別人。

general.en: The typhoon affected the factory plan.
general.zh: 颱風影響了工廠的計畫。

general.en: Every day, Mia thinks about her future. She knows that her choices today will affect her tomorrow.
general.zh: 每一天，Mia 都會思考她的未來。她知道她今天的選擇將會影響她的明天。

qa.en: The line is stopped and the affected units are on hold. I will start the containment check right away.
qa.zh: 線停了，受影響的產品扣住了，我馬上開始圍堵檢查。

qa.en: The affected lots have been identified and placed on hold.
qa.zh: 有問題的批次已經查出來、先扣住了。

qa.en: This issue may affect the shipment schedule, so I am raising it now.
qa.zh: 這個問題可能影響出貨，所以我現在就先提出來。

qa.en: Contain first: sort all in-process and in-stock handrail tubes and check for internal rust. Mark and segregate any affected lots.
qa.zh: 先圍堵：在製品跟庫存的扶手管全部翻出來，看裡面有沒有鏽。有問題的批次標起來隔開。

qa.en: Any change to a specification requires an engineering change notice and, where it affects form, fit, or function, your written approval before implementation.
qa.zh: 規格要改要先發 ECN；如果影響到形狀、配合或功能，要你們書面核准才能實施。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

words.definition: not too expensive, so that ordinary people can pay for it.

general.en: Your employer covers about sixty percent, so your own part stays affordable.
general.zh: 你的雇主大約負擔六成，所以你自己要付的部分是負擔得起的。

general.en: Most medical costs, especially for serious illnesses or surgeries, are covered by government insurance, so healthcare is relatively affordable.
general.zh: 對於重大疾病或手術，大部分醫療費用由保險支付，因此醫療費用相對便宜。

words.definition: to plan or hope to achieve something.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: I aim to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience and contribute to global projects.
general.zh: 我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗、並為全球專案做出貢獻的公司。

general.en: My aim is to improve my English speaking this year.
general.zh: 我的目標是今年提升我的英語口說能力。

general.en: She finally achieved her aim after months of practice.
general.zh: 經過幾個月的練習，她終於達成了目標。

general.en: My aim is to improve my English speaking skills so I can communicate better with customers.
general.zh: 我的目標是增進我的英文口說技巧，這樣我才能更好地與客戶溝通。

general.en: In the near future, I aim to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience and contribute to global projects.
general.zh: 短期內，我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗、並為全球專案做出貢獻的公司。

words.definition: the service desk where passengers check in, drop off luggage, or get help with flights
words.lesson: 20260708 A Flight Problem 航班旅遊閱讀

general.en: I went to the airline counter and asked about a refund.
general.zh: 我去航空公司櫃檯詢問退款。

general.en: I went to the airline counter and asked about a refund. The staff explained that I could apply for a refund through the airline's online platform.
general.zh: 我去航空公司櫃檯詢問退款。工作人員解釋說我可以透過航空公司的線上平台申請退款。

words.definition: A long narrow space you walk through between rows of shelves or seats.

general.en: Here you are. I'd like an aisle seat if that's possible.
general.zh: 在這裡。如果可以的話，我想要靠走道座位。

general.en: Let me check. Yes, I can give you an aisle seat near the front. Are you checking any luggage today?
general.zh: 我查一下。可以，我可以給您前面一點的靠走道座位。今天有要託運行李嗎？

general.en: No problem. I always seem to pick the busiest aisle.
general.zh: 沒事。我好像總是選到最擠的走道。

general.en: The middle seat is between the window and the aisle.
general.zh: 中間座位在靠窗和走道之間。

general.en: The cereal is in aisle five.
general.zh: 麥片在第五走道。

general.en: I prefer an aisle seat.
general.zh: 我偏好靠走道的座位。

words.definition: A seat next to the aisle on a plane.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Here you are. I'd like an aisle seat if that's possible.
general.zh: 在這裡。如果可以的話，我想要靠走道座位。

general.en: Let me check. Yes, I can give you an aisle seat near the front. Are you checking any luggage today?
general.zh: 我查一下。可以，我可以給您前面一點的靠走道座位。今天有要託運行李嗎？

general.en: I prefer an aisle seat.
general.zh: 我偏好靠走道的座位。

words.definition: 發出聲響以提醒或警示的裝置

general.en: Amy was frying the chicken when the smoke alarm went off.
general.zh: 警報器響起的時候，Amy正在炸雞。

general.en: It was! The smoke alarm was going off, and my dog was barking at the same time.
general.zh: 真的！煙霧警報器一直響，我的狗同時也在叫。

general.en: Now my body has got used to it. I even wake up before my alarm.
general.zh: 現在身體已經習慣了。我甚至會在鬧鐘響之前醒來。

general.en: The alarm clock went off this morning.
general.zh: 今天早上鬧鐘響了。

general.en: The smoke alarm suddenly went off.
general.zh: 煙霧警報器突然響了。

general.en: Lily offered to help, so the two of them worked together in the kitchen. Amy was frying the chicken when the smoke alarm suddenly went off, and both women laughed loudly. The chicken was a little more burnt than usual, but nobody minded.
general.zh: Lily主動說要幫忙，於是兩人一起在廚房裡忙。Amy正在炸雞的時候，煙霧警報器突然響了，兩個人都笑得很大聲。雞肉比平常燒焦了一點，但沒有人介意。

qa.en: All the parts are still in spec. Why are you raising an alarm?
qa.zh: 所有零件都還在規格內，你在緊張什麼？

qa.en: Nice. Any alarms overnight?
qa.zh: 不錯。昨晚有跳警報嗎？

words.definition: A collection of songs on a CD or online.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: He plays the piano, he sings, and he even recorded a blues album.
general.zh: 他會彈鋼琴、會唱歌，甚至還錄過一張藍調專輯。

general.en: An album? Really? A grumpy doctor who makes records.
general.zh: 專輯？真的假的？一個脾氣很差的醫生還出唱片。

general.en: The band is recording a music album.
general.zh: 樂團正在錄製一張音樂專輯。

general.en: Like Dr. House, Laurie is also a talented musician and is passionate about the blues. He recently went to New Orleans to record an album in which he plays 15 of his favorite songs. But of course, he doesn't think that people will like it.
general.zh: 和豪斯醫生一樣，羅利也是位才華洋溢的音樂家，並且熱愛藍調。他最近去了紐奧良錄製一張專輯，收錄了他最喜愛的 15 首歌。但他當然還是覺得大家不會喜歡。

words.definition: a situation in which people or groups agree with or support each other.

general.en: I communicate regularly with clients to ensure alignment.
general.zh: 我也會定期與客戶溝通，以確保雙方的需求與方向保持一致。

general.en: Implement effective solutions to ensure alignment with our clients' requirements.
general.zh: 落實有效的解決方案，以確保與客戶需求保持一致。

qa.en: We will run a PDCA cycle on the treadmill belt alignment problem this week.
qa.zh: 本週我們會針對跑帶偏移問題跑一輪 PDCA 循環。

qa.en: We measure them on the CMM using the datum scheme defined on the drawing. The CMM program is fixed, so every part is measured with the same alignment and the same probe path.
qa.zh: 我們用三次元，照圖面定的基準量。程式是固定的，每件都用同樣的基準對齊、同樣的探測路徑。

words.definition: A thin metal sheet used to wrap food.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: I wrapped the sweet potato in aluminum foil and roasted it.
general.zh: 我用鋁箔紙把地瓜包起來然後烤。

general.en: The flight attendants wrap the food in aluminum foil to keep it warm.
general.zh: 空服員用鋁箔紙包住食物來保溫。

general.en: The flight attendants wrap the food in aluminum foil.
general.zh: 空服員用鋁箔紙包住食物。

general.en: They keep the food in aluminum foil to keep it hot.
general.zh: 他們用鋁箔紙包食物來保熱。

general.en: I wrapped the food in aluminum foil.
general.zh: 我用鋁箔紙把食物包起來。

qa.en: Before we trust the new thickness gauge, please run a measurement system analysis.
qa.zh: 在信任這台新膜厚計之前，請先做量測系統分析。

qa.en: Measurement system analysis is repeated whenever the gauge, the fixture, or the operator group changes.
qa.zh: 量具、治具或量的人換了，GR&R 就重做。

qa.en: A structured risk analysis that lists potential failure modes, their effects and causes, and scores them to set priorities.
qa.zh: 把可能出的失效、影響跟原因一條條列出來，打分數排優先順序的風險分析。

qa.en: The root cause was confirmed by 5-Why analysis, and the corrective action has been horizontally deployed to all products using the same fixture.
qa.zh: 根因用 5 Why 確認過，對策已經水平展開到所有用同一個治具的產品。

qa.en: The root cause analysis in D4 stops at the operator level. Please continue the why-why analysis to the process level and resubmit by Friday.
qa.zh: D4 的根因分析停在人的層級。請把 why-why 往下做到製程層級，週五前重交。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

words.definition: people in your family who lived a long time ago

general.en: During Tomb Sweeping Day, families visit the graves of their ancestors.
general.zh: 在清明節期間，家人們前往祭掃祖先的墳墓。

general.en: We burn paper money as offerings for our ancestors.
general.zh: 我們燒紙錢作為給祖先的祭品。

general.en: Families burn paper money for their ancestors.
general.zh: 家人為祖先燒紙錢。

general.en: Every year in early April, people in Taiwan celebrate Sweeping Tombs Day, also known as Qingming Festival. It is a special time when families remember their ancestors.
general.zh: 每年四月初，台灣人會慶祝掃墓節，也就是為人熟知的清明節。這是一個家人們緬懷祖先的特殊時刻。

general.en: After cleaning the tombs, families may sit together, eat the food, and talk about their ancestors. It is not only a time to feel sad, but also a time to remember happy memories.
general.zh: 打掃完墳墓後，家人們可能會坐在一起，吃著食物，並談論他們的祖先。這不僅僅是一個感到悲傷的時刻，也是一個回憶快樂記憶的時刻。

words.definition: a large formal dinner that a company holds once a year for its staff

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。

general.en: Emma, are you coming to the annual banquet on Friday night?
general.zh: Emma，你星期五晚上會來尾牙嗎？

general.en: The annual banquet is the highlight of the year for many employees.
general.zh: 對許多員工來說，年終大會是這一年的重頭戲。（Our company holds an annual banquet every year. 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。）

general.en: The annual banquet is usually held at the end of the year.
general.zh: 年終宴會通常在年底舉辦。

general.en: Among the most anticipated of these is the annual banquet, often referred to as the year-end party or company party.
general.zh: 在這些活動之中，最受期待的之一就是年度宴會，也常被稱為年終派對或公司聚會。

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year. The atmosphere is lively and festive. The boss gives a speech, and we all make a toast together. The lucky draw is the most exciting part, and everyone has a great time.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。氣氛非常熱鬧且充滿節慶感。老闆會上台致詞，然後我們大家一起敬酒。抽獎是最令人興奮的部分，每個人都玩得很開心。

words.definition: a worried, nervous feeling.

general.en: People experience feelings of anxiety when separated from their phones.
general.zh: 當人們與手機分開時，會經歷焦慮的感受。

general.en: Does phone separation anxiety really exist?
general.zh: 手機分離焦慮真的存在嗎？

general.en: Reading a book is a good way to relieve anxiety.
general.zh: 看書是緩解焦慮的好方法。

words.definition: worried and nervous.

general.en: When I lost my phone, I felt anxious.
general.zh: 當我丟失手機時，我感到焦慮。

words.definition: to say that you are sorry for something you have done wrong

general.en: The farmer apologized and thanked the Wise Woman for her advice.
general.zh: 農夫道歉，並感謝智者的建議。

general.en: The farmer apologized and said he was sorry for his behavior.
general.zh: 農夫道歉，說他對自己的行為感到抱歉。

general.en: Please apologize to your colleague if you made a mistake.
general.zh: 如果你犯了錯，請向你的同事道歉。

general.en: He apologized for being late to the meeting.
general.zh: 他為開會遲到道歉。

general.en: The hotel gave us a breakfast voucher to apologize for the noise.
general.zh: 飯店給了我們一張早餐券，為噪音致歉。

general.en: We apologize publicly, and we do it today. No excuses, no legal language.
general.zh: 我們公開道歉，而且今天就要做。不要找藉口，也不要用法律用語。

qa.en: Thank you for the photos and the affected serial numbers. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.
qa.zh: 謝謝您提供照片跟受影響的序號，造成困擾我們很抱歉。

qa.en: What is the appearance standard after sandblasting?
qa.zh: 噴砂後的外觀標準是什麼？

words.definition: 對食物的渴望感

general.en: I lose my appetite when the weather is too hot.
general.zh: 天氣太熱的時候我會失去食慾。

general.en: The mouth-watering smell gave me a big appetite.
general.zh: 那令人垂涎的香味讓我胃口大開。

general.en: She had no appetite because she was worried about the exam.
general.zh: 因為擔心考試，她一點食慾都沒有。

general.en: The slimming injection works because it causes you to lose your appetite.
general.zh: 減肥針有效是因為它會讓你食慾不振。

general.en: Working late always makes me lose my appetite.
general.zh: 加班總讓我失去胃口。

general.en: I lose my appetite in very hot weather.
general.zh: 天氣非常熱時我會失去食慾。

qa.en: The AQL levels are agreed with the customer and documented in the inspection standard; any change requires customer approval.
qa.zh: AQL 是跟客戶談好、寫進檢驗標準的，要改要客戶點頭。

qa.en: What will you submit for our sample approval?
qa.zh: 樣品承認你們會提交什麼？

qa.en: We will send samples and the reports for your approval.
qa.zh: 我們會送樣品和報告給您承認。

qa.en: Any change requires our written approval before implementation.
qa.zh: 任何變更都要先拿到我們的書面同意才能改。

qa.en: Mass production will not start until we receive your written approval of the submission; any subsequent change requires a new submission.
qa.zh: 你們書面承認之前不會開量產；之後有任何變更都要重新送。

qa.en: Any change to a specification requires an engineering change notice and, where it affects form, fit, or function, your written approval before implementation.
qa.zh: 規格要改要先發 ECN；如果影響到形狀、配合或功能，要你們書面核准才能實施。

words.definition: To agree with or accept something.

general.en: Some employees didn't approve of the manager's decision.
general.zh: 一些員工不認可經理的決定。

general.en: Grace, good news. The city office approved our funding. The community reading program runs for a whole year.
general.zh: Grace，好消息。市政府核准我們的補助了。社區閱讀計畫可以辦整整一年。

general.en: They didn't approve of the decision at first.
general.zh: 他們一開始不認可這個決定。

qa.en: Mass production is released only after the first article inspection is approved.
qa.zh: 首件過了才放量產。

qa.en: The lot stays on hold until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 品保簽首件之前，這批繼續扣著。

qa.en: The package of evidence submitted to the customer to prove the process can consistently make parts to specification before mass production is approved.
qa.zh: 量產核准前交給客戶的一整包資料，證明製程能穩定做出合規格的東西。

qa.en: Action: ask that the carry-over be approved with a condition — either a design change or a specific validation test for that failure mode.
qa.zh: 行動：要求沿用改成「有條件核准」——要嘛改設計，要嘛針對這個故障模式安排專門的驗證。

qa.en: Samples prove these pieces are good. PPAP proves your process can keep making good pieces at production rate — that is what we are approving.
qa.zh: 樣品只證明「這幾件」是好的；PPAP 是證明你的製程用量產速度也能一直做出好件。我們承認的是後面這個。

qa.en: We perform first article inspection whenever there is a new setup, a mold change, or a design change. Mass production is not released until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 只要重新設定、換模或設計變更，就做首件。品保沒簽首件，不放量產。

words.definition: Close to a number but not exact; about.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: We have approximately 300 employees at our factory in Vietnam.
general.zh: 我們在越南的工廠大約有300名員工。

general.en: It will take approximately three and a half hours. We expect some turbulence during the first hour, but it shouldn't be serious.
general.zh: 大約需要三個半小時。我們預期第一個小時會有一些亂流，但應該不嚴重。

general.en: We have approximately 300 employees at our factory in Vietnam, and the number is still increasing.
general.zh: 我們在越南的工廠大約有 300 名員工，而且人數還在增加。（清楚說明目前規模，並帶出「有機成長」的趨勢。）

general.en: We currently have approximately 300 employees at our factory in Vietnam, and we are still hiring.
general.zh: 我們目前在越南的工廠大約有 300 名員工，而且還在招募人員。（increasing 偏「成長趨勢」，hiring 偏「積極招募」，依你想傳達的訊息選用。）

general.en: It will take approximately three hours.
general.zh: 這大約需要三個小時。

general.en: We have approximately 300 employees.
general.zh: 我們大約有 300 名員工。

qa.en: Risk: 'typically', 'around' and 'approximately' in a supplier email are not evidence — they are the supplier's opinion.
qa.zh: 風險：供應商 email 裡的「通常」「大概」「大約」不是證據，那只是供應商的看法。

words.definition: The worst average defect level that is still treated as an acceptable process average.
To plan or organize something so it can happen.

general.en: I asked the landlord several times to arrange repairs.
general.zh: 我請房東安排維修好幾次了。

general.en: No, I'll arrange one. As the landlord, I'm responsible for repairs like this.
general.zh: 不用，我會安排。身為房東，這類維修是我的責任。

general.en: I'll arrange for him to come at nine tomorrow morning. Will you be home?
general.zh: 我會安排他明天早上九點過來。你會在家嗎？

general.en: I will arrange a meeting with the manager tomorrow.
general.zh: 我明天會安排和經理開會。

general.en: The teacher will arrange a field trip next week.
general.zh: 老師下週將安排一場實地考察。

general.en: They arranged to meet at 8 o'clock.
general.zh: 4. A: Let's meet at 8 o'clock. B: OK, fine.／他們約好八點見面。

qa.en: Could you please either confirm the scope entry covering this method, or arrange the test at a laboratory whose scope covers it?
qa.zh: 可以請你們確認認證範圍裡涵蓋這個方法的那一條，或是改到認證範圍有這個方法的實驗室重測嗎？

qa.en: The die is worn, so please arrange maintenance.
qa.zh: 模具磨耗了，請安排保養。

words.definition: the act or time of reaching a destination
words.lesson: 20260708 A Flight Problem 航班旅遊閱讀

general.en: The arrival of the flight was delayed by an hour.
general.zh: 班機的抵達時間延誤了一小時。

general.en: The departure and arrival times matched my travel schedule.
general.zh: when a flight leaves（航班起飛的時間）。Depart = verb（動詞）；Departure = noun（名詞）。

general.en: Before buying the ticket, I checked the flight timetable carefully to make sure the departure and arrival times matched my travel schedule.
general.zh: 在買票之前，我仔細查看了航班時刻表，以確保起飛和抵達的時間符合我的旅行行程。

general.en: The arrival time matched my schedule.
general.zh: when a flight reaches a place（航班抵達的時間）

general.en: Definitely. A delay is rarely a real crisis unless you treat it as one. What matters is protecting your sleep and your focus, not the exact arrival time.
general.zh: 當然有。延誤很少真的是危機，除非你把它當成危機看待。重要的是保護你的睡眠和專注力，而不是精確的抵達時間。

general.en: By seven o'clock, all six guests were sitting around the table. The food was simpler than Amy planned, but the evening was much more fun because of Lily's early arrival. Amy decided that a little chaos always makes a party better.
general.zh: 到了七點，六位客人都圍坐在餐桌旁。菜色比Amy原本計劃的簡單一些，但因為Lily提早到，整個晚上反而更有趣。Amy覺得，一點小混亂總是能讓派對更好玩。

words.definition: to reach a destination
words.lesson: 20260708 A Flight Problem 航班旅遊閱讀

general.en: We will arrive in Paris tomorrow morning.
general.zh: 我們明天早上會抵達巴黎。

general.en: People are buying food and water before the hurricane arrives.
general.zh: 在颶風來臨之前，人們正在購買食物和飲用水。

general.en: I arrived at eight forty. My meeting started at eight thirty, so I was ten minutes late. Next Monday I will take an earlier bus.
general.zh: 我八點四十到。我的會議八點半開始，所以我遲到了十分鐘。下週一我會搭早一點的公車。

general.en: Daniel had an important meeting in Taichung, so he booked a ticket for the 7:40 train. He usually arrives early, but that morning everything went wrong.
general.zh: Daniel 在台中有一場重要的會議，所以他訂了 7 點 40 分的火車票。他平常都會提早到，但那天早上一切都出錯了。

general.en: I arrived at eight forty.
general.zh: 我八點四十分到。

general.en: At six thirty, while she was chopping vegetables for the salad, the doorbell rang. Her friend Lily arrived thirty minutes early because she got the time wrong. Amy quickly wiped her hands and opened the door.
general.zh: 六點半，她正在切沙拉用的蔬菜時，門鈴響了。她的朋友Lily提早了三十分鐘到，因為她記錯了時間。Amy趕緊擦乾手，去開門。

qa.en: Design verification was run on the machined samples and passed. The die-cast parts arrived later and went straight into the reliability build, because "the drawing is the same."
qa.zh: DV 用 CNC 樣品做，全部過。壓鑄件比較晚到，因為「圖面一樣」，就直接裝上可靠度測試機。

words.definition: in a state of sleep

general.en: I tossed and turned all night and still didn't fall asleep.
general.zh: 我整晚翻來覆去還是睡不著。

general.en: They didn’t know I was listening to them. I pretended to be asleep.
general.zh: 7. (be) 他們不知道我在聽，我假裝睡著了。

general.en: She was fast asleep when I got home.
general.zh: 我到家時她正熟睡著。

general.en: A medical condition characterized by the inability to fall or stay asleep. This is more severe than simply having a restless night.
general.zh: 失眠，是一種無法入睡或無法維持睡眠的醫學狀況，比單純睡得不安穩來得嚴重。

general.en: She fell asleep while reading.
general.zh: 她看書時睡著了。

general.en: She was fast asleep / sound asleep.

words.definition: a common medicine for pain and fever.

general.en: Mom gives me an aspirin every four hours.
general.zh: 媽媽每四小時給我一顆阿斯匹靈。

words.definition: to bring people or things together in one place

general.en: Rescue workers assembled outside the collapsed building.
general.zh: 救援人員在倒塌的建築物外集合。

general.en: The animals assembled all over the house, gathering in groups.
general.zh: To put together or gather in groups.（零件組裝或人員聚集）

general.en: We need to assemble the furniture before moving into the house.
general.zh: 在搬進房子之前，我們需要組裝家具。（before 是介係詞，後接動名詞 moving。）

general.en: We need to assemble the furniture before using it.
general.zh: 我們需要先組裝這些家具才能使用。

qa.en: Don't judge from the report only — go to the gemba and watch the assembly.
qa.zh: 不要只看報告判斷，到現場實際看組裝過程。

qa.en: The first pass yield of the treadmill assembly line dropped from 96 % to 88 % last week.
qa.zh: 上週跑步機組裝線的一次通過率從 96% 掉到 88%。

qa.en: The crank assembly is a carry-over design from the previous model.
qa.zh: 曲柄組是沿用上一代機種的設計。

qa.en: One point on the crank assembly before we close this item.
qa.zh: 曲柄組這一項結案前，我有一點要提。

qa.en: Risk: internal rust may not be visible after assembly, but it weakens the tube wall over time and can cause rust stains to bleed through the outer coating after the product reaches the customer.
qa.zh: 風險：組裝完看不到裡面的鏽，但時間久了管壁會變薄，鏽漬還可能從烤漆面滲出來，到客戶那邊才出事。

qa.en: The crank assembly is a carry-over, but the previous model recorded eleven field complaints for creaking under load. Carrying the design over carries that failure mode with it.
qa.zh: 曲柄組是沿用件，但上一代有十一件在受力時產生異音的客訴。沿用設計，等於把這個故障模式也一起沿用。

qa.en: Budget for the standard itself and for the gap assessment in this year's plan, not next year's.
qa.zh: 買標準和做差距評估的錢，編在今年的計畫裡，不要拖到明年。

qa.en: Plan a gap assessment for the weeks after publication, once the final text is available.
qa.zh: 發布後幾週、拿到正式條文時，安排做差距評估。

qa.en: Check whether cybersecurity and software are covered in your existing risk assessment — under the Directive they usually were not.
qa.zh: 看一下現在的風險評估有沒有涵蓋資安和軟體 —— 舊指令下通常都沒有。

qa.en: We analyse complaint and incident data by model and failure mode on a monthly basis. Once a defined threshold is reached, the case is escalated to our quality manager for a reportability assessment.
qa.zh: 我們每個月照機種和故障模式分析客訴和事故資料。一到我們訂的門檻，案子就升級給品保經理，評估要不要通報。

qa.en: We are conducting a gap assessment to identify areas that may require updates before the transition, and we have already contacted our certification body about the transition schedule.
qa.zh: 我們正在做差距評估，找出轉版前要更新的地方，轉版時程也已經去問驗證機構了。

qa.en: We will send you the case summary and our assessment by the end of this week.

words.definition: at the latest possible time.
words.lesson: 20250807 現在進行式與過去進行式

general.en: Don't skip your class at the last minute.
general.zh: 不要在最後一刻翹課。

general.en: It's ridiculous to change the specifications at the last minute.
general.zh: 在最後一刻才改規格實在很荒謬。

general.en: We finished the project at the last minute.
general.zh: 我們在最後一刻才完成專案。

words.definition: The mood or feeling of a place.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: The decorations give the hall a very festive atmosphere.
general.zh: 這些裝飾讓大廳充滿了節慶的氣氛。

general.en: Music helps create a good atmosphere.
general.zh: 音樂有助於營造好氣氛。

general.en: The atmosphere is lively and festive.
general.zh: 氣氛熱鬧又有節慶感。

general.en: I like the atmosphere here.
general.zh: 我喜歡這裡的氣氛。

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year. The atmosphere is lively and festive. The boss gives a speech, and we all make a toast together. The lucky draw is the most exciting part, and everyone has a great time.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。氣氛非常熱鬧且充滿節慶感。老闆會上台致詞，然後我們大家一起敬酒。抽獎是最令人興奮的部分，每個人都玩得很開心。

words.definition: to go to an event or a class.

general.en: Tom gave me the opportunity to attend this party tonight.
general.zh: Tom 給了我機會參加今晚的派對。

general.en: Anita has become more confident after attending the conversation classes.
general.zh: Anita 上完會話課後變得更有自信了。

general.en: Their schedules clash, so they cannot attend the same classes.
general.zh: 他們的時間表衝突，所以無法參加同一門課。（指時間強碰）

general.en: She plans to attend the English workshop tomorrow.
general.zh: 參加一場有特定時間長度的活動／課程（workshop），要用 attend。

general.en: I attend a company party every January.
general.zh: 我每年一月都會參加公司派對。

general.en: I attended a meeting yesterday.
general.zh: 我昨天出席了一場會議。（❌ I joined the meeting. 應為 attended）

words.definition: The way a person thinks or feels about something, shown in their behavior.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: He has a positive attitude towards life.
general.zh: 他對生活抱持積極的態度。

general.en: Emma remained an optimist and believed every challenge was an opportunity to grow. Her positive attitude and smart decisions helped her become a successful leader.
general.zh: Emma 保持樂觀，相信每個挑戰都是成長的機會。她的正面態度和聰明的決定幫助她成為一位成功的領導者。

general.en: Emma remained an optimist, viewing every challenge as an opportunity for growth. Her positive attitude and smart decision-making were the cornerstones that helped her become a successful leader.
general.zh: Emma 始終保持樂觀，把每個挑戰都視為成長的機會。她正面的態度與聰明的決策，正是幫助她成為一位成功領導者的基石。

words.definition: A place that people like to visit because it is interesting or enjoyable.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: This is a famous tourist attraction.
general.zh: 這是一個著名的觀光景點。

general.en: The attraction of a cheap policy is obvious: a lower monthly payment. What most buyers never examine is the list of exclusions printed on the final pages, and it is there that the true price is hidden.
general.zh: 便宜保單的吸引力很明顯：月付金額較低。但大多數購買者從不細看的，是印在最後幾頁的除外條款清單，而真正的代價就藏在那裡。

words.definition: A group of people who watch or listen to a show or speech.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Standing in front of an audience of forty adults isn't the same as teaching eight children.
general.zh: 站在四十位大人面前，跟教八個小孩完全不是同一回事。

general.en: Good call. A short talk to a friendly audience. Nothing to be nervous about.
general.zh: 好主意。對著友善的聽眾講一小段。沒什麼好緊張的。

general.en: The audience clapped loudly.
general.zh: 觀眾大聲鼓掌。

qa.en: The customer will run a quality audit on our exercise bike line next month.
qa.zh: 客戶下個月會來稽核我們的飛輪車生產線。

qa.en: Is your quality system certified, and when was your last audit?
qa.zh: 你們的品質系統有認證嗎？最近一次稽核是什麼時候？

qa.en: Our quality management system is certified to ISO 9001 and subject to annual surveillance audits.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 有 ISO 9001 認證，每年都有追查稽核。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: Yes. We are ISO 9001 certified. Our last surveillance audit was in March this year with no major findings, and our internal audit is conducted twice a year.
qa.zh: 有，我們有 ISO 9001。最近一次追查稽核是今年三月，沒有重大缺失；內稽一年做兩次。

qa.en: Torque wrenches on the line are calibrated daily with a torque tester. QA re-checks critical fasteners with a marked-line audit — the mark must not move under the specified check torque.
qa.zh: 線上的扭力扳手每天用扭力計校。關鍵螺栓品保用劃線複檢：用規定的複檢扭力去帶，線不能動。

qa.en: Two standards are moving at the same time. If you supply any automotive-adjacent customer, or if your customer's group uses IATF as its internal benchmark, you will be asked about both transitions in the same audit conversation.
qa.zh: 兩個標準同時在動。只要你有做汽車相關的客戶，或客戶集團內部拿 IATF 當標竿，稽核時就會在同一段對話裡被同時問這兩個轉版。

general.en: What is the baggage allowance for this domestic flight?
general.zh: 這班國內航班的行李限額是多少？

general.en: Is it possible to check in more than 7 kg of baggage?
general.zh: 我可以托運超過7公斤的行李嗎？

general.en: What is the maximum baggage weight I can check in?
general.zh: 我最多可以托運多少公斤的行李？

general.en: If your bag is too heavy, you may pay excess baggage fees.
general.zh: 如果行李太重，你可能要付超重行李費。

general.en: The carry-on baggage weight limit is 7 kg on budget airlines.
general.zh: 廉價航空的隨身行李重量限制是7公斤。

general.en: Domestic flights often have stricter baggage limits.
general.zh: 國內航班的行李限制通常比較嚴格。

words.definition: The amount of luggage you can bring without paying extra.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: What is the baggage allowance for this domestic flight?
general.zh: 這班國內航班的行李限額是多少？

general.en: Excuse me, what is the baggage allowance for this domestic flight?
general.zh: 不好意思，這班國內航班的行李限額是多少？

general.en: The baggage allowance is only 7 kg.
general.zh: 行李限額只有 7 公斤。

qa.en: The baking temperature is 180 degrees for 20 minutes.
qa.zh: 烘烤溫度 180 度、時間 20 分鐘。

words.definition: 建築物地面以下的樓層空間

general.en: A strange sound from the basement scared me.
general.zh: 來自地下室的奇怪聲音嚇到了我。

general.en: The basement was flooded after the storm.
general.zh: 暴風雨後地下室被淹了。

general.en: The basement is always a damp room.
general.zh: 地下室總是個潮濕的房間。

words.definition: to have the duty to do something.

general.en: Teachers are responsible for learners' improvement.
general.zh: 教師負責學生的進步。

words.definition: the things that you own or are carrying with you.

general.en: Please make sure you have all your personal belongings before leaving the train.
general.zh: 下車前請確認你帶齊所有隨身物品。

general.en: Please be careful not to leave any belongings in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 請小心不要把任何隨身物品留在頭頂行李櫃裡。

general.en: Please check your belongings before leaving.
general.zh: 離開前請檢查你的隨身物品。

general.en: Make sure you don't leave your belongings in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 請務必確認你沒有把隨身物品留在行李櫃中。

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請繫好安全帶。

general.en: Yes, please, and fasten your seat belt. We'll be taking off in about ten minutes.
general.zh: 是的，麻煩您，並且繫好安全帶。我們大約十分鐘後起飛。

general.en: Certainly. I'll bring one once the seat belt sign is off.
general.zh: 沒問題。安全帶指示燈熄滅後我就拿一條給您。

general.en: Try to stay relaxed and keep your seat belt fastened. Many passengers find that listening to music or watching a movie helps.
general.zh: 試著保持放鬆並繫好安全帶。很多乘客發現聽音樂或看電影會有幫助。

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt.
general.zh: 請繫好安全帶。（t 不發音）

qa.en: We will run a PDCA cycle on the treadmill belt alignment problem this week.
qa.zh: 本週我們會針對跑帶偏移問題跑一輪 PDCA 循環。

qa.en: SPC data shows the running belt width is drifting toward the upper limit.
qa.zh: 統計製程管制的數據顯示跑帶寬度正往上限偏移。

qa.en: The running belt must meet the quality requirement of 100,000 cycles without cracking.
qa.zh: 跑帶必須符合十萬次循環不裂的品質要求。

qa.en: Final inspection checks noise and belt speed. There is no torque check on the motor mount.
qa.zh: 最終檢驗查的是噪音跟跑帶速度，馬達座沒有扭力檢查。

qa.en: Check the HS codes of your rubber and belt components against the updated annex — scope is decided by code, not by product name.
qa.zh: 拿橡膠件和皮帶的 HS code 去對更新後的附件 —— 範圍是看 HS code，不是看品名。

qa.en: The detection score of 2 assumes a control that is not in the control plan. Final inspection covers noise and belt speed only, so detection should be re-scored and the action priority reassessed.
qa.zh: 偵測度給 2，是假設有一道管制，但管制計畫上根本沒有。最終檢驗只查噪音跟跑帶速度，所以偵測度要重評，行動優先度也要跟著重算。

qa.en: Check the belt tension with the belt tension gauge.
qa.zh: 用皮帶鬆緊度檢測卷檢查皮帶張力。

qa.en: Springback made the bending angle 2 degrees off.
qa.zh: 回彈造成折彎角度偏差 2 度。

words.definition: A helpful or good effect that something has.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Good habits have lasting benefits for your health.
general.zh: 良好的習慣對健康有長期的好處。

general.en: Regular exercise has lasting benefits for your body and mind.
general.zh: 定期運動對身心都有長期的好處。

general.en: Yoga brings many health benefits.
general.zh: 瑜珈帶來許多健康益處。

words.definition: a piece of paper showing how much you owe for food or a service, especially in British English.

general.en: Nearly half of her salary is already spent on rent and bills.
general.zh: 她薪水的將近一半已經花在房租和帳單上了。

general.en: Renters now calculate not only the rent but also utility bills.
general.zh: 租屋族現在不只算月租，還會算水電帳單。

general.en: He's passionate about music. He said acting paid the bills, but music kept him happy.
general.zh: 他對音樂充滿熱忱。他說演戲是為了生活，但音樂讓他保持快樂。

general.en: May I have the bill, please?
general.zh: 可以給我帳單嗎？（英式／通用說法）

general.en: Even with insurance, a simple hospital visit can cost hundreds of dollars. That is why many people in the USA worry about medical bills. Early treatment is important — but people sometimes wait because they are afraid of the cost.
general.zh: 即使有保險，一次簡單的就醫也可能花費數百美元。這就是為什麼許多美國人擔心醫療帳單。及早治療很重要——但有些人因為害怕費用而等待。

general.en: Anita looked at her budget carefully. Nearly half of her salary is already spent on rent and bills. She called several agents, but most rooms in the area are priced even higher than her current one.
general.zh: Anita仔細看了自己的預算。她薪水的將近一半已經花在房租和帳單上了。她打了幾間仲介，但這一帶大部分的房間定價還比她現在的更高。

qa.en: We have re-checked our bill of materials against the revised annex by HS code. We will continue to retain supplier origin records so that we can support your due-diligence requirements even where the regulation no longer requires them.
qa.zh: 我們已經用 HS code 把整份 BOM 對過修訂後的附件。就算法規不要求了，我們還是會繼續留供應商產地紀錄，配合你們的盡職調查。

words.definition: having a sharp, unpleasant taste like strong black coffee

general.en: I left the tea bag in too long, so the tea tasted bitter.
general.zh: 我把茶包留太久，所以茶喝起來很苦。

general.en: Many people don't like black coffee because it has a bitter taste.
general.zh: 很多人不喜歡黑咖啡，因為它有一股苦味。（尖銳刺鼻的味道，通常與咖啡、黑巧克力或某些綠色蔬菜有關。）

words.definition: the crime of threatening to tell secrets about someone unless they give you money
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and much more.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and more terrible things in the world.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: He was arrested for blackmail.
general.zh: 他因勒索而被逮捕。

words.definition: To say someone is responsible for something bad.

general.en: The manager wanted to blame the delivery company.
general.zh: 經理想要責怪物流公司。

general.en: The driver was blamed for the accident, but the road was icy.
general.zh: 司機被責怪造成事故，但路面其實結冰了。

general.en: Investigators blamed weak oversight of production.
general.zh: 調查人員歸咎於生產流程的監督不夠嚴謹。

general.en: Instead of blaming others, she decided to take action.
general.zh: 她沒有指責別人，而是決定採取行動。

general.en: So you'd blame greed instead?
general.zh: 所以你反而會怪貪婪囉？

qa.en: Before we blame the supplier — when Rev C was released, who informed them?
qa.zh: 怪供應商之前先問一下——C 版發行的時候，是誰通知他們的？

qa.en: Check whether the test setup itself is valid — load, frequency, fixture — before blaming the design.
qa.zh: 先確認測試條件本身沒問題——負載、頻率、治具——再來談設計。

words.definition: having very little flavour — mild food that is easy on the stomach

general.en: She planned to eat bland dishes before her health check.
general.zh: 她計劃在健康檢查前吃清淡的料理。

general.en: The doctor advised him to eat bland food while he was sick.
general.zh: 醫生建議他生病期間吃清淡的食物。

general.en: Hospital food is usually bland but easy to digest.
general.zh: 醫院的食物通常清淡，但容易消化。

general.en: The hospital food was so bland.
general.zh: 形容食物缺乏味道，通常被認為不好吃（Unappetizing）。

words.definition: A soft cover to keep you warm.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Got it. Could I have a blanket after takeoff? It's a bit cold in the cabin.
general.zh: 了解。起飛後可以給我一條毯子嗎？客艙裡有點冷。

general.en: Could I have a blanket, please?
general.zh: 可以給我一條毯子嗎？

words.definition: feeling full and uncomfortable, often after eating.

general.en: I feel bloated after eating greasy food.
general.zh: 吃了油膩的食物後我覺得脹氣。

general.en: My stomach feels bloated and uncomfortable.
general.zh: 我的胃覺得脹脹的很不舒服。

general.en: I often feel bloated after drinking milk.
general.zh: 我喝完牛奶後常常覺得脹氣。

general.en: I've been feeling bloated for three days.
general.zh: 我已經脹氣三天了。

general.en: I feel bloated after eating too much.
general.zh: 吃太多後我覺得脹氣。

general.en: The old tree was blown down by strong wind.
general.zh: 老樹被強風吹倒了。

general.en: The scooters are all blown over. / Don't worry, this problem will blow over soon.
general.zh: 機車全部被吹倒了。／別擔心，這個問題很快就會平息。

general.en: The storm will soon blow over and everything will be normal again.
general.zh: 暴風雨很快就會過去，一切將恢復正常。

general.en: The wind blew the papers away.
general.zh: 風把紙吹走了。

general.en: This problem will blow over soon.
general.zh: 這個問題很快就會平息。

general.en: She went for a run to blow off steam.
general.zh: 她去跑步紓解壓力。

words.definition: to carry something away by wind; (figurative) to impress greatly

general.en: The wind blew away my hat. / I was blown away by her performance.
general.zh: 風把我的帽子吹走了。／她的表演讓我大開眼界。

words.definition: to knock down a tall structure by the force of wind

general.en: The storm blew down the tree.
general.zh: 暴風雨把樹吹倒了。

words.definition: to do something to release tension or frustration; steam takes no article

general.en: She went for a run to blow off steam.
general.zh: 她去跑步紓解壓力。

words.definition: to knock something over by the force of wind, without carrying it away

general.en: The scooters are all blown over. / Don't worry, this problem will blow over soon.
general.zh: 機車全部被吹倒了。／別擔心，這個問題很快就會平息。

general.en: The storm will soon blow over and everything will be normal again.
general.zh: 暴風雨很快就會過去，一切將恢復正常。

general.en: Don't worry, this problem will blow over soon.
general.zh: 別擔心，這個問題很快就會平息。

general.en: The strong wind blew over the fence.
general.zh: 強風把圍籬吹倒了。

general.en: This problem will blow over soon.
general.zh: 這個問題很快就會平息。

general.en: When I boarded the plane, I put my carry-on bag in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 當我登機時，我把隨身行李放進頭頂置物櫃。

general.en: We walked through the jet bridge to board the plane.
general.zh: 我們走過空橋登上飛機。

general.en: We walked on the tarmac to board the plane.
general.zh: 我們走過停機坪登機。

general.en: We boarded the plane by stairs.
general.zh: 我們走樓梯登機。

general.en: The captain welcomed us on board.
general.zh: 機長歡迎我們登機。

general.en: Boarding will begin in ten minutes.
general.zh: 十分鐘後開始登機。

qa.en: The lot is segregated in the quarantine area, and the disposition will be decided by the material review board and documented.
qa.zh: 這批移到隔離區，怎麼處理由 MRB 決定，會留書面紀錄。

words.definition: Getting on a plane.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: The flight was cancelled before boarding.
general.zh: 那班飛機在登機前就被取消了。

general.en: Perfect, it's twenty-three kilos now. Here's your boarding pass. Your departure gate is C12, and boarding starts at ten forty.
general.zh: 很好，現在是二十三公斤。這是您的登機證。您的登機門是 C12，十點四十開始登機。

general.en: People are boarding up the windows before the typhoon arrives. — Good idea. The forecast says it could last for several days.
general.zh: 人們在颱風來臨前正在釘木板封窗戶。——好主意。預報說這可能會持續好幾天。

general.en: Boarding will begin in ten minutes.
general.zh: 十分鐘後開始登機。

general.en: Our flight is boarding at Gate B12.
general.zh: 我們的班機在B12登機門登機。

general.en: Show your boarding pass at the gate.
general.zh: 在登機門出示你的登機證。

words.definition: A card that lets you get on a plane.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Perfect, it's twenty-three kilos now. Here's your boarding pass. Your departure gate is C12, and boarding starts at ten forty.
general.zh: 很好，現在是二十三公斤。這是您的登機證。您的登機門是 C12，十點四十開始登機。

general.en: Show your boarding pass at the gate.
general.zh: 在登機門出示你的登機證。

words.definition: a person who drives a boat for passengers.
words.lesson: 20260728 越南寧平旅遊 Tam Coc Trip

general.en: The boat operator took me through several caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我穿過好幾個洞穴。

general.en: The boat operator took me through the caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我穿過那些洞穴。

general.en: The boat operator took us through the caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我們穿過洞穴。

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100 % inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺絲採抽樣檢驗，但跑步機馬達採全檢。

qa.en: Use the 5 Whys — the loose bolt is a symptom, not the root cause.
qa.zh: 用五問法追下去——螺絲鬆動只是症狀，不是根本原因。

qa.en: How do you control the tightening torque on safety-critical bolts?
qa.zh: 安全關鍵螺栓的鎖付扭力你們怎麼管控？

qa.en: We check the bolts with a torque wrench.
qa.zh: 我們用扭力扳手檢查螺栓。

qa.en: The torque wrench is set and calibrated daily, the operator marks each tightened bolt, and QA performs a torque audit on every unit for safety-critical joints. The result is recorded per serial number.
qa.zh: 扭力扳手每天設定跟校驗，作業員每鎖完一支螺栓就劃線，安全相關的鎖點品保一台一台驗扭力，結果照序號記。

words.definition: A close connection or feeling of friendship between people.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: Hot pot is a great way to strengthen family bonds.
general.zh: 火鍋是增進家庭感情的好方式。

general.en: We have a strong family bond.
general.zh: 我們有很深的家庭感情。

general.en: Traditional Taiwanese dishes, like ginger duck or hot pot, are a great way to bring family members together and strengthen family bonds.
general.zh: 像薑母鴨或火鍋這樣的台灣傳統料理，是讓家人聚在一起、增進家庭感情的好方式。

words.definition: to increase or improve something.

general.en: Plastic surgery can significantly boost a person's confidence.
general.zh: 整形手術可以顯著提升一個人的自信。

general.en: This vitamin can help boost your immune system.
general.zh: To lift or increase.（提升產量、噪音或免疫系統）

general.en: Having a one-on-one class every week really helps me boost my English skills.
general.zh: 每週上一對一的課程真的幫助我提升了英文能力。

general.en: The praise boosted my confidence.
general.zh: 這份讚美增強了我的自信。

general.en: First, plastic surgery can significantly boost a person's confidence. When people fix a feature that has always bothered them, they often feel much happier and more secure in themselves.
general.zh: 首先，整形手術可以顯著提升一個人的自信。當人們修復了長久以來困擾他們的特徵時，他們通常會感到更快樂，對自己更有安全感。

general.en: Boosting Morale and Motivation — A well-organized, generous party makes employees feel valued. This positive experience can boost morale and motivate staff for the year ahead.
general.zh: 提升士氣與動力——一場規劃完善、內容豐富的聚會，能讓員工感受到被重視。這樣的正向體驗可以提升士氣，並激勵員工迎接新的一年。

words.definition: -ed adjective: describes how a person feels when nothing interests them

general.en: The students were bored during the long speech.
general.zh: 學生們在這場漫長的演講中感到很無聊。

general.en: He felt bored during the lecture. / The lecture was boring.
general.zh: 他上課時覺得很無聊。／那堂課很無聊。

general.en: He felt bored during the lecture.
general.zh: 他上課時覺得很無聊。

words.translation: 令人無聊的（事物的特質）
words.definition: -ing adjective: describes what causes boredom

general.en: The movie was so boring that I fell asleep.
general.zh: 這部電影太無聊了，以至於我睡著了。

general.en: They looked boring, even though they offered variety.
general.zh: many different kinds（許多不同的種類）

general.en: He felt bored during the lecture. / The lecture was boring.
general.zh: 他上課時覺得很無聊。／那堂課很無聊。

general.en: The city was not boring but full of surprises.
general.zh: 這座城市不無聊，反而充滿驚喜。

general.en: The lecture was boring.
general.zh: 那堂課很無聊。

words.definition: to become wider or more general, or to make something do this.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: My short-term goal is to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience.
general.zh: 短期內，我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗的公司。

general.en: I aim to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience and contribute to global projects.
general.zh: 我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗、並為全球專案做出貢獻的公司。

general.en: I want to broaden my experience. Same job, bigger scale, and I think I can contribute a lot.
general.zh: 我想拓展我的經驗。一樣的工作，但規模更大，而且我認為我可以有很多貢獻。

general.en: In the near future, I aim to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience and contribute to global projects.
general.zh: 短期內，我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗、並為全球專案做出貢獻的公司。

words.definition: An airline with low prices and fewer services.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: The carry-on baggage weight limit is 7 kg on budget airlines.
general.zh: 廉價航空的隨身行李重量限制是7公斤。

general.en: Budget airlines have strict baggage limits.
general.zh: 廉價航空有嚴格的行李限制。

qa.en: We found a burr on the edge. What will you do with this lot?
qa.zh: 邊緣發現毛邊，這批你們要怎麼處理？

qa.en: How do you prevent burrs on the stamped parts?
qa.zh: 沖壓件毛邊你們怎麼防止？

qa.en: Die maintenance is scheduled by shot count, and burr height is checked at first article and at defined intervals during the run.
qa.zh: 模具保養照沖次排，毛邊高度首件要量，量產中也照規定間隔量。

qa.en: We found a burr on the edge of the bracket.
qa.zh: 我們發現支架邊緣有毛邊。

qa.en: We found a burr on the edge. What should we do with this lot?
qa.zh: 邊緣發現毛邊，這批該怎麼處理？

qa.en: The burr height must not exceed 0.1 mm.
qa.zh: 毛邊高度不可超過 0.1 mm。

qa.en: Die maintenance is scheduled by shot count, and burr height is checked at first article and at defined intervals during the run.
qa.zh: 模具保養照沖次排，毛邊高度首件要量，量產中也照規定間隔量。

qa.en: The burr height must not exceed 0.1 mm.
qa.zh: 毛邊高度不可超過 0.1 mm。

words.definition: to break open suddenly because of pressure.

general.en: The pipe burst due to high pressure, causing water damage.
general.zh: 水管因高壓而爆裂，造成水損。

general.en: A pipe under the sink burst on Tuesday night. Water went everywhere.
general.zh: 星期二晚上水槽下面的水管爆了。水噴得到處都是。

words.definition: A more expensive and comfortable class of travel on a plane, train, etc.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: I'd like a single business class ticket.
general.zh: 我想要一張單程商務艙機票。

general.en: If I have a thousand dollars, I would like to fly to Japan in business class.
general.zh: 如果我有一千美金，我想要搭商務艙去日本。

general.en: Sure. And if you'd like more space, business class is only fifteen euros more today.
general.zh: 沒問題。另外如果你想要寬敞一點，今天升等商務艙只要多十五歐元。

general.en: Fifteen? I'd be silly to say no. Business class, then.
general.zh: 十五？不加就太傻了。那就商務艙吧。

general.en: If I have a thousand dollars, I like fly to Japan in business class because I like lying down on fully flat seats.
general.zh: 文法不完整（like fly）。

general.en: If I have a thousand dollars, I would like to fly to Japan in business class because I like lying down on fully flat seats.
general.zh: 如果我有一千美元，我想搭商務艙飛日本，因為我喜歡躺在全平躺座椅上。

words.definition: Full of people moving about busily and noisily.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: At night, the market becomes bustling and lively.
general.zh: 夜晚時，市場變得繁忙且熱鬧。

general.en: What is your hometown like? — My hometown is lively and bustling. It is famous for its night market.
general.zh: 你的家鄉是什麼樣的地方？——我的家鄉熱鬧繁華，以夜市聞名。（⚠️ 必須直接用「形容詞」與「地方特徵」回答，絕對不可以用 "it is like…"！Bustling 指一個地方非常忙碌，充滿活動、人群與能量。）

general.en: At night, the market becomes bustling and lively. Though it can get crowded, many people still enjoy visiting because it makes them feel connected to their community.
general.zh: 夜晚時，市場變得繁忙且熱鬧。雖然可能會變得很擁擠，許多人仍然喜歡造訪，因為這讓他們感到與社區有所連結。

words.definition: The inside of a plane where passengers sit.

general.en: You can take a carry-on bag into the cabin.
general.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李進客艙。

general.en: Got it. Could I have a blanket after takeoff? It's a bit cold in the cabin.
general.zh: 了解。起飛後可以給我一條毯子嗎？客艙裡有點冷。

general.en: We need to ensure the testing equipment is calibrated properly.
general.zh: 我們必須確保測試設備有被妥善校準。（in the correct way）

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: Every gauge is calibrated. The label shows the next due date.
qa.zh: 每支量具都有校驗，標籤上有下次到期日。

qa.en: Measuring instruments are calibrated at defined intervals with results traceable to national standards.
qa.zh: 量測儀器照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: If an instrument is found out of tolerance at calibration, we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured with it since the previous calibration.
qa.zh: 如果校驗時發現儀器超差，上次校驗之後用它量過的產品，我們會全部回頭追。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

qa.en: Calibration intervals are defined by instrument type and usage frequency, and all results are traceable to national standards.
qa.zh: 校驗週期看儀器種類跟用多頻繁，結果都可追溯到國家標準。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: If an instrument is found out of tolerance at calibration, we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured with it since the previous calibration.
qa.zh: 如果校驗時發現儀器超差，上次校驗之後用它量過的產品，我們會全部回頭追。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

qa.en: Operators use go/no-go gauges and calipers on the line; QA uses micrometers and height gauges for the patrol check. Every tool is zeroed before use and included in the calibration system.
qa.zh: 作業員在線上用通止規跟卡尺；品保巡檢用分厘卡跟高度規。每支量具用之前先歸零，全部都在校驗系統裡。

qa.en: Yes. I will send the inspection report with the actual measured values for each characteristic, together with the lot number and the calibration status of the instruments used.
qa.zh: 可以。我會把檢驗報告寄過去，每個特性都有實測值，也會附批號跟用到的儀器校驗狀態。

qa.en: The auditor asked for the calibration certificates.
qa.zh: 稽核員要求提供校驗證書。

general.en: And the practical task? I saw a caliper and a test piece on the table.
general.zh: 那實作任務呢？我看到桌上有卡尺和一個測試件。

qa.en: Calipers, micrometers, height gauges, feeler gauges, and thread gauges used for routine in-process checks.
qa.zh: 卡尺、分厘卡、高度規、厚薄規、螺紋規這些，製程中例行檢查用的量具。

qa.en: We use a caliper to check this dimension.
qa.zh: 這個尺寸我們用卡尺量。

qa.en: We measure it with a caliper at three points and take the average.
qa.zh: 我們用卡尺量三點取平均。

qa.en: The GR&R for this caliper check came out at 27%, above the 10% acceptance limit. The measurement system needs improvement before we can trust the data.
qa.zh: 這項卡尺量測的 GR&R 是 27%，超過 10% 的允收上限。量測系統要先改善，數據才能信。

qa.en: Operators use go/no-go gauges and calipers on the line; QA uses micrometers and height gauges for the patrol check. Every tool is zeroed before use and included in the calibration system.
qa.zh: 作業員在線上用通止規跟卡尺；品保巡檢用分厘卡跟高度規。每支量具用之前先歸零，全部都在校驗系統裡。

qa.en: The operator performs a self-check every hour with a go/no-go gauge, and QA performs a patrol inspection every two hours with a caliper and a micrometer. Both results are recorded on the process control sheet.
qa.zh: 作業員每小時用通止規自檢，品保每兩小時用卡尺跟分厘卡巡檢。兩邊的結果都記在製程管制表上。

words.definition: to decide that something planned will not happen

general.en: The flights will be cancelled if the typhoon hits.
general.zh: 如果颱風登陸，班機將被取消。

general.en: I want to cancel my ticket and request a refund.
general.zh: 我想要取消我的票並要求退款。

general.en: Can I cancel this ticket and get my money back?
general.zh: 我可以取消這張票並把錢拿回來嗎？

general.en: I need to cancel my ticket. Is a refund possible?
general.zh: 我需要取消我的票，可以退款嗎？

general.en: The meeting may well be canceled if the boss is still sick.
general.zh: 如果老闆還在生病，會議很可能會取消。

general.en: There's a small cancellation fee, but only if you cancel less than one day before.
general.zh: 會有一筆小額的取消手續費，不過只有在出發前一天以內取消才要付。

words.definition: Money you must pay if you cancel a booking.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: There is a small cancellation fee.
general.zh: 有一筆小額的取消手續費。

qa.en: What is the process capability for this dimension?
qa.zh: 這個尺寸的製程能力是多少？

qa.en: The key characteristic is monitored by control chart and the process capability index is reviewed monthly.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用管制圖盯，Cpk 每個月檢討。

qa.en: A capability below the target triggers an improvement plan before the trend can produce out-of-specification product.
qa.zh: Cpk 低於目標就啟動改善計畫，趁還沒做出超規品之前先處理。

qa.en: Pull the historical capability data for the same feature on a similar part instead of arguing from memory.
qa.zh: 把類似零件同一個特徵的歷史能力資料調出來，不要憑印象吵。

qa.en: Our process capability for this feature is about ±0.15 mm.
qa.zh: 這個特徵我們的製程能力大約是 ±0.15 mm。

qa.en: The PPAP package is missing the material certifications and the capability study for the critical dimensions. Please complete and resubmit before the run-at-rate.
qa.zh: PPAP 資料少了材證跟關鍵尺寸的能力分析。請在 run-at-rate 前補齊重交。

qa.en: The capability study on the special characteristics is still missing.
qa.zh: 特殊特性的能力研究還缺著。

qa.en: This PPAP is not complete. Please send the control plan, the MSA and the capability study.
qa.zh: 這份 PPAP 資料不齊，請補管制計畫、MSA 跟能力研究。

qa.en: The PPAP package is missing the material certifications and the capability study for the critical dimensions. Please complete and resubmit before the run-at-rate.
qa.zh: PPAP 資料少了材證跟關鍵尺寸的能力分析。請在 run-at-rate 前補齊重交。

qa.en: The following are missing: control plan, measurement system analysis, capability study for the designated special characteristics, and the material certificate.
qa.zh: 缺的項目有：管制計畫、MSA、特殊特性的能力研究、還有材證。

words.definition: The person in charge of a plane or ship.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: The captain had to wait in the air for 30 minutes.
general.zh: 機長必須在空中等待 30 分鐘。

general.en: Captain is the role; pilot is the profession.
general.zh: captain 是職務、pilot 是職業。

general.en: The captain welcomed us on board.
general.zh: 機長歡迎我們登機。

words.definition: A device in a car that makes a loud warning sound.

general.en: The car horn is stuck and won't stop honking.
general.zh: 汽車喇叭卡住了，一直響不停。

general.en: The car horn got stuck, so it kept honking.
general.zh: 汽車喇叭卡住，所以一直按個不停。

words.definition: The lower part of a plane where luggage is stored.

general.en: Checked bags are stored in the aircraft's cargo hold.
general.zh: 託運行李存放在飛機的貨艙裡。

words.definition: kind and helpful to other people.

general.en: Sarah is a good friend because she's kind and caring.
general.zh: Sarah 是個好朋友，因為她善良又有愛心。

words.definition: A person who builds or repairs things made of wood, such as doors or furniture.

general.en: The carpenter repaired a broken door and installed new shelves.
general.zh: 木匠修理了一扇破掉的門並安裝了新的層架。

general.en: The carpenter installed new shelves.
general.zh: 木工安裝了新層架。

general.en: It was a long day, but I realized how important it is to have skilled professionals like plumbers, electricians, carpenters, and civil servants. They help solve problems efficiently and make life much easier.
general.zh: 這是漫長的一天，但我意識到擁有像水管工人、電工、木匠和公務員等熟練的專業人員有多麼重要。他們幫助有效率地解決問題，讓生活變得更輕鬆。

words.definition: A small bag you take onto the plane with you.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: You can bring one carry-on onto the plane.
general.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李上飛機。

general.en: Your carry-on bags will pass through an X-ray machine.
general.zh: 你的隨身行李會通過 X 光機掃描。

general.en: You can take a carry-on bag into the cabin.
general.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李進客艙。

general.en: The carry-on baggage weight limit is 7 kg on budget airlines.
general.zh: 廉價航空的隨身行李重量限制是7公斤。

general.en: When I boarded the plane, I put my carry-on bag in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 當我登機時，我把隨身行李放進頭頂置物櫃。

general.en: You can bring one carry-on bag.
general.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李。

words.definition: A small bag you take onto the plane with you.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Your carry-on bags will pass through an X-ray machine.
general.zh: 你的隨身行李會通過 X 光機掃描。

general.en: You can take a carry-on bag into the cabin.
general.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李進客艙。

general.en: When I boarded the plane, I put my carry-on bag in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 當我登機時，我把隨身行李放進頭頂置物櫃。

general.en: It's usually eight hundred dollars, but you could move something into your carry-on bag instead.
general.zh: 通常是八百元，不過您也可以把一些東西移到隨身行李裡。

general.en: Good idea. I'll take my books out and put them in my carry-on bag.
general.zh: 好主意。我把書拿出來放進隨身行李。

general.en: You can bring one carry-on bag.
general.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李。

qa.en: The crank assembly is a carry-over design from the previous model.
qa.zh: 曲柄組是沿用上一代機種的設計。

words.definition: To talk with someone about what has happened since you last met.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: They are working overtime to catch up with the delayed schedule.
general.zh: 他們正在加班，為了趕上延誤的進度。

general.en: I need to study harder to catch up.
general.zh: 我需要更努力學習才能趕上進度。

general.en: I need to catch up with my classmates.
general.zh: 我需要趕上同學們的進度。

general.en: Let's catch up tomorrow!
general.zh: 我們明天敘敘舊吧！

words.definition: to make something happen, especially something bad.

general.en: Lack of sleep caused her to make mistakes.
general.zh: 睡眠不足導致她犯錯。

general.en: The pipe burst due to high pressure, causing water damage.
general.zh: 水管因高壓而爆裂，造成水損。

general.en: The doctor was able to identify the cause of the pain.
general.zh: 醫生能夠找出疼痛的原因。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers to investigate the root causes and implement effective solutions.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，進行根本原因分析，並落實有效的解決方案。

general.en: Drinking contaminated water can cause severe diarrhea.
general.zh: 喝到受污染的水會導致嚴重的腹瀉。

general.en: Diarrhea is often caused by a stomach virus or eating spoiled food.
general.zh: 腹瀉通常是由胃病毒或吃到變質食物造成的。

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: Use the 5 Whys — the loose bolt is a symptom, not the root cause.
qa.zh: 用五問法追下去——螺絲鬆動只是症狀，不是根本原因。

qa.en: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.
qa.zh: 一套有步驟的解決問題流程：先圍堵、再找根因、最後讓它不要再發生。

qa.en: What is the root cause, and when can you send us the 8D report?
qa.zh: 根本原因是什麼？8D 報告什麼時候可以給我們？

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

words.definition: A large hole in the side of a hill or under the ground.

general.en: The boat operator took me through several caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我穿過好幾個洞穴。

general.en: The cave was the best place to avoid the heat in the summer.
general.zh: 洞穴是夏天躲避暑熱最好的地方。

general.en: The boat operator took me through the caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我穿過那些洞穴。

general.en: The boat operator took us through the caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我們穿過洞穴。

words.definition: The surface that forms the top of the inside of a room.

general.en: One of the ceiling tiles came off in my apartment.
general.zh: 我公寓裡的一片天花板磁磚掉落了。

general.en: What would you do if a ceiling tile fell off at your home?
general.zh: 如果你家的天花板磁磚掉下來，你會怎麼做？

general.en: Testing found a concentration well above the legal ceiling of 2 micrograms.
general.zh: 檢測發現濃度遠超過每公斤2微克的法定上限。

general.en: There's water coming through the ceiling in the bathroom, and the wall feels wet.
general.zh: 浴室的天花板一直在漏水，牆壁摸起來也是濕的。

general.en: Water through the ceiling? That sounds serious. Is it still dripping now?
general.zh: 從天花板漏水？聽起來很嚴重。現在還在滴嗎？

general.en: Great. I'll come and inspect the ceiling myself while he's there.
general.zh: 太好了。他在的時候我也會過去親自檢查天花板。

words.translation: 天花板磁磚（輕鋼架天花板）
words.definition: one of the flat panels that make up the surface of a ceiling

general.en: What would you do if a ceiling tile fell off at your home?
general.zh: 如果你家的天花板磁磚掉下來，你會怎麼做？

general.en: One of the ceiling tiles came off in my apartment.
general.zh: 我公寓裡的一片天花板磁磚掉落了。

words.definition: to do something enjoyable or special to mark an important event or occasion.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: Taichung Park was decorated with lanterns to celebrate the Lantern Festival.
general.zh: 台中公園為了慶祝元宵節而掛滿燈籠。

general.en: Thanksgiving is a national holiday celebrated mainly in the United States and Canada.
general.zh: 感恩節是一個主要在美國和加拿大慶祝的國家節日。

general.en: People celebrate with traditions that bring hope and happiness.
general.zh: 假期間拜廟與探親，象徵希望與幸福。

general.en: In the corporate world, events serve as crucial milestones for celebrating achievements, fostering team spirit, and strengthening company culture.
general.zh: 在企業世界中，各種活動扮演著重要的里程碑角色，用來慶祝成就、培養團隊精神，以及強化公司文化。

general.en: For many employees, the year-end banquet is one of the most important company events of the year because it's fun, social, and a way to celebrate together.
general.zh: 對許多員工來說，尾牙是一年中最重要的公司活動之一，因為氣氛輕鬆、有趣，大家可以一起慶祝。

general.en: For many employees, the year-end banquet is one of the most important company events of the year because it's fun, social, and a way to celebrate together.
general.zh: 對許多員工來說，尾牙是一年中最重要的公司活動之一，因為氣氛輕鬆、有趣，大家可以一起慶祝。

words.definition: Yes, of course.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Certainly. Would you like anything else?
general.zh: 當然。您還需要別的嗎？

general.en: Certainly. I'll bring one once the seat belt sign is off.
general.zh: 沒問題。安全帶指示燈熄滅後我就拿一條給您。

qa.en: Certainly. Let me walk you through the durability test area first, and then the environmental chambers.
qa.zh: 當然。先帶您看耐久測試區，接著是環境試驗箱。

general.en: My manager suggested that everyone on the quality team complete a short certification in statistical process control.
general.zh: 我的主管建議品管團隊的每個人都去修一個統計製程管制的短期認證。

general.en: Companies want problem solvers, not people who only collect certificates.
general.zh: 企業要的是能解決問題的人，而不是只會收集證書的人。

general.en: Exactly. And Taiwan is moving the same way. Companies now want work samples and real tasks, not just certificates.
general.zh: 沒錯。而且台灣也在往同一個方向走。企業現在要的是工作實例和實作任務，不只是證書。

qa.en: We have ISO 9001. I can show you the certificate.
qa.zh: 我們有 ISO 9001，我可以給您看證書。

qa.en: Routine testing is performed in-house; certification testing is performed by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內做，認證測試送有認證的實驗室。

qa.en: Tensile testing is performed on every incoming material lot, and the mill certificate is cross-checked against our own test result.
qa.zh: 每批進料都做拉伸，材證跟我們自己測的結果會互相對。

qa.en: Routine tests are done in our own lab; certification tests such as EN 957 or EN ISO 20957 for fitness equipment are done by an accredited third-party laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內實驗室做；健身器材 EN 957／EN ISO 20957 這種認證測試，送有認證的第三方實驗室。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

general.en: My manager suggested that everyone on the quality team complete a short certification in statistical process control.
general.zh: 我的主管建議品管團隊的每個人都去修一個統計製程管制的短期認證。

qa.en: Routine testing is performed in-house; certification testing is performed by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內做，認證測試送有認證的實驗室。

qa.en: Please provide the material certification for the new grade.
qa.zh: 請提供新等級的材證。

qa.en: The PPAP package is missing the material certifications and the capability study for the critical dimensions. Please complete and resubmit before the run-at-rate.
qa.zh: PPAP 資料少了材證跟關鍵尺寸的能力分析。請在 run-at-rate 前補齊重交。

qa.en: Decide what re-qualification is needed — at minimum material certification, and possibly UV and impact testing for outdoor-exposed parts.
qa.zh: 決定要重新驗證哪些——至少要材證，外露件可能還要做 UV 跟衝擊測試。

qa.en: Routine tests are done in our own lab; certification tests such as EN 957 or EN ISO 20957 for fitness equipment are done by an accredited third-party laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內實驗室做；健身器材 EN 957／EN ISO 20957 這種認證測試，送有認證的第三方實驗室。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

qa.en: Do not promise a certification date to a customer before your certification body has given you one.
qa.zh: 驗證機構還沒給你日期之前，不要先跟客戶承諾什麼時候拿到證書。

qa.en: The new standard comes out in September. We are waiting for our certification body to give us a date.
qa.zh: 新標準九月才出來，我們在等驗證機構給我們日期。

qa.en: Confirm that your certification body's and your test labs' accreditation status is unaffected.
qa.zh: 確認驗證機構和委外實驗室的認證狀態沒受影響。

qa.en: The accreditation body assesses the certification body, not the factory.
qa.zh: 認證機構評的是驗證機構，不是工廠。

qa.en: Ask your certification body now for their transition schedule and audit availability — slots fill up from the publication date onwards.
qa.zh: 現在就去問驗證機構轉版時程和稽核檔期 —— 發布日一到，檔期就會開始被搶。

qa.en: Do not revise everything immediately — wait for your certification body and accreditation body to publish the new naming and mark-usage rules, then change once.
qa.zh: 先不要急著全部改版 —— 等驗證機構和認證機構公告新名稱和標誌怎麼用，再一次改完。

qa.en: Measure the chamfer angle with the digital bevel protractor.
qa.zh: 用電子角度規量測倒角角度。

qa.en: Add a 0.5 mm chamfer to the hole edge.
qa.zh: 孔緣請加 0.5 mm 倒角。

qa.en: Raise the missing change notice — the process change control gap matters more than this one report.
qa.zh: 漏開的變更通知要補開——製程變更管不住，比這一份報告嚴重多了。

qa.en: The fixture was changed without a change notice.
qa.zh: 夾具更換沒有開變更通知。

qa.en: Any change to a specification requires an engineering change notice and, where it affects form, fit, or function, your written approval before implementation.
qa.zh: 規格要改要先發 ECN；如果影響到形狀、配合或功能，要你們書面核准才能實施。

qa.en: Separately, the fixture change was made without a change notice. Please confirm who will raise it retrospectively so the change control record is complete.
qa.zh: 另外，這次換夾具沒有開變更通知。請確認誰來補開，變更管制的紀錄才會完整。

qa.en: Only the current revision on the shop floor is valid. Superseded drawings are removed immediately, and any change requires an engineering change notice before production may use it.
qa.zh: 現場只有現行版有效。舊版圖面馬上收掉，要改一定要先發 ECN 才能用在生產。

words.definition: likely to change frequently; = unpredictable (for weather)

general.en: The weather is often changeable in the mountains.
general.zh: 山區天氣常常多變。

general.en: Let's not cancel yet. The weather here is so changeable — it can be pouring at ten and sunny at noon.
general.zh: 先別急著取消。這裡的天氣很多變，可能十點還在下大雨，中午就出太陽了。

general.en: That's true. Taiwan's summer weather is really changeable.
general.zh: 也對。台灣夏天的天氣真的很多變。

qa.en: The Pareto chart shows that paint defects account for 60 % of all rejects.
qa.zh: 柏拉圖顯示烤漆不良佔了所有拒收的 60%。

qa.en: We plot the frame welding gap on a control chart every two hours.
qa.zh: 我們每兩小時把車架焊接間隙點在管制圖上。

qa.en: Monitoring a process with control charts and expressing how well it fits inside the specification limits.
qa.zh: 用管制圖盯製程，再用一個指數（Cpk）講製程落在規格內的程度。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

qa.en: We chart the key characteristic with X-bar and R charts. Cpk above 1.33 is the target; below 1.33 requires a process improvement plan even when all parts are still within specification.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用 X-bar／R 管制圖盯。Cpk 目標 1.33 以上；低於 1.33，就算每件都在規格內，還是要提改善計畫。

qa.en: The current Cpk for this dimension is 1.52 based on the last thirty subgroups, which is above our internal target of 1.33. The control chart shows no out-of-control points.
qa.zh: 看最近 30 組子群，這個尺寸 Cpk 是 1.52，高於我們內部目標 1.33，管制圖也沒有失控點。

qa.en: There are chatter marks on the machined surface.

words.definition: the American English word for the piece of paper showing how much you must pay at a restaurant.

general.en: Checked bags are stored in the aircraft's cargo hold.
general.zh: 託運行李存放在飛機的貨艙裡。

general.en: Check-in opens two hours before the flight.
general.zh: 報到手續在班機起飛前兩小時開始。

general.en: She planned to eat bland dishes before her health check.
general.zh: 她計劃在健康檢查前吃清淡的料理。

general.en: Please check the departure time on your ticket.
general.zh: 請確認你票上的出發時間。

general.en: Could we have the check, please?
general.zh: 可以給我們帳單嗎？（美式說法）

general.en: We went through the security check.
general.zh: 我們通過了安檢。

qa.en: QA builds quality into the treadmill production process; QC checks the finished treadmills.
qa.zh: 品保把品質做進跑步機的製程裡；品管則檢查完成的跑步機。

qa.en: Check the motor noise of every treadmill before packing.
qa.zh: 包裝前檢查每台跑步機的馬達噪音。
