qa.en: Judging a whole lot by inspecting only a sample drawn from it, instead of checking every piece.
qa.zh: 只抽一部分來檢，用抽出來的結果判整批，不是每件都檢。

qa.en: We check some pieces from each lot, not all of them.
qa.zh: 我們每批抽幾件檢查，不是全部都檢。

qa.en: We look up a letter in the table, and the letter tells us how many to check.
qa.zh: 我們在表上查一個代字，代字告訴我們要檢查幾件。

qa.en: A higher level means we check more pieces.
qa.zh: 水準越高，我們檢查的件數越多。

words.definition: Registering at the airport before a flight.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Check-in opens two hours before the flight.
general.zh: 報到手續在班機起飛前兩小時開始。

general.en: Good morning. May I see your passport? This is the check-in counter for Flight 725 to Tokyo.
general.zh: 早安，可以看一下您的護照嗎？這裡是飛往東京 725 班機的報到櫃檯。

general.en: The traveler left his passport on the check-in desk.
general.zh: 那位旅客把護照留在報到櫃檯。

words.definition: Bags you hand to the airline to store on the plane.

general.en: We checked in two bags for our trip to Japan.
general.zh: 我們為了日本之旅託運了兩件行李。

general.en: A new backup procedure has since been added to the factory's shipping checklist.
general.zh: 工廠的出貨檢查清單後來加入了一項新的備援流程。

general.en: Our backup checklist, which barely existed a year ago, has already been used several times this season.
general.zh: 我們的備援檢查清單，一年前根本還沒成形，這一季已經被用過好幾次了。

qa.en: We have added this item to the inspection checklist to prevent recurrence.
qa.zh: 「會注意」不是對策，客戶聽了只會更擔心。要講你改了哪份文件、加了哪個管制點、怎麼確認有效。

qa.en: Send the supplier the element checklist for the level you requested, with the missing items ticked — not a general complaint.
qa.zh: 把你要求那個等級的 PPAP 清單寄給供應商，缺的項目直接勾出來——不要只寫一句「資料不齊」。

qa.en: Here is the element checklist with the missing items marked.
qa.zh: 這是 PPAP 清單，缺的項目我已經標出來了。

qa.en: At the end, we fill in the checklist. We write down the date, the part number, how many we checked, and the result. If the sample passes, the whole lot can go to the line. If it fails, we hold the lot and call the supplier.
qa.zh: 最後，我們填寫檢查表。寫下日期、料號、檢查數量和結果。如果樣本合格，整批就可以送上產線。如果不合格，我們扣住整批並通知供應商。

qa.en: At the end, we fill in the checklist.

words.definition: to make someone feel happier.

general.en: She knows just how to cheer me up.
general.zh: 她很知道怎麼讓我開心起來。

words.definition: to become happier, or to make someone happier.

general.en: Cheer up! This is not the end of the world.
general.zh: 振作起來！這不是世界末日。

general.en: When he was asked why he was so pessimistic about life, Laurie said it was because he is Scottish. Because of his reputation as a pessimist, complete strangers come up to him on the street and say, "Cheer up, it'll never happen!"
general.zh: 當他被問到為何對人生如此悲觀時，羅利說那是因為他是蘇格蘭人。因為他悲觀者的名聲，常有陌生人在街上走向他說：「振作點，壞事不會發生的！」

words.definition: a professional cook, especially the main cook in a restaurant or kitchen
words.lesson: 20260708 A Flight Problem 航班旅遊閱讀

general.en: A chef may be employed to prepare meals for residents.
general.zh: 可能會聘請廚師為住客準備餐點。

general.en: Most of a chef's day is spent on unglamorous tasks like chopping onions.
general.zh: 廚師一天大部分時間都在做切洋蔥這類平淡的工作。

general.en: Some long-stay apartments arrange a chef to prepare meals for guests.
general.zh: 在「長租公寓有時會安排廚師為住客準備餐點」的情境下提到。

words.definition: to relax and do nothing special.

general.en: Sometimes they just chill in the park beside the church.
general.zh: 有時她們就在教堂旁的公園裡放鬆。

general.en: Just chill out and enjoy the weekend.
general.zh: 放鬆一下，享受週末吧。

words.definition: small regular tasks done around the house, like cleaning and washing dishes

general.en: Roommates need to negotiate chores so everyone shares the work fairly.
general.zh: 室友們需要協商家事，以便每個人都能公平地分擔工作。

general.en: Before dinner, I feed the animals and do a few chores.
general.zh: 晚餐前我餵動物、做一些家事。

general.en: I have to do my household chores before I can go out with friends.
general.zh: 在我和朋友出門之前，我必須先做完家事。（have to + 原形表客觀「必須」。另例：Sharing household chores with roommates can prevent arguments. 與室友分擔家事可以預防爭吵——動名詞當主詞；prevent + 名詞。）

general.en: Household chores are another common issue. Who takes out the trash, washes the dishes, or cleans the bathroom?
general.zh: 家務是另一個常見的問題。誰去倒垃圾、洗碗或打掃浴室？（another + 單數名詞；Who 當主詞視為單數，後接 takes、washes、cleans。）

general.en: When chores are ignored, tension can build quickly, so it's important to set rules early and stick to them.
general.zh: 當家務被忽視時，緊張氣氛會迅速累積，所以儘早制定規則並遵守它們是很重要的。（are ignored 為被動語態；it 為虛主詞；stick to + 名詞 堅持／遵守。）

general.en: Household chores are another common issue.
general.zh: 家務是另一個常見的問題。

qa.en: The company agreed to pay a civil penalty to settle the charges.
qa.zh: 那家公司同意付民事罰款來和解。

words.definition: A person who works for the government and helps run public services.

general.en: I met a civil servant at the local government office to ask about my documents.
general.zh: 我在當地政府辦公室見了一位公務員，詢問關於我文件的事。

general.en: It was a long day, but I realized how important it is to have skilled professionals like plumbers, electricians, carpenters, and civil servants. They help solve problems efficiently and make life much easier.
general.zh: 這是漫長的一天，但我意識到擁有像水管工人、電工、木匠和公務員等熟練的專業人員有多麼重要。他們幫助有效率地解決問題，讓生活變得更輕鬆。

words.definition: 時間重疊或意見不合

general.en: The two meetings clash, so we need to reschedule.
general.zh: 兩個會議時間衝突，需要重新安排。

general.en: Their schedules clash, so they can't meet for lunch.
general.zh: 他們的時間表有衝突，所以無法一起吃午餐。（clash 作不及物動詞；so 連接因果。另例：The colors of your shirt and pants clash. 你襯衫和褲子的顏色不搭——主詞複數動詞保持原形。Living together can cause routines to clash, like one person wanting quiet while another plays music. 住在一起可能會導致作息衝突——cause + 受詞 + to V。）

general.en: His opinion clashed with hers during the discussion.
general.zh: 在討論中，他的意見與她的發生了衝突。（搭配 with）

general.en: Their schedules clash, so they cannot attend the same classes.
general.zh: 他們的時間表衝突，所以無法參加同一門課。（指時間強碰）

general.en: On the other hand, daily routines can clash: one person may prefer quiet mornings, while another likes to play music while cooking breakfast.
general.zh: 另一方面，日常作息可能會起衝突：一個人可能偏好安靜的早晨，而另一個人則喜歡在做早餐時放音樂。（第一個 while 表對比「然而」；第二個 while 是「當…的時候」，接分詞構句 cooking。）

general.en: Daily routines can clash.
general.zh: 日常作息可能會起衝突。

words.definition: A machine that measures a part in three axes with a touch probe and compares the result against the CAD model or drawing.
a fixed amount of money that you pay for medical care, with the rest covered by insurance.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: I had to pay a co-pay when I visited the dentist yesterday.
general.zh: 我昨天去看牙醫時，必須支付部分負擔費用 / 掛號費。

qa.en: How many hours of salt spray does this coating pass?
qa.zh: 這個塗裝可以通過幾小時鹽霧？

qa.en: The thickness of the cured coating film, measured on the finished part in microns.
qa.zh: 成品上塗膜烤乾後的厚度，用微米量。

qa.en: What is the coating thickness, and where do you measure it?
qa.zh: 膜厚是多少？你們在哪裡量？

qa.en: A test that cuts a grid into the coating, applies tape, and removes it to see how much coating peels off.
qa.zh: 在塗層上劃格子、貼膠帶再撕掉，看掉了多少的附著力測試。

qa.en: We use the cross-hatch adhesion test per ASTM D3359. The acceptance criterion is class 5B, meaning no coating is removed from any of the one hundred squares.
qa.zh: 我們照 ASTM D3359 做百格，允收標準 5B，就是 100 格都不能有塗層掉下來。

qa.en: This powder coating passes 48 hours of neutral salt spray with no red rust and with creepage from the scribe line under one millimeter, which meets the requirement in the specification.
qa.zh: 這個粉體塗裝過 48 小時中性鹽霧，沒有紅鏽，劃線處擴散小於 1 mm，符合規格。

qa.en: The coating coverage rate and the color must meet the standard.
qa.zh: 上膜率與皮膜色澤必須符合標準。

qa.en: QA personnel are responsible for inspecting every step on the coating line.
qa.zh: 塗裝線每個步驟都由品保人員負責檢核。

words.definition: The thickness of the cured coating film, measured on the finished part in microns.

qa.en: Use the coating thickness gauge to measure the film thickness.
qa.zh: 用膜厚計量測漆膜厚度。

qa.en: Measure the paint thickness with the coating thickness gauge.
qa.zh: 用膜厚計量測漆膜厚度。

words.definition: to gently persuade someone to do something

general.en: She coaxed the cat down from the tree with a treat.
general.zh: 她用食物把貓哄下樹。

general.en: They tried to coax the child to eat more vegetables.
general.zh: To persuade in a gentle way.（哄誘某人／動物做某事）

general.en: We tried to coax my younger brother to join us for a bike ride.
general.zh: 我們試著說服我弟弟和我們一起去騎腳踏車。

general.en: She coaxed the child to eat his vegetables.
general.zh: 她哄著孩子把蔬菜吃完。

general.en: The Wise Woman said, "Coax your horse to come inside your house by talking to it in a pleasant and gentle way." The farmer thought this an odd suggestion, but he did as he was told.
general.zh: 智者說：「用愉快溫和的方式對你的馬說話，哄勸（Coax）牠進到你的房子裡。」農夫覺得這個建議很奇怪，但他還是照做了。

words.definition: to fall down suddenly; or the act of falling down

general.en: The building collapsed during the earthquake.
general.zh: 那棟建築在地震中倒塌了。

general.en: Rescue workers assembled outside the collapsed building.
general.zh: 救援人員在倒塌的建築物外集合。

general.en: Some buildings collapsed during the strong earthquake.
general.zh: 地震劇烈時，部分建築物倒塌了。

general.en: Firefighters worked to rescue trapped people from the collapsed buildings.
general.zh: 消防員努力從倒塌建築物中救出受困者。

general.en: They rescued trapped people from under the collapsed building.
general.zh: 他們從倒塌的建築物下方救出受困者。（rescue + 受詞 + from under）

general.en: The old building collapsed in the earthquake.
general.zh: 那棟老建築在地震中倒塌了。

words.definition: a person you work with.

general.en: My colleague and I are on the same page about this problem.
general.zh: 我和同事對這個問題有共識。

general.en: My colleague had abdominal surgery and lost 20 kg.
general.zh: 我的同事做了腹部手術，瘦了 20 公斤。

general.en: Please apologize to your colleague if you made a mistake.
general.zh: 如果你犯了錯，請向你的同事道歉。

general.en: I have also noticed that colleagues who once panicked during a warning now respond much more calmly.
general.zh: 我也注意到，那些以前一聽到警報就慌張的同事，現在反應冷靜多了。

general.en: My colleague had surgery on his stomach and lost 20 kilos.
general.zh: 我的同事做了胃部手術，瘦了 20 公斤。

general.en: The colleague sneezes continuously in the office.
general.zh: 同事在辦公室裡連續打噴嚏。（描述他的過敏體質或辦公室目前的常態。）

words.definition: words that are often used together.

general.en: We'll do some exercises practising these collocations tomorrow.
general.zh: 我們明天會做一些練習，來練習這些搭配詞。

qa.en: The color difference is ΔE 2.4 against the approved master panel — our limit is 2.0, so the parts have to be re-sprayed.
qa.zh: 跟承認色板比，色差 ΔE 2.4，我們的上限是 2.0，所以這批要重噴。

qa.en: The color difference is ΔE 2.4, which exceeds our limit of 2.0.
qa.zh: 色差 ΔE 2.4，超過我們 2.0 的上限。

qa.en: The color difference is ΔE 2.4 against the master panel, which exceeds our limit of 2.0. The parts need to be re-sprayed.
qa.zh: 「不一樣、再噴一次」沒有判定依據，對方可以跟你吵到底差多少。把量測條件、數值、規格上限、後面要驗什麼講清楚，判定才站得住。

qa.en: The color difference is over the limit; delta E must be under 1.0.
qa.zh: 色差超出上限，ΔE 必須小於 1.0。

qa.en: The color difference ΔE is 0.6, within the tolerance of 1.0.
qa.zh: 色差 ΔE 為 0.6，在 1.0 的容差內。

qa.en: The trial batch is rejected: the color difference against the approved master panel is ΔE 2.4, above our 2.0 limit. The parts will be re-sprayed.
qa.zh: 試噴這批判退：跟承認色板比色差 ΔE 2.4，超過我們 2.0 的上限，這批要重噴。

words.definition: 物理或心理上感到放鬆、自在

general.en: Money can support a comfortable life, but it cannot guarantee happiness.
general.zh: 金錢可以支持舒適的生活，但無法保證幸福。

general.en: On the one hand, household chores are tiring; on the other hand, they keep the home clean and comfortable.
general.zh: 一方面，做家務很累；另一方面，它們能保持家裡整潔舒適。

general.en: This chair is very comfortable. / I feel comfortable in my new job.
general.zh: 這張椅子坐起來非常舒服。／我在新工作裡感到很自在。

general.en: I feel very comfortable in my new job.
general.zh: 我在新工作裡感到非常自在。

words.definition: 使人在悲傷或疲憊時感覺好一點的

general.en: It is comforting to eat a warm meal after a long day.
general.zh: 漫長一天後吃一頓熱食真的很療癒。

general.en: It is comforting to eat a fried chicken chop after a long day.
general.zh: 下班後吃一塊炸雞排，真的非常療癒。

general.en: Her words were very comforting after the bad news.
general.zh: 聽到壞消息後，她的話語給了人很大的寬慰。

general.en: It is comforting to know that you are not alone.
general.zh: 知道自己並非孤身一人，真是令人感到欣慰。

general.en: After a long day of meetings, a hot bowl of soup is very comforting.
general.zh: 經過一整天的會議後，一碗熱湯非常療癒。

general.en: "A warm bowl of soup after cleaning the fridge — that's truly comforting," she smiled. She reminded herself: when food looks or smells wrong, always throw it out.
general.zh: 「清完冰箱後喝一碗熱湯——真的非常療癒，」她微笑著說。她提醒自己：當食物看起來或聞起來不對勁時，一定要把它丟掉。

words.definition: A group of people who live in the same area or share something in common.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: More people participate in community service during Thanksgiving.
general.zh: 越來越多人會在感恩節參與社區服務。

general.en: Grace, good news. The city office approved our funding. The community reading program runs for a whole year.
general.zh: Grace，好消息。市政府核准我們的補助了。社區閱讀計畫可以辦整整一年。

general.en: We'll see on Friday. But I do think this community will get behind it.
general.zh: 星期五就知道了。不過我真的覺得這個社區會支持這件事。

general.en: We live in a safe community.
general.zh: 我們住在一個安全的社區。

general.en: Free vaccines are available at most clinics and community health stations. A short visit now can prevent a much longer illness later.
general.zh: 大部分診所與社區健康站都還有免費疫苗。現在去一趟，可能就能避免之後一場更長的病。

general.en: At night, the market becomes bustling and lively. Though it can get crowded, many people still enjoy visiting because it makes them feel connected to their community.
general.zh: 夜晚時，市場變得繁忙且熱鬧。雖然可能會變得很擁擠，許多人仍然喜歡造訪，因為這讓他們感到與社區有所連結。

words.definition: work done to help people in your area.

general.en: More people participate in community service during Thanksgiving.
general.zh: 越來越多人會在感恩節參與社區服務。

words.definition: to travel between home and work.

general.en: I ride a scooter to commute to work every morning.
general.zh: 我每天早上騎機車通勤上班。

general.en: Workers had to choose between a longer commute and a tighter budget.
general.zh: 工作者必須在更長的通勤和更緊的預算之間做選擇。

general.en: A household relocating twenty kilometres from the city centre spent more on commuting.
general.zh: 搬離市中心二十公里的家庭在通勤上花了更多錢。

general.en: One study estimated that commuting costs absorbed eight percent of household income.
general.zh: 一項研究估計，通勤成本吃掉了家庭收入的百分之八。

general.en: That's right, your commute is longer now. How far is it?
general.zh: 對喔，你現在通勤變長了。有多遠？

general.en: I commute by scooter.
general.zh: 我騎摩托車上下班。

words.definition: to force someone to do something.

general.en: The rain compelled us to stay indoors.
general.zh: 雨迫使我們待在室內。

words.definition: To give something to make up for a loss or problem.

general.en: The hotel gave us a free meal to compensate for the noisy room.
general.zh: 飯店給我們免費餐點，以補償房間太吵的問題。

general.en: The airline company offered a free ticket to compensate for the flight delay.
general.zh: 航空公司提供免費機票來補償航班延誤。

general.en: He compensated his wife for forgetting her birthday by taking her on a special trip.
general.zh: 他因為忘記太太的生日，而帶她去特別旅行作為補償。

general.en: The sponsor offered refunds to compensate the customers.
general.zh: 贊助商提供退款來補償顧客。

general.en: The insurance company offered us compensation for the car accident.
general.zh: 保險公司為車禍事故提供我們賠償。

general.en: The concert was canceled because of the typhoon, so the sponsor offered refunds to compensate the customers.
general.zh: 演唱會因颱風取消，贊助商提供退款來補償顧客。

words.definition: Money or something else given to make up for a loss or problem.

general.en: The insurance company offered us compensation for the car accident.
general.zh: 保險公司為車禍事故提供我們賠償。

words.definition: An event in which people try to win against each other.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: There is a lot of competition in the market.
general.zh: 市場競爭很激烈。

general.en: There is a swimming competition for beginners in October.
general.zh: 十月有一場給初學者的游泳比賽。

general.en: Now Tom practices every weekend at the same pool. He can swim about ten meters without stopping. There is a swimming competition for beginners in October.
general.zh: 現在Tom每個週末都在同一個泳池練習。他現在可以連續游大約十公尺不停。十月有一場給初學者的游泳比賽。

words.definition: to say that you are unhappy or not satisfied with something

general.en: My neighbor often complains about the noise.
general.zh: 我的鄰居常常抱怨噪音。

general.en: He hardly ever complains about the noise.
general.zh: 他幾乎不抱怨噪音。

general.en: Sometimes, she has to complain about problems in the office. But today, the situation is better, and she can work calmly.
general.zh: 有時候，她必須抱怨辦公室裡的問題。但今天，情況比較好，她可以平靜地工作。

general.en: Customers complained about damaged products.
general.zh: 顧客投訴損壞的產品。

general.en: Sometimes, she has to complain about problems in the office. But today, the situation is better, and she can work calmly.
general.zh: 有時候，她必須抱怨辦公室裡的問題。但今天，情況比較好，她可以平靜地工作。

general.en: The traffic is terrible in the morning and evening. At first, I didn't like it. My neighbor often complained about the noise. We even had an argument about parking one day.
general.zh: 早晚的交通非常糟糕。起初，我不喜歡這裡。我的鄰居經常抱怨噪音。有一天我們甚至因為停車問題發生了爭執。

general.en: The company will investigate the customer's complaint.
general.zh: 公司將調查客戶的投訴。

general.en: The company began receiving several complaints from customers regarding damaged products.
general.zh: 公司開始收到好幾位顧客針對損壞產品的投訴。

qa.en: Let's draw a fishbone diagram for the exercise bike noise complaint.
qa.zh: 我們針對飛輪車異音客訴畫一張魚骨圖吧。

qa.en: Risk: if the failure mode carries over and the new model sells more, the same defect rate produces more complaints.
qa.zh: 風險：故障模式跟著沿用，新機種又賣得更多，同樣的不良率客訴只會更多。

qa.en: We had eleven field complaints of the same failure mode.
qa.zh: 同一個故障模式我們有十一件市場客訴。

qa.en: The previous model generated eleven field complaints of creaking. Here they are on one chart.
qa.zh: 上一代有十一件異音客訴，我整理在同一張圖上。

qa.en: The FMEA is a living document — it is revised after any design change, process change, or customer complaint, and the revision history is retained.
qa.zh: FMEA 是活的文件，設計改、製程改或有客訴就修訂，改版紀錄都留著。

qa.en: We score severity, occurrence, and detection. High-risk items must have an additional control in the control plan, and the FMEA is reviewed after every customer complaint.
qa.zh: 打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。高風險的項目要在管制計畫追加管制；每次客訴後都要回頭看 FMEA。

general.en: I initiated a comprehensive inspection protocol, personally tested the electronic components, and documented a dimensional discrepancy in the frame.
general.zh: 我啟動了一套完整的檢驗流程，親自測試電子零件，並記錄了車架的尺寸偏差。

qa.en: Check the HS codes of your rubber and belt components against the updated annex — scope is decided by code, not by product name.
qa.zh: 拿橡膠件和皮帶的 HS code 去對更新後的附件 —— 範圍是看 HS code，不是看品名。

qa.en: Are your rubber and belt components in scope of the EUDR?
qa.zh: 你們的橡膠件和皮帶在 EUDR 範圍內嗎？

qa.en: These components are out of scope under the revised annex.
qa.zh: 照修訂後的附件，這些零組件不在範圍內。

qa.en: This sensor performs a safety function, so it is treated as a critical component.
qa.zh: 這個感測器是做安全功能的，所以算關鍵零件。

qa.en: We have identified which of our components fall within the commodity scope and we retain supplier origin records for them. We can supply the data in whatever format your due diligence system requires.
qa.zh: 我們已經確認哪些零組件在範圍內，也留著它們的供應商產地紀錄。你們盡職調查系統要什麼格式，我們都可以配合。

words.definition: the ability to understand something.

general.en: Reading comprehension takes practice.
general.zh: 閱讀理解需要練習。

words.definition: 由法律或規定所要求，必須做的

general.en: Joining NHI is compulsory for all citizens in Taiwan.
general.zh: 在台灣，加入全民健保對所有公民來說都是強制的。

general.en: Required by law or a rule — In Taiwan, joining the National Health Insurance program is compulsory for all citizens.
general.zh: 法律或規定所要求的。（在台灣，所有公民都必須（強制）加入全民健康保險計畫。）

words.translation: 伺服電腦式紙箱抗壓試驗機

words.definition: to give all your attention and effort to one thing

general.en: The farmer could not concentrate because his house was so noisy.
general.zh: 農夫因為家裡太吵而無法專心。

general.en: The farmer could not concentrate because his house was too noisy.
general.zh: 農夫因為家裡太吵而無法專心。

general.en: I need to concentrate on the quality inspection report today.
general.zh: 我今天需要專心處理品質檢驗報告。

general.en: It is hard to concentrate when you have a bad headache.
general.zh: 頭痛很嚴重時很難集中注意力。

general.en: They say they concentrate better at home.
general.zh: 他們說自己在家比較能專心。

general.en: Testing found a concentration well above the legal ceiling of 2 micrograms.
general.zh: 檢測發現濃度遠超過每公斤2微克的法定上限。

qa.en: We test the bath concentration twice a day and record the result.
qa.zh: 槽液濃度一天測兩次並記錄。

qa.en: Free acid, total acidity, and accelerator concentration are titrated at the defined frequency, and any out-of-range result triggers an immediate adjustment and a recheck.
qa.zh: 游離酸、總酸度跟促進劑濃度照規定頻率滴定，一超出範圍馬上調，調完再測一次。

words.definition: 對某事的擔心或興趣

general.en: Our customer expressed concern about the quality.
general.zh: 我們的客戶對品質表示擔憂。

general.en: Our client was concerned about the project delay.
general.zh: 我們的客戶很擔心專案延遲。

general.en: While I understand your concern, we still need to finish the project.
general.zh: 雖然我理解你的擔憂，但我們仍需要完成專案。

general.en: Thank you for your concern.
general.zh: 謝謝你的關心。（回應別人表達擔心時的固定說法，concern 此處為名詞）

general.en: Safety is our main concern.
general.zh: 安全是我們最大的擔心。

qa.en: All results are within specification, so this is not a quality concern today. It is a validity concern: the three runs are not three runs of the same process.
qa.zh: 結果全部在規格內，所以今天不是品質問題，是驗證算不算數的問題：這三批不是同一個製程跑出來的。

words.translation: 條件的；條件句（文法用語）
words.definition: a grammar term for a sentence that describes what happens if something else happens first

general.en: This lesson is about the first and second conditionals.
general.zh: 這堂課是關於第一與第二條件句。

general.en: The first conditional talks about real possibilities.
general.zh: 第一條件句討論的是真實的可能性。

general.en: The second conditional is used for imaginary situations.
general.zh: 第二條件句用於想像的情況。

general.en: Nice. And notice what you both just did - that's the second conditional.
general.zh: 很好。而且注意你們兩個剛剛做了什麼 - 那就是第二條件句。

general.en: So the second conditional is for imaginary situations, right? Not real ones.
general.zh: 所以第二條件句是用在想像的情況，對吧？不是真實的情況。

general.en: And the first conditional is for a real possibility?
general.zh: 那第一條件句是用在真實的可能性嗎？

qa.en: My proposal is to approve the carry-over conditional on a dedicated durability test for that failure mode.
qa.zh: 我的提案是：沿用有條件核准，條件是針對這個故障模式做專門的耐久測試。

words.definition: A feeling of trust in your own abilities.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: A loss of confidence in one's own competence.
general.zh: 對自己能力失去信心。

general.en: The feedback has slowly built her confidence.
general.zh: 這些回饋漸漸建立了她的信心。

general.en: Being forced to apply what I had barely learned built more confidence than any textbook practice could.
general.zh: 被迫運用自己才剛學會的東西，反而比任何課本練習都更能建立信心。

general.en: That's fair. But your confidence has grown a lot this year. I've watched it happen.
general.zh: 這說得有理。但你今年的自信成長了很多。我都看在眼裡。

general.en: She has a lot of confidence in herself.
general.zh: 她對自己很有自信。

general.en: The praise boosted my confidence.
general.zh: 這份讚美增強了我的自信。

qa.en: The inspection level is part of the agreed inspection standard; we can tighten it for your product if you require additional confidence.
qa.zh: 檢驗水準是談好的檢驗標準的一部分；你們想要更保險，我們可以針對你們的產品加嚴。

words.definition: sure about your own ability.

general.en: Anita has become more confident after attending the conversation classes.
general.zh: Anita 上完會話課後變得更有自信了。

general.en: Forecasters were confident about its path.
general.zh: 預報人員對它的路徑很有把握。

general.en: After some time, Tom felt more confident because he practiced every day.
general.zh: 一段時間後，Tom 感到更有自信了，因為他每天練習。（feel 是連綴動詞，後面接形容詞 confident。）

general.en: Her teacher gave her encouraging feedback, so she felt confident.
general.zh: 老師給了她令人鼓舞的回饋，所以她感到很有自信。

general.en: In my opinion, plastic surgery can be helpful when used carefully and for the right reasons, but it should not be seen as the only way to feel confident or happy.
general.zh: 在我看來，當整形手術被謹慎使用，並且出於正確的理由時，它是有幫助的，但它不應該被視為獲得自信或幸福的唯一方式。

general.en: Now, I feel more confident. I can identify many words in texts, understand their translation, and use them in both formal and informal situations. I know I will continue to make mistakes, but each mistake is an opportunity to learn.
general.zh: 現在，我感覺更有自信了。我能在文章中認出許多單字、了解它們的翻譯，並在正式與非正式場合使用它們。我知道我會繼續犯錯，但每一次錯誤都是學習的機會。（文法解說：both A and B 意思是「A 和 B 兩者都…」。）

qa.en: Runs 2 and 3 used a different configuration from run 1.
qa.zh: 第二、三批的組態跟第一批不一樣。

qa.en: The fixture change means the validation only covers the new configuration.
qa.zh: 夾具換了，這份驗證就只算新組態。

qa.en: I propose one additional run on the current configuration so that we have three consecutive runs of the process we will actually use in production.
qa.zh: 我建議用現在的條件再跑一批，這樣量產真正要用的製程才有連續三批的資料。

qa.en: Action: either add one more run on the current configuration so you have three consecutive runs of the same process, or re-scope the report to the new configuration and state it.
qa.zh: 行動：要嘛用現在的條件再跑一批，湊足同一製程連續三批；要嘛把報告範圍改成新條件，並且寫清楚。

qa.en: The three runs were not produced under the same conditions, so they do not demonstrate a stable process. I would like one additional run on the current configuration before sign-off.
qa.zh: 這三批不是同樣條件做的，所以證明不了製程穩定。簽之前我希望用現在的條件再跑一批。

words.definition: A cone-shaped hat used by farmers in Asia.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: A conical hat is a kind of farming hat.
general.zh: 斗笠是一種務農用的帽子。

words.definition: A link or relationship between two things or people.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Is there a connection between the two events?
general.zh: 這兩件事有關聯嗎？

general.en: Sorry, the connection is not good today.
general.zh: 抱歉，今天連線品質不太好。

words.definition: Careful not to trouble other people.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: A considerate person is careful not to inconvenience others.
general.zh: 體貼的人小心不造成他人不便。

words.definition: Happening all the time without stopping.

general.en: He has a constant cough because the air conditioner is too strong.
general.zh: 他一直在咳嗽，因為冷氣太強了。

general.en: Because of her constant effort, the team solved the problems.
general.zh: 因為她持續的努力，團隊解決了問題。

general.en: Cars in Vietnam constantly honk their horns, and the noise affects my sleep.
general.zh: 越南的車經常按喇叭，噪音影響我的睡眠。

general.en: The car horn got stuck, so it kept honking.
general.zh: 汽車喇叭卡住，所以一直按個不停。

general.en: Because of her effective communication and constant effort, the team solved the problems efficiently. They finished the project in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 因為她有效的溝通和持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就完成了專案，並收到了老闆的正面回饋。

general.en: Thanks to Emma's effective communication and constant efforts, the team efficiently resolved the issues. They completed the project successfully in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 多虧了 Emma 有效的溝通與持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就順利完成專案，並得到老闆正面的回饋。

qa.en: We cut a 100-square grid, apply the specified tape, and pull it off at a constant angle. The acceptance criterion is class 5B — no squares removed.
qa.zh: 劃 100 格、貼指定膠帶，固定角度撕掉。允收標準 5B，就是一格都不能掉。

words.definition: Happening again and again without stopping.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: Cars in Vietnam constantly honk their horns, and the noise affects my sleep.
general.zh: 越南的車經常按喇叭，噪音影響我的睡眠。

general.en: He is constantly expecting a plane to drop on his head.
general.zh: 他不斷擔心飛機會掉到他頭上。

general.en: Cars in Vietnam constantly honk their horns.
general.zh: 越南的車經常按喇叭。

general.en: Yes. He's the main character, and he's constantly telling everyone that the worst thing will happen.
general.zh: 對。他就是主角，而且他不斷地告訴所有人最糟的事一定會發生。

words.definition: to go to someone for advice or information; to look up a reference

general.en: He went to consult the Wise Woman to ask for her advice.
general.zh: 他去請教智者，尋求她的建議。

general.en: Residents are consulted before the numbers are set.
general.zh: 在訂出數字之前會先徵詢居民的意見。

general.en: Before taking the medicine, she consulted a pharmacist.
general.zh: 吃藥之前，她先諮詢了藥師。

general.en: Have you tried telemedicine? A friend of mine was consulted by video call last week.
general.zh: 你試過遠距醫療嗎？我一個朋友上禮拜就是透過視訊看診的。

general.en: She had to consult a doctor about her symptoms.
general.zh: To go to a person for advice.（諮詢專業人士或查工具書）

general.en: Once upon a time, there was a farmer who could not concentrate because his house was so noisy. He asked many people what to do. They told him to consult the Wise Woman to ask her advice.
general.zh: 從前，有一個農夫因為家裡太吵而無法專心（concentrate）。他問了很多人該怎麼辦。他們告訴他去請教（consult）智者，尋求她的建議。

words.definition: To have something inside.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: Please put a fragile label on the box, because it contains cups.
general.zh: 請在箱子上貼易碎標籤，因為裡面裝了杯子。

general.en: If my luggage contains dangerous items, they will inspect it.
general.zh: 如果我的行李裡有危險物品，他們會檢查。

general.en: The box contains glass cups.
general.zh: 這個箱子裝有玻璃杯。

general.en: My luggage contains some liquids.
general.zh: 我的行李裡裝有一些液體。

qa.en: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.
qa.zh: 一套有步驟的解決問題流程：先圍堵、再找根因、最後讓它不要再發生。

qa.en: Contain first: sort all in-process and in-stock handrail tubes and check for internal rust. Mark and segregate any affected lots.
qa.zh: 先圍堵：在製品跟庫存的扶手管全部翻出來，看裡面有沒有鏽。有問題的批次標起來隔開。

qa.en: We requested submission level 3. The package received contains the part submission warrant and the dimensional report only.
qa.zh: 我們要求的是 Level 3，但收到的只有 PSW 跟尺寸報告。

qa.en: Put the current lot on hold and identify which finished units contain the changed material.
qa.zh: 先把現有批次扣住，清查哪些成品機台已經用到改過的材料。

qa.en: We identified an unauthorized change to a customer-approved material. We have contained the affected lots, defined the re-qualification plan, and will review the disposition of in-process units once the comparison data is available.
qa.zh: 我們發現供應商改了客戶承認過的材料，沒經過核准。受影響批次已經圍堵、重新驗證的計畫也定了，比對數據出來後再決定在製品怎麼處理。

words.definition: Something you keep or carry things in.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: There is a disposable container on the back of his motorcycle.
general.zh: 他的機車後面有一個一次性容器。

general.en: Workers are checking the containers at the port.
general.zh: 工人正在港口檢查貨櫃。

general.en: If we have any liquids, we need to put them into a small container.
general.zh: 如果我們有任何液體，需要把它們放進一個小容器裡。

general.en: Hot food softens the plastic container.
general.zh: 熱食會使塑膠容器變軟。

general.en: He found a container of pasta.
general.zh: 他看見一盒義大利麵容器（保鮮盒）。

general.en: Put the liquids into a small container.
general.zh: 把液體放進小容器裡。

qa.en: As a containment action we sorted all treadmill frames in the warehouse and put the suspect lot on hold.
qa.zh: 作為圍堵措施，我們把倉庫裡所有跑步機機架全檢，並扣留可疑批次。

qa.en: The containment is done. We will submit the full report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵做完了，完整報告週五前給。

qa.en: The line is stopped and the affected units are on hold. I will start the containment check right away.
qa.zh: 線停了，受影響的產品扣住了，我馬上開始圍堵檢查。

qa.en: We will submit the interim report today with the containment evidence, and the full 8D including effectiveness verification by Friday.
qa.zh: 今天先給暫行報告，附圍堵的證據；完整 8D 含效果確認，週五前給。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

words.definition: A temporary action that stops bad parts reaching the customer while you investigate.

qa.en: As a containment action we sorted all treadmill frames in the warehouse and put the suspect lot on hold.
qa.zh: 作為圍堵措施，我們把倉庫裡所有跑步機機架全檢，並扣留可疑批次。

qa.en: As a containment action, we are re-screening all units in the warehouse.
qa.zh: 圍堵措施是把庫存所有機台重新篩一遍。

qa.en: The containment action is done. We will submit the full report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵措施已完成，完整報告會在週五前提交。

qa.en: Thursday works, but I need the containment action today.
qa.zh: 週四可以，但圍堵措施今天就要給我。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

words.definition: to give something, such as help, money, or ideas, to a shared purpose or goal.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: I aim to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience and contribute to global projects.
general.zh: 我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗、並為全球專案做出貢獻的公司。

general.en: She made a useful contribution to the discussion.
general.zh: 她對討論做出了有用的貢獻。

general.en: I want to broaden my experience. Same job, bigger scale, and I think I can contribute a lot.
general.zh: 我想拓展我的經驗。一樣的工作，但規模更大，而且我認為我可以有很多貢獻。

general.en: In the near future, I aim to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience and contribute to global projects.
general.zh: 短期內，我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗、並為全球專案做出貢獻的公司。

general.en: My manager suggested that everyone on the quality team complete a short certification in statistical process control.
general.zh: 我的主管建議品管團隊的每個人都去修一個統計製程管制的短期認證。

general.en: Air traffic control demands fast decisions and steady attention.
general.zh: 飛航管制需要快速決策和穩定的專注力。

general.en: When everything is out of your control, stay calm.
general.zh: 當一切都不在你的掌控中時，保持冷靜。

general.en: It was caused by weak controls over raw materials and not enough testing before products left the factory.
general.zh: 而是原料控管不足，加上產品出廠前檢驗不夠所造成的。

general.en: The project is under the manager's control.
general.zh: 這個專案由經理掌控。

qa.en: We plot the frame welding gap on a control chart every two hours.
qa.zh: 我們每兩小時把車架焊接間隙點在管制圖上。

qa.en: Nonconforming product is segregated and dispositioned according to our nonconforming product control procedure.
qa.zh: 不合格品照不合格品管制程序隔離，再決定怎麼處理。

qa.en: The documented system of procedures, records, and responsibilities that controls quality across the whole company.
qa.zh: 用寫下來的程序、紀錄跟權責分工，管全公司品質的一套系統。

qa.en: The corrective action has been horizontally deployed to all products using the same fixture, and the control plan has been updated accordingly.
qa.zh: 對策已經水平展開到所有用同一個治具的產品，管制計畫也一起更新了。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: All procedures referenced during this visit are controlled documents within our ISO 9001 system, and the records are retained for the period defined in our document control procedure.
qa.zh: 今天參訪提到的程序，都是 ISO 9001 系統裡的管制文件；紀錄照文件管制程序規定的年限保存。

words.definition: A time chart with an upper and a lower control limit that shows whether a process is in control.

qa.en: We plot the frame welding gap on a control chart every two hours.
qa.zh: 我們每兩小時把車架焊接間隙點在管制圖上。

qa.en: Monitoring a process with control charts and expressing how well it fits inside the specification limits.
qa.zh: 用管制圖盯製程，再用一個指數（Cpk）講製程落在規格內的程度。

qa.en: The key characteristic is monitored by control chart and the process capability index is reviewed monthly.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用管制圖盯，Cpk 每個月檢討。

qa.en: Tool life is controlled by piece count, and the key dimension is monitored on a control chart so that a wear trend is detected before it goes out of specification.
qa.zh: 刀具壽命用件數管，關鍵尺寸用管制圖盯，磨耗趨勢在超規之前就看得出來。

qa.en: The current Cpk for this dimension is 1.52 based on the last thirty subgroups, which is above our internal target of 1.33. The control chart shows no out-of-control points.
qa.zh: 看最近 30 組子群，這個尺寸 Cpk 是 1.52，高於我們內部目標 1.33，管制圖也沒有失控點。

qa.en: All coating pre-treatment processes must follow the control parameters.
qa.zh: 塗裝前處理各項目必須依照管控參數執行。

words.definition: A document listing every characteristic to be controlled, with its specification, measuring method, sample size, frequency, and reaction plan.

qa.en: In-process dimensions are verified with calibrated hand tools at the frequency defined in the control plan.
qa.zh: 製程中的尺寸照管制計畫的頻率，用校驗過的手工量具量。

qa.en: Can you show me the control plan for this part?
qa.zh: 可以給我看這個零件的管制計畫嗎？

qa.en: The control plan says what to check and how often.
qa.zh: 管制計畫上寫要檢查什麼、多久檢一次。

qa.en: The corrective action has been horizontally deployed to all products using the same fixture, and the control plan has been updated accordingly.
qa.zh: 對策已經水平展開到所有用同一個治具的產品，管制計畫也一起更新了。

qa.en: The control plan is built from the FMEA — every high-RPN failure mode must have a corresponding control. It is updated whenever the process or the design changes.
qa.zh: 管制計畫是從 FMEA 展開的：每個高 RPN 的失效模式都要有對應的管制項。製程或設計一改就更新。

qa.en: Yes. The control plan lists each characteristic, the specification, the measuring instrument, the sample size and frequency, and the reaction plan when the result is out of specification.
qa.zh: 可以。管制計畫上面有每項特性、規格、用什麼儀器量、抽幾件、多久量一次，還有超規時怎麼處理。

words.definition: An informal talk between two or more people.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: We had a long conversation about the future.
general.zh: 我們針對未來長談了一番。

general.en: Anita has become more confident after attending the conversation classes.
general.zh: Anita 上完會話課後變得更有自信了。

general.en: You know what? This conversation has changed my mind a little.
general.zh: 你知道嗎？這場對話讓我的想法有點改變了。

general.en: Short conversations build trust.
general.zh: 簡短的交談能建立信任。

general.en: To improve, I decided to keep a record of all the new words I learned and make a note of important phrases. Every day, I repeat these words out loud and try to use them in a conversation with my friends.
general.zh: 為了進步，我決定把我學到的所有新單字記錄下來，並記下重要的片語。每天，我都會大聲朗讀這些單字，並試著在跟朋友的對話中使用它們。

general.en: Finally, I became frustrated and had a face-to-face conversation with him. I told him that the apartment was unsafe... The landlord finally agreed to hire professionals to inspect and repair all the issues.
general.zh: 最後，我感到很挫折，便與他進行了面對面的談話。我告訴他這間公寓不安全……房東終於同意聘請專業人員來檢查並修復所有問題。

qa.en: Withdrawing a number early costs a conversation. Withdrawing it during an audit costs a finding.
qa.zh: 早點撤回數字，代價是講一次；等稽核才撤，代價是一條缺失。

qa.en: Risk: an optimistic detection score hides a high-severity failure mode, and severity 7 with a loose fastener is a safety conversation.
qa.zh: 風險：偵測度給太樂觀，高嚴重度的故障模式就被藏起來了——嚴重度 7 加上螺栓鬆脫，那是安全問題。

qa.en: Two standards are moving at the same time. If you supply any automotive-adjacent customer, or if your customer's group uses IATF as its internal benchmark, you will be asked about both transitions in the same audit conversation.
qa.zh: 兩個標準同時在動。只要你有做汽車相關的客戶，或客戶集團內部拿 IATF 當標竿，稽核時就會在同一段對話裡被同時問這兩個轉版。

words.definition: to deal successfully with a difficult situation.

general.en: After her illness, she couldn't cope with the stress of work.
general.zh: 她生病之後，無法承受工作的壓力。

general.en: I can't cope with my job difficulties.
general.zh: 我無法應付工作上的困難。

words.definition: to change something so that it becomes accurate or right.

general.en: I work with design engineers to correct dimensional inaccuracies.
general.zh: 我與設計工程師合作修正尺寸不準確的問題。

general.en: I frequently investigate appliance malfunctions and work with design engineers to correct dimensional inaccuracies.
general.zh: 我經常會調查設備異常，並與設計工程師合作修正尺寸不準確的問題。

general.en: Students must identify the correct answer from the list.
general.zh: 學生必須從清單中找出正確答案。

general.en: It's important to say words accurately because correct pronunciation helps people understand me better.
general.zh: 準確發音很重要，因為這能讓人更了解我。

general.en: Accurate data is essential for making correct decisions.
general.zh: 準確的數據對於做出正確的決定是不可或缺的。（be essential for + 名詞/V-ing。）

general.en: As a result, we corrected the issue before mass production, preventing a costly recall and potential damage to our client relationship. This improved our production-line efficiency by 15% for that specific model.
general.zh: 結果我們在量產前修正了問題，避免了昂貴的召回與客戶關係受損。這也讓該款產品的生產線效率提升了 15%。

qa.en: We are using different drawings. Let's check which one is correct first.
qa.zh: 我們用的圖不一樣，先確認哪一版才是對的。

qa.en: Update the work instruction to specify the correct oil by product name, application method, and coverage requirement for tube interiors.
qa.zh: 更新 SOP，寫清楚要用哪一支油、怎麼上、管子裡面要塗到什麼程度。

qa.en: Sort them and check the inside. If there is no rust yet, we can still apply the correct oil. If there is rust, they need to be cleaned and re-treated — or scrapped if the rust has pitted the surface.
qa.zh: 翻出來看裡面。還沒鏽的，補上對的油還來得及。已經鏽了的要磨乾淨重新處理——鏽到有坑的就報廢。

qa.en: The permanent corrective action is a new fixture that makes the wrong crank orientation impossible.
qa.zh: 永久矯正措施是新的治具，讓曲柄不可能裝反。

qa.en: We identified the root cause and implemented a permanent corrective action with effectiveness verification.
qa.zh: 根因確認了，永久對策也上了，效果也驗證過了。

qa.en: The welding fixture was loose. We added a daily check as the corrective action.
qa.zh: 焊接治具鬆掉，對策是加每日點檢。

qa.en: The corrective action has been horizontally deployed to all products using the same fixture, and the control plan has been updated accordingly.
qa.zh: 對策已經水平展開到所有用同一個治具的產品，管制計畫也一起更新了。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

qa.en: The permanent corrective action is a new fixture that makes the wrong crank orientation impossible.
qa.zh: 永久矯正措施是新的治具，讓曲柄不可能裝反。

qa.en: We identified the root cause and implemented a permanent corrective action with effectiveness verification.
qa.zh: 根因確認了，永久對策也上了，效果也驗證過了。

qa.en: The welding fixture was loose. We added a daily check as the corrective action.
qa.zh: 焊接治具鬆掉，對策是加每日點檢。

qa.en: The corrective action has been horizontally deployed to all products using the same fixture, and the control plan has been updated accordingly.
qa.zh: 對策已經水平展開到所有用同一個治具的產品，管制計畫也一起更新了。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

words.definition: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.

qa.en: An accelerated corrosion test in which the sample is exposed to a salt fog for a defined number of hours.
qa.zh: 把樣品放進鹽霧箱噴規定的小時數，看會不會生鏽的加速腐蝕測試。

qa.en: Corrosion resistance is verified by neutral salt spray testing per ASTM B117 for the specified duration.
qa.zh: 耐蝕性照 ASTM B117 做中性鹽霧，做到規定的小時數。

qa.en: Internal corrosion is harder to find than surface rust.
qa.zh: 裡面的鏽比外面的難發現。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: Action: work with the chemical supplier to select a vapor-phase corrosion inhibitor (VCI) oil or a rust preventive specifically rated for enclosed cavities. Validate the new product on sample tubes before switching production.
qa.zh: 行動：跟油品供應商要一支 VCI 防鏽油（揮發型的，管子裡面油碰不到的地方也能保護），拿樣品管先驗證再切換產線。

qa.en: Salt eats metal — this is called corrosion.
Corrosion resistance is verified by neutral salt spray testing per ASTM B117 for the specified duration.
qa.zh: 耐蝕性照 ASTM B117 做中性鹽霧，做到規定的小時數。

words.definition: dishonest or illegal behavior by people in power, especially for money
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and much more.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: Maybe, but look at the news. Corruption, politicians taking money under the table...
general.zh: 也許吧，但你看看新聞。貪污、政治人物私下收錢……

general.en: And give it to a bad one and you get corruption.
general.zh: 給一個壞政府，你得到的就是貪污。

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and more terrible things in the world.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: Money isn't the root of all evil; human greed is the problem. Greed for money can lead to bad behavior like corruption.
general.zh: 金錢不是萬惡之源。金錢本身是中性的，只是一個工具，真正的問題是人類的貪婪。對金錢的貪婪會導致像貪污這樣的不良行為。

general.en: Corruption hurts the economy.
general.zh: 貪污會傷害經濟。

words.definition: relating to the way something looks on the outside, not how it works.

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題等。

general.en: Cosmetic surgery is becoming more common these days.
general.zh: 現在整形手術越來越普遍。

general.en: She visited a cosmetic surgeon to change her appearance.
general.zh: 她去找整形外科醫師改變外表。

general.en: A nose job is one of the most common cosmetic operations.
general.zh: 隆鼻是最常見的整形手術之一。

general.en: He thinks cosmetic surgery is a waste of money.
general.zh: 他認為整形手術是浪費錢。

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems, functional defects, and performance-related issues.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題、功能性缺陷，以及性能相關問題。

qa.en: We apply different AQLs by defect class — tighter for critical and major defects, looser for minor cosmetic defects.
qa.zh: 不同缺點等級用不同 AQL：嚴重跟主要缺點抓緊一點，輕微外觀缺點放鬆一點。

words.definition: a doctor who performs operations to change how a person looks.

general.en: She visited a cosmetic surgeon to change her appearance.
general.zh: 她去找整形外科醫師改變外表。

general.en: Many people think about this. They spend a lot of money to see a cosmetic surgeon to change how they look.
general.zh: 許多人都曾想過這個問題。他們花很多錢去找整形外科醫師，改變自己的外表。

general.en: Many people think about this. They spend a lot of money to see a cosmetic surgeon to change how they look.
general.zh: 許多人都曾想過這個問題。他們花很多錢去找整形外科醫師，改變自己的外表。

words.definition: medical operations that change the way a person looks.

general.en: Cosmetic surgery is becoming more common these days.
general.zh: 現在整形手術越來越普遍。

general.en: He thinks cosmetic surgery is a waste of money.
general.zh: 他認為整形手術是浪費錢。

general.en: Some people choose cosmetic surgery to change how they look.
general.zh: 有些人選擇整形手術來改變自己的外表。

general.en: Few subjects divide opinion as quickly as cosmetic surgery. Supporters argue that what a person does with their own body is nobody else's business, and that argument is difficult to dismiss.
general.zh: 很少有話題像整形手術一樣，能這麼快讓意見分裂。支持者主張，一個人如何對待自己的身體不干別人的事，而這個論點很難反駁。

words.definition: All the money lost to scrap, rework, sorting, warranty and complaints.
costing a lot of money, especially more than you expect or want to pay.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: Without insurance, medical expenses can be very costly.
general.zh: 如果沒有保險，醫療費用可能會非常昂貴。

general.en: As a result, we corrected the issue before mass production, preventing a costly recall and potential damage to our client relationship. This improved our production-line efficiency by 15% for that specific model.
general.zh: 結果我們在量產前修正了問題，避免了昂貴的召回與客戶關係受損。這也讓該款產品的生產線效率提升了 15%。

qa.en: We use general level II as the default, tighten to level III for a new supplier or after a quality issue, and use special levels S-1 to S-4 for destructive or costly tests.
qa.zh: 平常用一般水準 II；新供應商或出過問題就加嚴到 III；破壞性或很貴的測試改用特殊水準 S-1～S-4。

qa.en: The supplier must state the country of production for each lot.
qa.zh: 供應商每一批都要寫清楚生產國。

words.definition: land outside towns and cities, with fields and farms.
words.lesson: 20260728 越南寧平旅遊 Tam Coc Trip

general.en: I rented an e-bike and rode around the countryside.
general.zh: 我租了一台電動車在鄉間騎行。

general.en: The festival takes place in spring, so some families also enjoy the nice weather and go for a walk in the countryside. It is a meaningful tradition that helps people stay connected to their family and culture.
general.zh: 這個節日發生在春天，所以有些家庭也會享受好天氣，並到鄉下散步。這是一個有意義的傳統，能幫助人們與他們的家人和文化保持聯繫。

words.definition: two lines of writing, often rhyming, that go together — in Chinese culture often hung on doors for good luck.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: People decorate their homes with red couplets, paper lanterns, and the word "Fu".
general.zh: 之後用春聯、燈籠與「福」字裝飾家裡。

general.en: People decorate their homes with red couplets, paper lanterns, and the word "Fu", which means good fortune.
general.zh: 之後用春聯、燈籠與「福」字裝飾家裡。

general.en: People put red couplets on the door and pray for good luck.
general.zh: 人們把紅色春聯貼在門上並祈求好運。

general.en: Yes, with money inside for good luck. Families also decorate their doors with couplets and hang lanterns.
general.zh: 對，裡面放錢代表好運。家家戶戶也會在門上貼對聯、掛燈籠。

words.definition: The ability to do something that frightens you.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: You need courage to face your fears.
general.zh: 你需要勇氣面對恐懼。

general.en: It takes courage to speak up.
general.zh: 需要勇氣才能開口說話。

words.definition: paid for by an insurance plan instead of by yourself.

general.en: For serious illness or surgery, most of the cost is covered by the insurance.
general.zh: 對於嚴重的疾病或手術，大部分費用都由保險給付。

general.en: Most doctor visits, medicine, and hospital stays are covered by insurance. You only pay a small fee at the counter.
general.zh: 大部分的看診、藥品和住院都由保險支付。你在櫃檯只需要付一小筆錢。

words.definition: to break partially without separating; a line where something has broken

general.en: We need to replace the cracked tiles on the wall.
general.zh: 我們需要更換牆上裂開的磁磚。

general.en: The earthquake shook the buildings and cracked the roads.
general.zh: 地震搖動了建築物，使道路出現裂縫。

general.en: Some of the wall tiles were cracked.
general.zh: 有些牆壁磁磚已經裂開了。

general.en: The earthquake cracked the roads.
general.zh: 地震使道路龜裂。

general.en: The ground shook / cracked.
general.zh: 地面震動／出現裂縫。

qa.en: The supplier must submit an 8D report for the cracked squat rack welds within ten working days.
qa.zh: 供應商必須在十個工作天內提出深蹲架焊道龜裂的 8D 報告。

qa.en: A cracked weld on the squat rack is a major defect; a small paint run is minor.
qa.zh: 深蹲架焊道裂痕是主要缺點；輕微流漆則是次要缺點。

qa.en: The running belt must meet the quality requirement of 100,000 cycles without cracking.
qa.zh: 跑帶必須符合十萬次循環不裂的品質要求。

qa.en: The failure mode is a fatigue crack initiating at the weld toe.
qa.zh: 失效模式是從焊趾開始的疲勞裂紋。

qa.en: We use dye penetrant testing to check the weld for cracks.
qa.zh: 我們用滲透探傷檢查焊道是否有裂縫。

qa.en: Let me separate the facts from the assumptions. Confirmed: the frame cracked at 60,000 cycles. Suspected: insufficient weld penetration. Unverified: the gusset fix.
qa.zh: 我先把事實跟假設分開。確認的：車架在 6 萬次裂了。懷疑的：熔深不足。還沒驗證的：補強板對策。

words.definition: sharp, intermittent pains, often in the abdomen.

general.en: I have stomach cramps and diarrhea.
general.zh: 我有胃絞痛和拉肚子。

qa.en: The permanent corrective action is a new fixture that makes the wrong crank orientation impossible.
qa.zh: 永久矯正措施是新的治具，讓曲柄不可能裝反。

qa.en: We added a poka-yoke pin so the exercise bike crank cannot be fitted the wrong way round.
qa.zh: 我們加了一根防呆銷，讓飛輪車曲柄不可能裝反。

qa.en: The crank assembly is a carry-over design from the previous model.
qa.zh: 曲柄組是沿用上一代機種的設計。

qa.en: One point on the crank assembly before we close this item.
qa.zh: 曲柄組這一項結案前，我有一點要提。

qa.en: The crank assembly is a carry-over, but the previous model recorded eleven field complaints for creaking under load. Carrying the design over carries that failure mode with it.
qa.zh: 曲柄組是沿用件，但上一代有十一件在受力時產生異音的客訴。沿用設計，等於把這個故障模式也一起沿用。

qa.en: The AQL defines the acceptance criteria for each defect class in the sampling plan.
qa.zh: AQL 就是抽樣計畫裡每個缺點等級收不收的標準。

qa.en: We apply general inspection level II by default and switch to tightened inspection when the acceptance criteria are not met.
qa.zh: 預設用一般檢驗水準 II；沒過允收標準就轉加嚴檢驗。

qa.en: The controlled documents that define the required dimensions, tolerances, materials, and acceptance criteria of the product.
qa.zh: 定產品尺寸、公差、材質跟允收標準的管制文件。

qa.en: May I confirm your acceptance criteria for this surface?
qa.zh: 想跟您確認一下，這個面的允收標準是什麼？

qa.en: Turn "everyone knows" items in meeting minutes into tracked open risks with owners and closure criteria.
qa.zh: 會議記錄裡「大家都知道」的事，要變成有人負責、有關閉條件的追蹤風險。

qa.en: The calibration result is within the acceptance criteria.
qa.zh: 校驗結果在允收基準內。

qa.en: We can check the critical items in thirty minutes.
qa.zh: 關鍵項目我們三十分鐘就能驗完。

qa.en: The paint passed the cross-cut adhesion test with grade 5B.
qa.zh: 漆膜以 5B 等級通過百格附著力測試。

qa.en: The cross-cut adhesion test result is 5B, which passes.
qa.zh: 百格附著力測試結果是 5B，合格。

words.definition: involving people from different teams or departments working together.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: My long-term goal is to become a senior quality manager, lead cross-functional teams, and run projects successfully.
general.zh: 我的長期目標是成為資深品管經理，領導跨部門團隊，並成功地完成專案。

general.en: Never. It's cross-functional work. Production, engineering and purchasing all sit in the same meeting.
general.zh: 從來不是。那是跨部門的工作。生產、工程和採購都會坐在同一個會議裡。

general.en: I would like to grow into a senior quality manager, lead cross-functional teams, and ensure that projects are successfully completed.
general.zh: 我希望能成長為資深品管經理，領導跨部門團隊，並確保專案能順利完成。

words.definition: A test that cuts a grid into the coating, applies tape, and removes it to see how much coating peels off.

qa.en: We use the cross-hatch adhesion test per ASTM D3359. The acceptance criterion is class 5B, meaning no coating is removed from any of the one hundred squares.
qa.zh: 我們照 ASTM D3359 做百格，允收標準 5B，就是 100 格都不能有塗層掉下來。

words.definition: the importance of something to a culture.

general.en: Thanksgiving has deep cultural significance in both the U.S. and Canada.
general.zh: 感恩節在美國和加拿大具有深厚的文化意義。

qa.en: Both curing temperature and film thickness shift the final color.
qa.zh: 烘烤溫度跟膜厚都會讓最後的顏色跑掉。

qa.en: Please confirm the curing temperature and the film thickness before the next trial.
qa.zh: 下一次試噴前，請先確認烘烤溫度跟膜厚。

qa.en: Give the process the two variables that move color: curing temperature/time and film thickness. Re-spraying without changing either just reproduces the same deviation.
qa.zh: 會影響顏色的兩個變數交回製程去查：烘烤溫度／時間跟膜厚。這兩個都不動就重噴，只會噴出一樣的偏差。

qa.en: This is a trial, so the useful outcome is not a pass — it is knowing which parameter moved the color. Give me the curing temperature and the film thickness readings from this run.
qa.zh: 這是試噴，重要的不是「過了」，是搞清楚哪個參數讓顏色跑掉。這一次的烘烤溫度跟膜厚數據給我。

words.definition: At the present time; now.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: I'm currently working as a quality engineer at Rexon, a fitness equipment company.
general.zh: 我目前在 Rexon 任職，擔任品質工程師，公司主要從事健身器材相關產品。

general.en: I'm currently working as a quality engineer at Rexon.
general.zh: 我目前在 Rexon 擔任品質工程師。

general.en: I am currently working as a Senior Quality Engineer at Rexon, a leading company in the fitness equipment industry.
general.zh: 我目前在 Rexon 擔任資深品質工程師，這是健身器材產業的領導廠商。

general.en: I visit my family in Changhua once a month because I currently work and live in Taichung, so it takes some time to commute.
general.zh: 我每個月回彰化探望家人一次，因為我目前在台中工作與生活，通勤需要一些時間。

general.en: Some words are difficult to pronounce currently.
general.zh: 目前有些單字很難發音。（are difficult to + 原形 表達某件事做起來很困難；currently 目前。）

general.en: We currently have about 300 employees.
general.zh: 我們目前大約有 300 名員工。

qa.en: We will screen all units currently in our warehouse and in transit.
qa.zh: 我們會把目前所有庫存跟在途的機台篩一遍。

qa.en: We are currently reviewing the updated requirements and evaluating their impact on our quality management system.
qa.zh: 我們正在看更新後的要求，評估對我們品質系統的影響。

qa.en: We can provide material certificates covering grade and composition. Recycled content is not currently declared by all of our suppliers, so we are collecting that data now.
qa.zh: 鋼種和成分的材證我們拿得出來。再生料含量目前不是每家供應商都有申報，我們正在收這部分資料。

general.en: The sponsor offered refunds to compensate the customers.
general.zh: 贊助商提供退款來補償顧客。

general.en: Our customer expressed concern about the quality.
general.zh: 我們的客戶對品質表示擔憂。

general.en: The company gave customers a discount to make up for the delay.
general.zh: 公司給顧客折扣來補償延誤。

general.en: Anita, who is responsible for coordinating with overseas clients, has already emailed the customer to explain the delay.
general.zh: 負責和海外客戶協調的Anita，已經寫信告知客戶延誤的狀況。

general.en: Customers complained about damaged products.
general.zh: 顧客投訴損壞的產品。

general.en: Have you told the customer yet?
general.zh: 你跟客戶說了嗎？

qa.en: We keep general inspection level II unless the customer asks for a tighter level.
qa.zh: 除非客戶要求更嚴的水準，我們維持一般檢驗水準 II 級。

qa.en: The customer will run a quality audit on our exercise bike line next month.
qa.zh: 客戶下個月會來稽核我們的飛輪車生產線。

qa.en: The AQL levels are agreed with the customer and documented in the inspection standard; any change requires customer approval.
qa.zh: AQL 是跟客戶談好、寫進檢驗標準的，要改要客戶點頭。

qa.en: The FMEA is a living document — it is revised after any design change, process change, or customer complaint, and the revision history is retained.
qa.zh: FMEA 是活的文件，設計改、製程改或有客訴就修訂，改版紀錄都留著。

qa.en: Nonconforming product is tagged with a red HOLD tag, moved to the quarantine area, and dispositioned by the MRB as rework, repair, use-as-is (with customer concession), or scrap.
qa.zh: 不合格品貼紅色 HOLD 標籤、移到隔離區，MRB 決定要重工、修理、特採（客戶要同意）還是報廢。

qa.en: We score severity, occurrence, and detection. High-risk items must have an additional control in the control plan, and the FMEA is reviewed after every customer complaint.
qa.zh: 打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。高風險的項目要在管制計畫追加管制；每次客訴後都要回頭看 FMEA。

qa.en: Risk: if this report goes into the PPAP file, the finding surfaces later at a customer audit, and by then the parts are already in mass production.
qa.zh: 風險：這份報告一進 PPAP 檔案，缺失就會等到客戶稽核才爆出來，那時候零件早就量產了。

words.definition: How to answer an auditor's question completely without volunteering information you don't need to.

qa.en: The FMEA is a living document — it is revised after any design change, process change, or customer complaint, and the revision history is retained.
qa.zh: FMEA 是活的文件，設計改、製程改或有客訴就修訂，改版紀錄都留著。

qa.en: We score severity, occurrence, and detection. High-risk items must have an additional control in the control plan, and the FMEA is reviewed after every customer complaint.
qa.zh: 打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。高風險的項目要在管制計畫追加管制；每次客訴後都要回頭看 FMEA。

qa.en: The service team forwards a customer complaint to QA.
Customer-specific requirements are controlled in a separate annex to the control plan.
qa.zh: 客戶特殊要求放在管制計畫的另一份附件裡管。

words.definition: Knives, forks and spoons.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Plastic cutlery is not good for hot food.
general.zh: 塑膠餐具不適合裝熱食。

general.en: The meal came with plastic cutlery.
general.zh: 餐點附了塑膠餐具。

words.definition: Broken or harmed.

general.en: The earthquake damaged many buildings in the city.
general.zh: 地震損毀了城市裡許多建築。

general.en: The drought lasted for three months and damaged many crops.
general.zh: 這場乾旱持續了三個月，損壞了許多農作物。

general.en: Emma, we've got a problem. A customer posted a video about a damaged package, and it already has fifty thousand views.
general.zh: Emma，我們有麻煩了。有位顧客把破損的包裹拍成影片放上網，現在已經五萬次觀看了。

general.en: My file is broken. My file is damaged. I can't open my file.
general.zh: 我的檔案壞了。損壞了，我打不開。

general.en: Customers complained about damaged products.
general.zh: 顧客投訴損壞的產品。

general.en: Around the world, roughly a third of the food that is produced every year is never eaten. Some of it is lost on farms, some is damaged during transport, and a surprising amount is simply thrown away in ordinary kitchens.
general.zh: 在全世界，每年生產的食物大約有三分之一從未被吃掉。有些在農場就損失了，有些在運送過程中受損，而令人意外的是，還有相當多是在普通家庭的廚房裡被直接丟掉。

words.definition: slightly wet — often uncomfortable; ideal conditions for mold growth

general.en: My clothes are still damp after washing.
general.zh: 衣服洗完後還是晾得微濕。

general.en: The clothes smell musty because the room is too damp.
general.zh: 衣服聞起來有一股霉味，因為房間太潮濕了。

general.en: The basement is always a damp room.
general.zh: 地下室總是個潮濕的房間。

general.en: It's been damp and cloudy all week.
general.zh: 這整週都是又濕又陰的天氣。

general.en: The air feels sticky or damp.
general.zh: 高濕度在皮膚上引起的觸覺感受，汗水不易蒸發。

words.definition: The condition of being slightly wet, often inside a building.

general.en: I had also noticed dampness on the living room wall.
general.zh: 我還注意到客廳牆壁上有受潮的現象。

general.en: Yes. There's dampness on the wall too, and the paint is starting to come off.
general.zh: 對。牆上也有濕氣，油漆開始剝落了。

general.en: Dampness like that usually means a pipe is leaking upstairs. I'll call a plumber first thing tomorrow.
general.zh: 這種濕氣通常代表樓上有水管在漏。我明天一早就打給水管工人。

general.en: Dampness in the walls can cause mold to grow.
general.zh: 牆壁潮濕會導致發霉。

general.en: Hello, Mr. Lin. I noticed more dampness on the bedroom wall today.
general.zh: 你好，林先生。我今天發現臥室牆壁上又更潮濕了。

general.en: The dampness caused mold to grow.
general.zh: 潮濕導致了發霉。

general.en: It was. I looked at the data, I weighed the options, and I decided. No emotion, just numbers.
general.zh: 的確是。我看了數據，權衡了選項，然後做了決定。沒有情緒，只看數字。

general.en: Sometimes. Everyone wants to protect their own department. But I've learned to bring data, not opinions.
general.zh: 有時候會。每個人都想保護自己的部門。但我學會了帶數據去，而不是帶意見去。

general.en: Accurate data is essential for making correct decisions.
general.zh: 準確的數據對於做出正確的決定是不可或缺的。（be essential for + 名詞/V-ing。）

general.en: We investigate. I pull the process data, talk to the operators, and try to find the root cause instead of just replacing the bad parts.
general.zh: 我們展開調查。我會調製程數據、跟線上作業員談，設法找出根本原因，而不是只把壞掉的零件換掉。

general.en: Accurate data is essential.
general.zh: 準確的數據是必要的。

qa.en: Our quality circle meets every Friday to review last week's defect data.
qa.zh: 我們的品管圈每週五開會檢討上週的不良數據。

qa.en: SPC data shows the running belt width is drifting toward the upper limit.
qa.zh: 統計製程管制的數據顯示跑帶寬度正往上限偏移。

qa.en: Can you send us the inspection report with the actual data?
qa.zh: 可以把含實測數據的檢驗報告寄給我們嗎？

qa.en: Based on the data, the defect rate is limited to lots produced between March 3rd and 7th.
qa.zh: 從數據看，不良只出在 3/3 到 3/7 生產的那幾批。

qa.en: GR&R measures the whole system — gauge, operator, and method. A new gauge with an unstable fixturing method still gives unreliable data.
qa.zh: GR&R 量的是整個系統：量具、人跟方法。新量具配上不穩的夾持方式，數據照樣不可靠。

qa.en: The GR&R for this caliper check came out at 27%, above the 10% acceptance limit. The measurement system needs improvement before we can trust the data.
qa.zh: 這項卡尺量測的 GR&R 是 27%，超過 10% 的允收上限。量測系統要先改善，數據才能信。

qa.en: Please provide a product data sheet showing this oil is rated for enclosed cavities.
qa.zh: 請提供 TDS，證明這支油可以用在管子裡面。

qa.en: Could you recommend a VCI-type rust-preventive oil or a product specifically rated for enclosed cavities? We need the product data sheet and a sample for validation before switching.
qa.zh: 可否推薦 VCI 型（揮發型）防鏽油、或適合管子內部使用的產品？切換前我們需要 TDS 跟樣品來驗證。

words.definition: to let your mind wander and imagine pleasant things instead of focusing on what you should be doing

general.en: Sometimes Mia daydreams about the future.
general.zh: 有時候 Mia 會對未來做白日夢。

general.en: Ha, that's my favourite daydream. If I won, I would quit my job the same afternoon.
general.zh: 哈，那是我最愛的白日夢。如果我中了，我當天下午就辭職。

words.definition: to take action to solve a problem.

general.en: Tom needs to deal with this problem because it happens frequently.
general.zh: Tom 需要處理這個問題，因為它經常發生。

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題等。

general.en: Using two monitors is an efficient setup for engineers to deal with multiple tasks.
general.zh: 使用兩個螢幕對工程師來說是有效率的配置。

general.en: My manager let me leave work early to deal with a family matter.
general.zh: 主管允許我提早下班去處理家庭事情。

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems, functional defects, and performance-related issues.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題、功能性缺陷，以及性能相關問題。

words.definition: A choice that you make after thinking about it.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Some employees didn't approve of the manager's decision.
general.zh: 一些員工不認可經理的決定。

general.en: She elaborated on the reasons for her decision.
general.zh: 她更完整地解釋了她做決定的原因。

general.en: No decision is made in a vacuum; every choice affects someone else.
general.zh: 沒有任何決定是在真空中做出的，每個選擇都會影響到別人。

general.en: Air traffic control demands fast decisions and steady attention.
general.zh: 飛航管制需要快速決策和穩定的專注力。

general.en: It was a difficult decision to make.
general.zh: 這是一個很難做的決定。

general.en: Emma remained an optimist and believed every challenge was an opportunity to grow. Her positive attitude and smart decisions helped her become a successful leader.
general.zh: Emma 保持樂觀，相信每個挑戰都是成長的機會。她的正面態度和聰明的決定幫助她成為一位成功的領導者。

qa.en: The sample size comes from the lot size and the inspection level; the accept/reject decision comes from the AQL table.
qa.zh: 抽幾件看批量跟檢驗水準；收不收，查 AQL 表。

qa.en: I need the data before I can support this decision.
qa.zh: 要有數據我才能支持這個決定。

qa.en: I need a decision from management on whether we accept this risk.
qa.zh: 這個風險要不要吃，要請主管決定。

qa.en: No nonconforming product can be released without a documented MRB disposition, and any use-as-is decision requires your written concession.
qa.zh: MRB 沒有書面決定，不合格品一件都不放；要特採照用，一定要你們書面同意。

qa.en: Decision: do not sign a requirement you cannot verify. A requirement without an acceptance criterion is a future dispute, not a specification.
qa.zh: 決定：驗證不了的東西不要簽。沒有允收基準的要求不是規格，是以後吵架的題目。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: The updated declaration of conformity will be issued before the first shipment.
qa.zh: 更新後的 DoC 會在第一批出貨前開出來。

qa.en: The auditor asked for objective evidence behind the declared figure.
qa.zh: 稽核員要看填的那個數字背後的客觀證據。

qa.en: We withdrew the declared figure and replaced it with what we can evidence.
qa.zh: 我們撤回原本填的數字，改填拿得出證據的。

words.definition: to make something look more attractive by adding nice things to it.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: People decorate their homes with red couplets, paper lanterns, and the word "Fu", which means good fortune.
general.zh: 之後用春聯、燈籠與「福」字裝飾家裡。

general.en: People decorate their homes with red couplets, paper lanterns, and the word "Fu".
general.zh: 之後用春聯、燈籠與「福」字裝飾家裡。

general.en: Taichung Park was decorated with lanterns to celebrate the Lantern Festival.
general.zh: 台中公園為了慶祝元宵節而掛滿燈籠。

general.en: Yes, with money inside for good luck. Families also decorate their doors with couplets and hang lanterns.
general.zh: 對，裡面放錢代表好運。家家戶戶也會在門上貼對聯、掛燈籠。

words.definition: Giving a lot of time and energy to something.

general.en: She was dedicated to learning and self-improvement.
general.zh: 她很投入於學習與自我提升。

general.en: Emma was a passionate employee who always dreamed of achieving career success. She was dedicated to learning and self-improvement, and her manager encouraged her to maintain a positive mindset and believe in her abilities.
general.zh: Emma 是一位充滿熱情的員工，一直夢想著在職涯上獲得成功。她很投入於學習與自我提升，而她的主管鼓勵她保持正面的心態，並相信自己的能力。

qa.en: My proposal is to approve the carry-over conditional on a dedicated durability test for that failure mode.
qa.zh: 我的提案是：沿用有條件核准，條件是針對這個故障模式做專門的耐久測試。

qa.en: Ask for an error-proofing (poka-yoke) answer: separation, dedicated bins, count-check by weight.
qa.zh: 要他們給防呆的答案：物料隔開、專用料盒、秤重點數。

qa.en: D5: Re-training does not prevent recurrence for a mixing error. We expect an error-proofing action, such as dedicated bins for each bolt length and a weight count-check before sealing.
qa.zh: D5：混料問題，重新訓練防不了再發。我們要的是防呆對策，例如每種長度的螺栓用專用料盒、封箱前秤重點數。

words.definition: 保險開始理賠前，先自費支付的金額

general.en: You must pay the deductible before insurance covers the rest.
general.zh: 在保險支付之前，你必須先支付自負額。

general.en: The policy carries a very high deductible.
general.zh: 這份保單的自負額非常高。

general.en: Patients often need to pay monthly premiums and deductibles before insurance covers costs, and medical expenses can be very expensive, especially without insurance.
general.zh: 病患通常需要支付每月保費與自付額，而且醫療費用通常非常高，尤其是沒有保險時。

qa.en: We found a crack at the corner after deep drawing.
qa.zh: 深引伸後在轉角處發現破裂。

words.definition: having a lot of money (informal).

general.en: If you have a deep pocket, quit your job.
general.zh: 如果你很有錢，就辭職吧。

general.en: If you are fine financially / have a deep pocket, quit your job.
general.zh: 如果你經濟上沒問題／口袋很深的話，就辭職吧。

general.en: We effectively trained operators to reduce cosmetic defects.
general.zh: 我們有效地培訓作業員，以降低外觀缺陷。

general.en: Definitely. Last week, a real defect-rate problem was solved using something I had just learned.
general.zh: 當然有。上週，一個真實的不良率問題就是用我剛學的方法解決的。

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems, functional defects, and performance-related issues.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題、功能性缺陷，以及性能相關問題。

general.en: I look at whether it's cosmetic or a functional defect. A small scratch is one thing. A part that stops working is completely different.
general.zh: 我會看它是外觀問題還是功能性缺陷。一道小刮痕是一回事，零件不能運作就完全是另一回事。

general.en: Last year we had a batch where the housing looked perfect, but the switch failed. That was a functional defect, so we stopped the line.
general.zh: 去年有一批貨的外殼看起來很完美，但開關失效。那是功能性缺陷，所以我們停線。

general.en: Second, it improves appearance, especially for those who have suffered from accidents or were born with defects. Surgery helps them look and feel normal again, which is very important for their mental health.
general.zh: 第二，它能改善外貌，特別是對於那些遭受意外或天生有缺陷的人。手術幫助他們再次看起來並感覺像個普通人，這對他們的心理健康非常重要。

qa.en: The AQL for major defects on this exercise bike order is 1.0.
qa.zh: 這批飛輪車訂單主要缺點的 AQL 是 1.0。

qa.en: A cracked weld on the squat rack is a major defect; a small paint run is minor.
qa.zh: 深蹲架焊道裂痕是主要缺點；輕微流漆則是次要缺點。

qa.en: The Pareto chart shows that paint defects account for 60 % of all rejects.
qa.zh: 柏拉圖顯示烤漆不良佔了所有拒收的 60%。

qa.en: Our quality circle meets every Friday to review last week's defect data.
qa.zh: 我們的品管圈每週五開會檢討上週的不良數據。

qa.en: Adding a jig to the line is defect prevention; sorting bad parts is defect identification.
qa.zh: 在線上加治具是不良預防；挑出不良件是不良辨識。

qa.en: The worst process average defect level that is still treated as acceptable for the purpose of sampling inspection.
qa.zh: 抽檢的時候，製程平均不良率最差還能接受到哪裡，那條線就是 AQL。

words.definition: Finding defects in finished products, the core idea of QC.

qa.en: Adding a jig to the line is defect prevention; sorting bad parts is defect identification.
qa.zh: 在線上加治具是不良預防；挑出不良件是不良辨識。

words.definition: Stopping problems before they occur, the core idea of QA.

qa.en: Adding a jig to the line is defect prevention; sorting bad parts is defect identification.
qa.zh: 在線上加治具是不良預防；挑出不良件是不良辨識。

qa.en: The lot is accepted when the number of defectives is equal to or less than the acceptance number.
qa.zh: 不良數沒超過允收數，這批就收。

qa.en: How do you make sure the defective parts are not shipped?
qa.zh: 你們怎麼確定不良品不會出貨？

qa.en: OK, the line is stopped. Please show me the defective part.
qa.zh: 好，已經停線。請給我看不良品。

qa.en: Ac is the maximum number of defectives that still allows the lot to be accepted; Re is the number at which the lot must be rejected.
qa.zh: Ac 是最多能有幾件不良還可以收；Re 是不良到幾件就一定要退。

qa.en: With Ac = 1 / Re = 2, one defective in the sample is still accepted, but two defectives reject the whole lot — there is no judgement call in between.
qa.zh: Ac＝1／Re＝2 的話，樣本裡 1 件不良還是收，2 件就整批退，中間沒得商量。

qa.en: The sampling plan for this lot is Ac 1 / Re 2. One defective is within the acceptance number, so the lot is accepted. We still record the defect and feed it back to the supplier.
qa.zh: 這批的抽樣計畫是 Ac 1／Re 2，1 件不良還在允收數內，所以收。不過這件不良我們還是會記下來，回饋給供應商。

qa.en: A test that presses an indenter into the surface under a defined load to measure resistance to permanent deformation.
qa.zh: 用規定的力把壓頭壓進表面，看材料多耐壓、會不會凹的測試。

qa.en: Check the total alkalinity of the degreasing solution.
qa.zh: 請檢查脫脂劑的全鹼度濃度。

words.definition: To make something happen later than planned.

general.en: Please don't delay — call the plumber today.
general.zh: 請別拖延——今天就打給水管工人。

general.en: The landlord kept delaying the repairs, saying he didn't have time.
general.zh: 房東一直拖延維修，總說他沒有時間。

general.en: The manager was irritated by the repeated delays in the project.
general.zh: 經理對專案一再延遲感到很惱火。

general.en: The arrival of the flight was delayed by an hour.
general.zh: 班機的抵達時間延誤了一小時。

general.en: The airline company offered a free ticket to compensate for the flight delay.
general.zh: 航空公司提供免費機票來補償航班延誤。

general.en: The company gave customers a discount to make up for the delay.
general.zh: 公司給顧客折扣來補償延誤。

qa.en: I am not asking to delay the programme — I am asking not to file evidence we cannot defend in an audit.
qa.zh: 我不是要延專案，我是不想歸檔一份稽核時我們守不住的證據。

words.definition: A rare or expensive food that is considered especially delicious.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: Stinky tofu is a delicacy.
general.zh: 臭豆腐是一道美食。

words.definition: to leave a place, especially to start a journey.

general.en: In this case, leave has the same meaning as depart from.
general.zh: 在這種情況下，leave 的意思等同於 depart from（離開）。

words.definition: the act or time of leaving a place
words.lesson: 20260708 A Flight Problem 航班旅遊閱讀

general.en: Please check the departure time on your ticket.
general.zh: 請確認你票上的出發時間。

general.en: I waited in the departure lounge before my flight.
general.zh: 登機前我在候機室等候。

general.en: I kept checking the departure board, but my gate had not been announced yet.
general.zh: 我一直看著出境航班看板，但我的登機門還沒公布。

general.en: I try not to panic. I open my laptop and keep working on whatever I can, rather than watching the departure board.
general.zh: 我試著不要慌張。我會打開筆電，繼續做能做的工作，而不是一直盯著出境看板。

general.en: Perfect, it's twenty-three kilos now. Here's your boarding pass. Your departure gate is C12, and boarding starts at ten forty.
general.zh: 很好，現在是二十三公斤。這是您的登機證。您的登機門是 C12，十點四十開始登機。

general.en: Please go to departure gate 12.
general.zh: 請前往 12 號登機門。

words.definition: The door where you board your plane.

general.en: Perfect, it's twenty-three kilos now. Here's your boarding pass. Your departure gate is C12, and boarding starts at ten forty.
general.zh: 很好，現在是二十三公斤。這是您的登機證。您的登機門是 C12，十點四十開始登機。

general.en: Thank you. Is the departure gate far from here?
general.zh: 謝謝。登機門離這裡遠嗎？

general.en: Please go to departure gate 12.
general.zh: 請前往 12 號登機門。

words.definition: The place at the airport where you wait before boarding.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: I waited in the departure lounge before my flight.
general.zh: 登機前我在候機室等候。

general.en: I got to the departure lounge one hour before takeoff.
general.zh: 我在起飛前一小時到達候機室。

qa.en: Any design change (gusset) restarts the reliability clock: plan the re-test time into the schedule honestly.
qa.zh: 只要改設計（加補強板），可靠度測試就要重新起算：重測的時間要老實排進時程。

qa.en: Action: ask that the carry-over be approved with a condition — either a design change or a specific validation test for that failure mode.
qa.zh: 行動：要求沿用改成「有條件核准」——要嘛改設計，要嘛針對這個故障模式安排專門的驗證。

qa.en: FAI is required at new product introduction, after a mold or fixture change, after a design change, and at the start of each shift for critical processes.
qa.zh: 新產品導入、換模／換治具、設計變更，還有關鍵製程每班開線，都要做首件。

qa.en: The control plan is built from the FMEA — every high-RPN failure mode must have a corresponding control. It is updated whenever the process or the design changes.
qa.zh: 管制計畫是從 FMEA 展開的：每個高 RPN 的失效模式都要有對應的管制項。製程或設計一改就更新。

qa.en: The FMEA is a living document — it is revised after any design change, process change, or customer complaint, and the revision history is retained.
qa.zh: FMEA 是活的文件，設計改、製程改或有客訴就修訂，改版紀錄都留著。

qa.en: We perform first article inspection whenever there is a new setup, a mold change, or a design change. Mass production is not released until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 只要重新設定、換模或設計變更，就做首件。品保沒簽首件，不放量產。

qa.en: The current design margin is not enough for the 100,000-cycle target.
qa.zh: 目前的設計裕度不夠撐到 10 萬次。

qa.en: A detection score has to point at a control that actually exists.
qa.zh: 偵測度打幾分，要對得到一道真的有在做的管制。

qa.en: Action: either add the control to the control plan, or re-score detection honestly and let the action priority rise.
qa.zh: 行動：要嘛把這道檢查加進管制計畫，要嘛老實重評偵測度，讓行動優先度升上來。

qa.en: Decision: every detection score must be traceable to a line in the control plan. If the control does not exist, the score is fiction.
qa.zh: 決定：每一個偵測度分數都要能對到管制計畫上的一行。管制不存在，分數就是虛構的。

qa.en: Risk: an optimistic detection score hides a high-severity failure mode, and severity 7 with a loose fastener is a safety conversation.
qa.zh: 風險：偵測度給太樂觀，高嚴重度的故障模式就被藏起來了——嚴重度 7 加上螺栓鬆脫，那是安全問題。

qa.en: We score severity, occurrence, and detection. High-risk items must have an additional control in the control plan, and the FMEA is reviewed after every customer complaint.
qa.zh: 打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。高風險的項目要在管制計畫追加管制；每次客訴後都要回頭看 FMEA。

qa.en: We use a process FMEA. Each potential failure mode is rated for severity, occurrence, and detection. Anything above our action threshold must have a preventive or detection control added to the control plan.
qa.zh: 我們用製程 FMEA，每個可能的失效模式都打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。超過對策門檻的，一定要在管制計畫加預防或偵測的管制。

qa.en: We moved the detection point to before the film application.
qa.zh: 我們把檢出點移到貼保護膜之前。

qa.en: The defect escaped because the detection point was after the film application — the inspection could not physically see it. We have moved the detection point and are verifying whether the film process itself created the scratches.
qa.zh: 不良會流出去，是因為檢出點在貼膜之後——檢驗根本看不到刮傷。我們已經把檢出點往前移，也在確認貼膜這道工序是不是刮傷的來源。

words.definition: the quality of being firm about what you want to achieve

general.en: Her determination helped her succeed against all odds.
general.zh: 她的決心幫助她克服一切困難，取得成功。

words.definition: The process of growing or becoming more advanced.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Education is key to a child's development.
general.zh: 教育是孩子發展的關鍵。

qa.en: The second edition is still in development, so there is no requirement to act on yet. We are tracking it together with the ISO 9001 transition.
qa.zh: 第二版還在寫，目前還沒有要因應的要求。我們會跟 ISO 9001 轉版一起追蹤。

qa.en: We cannot proceed until the deviation is dispositioned.
qa.zh: 這個偏差還沒決定怎麼處理之前，我們沒辦法往下走。

qa.en: We would like to confirm whether the deviation comes from the powder or from our curing parameters.
qa.zh: 問題整包丟給對方（you check it）通常換不到答案。講清楚你要什麼資料、要分清楚哪兩種可能，對方才知道要給什麼。

qa.en: If management still wants a direct release, make it a documented deviation with a named approver — not a verbal favor.
qa.zh: 主管還是要直接放行的話，就走特採——有人具名簽核的那種，不是口頭人情。

qa.en: A deviation must be approved and documented before the lot is released.
qa.zh: 特採要在批次放行前核准、留下紀錄。

qa.en: Give the process the two variables that move color: curing temperature/time and film thickness. Re-spraying without changing either just reproduces the same deviation.
qa.zh: 會影響顏色的兩個變數交回製程去查：烘烤溫度／時間跟膜厚。這兩個都不動就重噴，只會噴出一樣的偏差。

qa.en: The CMM program is version-controlled and the measurement report can be issued in your required format, including the actual value and the deviation for every characteristic.
qa.zh: 三次元程式有版本管制，報告可以照你們要的格式出，每個特性都有實測值跟偏差。

qa.en: We can only use this report under a documented deviation approval.
qa.zh: 這份報告只能在有書面特採核准的情況下用。

words.definition: to give a lot of time, energy, or effort to something

general.en: The farmer devoted all day to chasing the animals around the house.
general.zh: 農夫投入一整天的時間在追趕房子裡的動物。

general.en: The share of income devoted to housing has risen.
