general.zh: 投入在居住上的收入比例已經上升。

general.en: He decided to devote his life to helping others.
general.zh: To give time or effort.（devote... to... 投入於…）

general.en: He devoted his life to helping people in need.
general.zh: 他把一生奉獻給幫助有需要的人。

qa.en: Mount the dial indicator on the magnetic base.
qa.zh: 把百分表固定在磁性座上。

qa.en: Use the dial indicator to check the flatness of the surface.
qa.zh: 用百分表檢查表面的平面度。

words.definition: an illness in which waste from your body is much more liquid than usual and you need the toilet often.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: Drinking contaminated water can cause severe diarrhea.
general.zh: 喝到受污染的水會導致嚴重的腹瀉。

general.en: I think I have food poisoning because I have stomach pain and diarrhea.
general.zh: 我覺得我食物中毒了，因為我肚子痛又拉肚子。

general.en: Diarrhea is often caused by a stomach virus or eating spoiled food.
general.zh: 腹瀉通常是由胃病毒或吃到變質食物造成的。

general.en: Children sometimes get a stomach ache and diarrhea after eating too much ice cream.
general.zh: 小孩有時吃太多冰淇淋後會肚子痛和腹瀉。

general.en: I have stomach cramps and diarrhea.
general.zh: 我有胃絞痛和拉肚子。

general.en: He had diarrhea yesterday.
general.zh: 他昨天拉肚子了。（事情發生在過去，且已經結束了。）

general.en: My laptop died. / My laptop is dead.
general.zh: 我的筆電沒電了（口語；指已經完全沒電、關機了）。

qa.en: We check the die clearance and sharpen the die on schedule.
qa.zh: 我們會檢查模具間隙，照排程研磨模具。

qa.en: Die maintenance is scheduled by shot count, and burr height is checked at first article and at defined intervals during the run.
qa.zh: 模具保養照沖次排，毛邊高度首件要量，量產中也照規定間隔量。

qa.en: The prototype was machined and this lot is die-cast — different process, different first article. FAI follows the process, not the part number.
qa.zh: 原型是 CNC 加工，這批是壓鑄——製程不同就是不同的首件。FAI 跟著製程走，不是跟著料號走。

qa.en: The hinge supplier's sample was machined, but the production version would be die-cast to save cost. Everyone knew this, and it was written in the meeting minutes — as an FYI, not as an open risk.
qa.zh: 鉸鏈供應商送驗的樣品是 CNC 加工件，量產版為了省成本要改壓鑄。這件事大家都知道，也寫進會議記錄了——但是當成「知會一下」，不是當成「還沒關掉的風險」。

qa.en: Design verification was run on the machined samples and passed. The die-cast parts arrived later and went straight into the reliability build, because "the drawing is the same."
qa.zh: DV 用 CNC 樣品做，全部過。壓鑄件比較晚到，因為「圖面一樣」，就直接裝上可靠度測試機。

qa.en: The failed hinge showed porosity at the pivot bore — a die-casting defect the machined samples could never have shown. Verification had validated a part that was not the production part.
qa.zh: 壞掉的鉸鏈軸孔有氣孔——這是壓鑄才會有的缺陷，CNC 樣品根本不可能出現。驗證驗的，不是量產要用的那個零件。

words.definition: problems that are hard to solve.
words.lesson: 20250807 現在進行式與過去進行式

general.en: I can't cope with my job difficulties.
general.zh: 我無法應付工作上的困難。

general.en: Limited vocabulary makes it difficult to express basic ideas clearly; pronunciation difficulties; difficulty forming sentences accurately.
general.zh: 初級：字彙和片語量有限導致無法表達基本想法；某些單字有發音困難；難以準確造句。

general.en: Difficulties in communication in general.
general.zh: 溝通問題：泛指溝通上的困難。

words.translation: 數位千分表／標準型電子分厘卡

qa.en: The digital product passport will carry material composition data for the frame.
qa.zh: DPP 裡會放機架的材料組成資料。

general.en: Q: How do you check product quality? I test the equipment and inspect the dimensions carefully. If I find a problem, I investigate the cause and discuss it with the team.
general.zh: Q: 你如何檢查產品品質？ 我會測試設備並仔細檢查尺寸。如果發現問題，我會調查原因並與團隊討論。

qa.en: We use a caliper to check this dimension.
qa.zh: 這個尺寸我們用卡尺量。

qa.en: In-process dimensions are verified with calibrated hand tools at the frequency defined in the control plan.
qa.zh: 製程中的尺寸照管制計畫的頻率，用校驗過的手工量具量。

qa.en: The first article inspection report covers all dimensions on the drawing and is retained as part of the production record for traceability.
qa.zh: 首件報告圖面上每個尺寸都有，會跟生產紀錄一起存，之後要追都追得到。

qa.en: We use the CMM for first article inspection, for geometric tolerances such as flatness, position and profile, and for any dimension that cannot be measured reliably with hand tools.
qa.zh: 首件、平面度／位置度／輪廓度這些幾何公差，還有手工量具量不準的尺寸，都上三次元。

qa.en: We run a Gage R&R study on the key characteristics. The current result for this dimension is 12% of total variation, which is within the acceptable range for this application.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性我們有做 GR&R。這個尺寸目前是總變異的 12%，以這個用途來說在可接受範圍。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

words.definition: problems related to the size or measurements of a product
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: I work closely with design engineers by providing feedback on dimensional issues.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，提供尺寸相關的回饋。

general.en: Mostly dimensional issues. Parts that are half a millimetre off and then don't fit properly.
general.zh: 大多是尺寸問題。零件差個半毫米，就裝不進去。

general.en: Providing feedback on dimensional issues.
general.zh: 提供尺寸相關的回饋。

words.definition: to have a different opinion.

general.en: I disagree that money is the root of all evil. Money is just a tool; the real problem is human greed and morality.
general.zh: 我不同意金錢是萬惡之源。金錢只是一個工具；真正的問題是人類的貪婪與道德。

general.en: They strongly disagreed with the plan.
general.zh: 他們強烈反對這個計畫。

words.definition: feeling unhappy because something was not as good as expected

general.en: She was disappointed because the project didn't go well.
general.zh: 她感到失望，因為專案進行得不順利。

general.en: Yesterday, she was a little disappointed because a project did not go well. She tried to communicate with her team, but it was difficult.
general.zh: 昨天，她有點失望，因為一個專案進行得不順利。她試著與她的團隊溝通，但很困難。

words.definition: A sudden event that causes great damage or suffering.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: Food and supplies were transported to the disaster zone.
general.zh: 食物和物資被運送到災區。

general.en: It was a disaster. I burned the bottom, and it tasted a little strange.
general.zh: 根本是災難。底部燒焦了，味道也有點怪。

general.en: Yeah, it was a disaster! I was cooking pasta when my phone rang.
general.zh: 對啊，一場災難！我正在煮義大利麵，我的手機就響了。

general.en: You'd pay a ten-euro penalty and take the next one. It's not a disaster.
general.zh: 你要付十歐元的罰款，然後搭下一班。沒那麼嚴重。

general.en: A typhoon can be a terrible disaster.
general.zh: 颱風可能是一場可怕的災難。

general.en: Natural disasters are powerful events that can cause serious damage to people, buildings, and the environment. Some common natural disasters include earthquakes, typhoons, floods, droughts, wildfires, and volcanic eruptions.
general.zh: 天然災害是能對人類、建築物與環境造成嚴重破壞的強大事件。常見的天然災害包括地震、颱風、洪水、乾旱、野火和火山爆發。

words.definition: a feeling of being slightly uncomfortable, either physically or mentally.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: Drinking some hot water might help ease the discomfort in your stomach.
general.zh: 喝點熱水可能會幫助緩解你腸胃的不適。

general.en: I began to notice that discomfort was often a sign that real learning was happening, not a sign to quit.
general.zh: 我開始注意到：不舒服的感覺，往往不是要我放棄的訊號，而是代表真正的學習正在發生。

general.en: I've discovered that discomfort is often simply evidence that real learning is taking place.
general.zh: 我發現，不舒服的感覺，往往只是代表真正的學習正在發生的證據。

general.en: Instead of asking, 'Am I bad at this?', I ask, 'What is this discomfort teaching me?'
general.zh: 我不再問『我是不是很不擅長這件事？』，而是問『這種不舒服的感覺在教我什麼？』

general.en: The staff feels stomach discomfort after lunch.
general.zh: 員工午餐後會感到胃部不適。（可能暗示午餐的食材經常出問題。）

general.en: The staff felt stomach discomfort after lunch yesterday.
general.zh: 員工昨天午餐後感到了胃部不適。（可能是昨天的便當有問題。）

words.definition: 使用一次後即丟棄的物品

general.en: There is a disposable container on the back of his motorcycle.
general.zh: 他的機車後面有一個一次性容器。

general.en: True. I gave that up. But I gained a bigger apartment and a higher disposable income.
general.zh: 沒錯。那些我放棄了。但我換到更大的房子和更高的可支配所得。

words.definition: A disagreement or argument between people, often a serious one.

general.en: They had a serious dispute with their landlord.
general.zh: 他們和房東發生了一場嚴重的爭執。

general.en: I don't want a dispute with a good tenant. If I delay, the damage only gets worse.
general.zh: 我不想和好房客起糾紛。我要是拖延，損害只會更嚴重。

general.en: They are in a legal dispute over the property.
general.zh: 他們為了這處房產在打法律糾紛。

general.en: No, I am very frustrated. The faulty pipe is damaging the wall. If we don't fix it, it might cause a bigger dispute.
general.zh: 不行，我感到很挫折。有缺陷的水管正在損壞牆壁。如果不修，可能會引起更大的糾紛。

general.en: The condition could not be disputed.
general.zh: 那個狀況是無從爭辯的。

general.en: They had a dispute over the rent.
general.zh: 他們為了房租發生爭執。

qa.en: Decision: do not sign a requirement you cannot verify. A requirement without an acceptance criterion is a future dispute, not a specification.
qa.zh: 決定：驗證不了的東西不要簽。沒有允收基準的要求不是規格，是以後吵架的題目。

words.definition: to notice or show how two things are different from each other.

general.en: It's hard to distinguish between AI photos and real photos.
general.zh: 它很難辨別 AI 照片和真人照片的區別。

general.en: It is hard to distinguish AI photos from real ones.
general.zh: 它很難辨別 AI 照片和真人照片的區別。

qa.en: Check the ECN: was the supplier on the distribution list? When was the effective date?
qa.zh: 查 ECN：供應商在發行名單上嗎？生效日是哪一天？

qa.en: The supplier was not on the ECN distribution list.
qa.zh: 供應商不在這份 ECN 的發行名單上。

qa.en: The real corrective action is in our ECN process: the supplier must be on the distribution list and must confirm receipt.
qa.zh: 真正要矯正的是我們的 ECN 流程：供應商一定要在發行名單上，而且一定要回覆確認收到。

words.definition: feeling like everything is turning around you.

general.en: I also feel dizzy when I stand up, and I feel nauseous almost all the time.
general.zh: 我站起來的時候會頭暈，而且幾乎一直覺得噁心想吐。

general.en: I feel dizzy. / I feel nauseous.
general.zh: 我覺得頭暈。／我覺得噁心想吐。

words.definition: to cause damage or a bad effect.

general.en: Changing the rules may do more harm than good.
general.zh: 改變規則可能弊大於利。

words.definition: to do something kind to help someone.

general.en: Could you do me a favour and pick me up some milk from the supermarket?
general.zh: 你能幫我個忙，從超市買些牛奶回來嗎？

general.en: I met a civil servant at the local government office to ask about my documents.
general.zh: 我在當地政府辦公室見了一位公務員，詢問關於我文件的事。

general.en: a backup charger, a downloaded document, a flexible mindset about what "on time" really means.
general.zh: 備用充電器、事先下載好的文件、對「準時」這件事保有彈性的心態。

general.en: Frequent travelers tend to build small routines — a backup charger, offline documents, that sort of thing.
general.zh: 常出差的人往往會建立一些小習慣——備用充電器、離線的文件，諸如此類。

general.en: The document is corrupted and I can't open it.
general.zh: 這份文件毀損了，我打不開。

general.en: The document is corrupted.
general.zh: 這份文件毀損了。

general.en: The document became corrupted.

qa.en: The AQL levels are agreed with the customer and documented in the inspection standard; any change requires customer approval.
qa.zh: AQL 是跟客戶談好、寫進檢驗標準的，要改要客戶點頭。

qa.en: The documented system of procedures, records, and responsibilities that controls quality across the whole company.
qa.zh: 用寫下來的程序、紀錄跟權責分工，管全公司品質的一套系統。

qa.en: No nonconforming product can be released without a documented MRB disposition, and any use-as-is decision requires your written concession.
qa.zh: MRB 沒有書面決定，不合格品一件都不放；要特採照用，一定要你們書面同意。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: A document listing every characteristic to be controlled, with its specification, measuring method, sample size, frequency, and reaction plan.
qa.zh: 把每個要管的特性列出來的文件：規格、怎麼量、抽幾件、多久量一次、出問題怎麼辦。

qa.en: All procedures referenced during this visit are controlled documents within our ISO 9001 system, and the records are retained for the period defined in our document control procedure.
qa.zh: 今天參訪提到的程序，都是 ISO 9001 系統裡的管制文件；紀錄照文件管制程序規定的年限保存。

qa.en: Action: route customer questionnaires through document control, the same as drawings and reports.
qa.zh: 行動：客戶問卷比照圖面和報告，走文管。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: Retention periods are defined in our document control procedure, and the records are traceable to the lot number and the inspector.
qa.zh: 保存年限照文件管制程序，紀錄追得到批號跟檢驗員。

qa.en: All procedures referenced during this visit are controlled documents within our ISO 9001 system, and the records are retained for the period defined in our document control procedure.
qa.zh: 今天參訪提到的程序，都是 ISO 9001 系統裡的管制文件；紀錄照文件管制程序規定的年限保存。

qa.en: Every report shows the specification, the actual value, and the judgement — not just OK/NG. Reports are traceable to the lot number and retained per the document control procedure.
qa.zh: 每份報告都有規格、實測值跟判定，不是只寫 OK／NG。報告追得到批號，照文件管制程序保存。

qa.en: Drawings on the floor are controlled copies with a revision stamp. When a new revision is released, QA collects and destroys the superseded copies on the same day and records the exchange on the document control list.
qa.zh: 現場的圖面都是蓋版次章的管制副本。新版一發，品保當天就把舊版收回來銷毀，換版記在文件管制清單上。

words.definition: A flight that stays inside the same country.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: Domestic flights often have stricter baggage limits.
general.zh: 國內航班的行李限制通常比較嚴格。

general.en: What is the baggage allowance for this domestic flight?
general.zh: 這班國內航班的行李限額是多少？

general.en: Domestic flights have lower weight limits.
general.zh: 國內航班的重量限制較低。

general.en: Excuse me, what is the baggage allowance for this domestic flight?
general.zh: 不好意思，這班國內航班的行李限額是多少？

words.definition: to fall asleep without intending to, often during the day

general.en: I dozed off during the long meeting.
general.zh: 我在冗長的會議中不小心睡著了。

qa.en: A machine that measures a part in three axes with a touch probe and compares the result against the CAD model or drawing.
qa.zh: 用觸發式探針在 X、Y、Z 三軸量工件，再跟 CAD 或圖面比對的量測機。

qa.en: Geometric tolerances are verified on the CMM against the datum scheme specified on the drawing.
qa.zh: 幾何公差用三次元、照圖面指定的基準來驗。

qa.en: The first article inspection report covers all dimensions on the drawing and is retained as part of the production record for traceability.
qa.zh: 首件報告圖面上每個尺寸都有，會跟生產紀錄一起存，之後要追都追得到。

qa.en: We measure them on the CMM using the datum scheme defined on the drawing. The CMM program is fixed, so every part is measured with the same alignment and the same probe path.
qa.zh: 我們用三次元，照圖面定的基準量。程式是固定的，每件都用同樣的基準對齊、同樣的探測路徑。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

qa.en: Only the current revision on the shop floor is valid. Superseded drawings are removed immediately, and any change requires an engineering change notice before production may use it.
qa.zh: 現場只有現行版有效。舊版圖面馬上收掉，要改一定要先發 ECN 才能用在生產。

qa.en: How do you make sure the line is using the latest drawing revision?
qa.zh: 你們怎麼確定現場用的是最新版圖面？

qa.en: Which drawing revision are you inspecting against?
qa.zh: 你是照哪一版圖面在檢驗？

qa.en: Please confirm the latest drawing revision before you start the build.
qa.zh: 投產前請先確認最新圖面版次。

words.definition: a set of rules about what kind of clothes you should wear to an event

general.en: The dress code for the banquet is formal wear.
general.zh: 晚宴的服裝規定是正式服裝。

general.en: Is there a dress code? I don't want to wear the wrong thing.
general.zh: 有服裝規定嗎？我不想穿錯衣服。

words.definition: very light rain; to rain very lightly

general.en: It is drizzling outside, so you only need a light jacket.
general.zh: 外面在下毛毛雨，所以只需要一件薄外套。

general.en: He decided not to wear a raincoat because it was only drizzling.
general.zh: 他決定不穿雨衣，因為只是毛毛雨。

general.en: How's the weather there today? — It's drizzling now, but the forecast says it will clear up this afternoon.
general.zh: 你那邊今天天氣如何？——現在在下毛毛雨，但預報說下午會放晴。（clear up 意指天氣放晴。）

general.en: It is + V-ing / It's + adj.：It is drizzling now. The wind is strong.
general.zh: 現在在下毛毛雨。風很大。

general.en: It is drizzling. / It is sprinkling.
general.zh: 正在下毛毛雨。／正在飄雨。

general.en: It is drizzling outside.
general.zh: 外面正在下毛毛雨。

qa.en: The product still works after the drop test.
qa.zh: 跌落測試後產品仍可正常運作。

words.definition: a long period when there is little or no rain

general.en: The drought lasted for three months and damaged many crops.
general.zh: 這場乾旱持續了三個月，損壞了許多農作物。

general.en: The drought lasted three months and damaged crops.
general.zh: 旱災持續了三個月，農作物受損嚴重。

general.en: The drought lasted three months.
general.zh: 那場旱災持續了三個月。

general.en: Natural disasters are powerful events that can cause serious damage to people, buildings, and the environment. Some common natural disasters include earthquakes, typhoons, floods, droughts, wildfires, and volcanic eruptions.
general.zh: 天然災害是能對人類、建築物與環境造成嚴重破壞的強大事件。常見的天然災害包括地震、颱風、洪水、乾旱、野火和火山爆發。

qa.en: Will you be ready to support our EUDR due diligence before the end of the year?
qa.zh: 年底前你們能配合我們的 EUDR 盡職調查嗎？

qa.en: We retain supplier origin records to support your due diligence.
qa.zh: 我們留著供應商產地紀錄，配合你們的盡職調查。

qa.en: We have identified which of our components fall within the commodity scope and we retain supplier origin records for them. We can supply the data in whatever format your due diligence system requires.
qa.zh: 我們已經確認哪些零組件在範圍內，也留著它們的供應商產地紀錄。你們盡職調查系統要什麼格式，我們都可以配合。

words.definition: 用於說明原因，後面接名詞，相當於 because of

general.en: The news says roads may be closed due to the storm.
general.zh: 新聞說因為風暴的關係，道路可能會封閉。

general.en: The pipe burst due to high pressure, causing water damage.
general.zh: 水管因高壓而爆裂，造成水損。

general.en: Anita's factory near Ho Chi Minh City has been preparing a large shipment that is due to leave for the port on Friday.
general.zh: Anita在胡志明市附近的工廠，一直在準備一批預計週五要出貨到港口的大貨。

general.en: Good plan. By the way, my train was forty minutes late yesterday due to the rain.
general.zh: 好主意。對了，我昨天的火車因為下雨誤點了四十分鐘。

general.en: Mine too. Half the buses were delayed due to flooding near the station.
general.zh: 我的也是。車站附近淹水，害一半的公車都誤點了。

general.en: She is off work due to illness.

qa.en: Certainly. Let me walk you through the durability test area first, and then the environmental chambers.
qa.zh: 當然。先帶您看耐久測試區，接著是環境試驗箱。

qa.en: My proposal is to approve the carry-over conditional on a dedicated durability test for that failure mode.
qa.zh: 我的提案是：沿用有條件核准，條件是針對這個故障模式做專門的耐久測試。

qa.en: The frame completed 100,000 cycles in the durability test.
qa.zh: 車架在耐久測試中完成了十萬次循環。

qa.en: Hey Tom, how's the durability test going? We're on day six, right?
qa.zh: 嘿 Tom，耐久測試跑得怎麼樣？今天第六天對吧？

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

qa.en: The first test is the durability test.
The dust particles on the surface came from the spray booth.
qa.zh: 表面的落塵顆粒來自噴漆室。

words.definition: to get money by working.

general.en: He is earning good money now.
general.zh: 他現在賺很多錢。

words.definition: A sudden, violent shaking of the ground caused by movement of tectonic plates.

general.en: The earthquake damaged many buildings in the city.
general.zh: 地震損毀了城市裡許多建築。

general.en: A tsunami hit the coast after the earthquake.
general.zh: 地震後，海嘯侵襲了海岸。

general.en: The earthquake drill helped students know what to do in an emergency.
general.zh: 地震演練幫助學生知道緊急時該怎麼做。

general.en: The building collapsed during the earthquake.
general.zh: 那棟建築在地震中倒塌了。

general.en: Several residents were trapped inside buildings after the earthquake.
general.zh: 地震後，幾名居民被困在建築物內。

general.en: The earthquake cracked the roads.
general.zh: 地震使道路龜裂。

words.definition: a practice drill to prepare for an earthquake

general.en: The earthquake drill helped students know what to do in an emergency.
general.zh: 地震演練幫助學生知道緊急時該怎麼做。

words.definition: A sound that comes back to you.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: My voice is echoing on the call.
general.zh: 我的聲音在通話中有回音。

general.en: My voice is echoing.
general.zh: 我的聲音有回音。

words.definition: Producing the result that was wanted.

general.en: Taking a short break every hour is an effective tip to reduce eye strain.
general.zh: 每小時休息一下是減少眼睛疲勞的有效方法。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers to investigate the root causes and implement effective solutions.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，進行根本原因分析，並落實有效的解決方案。

general.en: Good communication is the key to effective collaboration.
general.zh: 溝通是有效協作的關鍵。

general.en: Implement effective solutions to ensure alignment with our clients' requirements.
general.zh: 落實有效的解決方案，以確保與客戶需求保持一致。

general.en: Because of her effective communication and constant effort, the team solved the problems efficiently. They finished the project in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 因為她有效的溝通和持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就完成了專案，並收到了老闆的正面回饋。

general.en: Thanks to Emma's effective communication and constant efforts, the team efficiently resolved the issues. They completed the project successfully in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 多虧了 Emma 有效的溝通與持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就順利完成專案，並得到老闆正面的回饋。

qa.en: Check the ECN: was the supplier on the distribution list? When was the effective date?
qa.zh: 查 ECN：供應商在發行名單上嗎？生效日是哪一天？

qa.en: The ECN effective date is October 1st for new builds.
qa.zh: 這張 ECN 從 10 月 1 日起，新投產的批次開始適用。

qa.en: How will you verify that the action is effective?
qa.zh: 你們要怎麼驗證對策有效？

qa.en: Check the ECN: was the supplier on the distribution list? When was the effective date?
qa.zh: 查 ECN：供應商在發行名單上嗎？生效日是哪一天？

qa.en: The ECN effective date is October 1st for new builds.
qa.zh: 這張 ECN 從 10 月 1 日起，新投產的批次開始適用。

words.definition: achieving the right result or goal.

general.en: She communicates effectively with her team.
general.zh: 她和團隊溝通很有效。

general.en: I can now express my ideas more effectively.
general.zh: 我現在能更有效地表達我的想法。

general.en: This medicine works effectively to reduce pain.
general.zh: 這種藥有效地減輕疼痛。

general.en: We need to solve this problem effectively.
general.zh: 我們需要有效地解決這個問題。

general.en: We effectively trained operators to reduce cosmetic defects.
general.zh: 我們有效地培訓作業員，以降低外觀缺陷。

general.en: She also changed the company's procedures so that every product would be checked more effectively and efficiently before delivery. The company also extended its return period and made its refund policy clearer.
general.zh: 她也修改了公司的作業流程，以便每一項產品在交貨之前都能被更有效且更有效率地檢查。公司也延長了退貨期限，並讓退款政策更加清楚。

qa.en: Please send the verification of effectiveness after three consecutive good lots.
qa.zh: 連續三批合格後，請提出有效性驗證資料。

qa.en: We identified the root cause and implemented a permanent corrective action with effectiveness verification.
qa.zh: 根因確認了，永久對策也上了，效果也驗證過了。

qa.en: The 8D must define how the effectiveness will be verified.
qa.zh: 8D 要寫清楚效果要怎麼驗證。

qa.en: Please re-submit by September 5th, including how the effectiveness will be verified over the next five shipments.
qa.zh: 請在 9 月 5 日前重交，並寫清楚後面五批出貨要怎麼驗證效果。

qa.en: We will submit the interim report today with the containment evidence, and the full 8D including effectiveness verification by Friday.
qa.zh: 今天先給暫行報告，附圍堵的證據；完整 8D 含效果確認，週五前給。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

qa.en: We identified the root cause and implemented a permanent corrective action with effectiveness verification.
qa.zh: 根因確認了，永久對策也上了，效果也驗證過了。

qa.en: We will submit the interim report today with the containment evidence, and the full 8D including effectiveness verification by Friday.
qa.zh: 今天先給暫行報告，附圍堵的證據；完整 8D 含效果確認，週五前給。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

words.definition: Working well without wasting time or resources.

general.en: Using two monitors is an efficient setup for engineers.
general.zh: 使用兩個螢幕對工程師來說是有效率的配置。

general.en: Using two monitors is an efficient setup for engineers to deal with multiple tasks.
general.zh: 使用兩個螢幕對工程師來說是有效率的配置。

words.definition: In a way that saves time and effort.

general.en: Digital notebook apps help students to search their study notes efficiently.
general.zh: 數位筆記軟體幫助學生有效率地搜尋學習筆記。

general.en: Skilled professionals help solve problems efficiently and make life much easier.
general.zh: 熟練的專業人員幫助有效率地解決問題，讓生活變得更輕鬆。

general.en: The technician repaired the machine efficiently and saved time.
general.zh: 技師有效率地修理機器並節省時間。

general.en: He manages his time efficiently.
general.zh: 他有效率地管理時間。

general.en: The company uses energy efficiently.
general.zh: 公司有效率地使用能源。

general.en: She also changed the company's procedures so that every product would be checked more effectively and efficiently before delivery. The company also extended its return period and made its refund policy clearer.
general.zh: 她也修改了公司的作業流程，以便每一項產品在交貨之前都能被更有效且更有效率地檢查。公司也延長了退貨期限，並讓退款政策更加清楚。

words.definition: the physical or mental energy that you use to do something

general.en: She believes that with effort, anything is possible.
general.zh: 她相信只要努力，任何事都是可能的。

general.en: Michael is really making an effort with his maths this term.
general.zh: Michael 這學期在數學上真的很努力。

general.en: Because of her constant effort, the team solved the problems.
general.zh: 因為她持續的努力，團隊解決了問題。

general.en: I'm an optimist because I believe most problems can be solved with effort, learning, and patience.
general.zh: 我是樂觀的人，因為我相信多數問題都能靠努力、學習和耐心解決。

general.en: Because of her effective communication and constant effort, the team solved the problems efficiently. They finished the project in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 因為她有效的溝通和持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就完成了專案，並收到了老闆的正面回饋。

general.en: Mia likes to plan her life, but she also enjoys imagining what could happen in a perfect world. She believes that with effort and a little imagination, anything is possible.
general.zh: Mia 喜歡規劃她的生活，但她也喜歡想像在一個完美的世界裡可能會發生什麼事。她相信，只要努力加上一點想像力，任何事情都是可能的。

words.definition: to give more information or details about something.

general.en: She elaborated on the reasons for her decision.
general.zh: 她更完整地解釋了她做決定的原因。

general.en: She asked him to elaborate on his proposal.
general.zh: 她請他針對他的提案再詳細說明。

general.en: Can you elaborate? / She elaborated on the reasons for her decision.
general.zh: 你可以詳細說明嗎？／她更完整地解釋了她做決定的原因。

general.en: Could you elaborate on your idea?
general.zh: 你可以詳細說明你的想法嗎？

general.en: Please elaborate on this problem.
general.zh: 請詳細說明這個問題。

general.en: He elaborated on his experience.
general.zh: 他詳細說明了他的經歷。

words.definition: A person who installs or fixes electrical wires, lights, and power systems.

general.en: An electrician came to fix a faulty electrical wire.
general.zh: 一位電工來修理故障的電線。

general.en: The electrician made sure that all the lights and sockets were safe.
general.zh: 電工確保所有的燈和插座都是安全的。

general.en: I haven't touched it since Monday. Should I call an electrician myself?
general.zh: 我從星期一就沒碰過了。我要自己找電工來嗎？

general.en: It was a long day, but I realized how important it is to have skilled professionals like plumbers, electricians, carpenters, and civil servants. They help solve problems efficiently and make life much easier.
general.zh: 這是漫長的一天，但我意識到擁有像水管工人、電工、木匠和公務員等熟練的專業人員有多麼重要。他們幫助有效率地解決問題，讓生活變得更輕鬆。

words.definition: Devices such as laptops and cameras.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: I have some electronic equipment in my bag.
general.zh: 我的包裡有一些電子設備。

general.en: Yes, I have a camera and some electronic equipment, so I'd like to make sure they're safe.
general.zh: 有，我有一台相機和一些電子設備，所以我想確保它們安全。

qa.en: The operator must be certified before using the electrostatic spray gun.
qa.zh: 操作人員必須通過認證才能使用靜電噴槍。

general.en: Anita, who is responsible for coordinating with overseas clients, has already emailed the customer to explain the delay.
general.zh: 負責和海外客戶協調的Anita，已經寫信告知客戶延誤的狀況。

general.en: I have already emailed them to explain the delay.
general.zh: 我已經寫信告知他們延誤的狀況了。

general.en: In the morning, I answer emails at my desk.
general.zh: 早上我在書桌前回電子郵件。

general.en: When I write business emails, I often consult the dictionary to make sure the grammar is correct.
general.zh: 當我寫商業電子郵件時，我經常查字典以確保文法正確。

general.en: Now, she thinks it is more convenient to use email to send messages quickly. Anna wants to improve her skills, so she can work faster and better.
general.zh: 現在，她認為使用電子郵件快速發送訊息比較方便。Anna 想要提升她的技能，這樣她就能工作得更快更好。

general.en: He also sent an email to the wrong person by mistake. "Please ignore my previous email — it was sent by mistake," he quickly replied. This was frustrating, but Tom stayed calm.
general.zh: 他還不小心把電子郵件寄給了錯誤的人。「請忽略我之前的郵件——那是誤發的，」他迅速回覆。這令人感到沮喪，但 Tom 保持冷靜。

qa.en: Yes. I will send it to you by email today.
qa.zh: 可以，我今天 email 給您。

qa.en: Action: get the agreed method and criterion written back into the specification before signature, not into an email.
qa.zh: 行動：談好的方法跟基準，簽之前要寫回規格書，不要只留在 email。

qa.en: Risk: 'typically', 'around' and 'approximately' in a supplier email are not evidence — they are the supplier's opinion.
qa.zh: 風險：供應商 email 裡的「通常」「大概」「大約」不是證據，那只是供應商的看法。

qa.en: That was an estimate from a supplier email, not a measured value.
qa.zh: 那是供應商 email 裡估的，不是量出來的。

qa.en: Please attach the test report to the email.
qa.zh: 請把測試報告附在郵件中。

qa.en: The 30% figure came from a supplier email rather than from a document, so we are withdrawing it. We can provide the material grade and the mill certificates we hold today.
qa.zh: 30% 這個數字是從供應商 email 來的，不是文件，所以我們撤回。我們今天可以給的是鋼種和手上的材證。

words.definition: A sudden and serious situation that requires immediate action.

general.en: The earthquake drill helped students know what to do in an emergency.
general.zh: 地震演練幫助學生知道緊急時該怎麼做。

general.en: Emergency repairs were being carried out on the transformer outside.
general.zh: 外面的變壓器正在進行緊急維修。

general.en: Always keep a first-aid kit at home in case of emergencies.
general.zh: 家中要常備急救箱，以備不時之需。

general.en: Our school holds an emergency drill every year.
general.zh: 我們學校每年舉行一次緊急演習。

general.en: Call 119 in an emergency.
general.zh: 緊急情況請撥打 119。

qa.en: We test the safety key and the emergency stop.

words.definition: the person or company that you work for and that pays your salary.

general.en: Many people get insurance from their employer. Others buy it by themselves.
general.zh: 許多人的保險是由雇主提供的。其他人則是自行購買。

general.en: Many people get health insurance from their employer. Some people also buy private insurance by themselves.
general.zh: 許多人透過公司取得保險，也有人自行購買私人保險。

general.en: Employers should give more weight to work samples and digital portfolios.
general.zh: 雇主應該把更多權重放在工作實例與數位作品集上。

general.en: Yes, everyone. You pay a small monthly fee, and your employer pays part of it too.
general.zh: 對，每個人都要。你每個月付一筆小額費用，你的雇主也會幫你負擔一部分。

general.en: Your employer covers about sixty percent, so your own part stays affordable.
general.zh: 你的雇主大約負擔六成，所以你自己要付的部分是負擔得起的。

words.definition: to give someone support or confidence to do something.

general.en: Her manager often encouraged her to keep a positive mindset.
general.zh: 她的主管經常鼓勵她保持正面心態。

general.en: Thanksgiving encourages people to express gratitude for the positive things in their lives.
general.zh: 感恩節鼓勵人們對生活中的美好事物表達感恩。

general.en: I passed the test, which was very encouraging.
general.zh: 我通過了測驗，這非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: It was obvious that I was getting better, and that was very encouraging.
general.zh: 很明顯地我正在變得更好，那非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: I passed the English test, which was very encouraging.
general.zh: 我通過了英文測驗，這非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: The teacher always gave us encouraging feedback.
general.zh: 老師總是給我們令人鼓舞的回饋。

words.definition: words or actions that give someone hope or support.

general.en: He gave me a lot of encouragement.
general.zh: 他給了我很多鼓勵。（動詞：encourage 鼓勵）

general.en: Thank you for your encouragement.

words.definition: 使人感到有希望和信心的

general.en: I passed the test, which was very encouraging.
general.zh: 我通過了測驗，這非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: It was obvious that I was getting better, and that was very encouraging.
general.zh: 很明顯地我正在變得更好，那非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: I passed the English test, which was very encouraging.
general.zh: 我通過了英文測驗，這非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: The teacher always gave us encouraging feedback.
general.zh: 老師總是給我們令人鼓舞的回饋。

general.en: Her teacher gave her encouraging feedback.
general.zh: 老師給了她令人鼓舞的回饋。

general.en: Her teacher gave her encouraging feedback, so she felt confident.
general.zh: 老師給了她令人鼓舞的回饋，所以她感到很有自信。

words.definition: 對某事強烈的興趣和積極性

general.en: She shows lots of enthusiasm for her job.
general.zh: 她對工作展現出極大的熱忱。

general.en: She has great enthusiasm for studying.
general.zh: 她對學習有很大的熱忱。

general.en: Enthusiasm helps me stay motivated.
general.zh: 熱忱幫助我保持動力。（help + 受詞 + (to) V，可省略 to；stay + 形容詞 表示「保持…的狀態」。）

words.definition: 充滿興趣與熱情，非常積極投入

general.en: She is very enthusiastic about learning English.
general.zh: 她對學英文非常熱情。

general.en: She became even more enthusiastic after noticing her progress.
general.zh: 她在注意到自己的進步後變得更加熱情。

general.en: He is very enthusiastic about the new project.
general.zh: 他對新計畫非常熱情。

general.en: I was enthusiastic about learning English when I first started.
general.zh: 我剛開始學英文時非常熱情。

general.en: He became even more enthusiastic after noticing his progress in English.
general.zh: 在注意到自己英文的進步後，他變得更加充滿熱忱。（after + V-ing；even more + 形容詞 表示「更加…」。）

general.en: I was very enthusiastic when I started.
general.zh: 當我剛開始學的時候，我充滿了熱情。（名詞：enthusiasm /ɪnˈθuːziæzəm/ 熱情）

words.definition: The natural world, including land, air, and water around us.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: After a while, I got used to the new environment.
general.zh: 過了一陣子，我習慣了新環境。

general.en: We must protect the environment.
general.zh: 我們必須保護環境。

general.en: Lack of an English-speaking environment in Taiwan makes progress risky or stagnant without regular usage. To reduce stress, speak English with colleagues. In real speaking contexts, prioritize fluency over grammar.
general.zh: 在台灣缺乏全英語環境，不常使用容易停滯；可以和同事說英文提升流利度；實際口語溝通中，流暢度優先於完美的文法（課堂上老師仍會糾正文法）。

general.en: Natural disasters are powerful events that can cause serious damage to people, buildings, and the environment. Some common natural disasters include earthquakes, typhoons, floods, droughts, wildfires, and volcanic eruptions.
general.zh: 天然災害是能對人類、建築物與環境造成嚴重破壞的強大事件。常見的天然災害包括地震、颱風、洪水、乾旱、野火和火山爆發。

qa.en: Ask for an error-proofing (poka-yoke) answer: separation, dedicated bins, count-check by weight.
qa.zh: 要他們給防呆的答案：物料隔開、專用料盒、秤重點數。

words.definition: To become bigger or more serious.

general.en: Take action before small issues escalate.
general.zh: 在小問題擴大之前先採取行動。

general.en: Then staying silent is the worst option. If we wait, this will escalate fast.
general.zh: 那保持沉默就是最糟的選擇。我們再等下去，事情會很快擴大。

qa.en: We have not received a response after two follow-ups, so I am escalating this to your management.
qa.zh: 追了兩次都沒回音，所以我把這件事往你們主管那邊提了。

qa.en: Write down the reporting threshold and the escalation path — who decides, and within how many days.
qa.zh: 通報門檻和升級路徑寫進程序書 —— 誰決定、幾天內要決定。

qa.en: Once the threshold is reached, we escalate the case to the quality manager.
qa.zh: 一到門檻，我們就把案子升級給品保經理。

qa.en: We analyse complaint and incident data by model and failure mode on a monthly basis. Once a defined threshold is reached, the case is escalated to our quality manager for a reportability assessment.
qa.zh: 我們每個月照機種和故障模式分析客訴和事故資料。一到我們訂的門檻，案子就升級給品保經理，評估要不要通報。

qa.en: The case has been escalated to our quality manager for a reportability decision.

words.definition: The control that should have detected the defect but did not.

qa.en: The escape point is our final inspection — the noise test was not performed on this exercise bike model.
qa.zh: 流出點在我們的最終檢驗 —— 這個飛輪車機種沒有做噪音測試。

qa.en: Verify the escape point honestly: could outgoing inspection have seen it through the film?
qa.zh: 老實查流出點：隔著保護膜，出貨檢驗到底看不看得到？

qa.en: Containment is in place for warehouse and in-transit units, replacements are on the way, and the escape point has been identified. The 8D will follow within five working days.
qa.zh: 庫存跟在途機台的圍堵已經做了，替換件已經寄出，流出點也找到了。8D 五個工作天內給。

words.definition: completely necessary; extremely important

general.en: Money is essential for daily life because food, education, and healthcare all require it.
general.zh: 金錢對日常生活是必要的，因為食物、教育和醫療都需要錢。

general.en: Accurate data is essential for making correct decisions.
general.zh: 準確的數據對於做出正確的決定是不可或缺的。（be essential for + 名詞/V-ing。）

general.en: Money is essential for daily life.
general.zh: 金錢對日常生活是必要的。

general.en: "Money makes the world go round." Money is essential because daily necessities like food, education, and healthcare all require it. People cannot survive without it.
general.zh: 「金錢讓世界運轉。」金錢是必要的，因為食物、教育、醫療這些日常必需品都需要錢。人們沒有錢無法生存。

general.en: Accurate data is essential.
general.zh: 準確的數據是必要的。

general.en: Money makes the world go round. — This idiom means money is a crucial, essential element for life and society to function. It's necessary for basic needs like food, education, and healthcare.
general.zh: 金錢讓世界運轉。這句諺語表示金錢是生活與社會運作不可或缺的關鍵要素，食物、教育、醫療等基本需求都需要它。

words.definition: A person who helps people buy, sell, or rent houses and apartments.

general.en: The estate agent showed me several apartments and advised on good neighborhoods.
general.zh: 房地產仲介帶我看了幾間公寓，並針對優質的社區提供建議。

words.definition: To leave a dangerous place, or to help people leave a dangerous place.

general.en: Residents were told to evacuate immediately.
general.zh: 居民被告知立即撤離。

general.en: We had to evacuate the building during the fire drill.
general.zh: 緊急演習時，我們必須撤離大樓。

general.en: The whole town was evacuated after the earthquake warning.
general.zh: 地震警報發布後，整個小鎮都被疏散了。

general.en: We practice evacuation drills at school every year.
general.zh: 我們每年在學校進行逃生演練。

general.en: The volcanic eruption forced thousands of people to evacuate.
general.zh: 火山爆發迫使數千人撤離。

general.en: This is the first time Anita has evacuated her apartment.
general.zh: 這是Anita第一次撤離她的公寓。

words.definition: a practice drill for evacuating a building in an emergency

general.en: We practice evacuation drills at school every year.
general.zh: 我們每年在學校進行逃生演練。

general.en: I've discovered that discomfort is often simply evidence that real learning is taking place.
general.zh: 我發現，不舒服的感覺，往往只是代表真正的學習正在發生的證據。

qa.en: The sample submission package includes dimensional, material, and performance evidence plus the process documents.
qa.zh: 樣品承認資料有尺寸、材質、性能的數據，還有製程文件。

qa.en: Decision: a carry-over is a decision, not a default. It needs the same evidence as a new design.
qa.zh: 決定：沿用是一個決定，不是預設值——要跟新設計一樣拿得出證據。

qa.en: A signed warrant does not replace the missing evidence.
qa.zh: PSW 簽了，不代表缺的資料可以不用補。

qa.en: The package of evidence submitted to the customer to prove the process can consistently make parts to specification before mass production is approved.
qa.zh: 量產核准前交給客戶的一整包資料，證明製程能穩定做出合規格的東西。

qa.en: We will submit the interim report today with the containment evidence, and the full 8D including effectiveness verification by Friday.
qa.zh: 今天先給暫行報告，附圍堵的證據；完整 8D 含效果確認，週五前給。

qa.en: Two things: the bezel is now inspected before the film goes on, and the film application itself is being checked as a possible scratch source. The 8D with evidence will reach you within five working days.
qa.zh: 兩件事：儀表框改成貼膜前先驗；貼膜這道工序本身也在查，看是不是刮傷就是它造成的。附證據的 8D 五個工作天內給您。

words.definition: morally very bad, or something morally very bad
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: I think if all the world's money was shared out, there would be less evil and more happiness.
general.zh: 我認為如果全世界的錢都被分配出去，邪惡會減少，快樂會更多。

general.en: They also say that money is the root of all evil.
general.zh: 人們也說金錢是萬惡之源。

general.en: Tom, do you know the expression “money is the root of all evil”?
general.zh: Tom，你知道那句話嗎：「金錢是萬惡之源」？

general.en: That's not money being evil. That's people being greedy.
general.zh: 那不是錢在作惡，那是人在貪心。

general.en: They also say that "money is the root of all evil". I think this is so true. Money makes people kill and steal.
general.zh: 人們也說「金錢是萬惡之源」。我認為這非常真實。金錢讓人殺人、偷竊。

general.en: I think if all the world's money was shared out, the world would go round more happily, and there would be less evil and more happiness.
general.zh: 我認為如果全世界的錢都被分配出去（共享），世界運轉起來會更快樂，邪惡會減少，快樂會更多。

words.definition: to develop gradually over a period of time.

general.en: How has your role evolved over the past ten years?
general.zh: 在過去十年中，你的職位／角色是如何成長或變化的？

words.definition: To be more than a set limit.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: It's twenty-four kilos, so it exceeds our limit by one kilo. I'm afraid there's an excess baggage fee.
general.zh: 是二十四公斤，超過我們的限重一公斤。恐怕要收超重行李費。

general.en: Your bag must not exceed 7 kg.
general.zh: 你的包不能超過 7 公斤。

general.en: Your carry-on bag must not exceed 7 kg.
general.zh: 你的手提行李不能超過 7 公斤。

qa.en: The color difference is ΔE 2.4, which exceeds our limit of 2.0.
qa.zh: 色差 ΔE 2.4，超過我們 2.0 的上限。

qa.en: The color difference is ΔE 2.4 against the master panel, which exceeds our limit of 2.0. The parts need to be re-sprayed.
qa.zh: 「不一樣、再噴一次」沒有判定依據，對方可以跟你吵到底差多少。把量測條件、數值、規格上限、後面要驗什麼講清楚，判定才站得住。

qa.en: The value exceeds the upper limit, so it is NG.
qa.zh: 數值超出上限，判定不合格。

qa.en: The reading exceeded the limit, so we stopped the machine.
qa.zh: 讀值超出上限，所以我們停機了。

qa.en: The burr height must not exceed 0.1 mm.
qa.zh: 毛邊高度不可超過 0.1 mm。

qa.en: The noise must not exceed 85 dB.
qa.zh: 噪音不得超過 85 分貝。

words.definition: Extra money you pay when your bag is too heavy.

general.en: If your bag is too heavy, you may pay excess baggage fees.
general.zh: 如果行李太重，你可能要付超重行李費。

general.en: It's twenty-four kilos, so it exceeds our limit by one kilo. I'm afraid there's an excess baggage fee.
general.zh: 是二十四公斤，超過我們的限重一公斤。恐怕要收超重行李費。

general.en: Oh no. How much is the excess baggage fee?
general.zh: 糟糕。超重行李費要多少錢？

general.en: If your bag is too heavy, you may have to pay excess baggage fees.
general.zh: 如果行李太重，你可能要付超重行李費。

words.definition: To give something back to a shop and get a different one instead.

general.en: I'd like to exchange this shirt for a larger size.
general.zh: 我想把這件襯衫換成大一號的。

general.en: Excuse me, I'd like to exchange this shirt.
general.zh: 不好意思，我想換這件襯衫。

general.en: What is the exchange rate today?
general.zh: 今天的匯率是多少？

qa.en: Drawings on the floor are controlled copies with a revision stamp. When a new revision is released, QA collects and destroys the superseded copies on the same day and records the exchange on the document control list.
qa.zh: 現場的圖面都是蓋版次章的管制副本。新版一發，品保當天就把舊版收回來銷毀，換版記在文件管制清單上。

words.definition: -ed adjective: describes how a person feels when looking forward to something

general.en: She is excited because she has never had her own balcony.
general.zh: 她很興奮，因為她從來沒有自己的陽台。

general.en: The kids are excited about going to the zoo.
general.zh: 孩子們對於要去動物園感到很興奮。

general.en: The kids were excited about the trip. / The game was exciting.
general.zh: 孩子們對這次旅行很興奮。／那場比賽很刺激。

general.en: The kids were excited about the trip.
general.zh: 孩子們對這次旅行很興奮。

general.en: Last spring, I traveled to Kyoto, Japan with two of my friends. We stayed there for five days and had an amazing experience. It was my first time visiting Japan, so I was very excited.
general.zh: 去年春天，我和兩個朋友一起去了日本京都旅遊。我們在那裡待了五天，度過了一段美好的時光。這是我第一次訪問日本，所以我非常興奮。

general.en: Now Amy has saved enough for the deposit on a bigger apartment. She found one near a park, so she can go running in the morning. She is excited because she has never had her own balcony before.
general.zh: 現在Amy已經存夠了押金，可以租一間大一點的公寓。她找到一間在公園旁邊的，所以早上可以去跑步。她很興奮，因為她從來沒有自己的陽台。

words.translation: 令人興奮的（事物的特質）
words.definition: -ing adjective: describes what causes excitement; ≠ exiting (離開中)

general.en: The lucky draw is the most exciting part of the night.
general.zh: 抽獎是整晚最令人興奮的部分。

general.en: The lucky draw is the most exciting part.
general.zh: 抽獎是最令人興奮的部分。

general.en: Riding a roller coaster is an exciting activity.
general.zh: 搭雲霄飛車是一項令人興奮的活動。

general.en: On the one hand, living in a city is exciting because there are many activities. On the other hand, it can be noisy and expensive.
general.zh: 一方面，住在城市很令人興奮，因為有很多活動。另一方面，它可能會很吵雜且花費昂貴。（另例：On the one hand, eating out is convenient. 一方面，外食很方便——動名詞片語當主詞視為單數。）

general.en: The game was exciting.
general.zh: 那場比賽很刺激。

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year. The atmosphere is lively and festive. The boss gives a speech, and we all make a toast together. The lucky draw is the most exciting part, and everyone has a great time.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。氣氛非常熱鬧且充滿節慶感。老闆會上台致詞，然後我們大家一起敬酒。抽獎是最令人興奮的部分，每個人都玩得很開心。

words.definition: extremely tired, with no energy left at all
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: I don't snore unless I am extremely exhausted.
general.zh: 除非我極度疲憊，否則我不會打呼。

general.en: Tom tends to snore when he's exhausted.
general.zh: 湯姆精疲力竭時傾向於打呼。

general.en: You look exhausted. Rough morning?
general.zh: 你看起來筋疲力盡。今天早上不太順嗎？

words.definition: to be real or present.

general.en: Does phone separation anxiety really exist?
general.zh: 手機分離焦慮真的存在嗎？

general.en: Our backup checklist, which barely existed a year ago, has already been used several times this season.
general.zh: 我們的備援檢查清單，一年前根本還沒成形，這一季已經被用過好幾次了。

qa.en: In spec today, but the trend says out of spec next week. SPC exists so we act on the trend, not on the rejects.
qa.zh: 今天在規格內，但趨勢看起來下週就會超規。SPC 就是要看趨勢動手，不是等不良品出來。

qa.en: A detection score has to point at a control that actually exists.
qa.zh: 偵測度打幾分，要對得到一道真的有在做的管制。

qa.en: Detection was scored 2, but no control exists for that characteristic.
qa.zh: 偵測度給了 2 分，但那個特性根本沒人在管。

qa.en: If the control does not exist yet, we should score it as if it does not exist.
qa.zh: 管制還沒有，分數就要照「沒有」來打。

qa.en: Decision: every detection score must be traceable to a line in the control plan. If the control does not exist, the score is fiction.
qa.zh: 決定：每一個偵測度分數都要能對到管制計畫上的一行。管制不存在，分數就是虛構的。

qa.en: The reliability program did exactly what it exists to do — it caught a field failure before the field did. The cost of the six-week finding is a re-test; the cost of skipping it would have been a home-use safety recall.
qa.zh: 可靠度測試做到了它該做的事——在市場之前先把市場失效抓出來。第六週才發現，代價是一次重測；跳過它的代價，是一場家用安全召回。

words.definition: costing a lot of money.

general.en: The soup was hot and the beef was soft. It cost 130 dollars. That is not expensive for lunch.
general.zh: 湯很燙，牛肉很軟。花了 130 元。這個午餐價格不貴。

general.en: Some do. Private insurance helps with things the NHI doesn't cover, like a single room or expensive cancer drugs.
general.zh: 有些人會。私人保險可以支付健保不給付的項目，像是單人病房或昂貴的癌症用藥。

general.en: We couldn't afford to live in London. It's too expensive.
general.zh: 3. 我們負擔不起住在倫敦，太貴了。

general.en: He bought his wife an expensive gift to make it up to her.
general.zh: 他買了一份昂貴的禮物來補償她。

general.en: Patients often need to pay monthly premiums and deductibles before insurance covers costs, and medical expenses can be very expensive, especially without insurance.
general.zh: 病患通常需要支付每月保費與自付額，而且醫療費用通常非常高，尤其是沒有保險時。

general.en: None of this means that expensive insurance is automatically better. It means that a price cannot be judged without the conditions attached to it. The most useful question is not "How much is it?" but "What exactly happens if I need it?"
general.zh: 這一切並不表示貴的保險自動就比較好。它的意思是：價格無法脫離附帶條件被評斷。最有用的問題不是「這要多少錢？」而是「如果我真的需要用到，究竟會發生什麼？」

words.definition: To no longer be valid or usable.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: He checked the milk and noticed that it had expired two days ago.
general.zh: 他檢查了牛奶，並注意到它兩天前就已經過期了。

general.en: He checked the milk and noticed that it had expired two days ago. The vegetables also looked soft and wilted.
general.zh: 他檢查了牛奶，發現兩天前就已經過期了。蔬菜看起來也變得十分軟爛且枯萎。

general.en: I can't travel because my passport has expired.
general.zh: 因為我的護照過期了，我無法出國旅行。

general.en: The milk had expired two days ago.
general.zh: 牛奶兩天前就已經過期了。

general.en: The return period had expired.
general.zh: 退貨期限已經過了。

general.en: My passport has expired.
general.zh: 我的護照過期了。

qa.en: The submission is therefore recorded as interim approval, limited to 500 pieces and expiring on 30 September 2026.
qa.zh: 所以這次我們先記為暫准，限 500 件，效期到 2026 年 9 月 30 日。

qa.en: Exactly. And look at the date — that's when it expires.
qa.zh: 沒錯。看一下日期，那是到期日。

words.definition: to make something clear to someone.

general.en: I explained to her why I was late, but she didn't accept my apology.
general.zh: 我向她解釋為什麼我遲到了，但她沒有接受我的道歉。

general.en: A sales representative called to explain the new service plan.
general.zh: 一位業務代表打電話來說明新的服務方案。

general.en: Anita, who is responsible for coordinating with overseas clients, has already emailed the customer to explain the delay.
general.zh: 負責和海外客戶協調的Anita，已經寫信告知客戶延誤的狀況。

general.en: I have already emailed them to explain the delay.
general.zh: 我已經寫信告知他們延誤的狀況了。

general.en: Later, Emma's manager asked about her experience. She explained that success does not happen by luck. Intelligent people learn from their mistakes, understand the symptoms of problems, and take action before small issues become big ones.
general.zh: 後來，Emma 的主管詢問了她的經驗。她解釋說成功不是靠運氣。聰明的人從錯誤中學習，了解問題的症狀，並在小問題變成大問題之前採取行動。

general.en: The change is small, but the result is clear. She hardly ever feels sleepy in the afternoon now, and she says her mind feels quieter. "I am not doing anything difficult," she explains. "I am just starting the day in a different order."
general.zh: 這個改變很小，但結果很明顯。她現在幾乎不會在下午覺得睏，她說自己的思緒感覺比較平靜。「我沒有在做什麼困難的事，」她解釋，「我只是換了一個開始一天的順序。」

qa.en: Explain it to the line in their language: we are acting now so that we do not sort ten pallets next week.
qa.zh: 用產線聽得懂的話解釋：現在處理，是為了下週不用去挑十個棧板。

qa.en: We noticed the side-rail material looks different from the approved sample. Can you explain?
qa.zh: 我們發現側條材料跟承認樣品不一樣，可以說明一下嗎？

qa.en: This change was not approved. Please explain what changed and when.
qa.zh: 罵人的「very bad」沒有資訊量。專業的講法是先定性（沒經過核准）、再要事實（改了什麼、什麼時候），資深的講法還會把之後的規矩一次講清楚。

qa.en: Let me explain how to use this instrument step by step.
qa.zh: 我一步一步說明這台儀器怎麼使用。

qa.en: Can you explain what happened here?
qa.zh: 可以說明一下這裡發生什麼事嗎？

qa.en: Decide what re-qualification is needed — at minimum material certification, and possibly UV and impact testing for outdoor-exposed parts.
qa.zh: 決定要重新驗證哪些——至少要材證，外露件可能還要做 UV 跟衝擊測試。

words.definition: Being seen or noticed by many people.

general.en: It's already going viral. The question is what kind of exposure we get from it.
general.zh: 它已經在瘋傳了。問題是我們從中拿到什麼樣的曝光。

general.en: Honestly, this could turn into good exposure if we handle it right.
general.zh: 老實說，如果處理得好，這反而可能變成不錯的曝光。

general.en: The brand sponsors the TV show because it wants more exposure.
general.zh: 該品牌贊助電視節目，因為它想要更多曝光。

general.en: The company wanted to gain more exposure.
general.zh: 公司想要獲得更多曝光。

general.en: Views are a metric; exposure is the goal.
general.zh: views 是可以數的指標，exposure 是策略目標

general.en: The brand wants more exposure.
general.zh: 該品牌想要更多曝光。

words.definition: to show that you are thankful.

general.en: Thanksgiving encourages people to express gratitude for the positive things in their lives.
general.zh: 感恩節鼓勵人們對生活中的美好事物表達感恩。

words.definition: a word or phrase used in a particular way.
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: Coper and Anita learn new words and expressions every day.
general.zh: Coper 和 Anita 每天學習新的單字和片語。

general.en: "Money makes the world go round" is a famous English expression.
general.zh: 「金錢讓世界運轉」是一句著名的英語表達。

general.en: Tom, do you know the expression “money is the root of all evil”?
general.zh: Tom，你知道那句話嗎：「金錢是萬惡之源」？

general.en: Right. So the expression is wrong. Money isn't the root of all evil. It's a mirror.
general.zh: 沒錯。所以那句話是錯的。金錢不是萬惡之源，它是一面鏡子。

general.en: "Money makes the world go round." I wonder if this famous English expression is very true.
general.zh: 「金錢讓世界運轉（有錢能使鬼推磨）。」我想知道這句著名的英語表達是否非常真實。

general.en: That is a common English expression.
general.zh: 那是一句常見的英文說法。

qa.en: Please send the gauge blocks out for external calibration.
qa.zh: 請將塊規送外校。

words.definition: Pain or tiredness in your eyes from using them too much.

general.en: Taking a short break every hour is an effective tip to reduce eye strain.
general.zh: 每小時休息一下是減少眼睛疲勞的有效方法。

words.definition: a situation in which something does not work correctly or does not succeed.

general.en: This communication failure became a significant obstacle.
general.zh: 這次的溝通失敗成了一大阻礙。

general.en: Failure is an inevitable part of business.
general.zh: 失敗是做生意中無可避免的一部分。

general.en: The situation was an unexpected failure.
general.zh: 這個情況是一個意料之外的失敗。

general.en: Every failure can be a fresh start.
general.zh: 每次失敗都可以是一個全新的開始。

general.en: Although the situation was an unexpected failure, the manager had a positive mindset. She was an optimist and believed that every problem could become an opportunity to improve.
general.zh: 儘管這次情況是一個意料之外的失敗，經理擁有正面的心態。她是個樂觀的人，相信每個問題都能成為進步的機會。

general.en: One day, Emma's team faced a crisis during an important project. Miscommunication issues among team members led to project delays, creating extra work and stress. This communication failure became a significant obstacle.
general.zh: 有一天，Emma 的團隊在一個重要專案中遇到了危機。團隊成員之間的溝通不良導致專案延誤，製造了額外的工作與壓力。這次的溝通失敗成了一大阻礙。

qa.en: A structured risk analysis that lists potential failure modes, their effects and causes, and scores them to set priorities.
qa.zh: 把可能出的失效、影響跟原因一條條列出來，打分數排優先順序的風險分析。

qa.en: Please update the PFMEA to include this failure mode, and review whether the current controls are adequate.
qa.zh: 請把這個失效模式更新進 PFMEA，並檢視現行管制是否足夠。

qa.en: This failure has never happened before. Why should we add it to the FMEA?
qa.zh: 這個失效從來沒發生過，為什麼要加進 FMEA？

qa.en: The control plan is linked to the FMEA, so every significant failure mode identified in the FMEA is covered by a control in production.
qa.zh: 管制計畫跟 FMEA 是連動的，FMEA 找出來的重大失效模式，量產都有對應的管制。

qa.en: The control plan is built from the FMEA — every high-RPN failure mode must have a corresponding control. It is updated whenever the process or the design changes.
qa.zh: 管制計畫是從 FMEA 展開的：每個高 RPN 的失效模式都要有對應的管制項。製程或設計一改就更新。

qa.en: We use a process FMEA. Each potential failure mode is rated for severity, occurrence, and detection. Anything above our action threshold must have a preventive or detection control added to the control plan.
qa.zh: 我們用製程 FMEA，每個可能的失效模式都打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。超過對策門檻的，一定要在管制計畫加預防或偵測的管制。

qa.en: A structured risk analysis that lists potential failure modes, their effects and causes, and scores them to set priorities.
qa.zh: 把可能出的失效、影響跟原因一條條列出來，打分數排優先順序的風險分析。

qa.en: Please update the PFMEA to include this failure mode, and review whether the current controls are adequate.
qa.zh: 請把這個失效模式更新進 PFMEA，並檢視現行管制是否足夠。

qa.en: Risk: if the failure mode carries over and the new model sells more, the same defect rate produces more complaints.
qa.zh: 風險：故障模式跟著沿用，新機種又賣得更多，同樣的不良率客訴只會更多。

qa.en: The control plan is linked to the FMEA, so every significant failure mode identified in the FMEA is covered by a control in production.
qa.zh: 管制計畫跟 FMEA 是連動的，FMEA 找出來的重大失效模式，量產都有對應的管制。

qa.en: The control plan is built from the FMEA — every high-RPN failure mode must have a corresponding control. It is updated whenever the process or the design changes.
qa.zh: 管制計畫是從 FMEA 展開的：每個高 RPN 的失效模式都要有對應的管制項。製程或設計一改就更新。

qa.en: We use a process FMEA. Each potential failure mode is rated for severity, occurrence, and detection. Anything above our action threshold must have a preventive or detection control added to the control plan.
qa.zh: 我們用製程 FMEA，每個可能的失效模式都打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。超過對策門檻的，一定要在管制計畫加預防或偵測的管制。

words.definition: A risk study that lists how a design or process can fail and ranks each risk before it happens.
to drop down from something.

general.en: What would you do if a ceiling tile fell off at your home?
general.zh: 如果你家的天花板磁磚掉下來，你會怎麼做？

general.en: The picture fell off the wall.
general.zh: 圖畫從牆上掉下來。

words.definition: Extremely interesting or attractive.

general.en: I hope to explore even more of this fascinating city one day.
general.zh: 我希望有一天能進一步探索這座迷人的城市。

general.en: At the end of the trip, I felt a little sad because I didn't want to leave. However, I also felt grateful for the wonderful memories. I hope to visit Kyoto again one day and explore even more of this fascinating city.
general.zh: 在旅程的尾聲，我感到有一點點傷感，因為我不想離開。然而，我也對這些美好的回憶充滿感激。我希望有一天能再次造訪京都，並進一步探索這座迷人的城市。

words.definition: following the latest styles and trends in clothing or lifestyle

general.en: There are many shops that sell fashionable clothes in this area.
general.zh: 這一帶有很多賣時尚衣服的商店。

general.en: The season is beautiful in spring, and there are many shops that sell fashionable clothes. Living here helped me improve my skills, like communication and patience.
general.zh: 這裡春天的季節很美，而且有很多賣時尚衣服的商店。住在這裡幫助我提升了技能，像是溝通和耐心。

words.translation: 熟睡中（也可說 sound asleep）
words.definition: sleeping very deeply at this moment
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: She was fast asleep when I got home.
general.zh: 我到家時她正熟睡著。

general.en: She was fast asleep / sound asleep.

words.definition: To close or attach something firmly.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請繫好安全帶。

general.en: Yes, please, and fasten your seat belt. We'll be taking off in about ten minutes.
general.zh: 是的，麻煩您，並且繫好安全帶。我們大約十分鐘後起飛。

general.en: Please fasten your seatbelt before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請繫好安全帶。

general.en: Try to stay relaxed and keep your seat belt fastened. Many passengers find that listening to music or watching a movie helps.
general.zh: 試著保持放鬆並繫好安全帶。很多乘客發現聽音樂或看電影會有幫助。

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt.
general.zh: 請繫好安全帶。

general.en: Please fasten your seatbelt.

words.definition: Not working correctly because of a problem or defect.

general.en: An electrician came to fix a faulty electrical wire.
general.zh: 一位電工來修理故障的電線。

general.en: A faulty socket near water isn't safe at all. Please don't use it.
general.zh: 靠近水的插座故障非常不安全，請千萬不要用它。

general.en: Faulty wiring is a common cause of house fires.
general.zh: 線路故障是住宅火災的常見原因。

general.en: The fire started because of faulty wiring.
general.zh: 火災因線路故障引起。

general.en: No, I am very frustrated. The faulty pipe is damaging the wall. If we don't fix it, it might cause a bigger dispute.
general.zh: 不行，我感到很挫折。有缺陷的水管正在損壞牆壁。如果不修，可能會引起更大的糾紛。

qa.en: QA signs the feasibility review before the quotation goes out.
qa.zh: 報價送出去之前，品保要先簽可行性評估。

words.definition: Comments about how well you did something.

general.en: They received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 他們得到老闆正面的回饋。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers by providing feedback on dimensional issues.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，提供尺寸相關的回饋。

general.en: The teacher always gave us encouraging feedback.
general.zh: 老師總是給我們令人鼓舞的回饋。

general.en: She has been given detailed feedback by her instructor after every quiz.
general.zh: 她每次小考後都會收到老師詳細的回饋意見。

general.en: Anna usually feels stressed at work, but today she feels relieved. Her manager gave her good feedback, so she is happy.
general.zh: Anna 通常在工作時感到壓力很大，但今天她感到如釋重負。她的經理給了她很好的回饋，所以她很高興。

general.en: Because of her effective communication and constant effort, the team solved the problems efficiently. They finished the project in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 因為她有效的溝通和持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就完成了專案，並收到了老闆的正面回饋。

words.definition: 圍繞某個區域的木頭或金屬柵欄

general.en: Many fences were blown down during the storm last night.
general.zh: 昨晚暴風雨中，許多柵欄被吹倒了。

general.en: Be careful, the old fence might fall down in the strong wind.
general.zh: 小心，那道舊圍籬可能會被強風吹倒。

general.en: The strong wind blew over the fence.
general.zh: 強風把圍籬吹倒了。

words.definition: a special day or period when people celebrate something, often with food and traditions.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: Chinese New Year is the most important festival in Taiwan.
general.zh: 農曆新年是台灣最重要的節日。

general.en: People believe this festival brings good luck, health, and happiness for the new year.
general.zh: 人們相信它會帶來新一年的好運、健康與幸福。

general.en: Some cities hold lantern festivals with beautiful shows.
general.zh: 許多城市會舉辦燈節，有精彩的表演。

general.en: Taichung Park was decorated with lanterns to celebrate the Lantern Festival.
general.zh: 台中公園為了慶祝元宵節而掛滿燈籠。

general.en: Granted, the festival brings money to the town.
general.zh: 誠然，那個節慶為小鎮帶來收入。

general.en: Chinese New Year is the most important festival in Taiwan. It usually comes in January or February and lasts for several days. People believe this festival brings good luck, health, and happiness for the new year.
general.zh: 農曆新年是台灣最重要的節日。通常在一月或二月，並持續好幾天。人們相信它會帶來新一年的好運、健康與幸福。

words.definition: having a happy, celebratory feeling, like at a holiday party

general.en: The decorations give the hall a very festive atmosphere.
general.zh: 這些裝飾讓大廳充滿了節慶的氣氛。

general.en: Semi-formal is fine. Most people wear red or something festive.
general.zh: 半正式就可以了。大部分的人會穿紅色或有節慶感的衣服。

general.en: I can't wait. It sounds like a really festive two weeks.
general.zh: 我等不及了。聽起來是非常有節慶氣氛的兩個星期。

general.en: The atmosphere is lively and festive.
general.zh: 氣氛熱鬧又有節慶感。

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year. The atmosphere is lively and festive. The boss gives a speech, and we all make a toast together. The lucky draw is the most exciting part, and everyone has a great time.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。氣氛非常熱鬧且充滿節慶感。老闆會上台致詞，然後我們大家一起敬酒。抽獎是最令人興奮的部分，每個人都玩得很開心。

words.definition: a body temperature that is higher than normal.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: He took a day off from work because he had a high fever.
general.zh: 他因為發高燒而請了一天假。

general.en: The manager is running a high fever right now.
general.zh: 經理現在正發著高燒。

general.en: This morning my daughter had a fever, so I could not go to work.
general.zh: 今天早上我女兒發燒，所以我不能去上班。

general.en: I've been feeling unwell since yesterday evening. I think I have a fever.
general.zh: 我從昨天傍晚就一直不太舒服。我覺得我在發燒。

general.en: I think I also have a fever.
general.zh: 我想我也發燒了。

general.en: My daughter had a fever.

words.definition: feeling hot and unwell because your body temperature is higher than normal.
words.lesson: 20260310 英文八大時態與健康症狀 Tenses & Symptoms

general.en: Amy felt a bit feverish, so she decided to go home early.
general.zh: Amy覺得有點發燒，所以她決定早點回家。

general.en: Flu: feeling weak, feverish, tired; Migraine: headache with nausea or light sensitivity; Depression: mental illness causing sadness, fatigue.
general.zh: 流感：虛弱、發燒、疲倦；偏頭痛：頭痛伴隨噁心或畏光；憂鬱症：造成悲傷與疲勞的心理疾病。

qa.en: We had eleven field complaints of the same failure mode.
qa.zh: 同一個故障模式我們有十一件市場客訴。

qa.en: The previous model generated eleven field complaints of creaking. Here they are on one chart.
qa.zh: 上一代有十一件異音客訴，我整理在同一張圖上。

qa.en: The crank assembly is a carry-over, but the previous model recorded eleven field complaints for creaking under load. Carrying the design over carries that failure mode with it.
qa.zh: 曲柄組是沿用件，但上一代有十一件在受力時產生異音的客訴。沿用設計，等於把這個故障模式也一起沿用。

general.en: I can't figure out how to use this new software.
general.zh: 我搞不清楚怎麼使用這個新軟體。

general.en: She figured out the puzzle quickly.
general.zh: 她很快就解出了謎題。

general.en: We need to figure out a better plan.
general.zh: 我們需要想出一個更好的計劃。

qa.en: The leg length of this fillet weld is 5 mm, as the drawing requires.
qa.zh: 這道角焊的焊腳長是 5 mm，符合圖面要求。

qa.en: Use the fillet weld gauge to check the throat thickness.
qa.zh: 用角焊規檢查焊喉厚度。

qa.en: Use the fillet weld gauge to check the throat thickness.
qa.zh: 用角焊規檢查焊喉厚度。

general.en: Watching foreign films helps me learn new words and phrases.
general.zh: 看外國的電影有助於我學習新單字和片語。

general.en: I enjoy watching foreign films because I learn new phrases.
general.zh: 我喜歡看外國電影，因為能學到新片語。（from a country that is not your own）

general.en: I also like to experiment with different learning methods. Sometimes I watch foreign films, sometimes I read English articles, and sometimes I listen to podcasts. I also revise my notes regularly to make sure I remember the words.
general.zh: 我也喜歡嘗試不同的學習方法。有時候我看外語片，有時候我讀英文文章，有時候我聽 Podcast。我也會定期複習我的筆記，以確保我記住了這些單字。

qa.en: The thickness of the cured coating film, measured on the finished part in microns.
qa.zh: 成品上塗膜烤乾後的厚度，用微米量。

qa.en: Dry film thickness is measured at defined positions and recorded on the process control sheet.
qa.zh: 乾膜厚在指定位置量，記在製程管制表上。

qa.en: Re-check film thickness and adhesion after the re-spray — a double coat is not the film you qualified.
qa.zh: 重噴後要重新確認膜厚跟附著力——疊上去的雙層膜，不是當初驗證過的那層膜。

qa.en: Dry film thickness is measured at five defined positions including the inside corners, and every point must meet the minimum specification.
qa.zh: 乾膜厚量五個指定位置（含內角），每一點都要到規格最小值。

qa.en: Give the process the two variables that move color: curing temperature/time and film thickness. Re-spraying without changing either just reproduces the same deviation.
qa.zh: 會影響顏色的兩個變數交回製程去查：烘烤溫度／時間跟膜厚。這兩個都不動就重噴，只會噴出一樣的偏差。

qa.en: The specified dry film thickness is 60 to 100 microns. We measure five fixed points per part, including the inside corners, and every single point must meet the minimum.
qa.zh: 規格乾膜厚 60～100 微米。每件量五個固定點，內角也算，每一點都要到最小值。

qa.en: A second coat causes film thickness build-up, so we re-check adhesion.
qa.zh: 再噴一層會造成膜厚疊加，所以我們要重驗附著力。

words.definition: Coffee made by passing hot water through ground coffee.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: It takes me five minutes to make filter coffee.
general.zh: 我泡濾泡咖啡要花五分鐘。

general.en: My boss prefers filter coffee for its rich flavor.
general.zh: 我老闆比較喜歡濾泡式咖啡的濃郁風味。

general.en: I make filter coffee for myself every morning.
general.zh: （日常準備）我每天早上為自己泡濾泡式咖啡。

words.definition: a practice drill to prepare for a fire emergency

general.en: We had a fire drill at the office this morning.
general.zh: 我們今天早上在辦公室進行了消防演練。

general.en: We had to evacuate the building during the fire drill.
general.zh: 緊急演習時，我們必須撤離大樓。

words.definition: A full dimensional and functional check of the first piece produced after a new setup, before mass production is released.
The percentage of units that pass a process the first time, with no rework or retest.
A cause-and-effect chart that sorts possible causes into man, machine, material, and method.
machines or tools used for exercising the body
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: I'm currently working as a quality engineer at Rexon, a fitness equipment company.
general.zh: 我目前在 Rexon 任職，擔任品質工程師，公司主要從事健身器材相關產品。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材。

general.en: Inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: I am currently working as a Senior Quality Engineer at Rexon, a leading company in the fitness equipment industry.
general.zh: 我目前在 Rexon 擔任資深品質工程師，這是健身器材產業的領導廠商。

general.en: Q: Tell me about your job. / Can you walk me through your professional background? I work as a quality engineer at a fitness equipment company. I have worked there for ten years. My job is to check product quality and solve problems.
general.zh: Q: 跟我談談你的工作。/ 請你簡述一下你的職涯背景。 我在一家健身器材公司擔任品質工程師。我在那裡工作了十年。我的工作是檢查產品品質並解決問題。

qa.en: Routine tests are done in our own lab; certification tests such as EN 957 or EN ISO 20957 for fitness equipment are done by an accredited third-party laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內實驗室做；健身器材 EN 957／EN ISO 20957 這種認證測試，送有認證的第三方實驗室。

qa.en: Connected fitness equipment increasingly ships with AI features — form detection, adaptive training, camera-based safety stops. If a feature is safety-related, it can pull the whole product into the high-risk category.
qa.zh: 聯網健身器材越來越常帶 AI 功能：姿勢辨識、自適應訓練、鏡頭安全停機。只要功能跟安全有關，就可能把整台機器拉進高風險那一類。

qa.en: Connected fitness equipment is machinery. Placing on the market is decided by the date the unit enters the EU market, not the date it was designed — so units built in late 2026 for Q1 2027 shipment are already exposed.
qa.zh: 聯網健身器材就是機械。「投放市場」看的是機器進歐盟市場的日期，不是設計日期 —— 所以 2026 年底做、2027 年第一季出的機台，現在就已經中了。

words.definition: A person whose job is to look after passengers on a plane.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: A flight attendant filled my cup with apple juice.
general.zh: 一位空服員把我的杯子倒滿蘋果汁。

general.en: The flight attendant cleared the trash after the meal.
general.zh: 空服員在餐後收走垃圾。

general.en: The flight attendants wrap the food in aluminum foil to keep it warm.
general.zh: 空服員用鋁箔紙包住食物來保溫。

general.en: The flight attendants wrap the food in aluminum foil.
general.zh: 空服員用鋁箔紙包住食物。

general.en: The flight attendant demonstrated how to use a life jacket.
general.zh: 空服員示範如何使用救生衣。

general.en: The roads are flooded after the typhoon.
general.zh: 颱風過後道路被淹沒了。

general.en: The roads are flooding right now — don't drive!
general.zh: 道路正在淹水——不要開車！

general.en: The basement was flooded after the storm.
general.zh: 暴風雨後地下室被淹了。

general.en: The gym was used as a shelter during the flood.
general.zh: 體育館在洪水期間被用作避難所。

general.en: Many volunteers helped clean up after the flood.
general.zh: 許多志工在洪水過後協助清理。

general.en: Thousands of affected families are still waiting for help after the flood.
general.zh: 水災過後，數千個受影響的家庭仍在等待援助。

words.definition: 水已經蓋住某處，描述完成的狀態

general.en: The roads are flooded after the typhoon.
general.zh: 颱風過後道路被淹沒了。

general.en: The basement was flooded after the storm.
general.zh: 暴風雨後地下室被淹了。

general.en: Yes. The access road has been flooded, and trucks have been blocked outside the gate.
general.zh: 對，聯外道路淹水了，卡車被困在大門外面。

general.en: Many trees were blown down, and some streets were flooded.
general.zh: 許多樹被吹倒，部分街道發生淹水。

general.en: Trees were blown down; streets were flooded.
general.zh: 樹木被吹倒；街道淹水。

general.en: The roads are flooded.
general.zh: 路面被淹沒了。（靜態結果：水已經蓋住路面了）

words.definition: 水正在上漲、淹上來的過程

general.en: The roads are flooding right now — don't drive!
general.zh: 道路正在淹水——不要開車！

general.en: Heavy rain caused flooding in several parts of the city.
general.zh: 大雨造成市區好幾個地方淹水。

general.en: Mine too. Half the buses were delayed due to flooding near the station.
general.zh: 我的也是。車站附近淹水，害一半的公車都誤點了。

general.en: After the typhoon, the roads are flooding.
general.zh: 颱風後，道路正在積水。（進行式，強調過程）

general.en: Last Wednesday there was a typhoon, so we did not go to work. The wind was very strong and the rain was heavy all morning. My mother called me because she was worried about the flooding near our house.
general.zh: 上週三有颱風，所以我們沒有去上班。風很大，整個早上雨都下得很大。我媽打電話給我，因為她擔心我們家附近會淹水。

general.en: The roads are flooding.
general.zh: 道路正在淹水。（動態進行：水正在上漲）

words.definition: 不規律地變化，忽高忽低

general.en: The weather has been fluctuating a lot recently.
general.zh: 最近天氣一直忽冷忽熱。

general.en: His mood tends to fluctuate when he is under a lot of stress.
general.zh: 他壓力大時情緒容易起伏不定。

general.en: Gas prices fluctuate every week.
general.zh: 油價每週波動。

general.en: The weather is fluctuating.
general.zh: 最近天氣忽冷忽熱／不穩定。

words.definition: in a smooth way, without stopping or making mistakes, when speaking a language

general.en: She practices every day, so she will speak English fluently soon.
general.zh: 她每天練習，所以很快就會說得很流利。

general.en: Let me try one. If I spoke English fluently, I would apply for that job in Singapore.
general.zh: 我試一句。如果我英文說得流利，我就會去應徵新加坡那個工作。

general.en: Perfect. And you don't speak fluently yet, so the sentence stays imaginary - that's why we use would.
general.zh: 完美。而且你還沒說得流利，所以這句話還停留在想像 - 這就是為什麼用 would。

words.definition: To clean a toilet by making water pass quickly through it.

general.en: The toilet wasn't flushing properly, so we called a plumber.
general.zh: 馬桶沖水不順，所以我們叫了水管工人。

general.en: Remember to flush the toilet after you use it.
general.zh: 用完廁所記得沖水。

general.en: The toilet won't flush, so we need a plumber.
general.zh: 馬桶沖不了水，所以我們需要水電工。

words.definition: A structured risk analysis that lists potential failure modes, their effects and causes, and scores them to set priorities.

qa.en: That works. Let's follow up next Wednesday.
qa.zh: 可以。我們下週三再追蹤。

words.definition: an illness caused by eating food that contains harmful bacteria.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: Several people got food poisoning from the seafood at the restaurant.
general.zh: 有幾個人因為吃了那家餐廳的海鮮而食物中毒。

general.en: I think I have food poisoning because I have stomach pain and diarrhea.
general.zh: 我覺得我食物中毒了，因為我肚子痛又拉肚子。

general.en: That's a very common symptom pattern after greasy street food. I think you have food poisoning.
general.zh: 吃完油膩的路邊小吃之後，這是很常見的症狀組合。我認為你是食物中毒。

general.en: Is food poisoning serious? Do I need to stay in the hospital?
general.zh: 食物中毒嚴重嗎？我需要住院嗎？

general.en: Eating bad sushi caused food poisoning and vomiting last night.
general.zh: 昨晚吃到壞掉的壽司導致了食物中毒和嘔吐。

general.en: The customer suffers from food poisoning.
general.zh: 這位顧客受食物中毒所苦。

words.definition: 對未來天氣等狀況的預測說明

general.en: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
general.zh: 天氣預報說明天會下雨。

general.en: The forecast predicts snow in the afternoon.
general.zh: 天氣預報預測下午會下雪。

general.en: A big typhoon is coming to Taiwan this weekend. Tom checks the weather app every morning. There is heavy rain in the forecast.
general.zh: 這個週末有一個大颱風要來台灣。Tom每天早上都會看天氣App。預報顯示會有大雨。

general.en: Have you seen the forecast for this weekend? We're supposed to go hiking on Saturday.
general.zh: 你看了這個週末的天氣預報嗎？我們星期六本來要去爬山。

general.en: The forecast calls for rain tomorrow.
general.zh: 天氣預報明天下雨。

general.en: There is heavy rain in the forecast.
general.zh: 預報顯示會有大雨。

words.definition: Used to say that something good happened by chance; luckily.

general.en: Fortunately, I realized quickly and went back to get my bag.
general.zh: 幸好，我很快就發現並回去拿了包包。

general.en: Fortunately, no one was injured in the accident.
general.zh: 幸好，事故中沒有人受傷。

general.en: Fortunately, a kind stranger helped me find the station.
general.zh: 幸好，一位好心的陌生人幫我找到了車站。

general.en: Fortunately, I had kept a photo of the map.
general.zh: 幸好，我保存了地圖的照片。

general.en: Of course, not everything went smoothly. On the third day, I accidentally left my backpack in a café. Fortunately, I realized it quickly and went back to get it. The staff had kept it safe for me, and I was very relieved.
general.zh: 當然，並非一切都很順利。第三天，我不小心把背包忘在一間咖啡廳裡。幸好我很快就發現並回去拿。店員幫我保管得很好，讓我鬆一口氣。

words.definition: to help something grow or develop over time
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: Good communication fosters strong teamwork.
general.zh: 良好的溝通能促進強大的團隊合作。

general.en: In the corporate world, events serve as crucial milestones for celebrating achievements, fostering team spirit, and strengthening company culture.
general.zh: 在企業世界中，各種活動扮演著重要的里程碑角色，用來慶祝成就、培養團隊精神，以及強化公司文化。

words.definition: Easily broken or damaged.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: Please put a fragile label on the box, because it contains cups.
general.zh: 請在箱子上貼易碎標籤，因為裡面裝了杯子。

general.en: Of course. Let me help you. Is there anything fragile inside?
general.zh: 當然。讓我幫您。裡面有易碎的東西嗎？

general.en: Please handle this box with care; it's fragile.
general.zh: 請小心搬這個箱子，它很易碎。

general.en: Is there anything fragile inside?
general.zh: 裡面有易碎的東西嗎？

general.en: One of the biggest challenges in my role is resolving quality issues within a limited time frame.
general.zh: 在我的工作中，最大的挑戰之一是需要在有限的時間內解決品質問題。

general.en: Resolving quality issues within a limited time frame.
general.zh: 在有限的時間內解決品質問題。

general.en: I initiated a comprehensive inspection protocol, personally tested the electronic components, and documented a dimensional discrepancy in the frame.
general.zh: 我啟動了一套完整的檢驗流程，親自測試電子零件，並記錄了車架的尺寸偏差。

qa.en: As a containment action we sorted all treadmill frames in the warehouse and put the suspect lot on hold.
qa.zh: 作為圍堵措施，我們把倉庫裡所有跑步機機架全檢，並扣留可疑批次。

qa.en: Ac is 5 and Re is 6, so six scratched frames means we reject the whole lot.
qa.zh: Ac 是 5、Re 是 6，所以出現六件刮傷機架就要拒收整批。

qa.en: We plot the frame welding gap on a control chart every two hours.
qa.zh: 我們每兩小時把車架焊接間隙點在管制圖上。

qa.en: We use dye penetrant testing on the welded frame — it is a non-destructive test.
qa.zh: 我們對焊接車架做滲透探傷，這是非破壞性檢測。

qa.en: How do you measure the geometric tolerances on this frame?
qa.zh: 這個機架的幾何公差你們怎麼量？

qa.en: For the frame, we propose the static and endurance tests of EN ISO 20957-1 at the declared maximum user mass, and we would like to confirm the value with you.
qa.zh: 機架的部分，我們建議用 EN ISO 20957-1 的靜態跟耐久測試、以標示的最大使用者體重來做，這個數值想跟您確認一下。

words.definition: happening often, many times.

general.en: I frequently investigate appliance malfunctions and work with design engineers to correct dimensional inaccuracies.
general.zh: 我經常會調查設備異常，並與設計工程師合作修正尺寸不準確的問題。

general.en: Tom needs to deal with this problem because it happens frequently.
general.zh: Tom 需要處理這個問題，因為它經常發生。

words.definition: A close relationship between people who like and trust each other.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: I know that our friendship will last a lifetime.
general.zh: 我知道我們的友誼會持續一輩子。

general.en: Cooking dinner together, watching movies in the living room, or celebrating birthdays as a group can create lasting friendships.
general.zh: 一起做晚飯、在客廳看電影或一群人慶祝生日，可以建立持久的友誼。（三個動名詞片語共同作為句子的主詞。）

general.en: Celebrating birthdays as a group can create lasting friendships.
general.zh: 一群人慶祝生日可以建立持久的友誼。

general.en: They have a lasting friendship that began in school.
general.zh: 他們有一段從學校開始的長久友誼。

general.en: Their friendship lasted for 20 years.
general.zh: 他們的友誼持續了20年。

general.en: It can create lasting friendships.
general.zh: 可以建立持久的友誼。

words.definition: 因無法達成目標而感到沮喪，形容人

general.en: I feel frustrated when I can't express my ideas.
general.zh: 當我無法表達想法時，我感到很沮喪。

general.en: I feel frustrated when I can't find the right words in English.
general.zh: 當我找不到正確的英文單字時，我感到很沮喪。

general.en: She felt frustrated because she couldn't get the answer.
general.zh: 她因為得不到答案而感到沮喪。

general.en: He was frustrated when the computer kept crashing.
general.zh: 電腦一直當機讓他很沮喪。

general.en: She felt a little frustrated, so she almost gave up twice.
general.zh: 她覺得有點挫折，所以差點放棄了兩次。

general.en: She has already bought all the ingredients: flour, yeast, salt, and sugar. When she began mixing the dough, her hands got sticky and messy. She felt a little frustrated, so she almost gave up twice.
general.zh: 她已經買齊了所有食材：麵粉、酵母、鹽和糖。當她開始揉麵團時，她的手變得又黏又髒。她覺得有點挫折，所以差點放棄了兩次。

words.definition: 使人感到沮喪的，形容事物

general.en: English grammar can be frustrating at times.
general.zh: 英文文法有時令人感到挫折。

general.en: It's frustrating when you can't understand.
general.zh: 當你聽不懂時，是很令人挫折的。（名詞：frustration 挫折）

general.en: Learning new words is sometimes frustrating, but it's worth it.
general.zh: 學習新單字有時令人沮喪，但這是值得的。

general.en: Learning new words is frustrating.
general.zh: 背單字令人沮喪。

general.en: He also sent an email to the wrong person by mistake. "Please ignore my previous email — it was sent by mistake," he quickly replied. This was frustrating, but Tom stayed calm.
general.zh: 他還不小心把電子郵件寄給了錯誤的人。「請忽略我之前的郵件——那是誤發的，」他迅速回覆。這令人感到沮喪，但 Tom 保持冷靜。
