general.en: But at intermediate level, I made slower progress. There were so many new words and phrases, but also words that I could understand but couldn't use accurately. I think I was more aware of my mistakes, which was good – but also frustrating.
general.zh: 但在中級階段，我的進步變慢了。有好多新的單字和片語，也有很多我聽得懂卻無法準確使用的單字。我想我更加意識到自己的錯誤，這是件好事——但也令人感到挫折。

words.definition: getting back all of the money you paid for something
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: Costco offers a full refund on most items within 30 days.
general.zh: 好市多在30天內針對大多數商品提供全額退款。

general.en: You can get a full refund within 30 days.
general.zh: 30天內你可以獲得全額退款。

words.definition: a fault that stops a product from working the way it should.

general.en: Functional defects and performance-related issues in fitness equipment.
general.zh: 健身器材的功能性缺陷與性能相關問題。

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems, functional defects, and performance-related issues.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題、功能性缺陷，以及性能相關問題。

general.en: I look at whether it's cosmetic or a functional defect. A small scratch is one thing. A part that stops working is completely different.
general.zh: 我會看它是外觀問題還是功能性缺陷。一道小刮痕是一回事，零件不能運作就完全是另一回事。

general.en: Last year we had a batch where the housing looked perfect, but the switch failed. That was a functional defect, so we stopped the line.
general.zh: 去年有一批貨的外殼看起來很完美，但開關失效。那是功能性缺陷，所以我們停線。

words.definition: To get or obtain something, often gradually through effort.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: True. I gave that up. But I gained a bigger apartment and a higher disposable income.
general.zh: 沒錯。那些我放棄了。但我換到更大的房子和更高的可支配所得。

general.en: The company wanted to gain more exposure.
general.zh: 公司想要獲得更多曝光。

general.en: I let my junior inspectors check the parts independently so they could gain more confidence.
general.zh: 我讓資淺的檢驗員獨立檢查零件，讓他們更有信心。

general.en: After a few months, he gained most of the weight back.
general.zh: 幾個月後，他又胖回來大部分體重。

general.en: He wants to gain more experience.
general.zh: 他想獲得更多經驗。

general.en: He gained weight after the surgery.

qa.en: Budget for the standard itself and for the gap assessment in this year's plan, not next year's.
qa.zh: 買標準和做差距評估的錢，編在今年的計畫裡，不要拖到明年。

qa.en: Plan a gap assessment for the weeks after publication, once the final text is available.
qa.zh: 發布後幾週、拿到正式條文時，安排做差距評估。

qa.en: We are conducting a gap assessment against the new requirements.
qa.zh: 我們正在對照新要求做差距評估。

qa.en: We are conducting a gap assessment to identify areas that may require updates before the transition, and we have already contacted our certification body about the transition schedule.
qa.zh: 我們正在做差距評估，找出轉版前要更新的地方，轉版時程也已經去問驗證機構了。

words.definition: The area in an airport where passengers get on their plane.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: I kept checking the departure board, but my gate had not been announced yet.
general.zh: 我一直看著出境航班看板，但我的登機門還沒公布。

general.en: Yes. The access road has been flooded, and trucks have been blocked outside the gate.
general.zh: 對，聯外道路淹水了，卡車被困在大門外面。

general.en: Perfect, it's twenty-three kilos now. Here's your boarding pass. Your departure gate is C12, and boarding starts at ten forty.
general.zh: 很好，現在是二十三公斤。這是您的登機證。您的登機門是 C12，十點四十開始登機。

general.en: Our flight is boarding at Gate B12.
general.zh: 我們的班機在B12登機門登機。

general.en: Please go to departure gate 12.
general.zh: 請前往 12 號登機門。

general.en: Show your boarding pass at the gate.
general.zh: 在登機門出示你的登機證。

qa.en: Before we trust the new thickness gauge, please run a measurement system analysis.
qa.zh: 在信任這台新膜厚計之前，請先做量測系統分析。

qa.en: Every gauge is calibrated. The label shows the next due date.
qa.zh: 每支量具都有校驗，標籤上有下次到期日。

qa.en: Measurement system analysis is repeated whenever the gauge, the fixture, or the operator group changes.
qa.zh: 量具、治具或量的人換了，GR&R 就重做。

qa.en: Calipers, micrometers, height gauges, feeler gauges, and thread gauges used for routine in-process checks.
qa.zh: 卡尺、分厘卡、高度規、厚薄規、螺紋規這些，製程中例行檢查用的量具。

qa.en: Operators use go/no-go gauges and calipers on the line; QA uses micrometers and height gauges for the patrol check. Every tool is zeroed before use and included in the calibration system.
qa.zh: 作業員在線上用通止規跟卡尺；品保巡檢用分厘卡跟高度規。每支量具用之前先歸零，全部都在校驗系統裡。

qa.en: The operator performs a self-check every hour with a go/no-go gauge, and QA performs a patrol inspection every two hours with a caliper and a micrometer. Both results are recorded on the process control sheet.
qa.zh: 作業員每小時用通止規自檢，品保每兩小時用卡尺跟分厘卡巡檢。兩邊的結果都記在製程管制表上。

words.definition: Going to the actual workplace to see the real process before making a decision.
in a soft, calm way that does not cause stress or harm
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: If you have money, the world goes round very gently and you are happy.
general.zh: 如果你有錢，世界會運轉得很溫柔，你會很開心。

general.en: Life goes gently and smoothly with money.
general.zh: 有錢能讓生活變得溫柔（gently）且順利；沒錢則會讓世界運轉不順暢。

general.en: Life goes more gently with money.
general.zh: 有錢時生活過得比較溫和順心。

qa.en: Great. Slide the jaws over the part — gently, don't squeeze.
qa.zh: 很好。把測爪滑到工件上，輕輕地，不要用力夾。

words.definition: to completely remove stress so that it no longer bothers you

general.en: Exercise helps me get rid of stress.
general.zh: 運動幫助我擺脫壓力。

words.definition: to be unable to move or progress

general.en: Cars would get stuck in the mud on the road.
general.zh: 車子會卡在路上的泥漿中動彈不得。

general.en: Sometimes I get stuck when I try to speak English.
general.zh: 有時候我嘗試說英文時會卡卡的。

general.en: I really don't want to get stuck in the mountains. Maybe we should just cancel.
general.zh: 我真的不想被困在山上。也許我們乾脆取消好了。

words.definition: a piece of paper or card that can be used like money to buy things at a certain store

general.en: I won a $2,000 gift voucher in the raffle.
general.zh: 我在摸彩中抽到了兩千元的禮券。

general.en: Last year the top prize was a new phone, and everyone went home with a gift voucher for a department store.
general.zh: 去年的頭獎是一支新手機，而且每個人都帶了一張百貨公司的禮券回家。

words.definition: the main point or meaning of something

general.en: The gist of the meeting was about product quality issues.
general.zh: 會議的主旨是關於產品品質問題。

general.en: I read the article and got the gist even though I didn't know all the words.
general.zh: 即使不認識所有單字，我讀了文章也抓到了大意。（the general meaning or idea）

general.en: The gist of the meeting was about quality issues.
general.zh: 會議的重點是關於品質問題。（gist 主旨、重點。The gist of... 意思是「…的重點」；動詞用過去式 was，表示會議已開完。）

general.en: I couldn't understand the article fully, but I got the gist.
general.zh: 我無法完全理解這篇文章，但我抓到了主旨。

words.definition: covering or affecting the whole world.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: I aim to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience and contribute to global projects.
general.zh: 我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗、並為全球專案做出貢獻的公司。

general.en: Last question. Why do you want to move to a global company?
general.zh: 最後一個問題。你為什麼想進到一間全球性的公司？

general.en: In the near future, I aim to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience and contribute to global projects.
general.zh: 短期內，我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗、並為全球專案做出貢獻的公司。

general.en: I hope to be hired by a company that can give me the opportunity to expand my global experience and get involved in international projects.
general.zh: 我希望能進入一家可以讓我拓展全球經驗、並參與國際專案的公司。

qa.en: Check the gloss with a gloss meter at three points.
qa.zh: 用光澤計在三個點量測光澤度。

qa.en: The color and the gloss must match the master sample.
qa.zh: 顏色與光澤必須符合主樣板標準。

qa.en: Measure the gloss at 60 degrees on three points.
qa.zh: 以 60 度角量測三個點的光澤度。

qa.en: The gloss value is 85 GU, which meets the standard.
qa.zh: 光澤值為 85 GU，符合標準。

qa.en: Check the gloss with a gloss meter at three points.
qa.zh: 用光澤計在三個點量測光澤度。

words.definition: A sticky substance used to join things together.

general.en: He used strong glue to fix the broken handle.
general.zh: 他用強力膠水修好了壞掉的把手。

general.en: The sink fell off the wall because the glue wasn't applied properly.
general.zh: 水槽從牆上掉下來了，因為黏膠沒有塗好。

words.definition: To spread very quickly on the internet.

general.en: One of their videos went viral, receiving thousands of views.
general.zh: 他們的一支影片爆紅，獲得數千次觀看。

general.en: You really think it could go viral?
general.zh: 你真的覺得這會爆紅嗎？

words.definition: Rules that make sure products are made safely and consistently.
The group of people who officially control a country.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: I met a civil servant at the local government office to ask about my documents.
general.zh: 我在當地政府辦公室見了一位公務員，詢問關於我文件的事。

general.en: In Taiwan, most people have National Health Insurance (NHI). This is a government program.
general.zh: 在台灣，大多數人都有全民健康保險 (NHI)。這是一項政府計畫。

general.en: This is a government program. Everyone pays a small monthly fee.
general.zh: 這是一項政府計畫。每個人每個月繳納少量的費用。

general.en: The government introduced a rent cap in 2024, but landlords found ways around it.
general.zh: 政府在 2024 年實施了租金上限，但房東找到了繞過去的方法。

general.en: The government plans to lower taxes.
general.zh: 政府計畫減稅。

general.en: Most medical costs, especially for serious illnesses or surgeries, are covered by government insurance, so healthcare is relatively affordable.
general.zh: 對於重大疾病或手術，大部分醫療費用由保險支付，因此醫療費用相對便宜。

words.definition: a system or plan that is organized and run by the government.

general.en: This is a government program. Everyone pays a small monthly fee.
general.zh: 這是一項政府計畫。每個人每個月繳納少量的費用。

general.en: In Taiwan, most people have National Health Insurance (NHI). This is a government program.
general.zh: 在台灣，大多數人都有全民健康保險 (NHI)。這是一項政府計畫。

general.en: No, it's a government program that helps everyone in Taiwan pay for medical care.
general.zh: 不一樣，那是一個政府計畫，幫助在台灣的每個人負擔醫療照護的費用。

words.definition: Feeling or showing thanks for something someone has done for you.

general.en: I felt grateful for the wonderful memories of the trip.
general.zh: 我對這次旅行的美好回憶充滿感激。

general.en: She felt grateful when her friends helped her move.
general.zh: 朋友幫她搬家時，她感到非常感激。

general.en: We are grateful for the support from the rescue team.
general.zh: 我們非常感謝救援團隊的支持。

general.en: At the end of the trip, I felt a little sad because I didn't want to leave. However, I also felt grateful for the wonderful memories. I hope to visit Kyoto again one day and explore even more of this fascinating city.
general.zh: 在旅程的尾聲，我感到有一點點傷感，因為我不想離開。然而，我也對這些美好的回憶充滿感激。我希望有一天能再次造訪京都，並進一步探索這座迷人的城市。

words.definition: the feeling of being thankful.

general.en: People show gratitude by thanking their family and friends.
general.zh: 人們透過感謝家人和朋友來表達感恩。

general.en: Thanksgiving encourages people to express gratitude for the positive things in their lives.
general.zh: 感恩節鼓勵人們對生活中的美好事物表達感恩。

words.definition: a thick oil used on machines.

general.en: The technician applied grease to the bearings to reduce friction.
general.zh: 技術員在軸承上塗潤滑脂以降低摩擦。

qa.en: A worker forgot to add grease at this point.

words.definition: covered in or containing a lot of oil or fat.

general.en: I feel bloated after eating greasy food.
general.zh: 吃了油膩的食物後我覺得脹氣。

general.en: A big plate of fried chicken from a night market stall. It was very greasy.
general.zh: 夜市攤子買的一大盤炸雞。非常油膩。

general.en: That's a very common symptom pattern after greasy street food. I think you have food poisoning.
general.zh: 吃完油膩的路邊小吃之後，這是很常見的症狀組合。我認為你是食物中毒。

general.en: The staff will feel stomach discomfort after lunch if the food is too greasy.
general.zh: 如果食物太油膩，員工午餐後將會感到胃部不適。

words.definition: a strong desire to have more money or things than you need
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and much more.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: Yes. Greed is the problem, not the money itself.
general.zh: 對。問題出在貪婪，而不是錢本身。

general.en: Greed is the root of all evil.
general.zh: 貪婪是萬惡之源。

general.en: Greed makes people do bad things.
general.zh: 貪婪讓人做壞事。

general.en: So you'd blame greed instead?
general.zh: 所以你反而會怪貪婪囉？

general.en: That's not greed. That's Taipei.
general.zh: 那不是貪婪，那叫台北。

words.definition: to promise that something will definitely happen or be true

general.en: We guarantee that this year's prizes will be better than last year.
general.zh: 我們保證今年的獎品會比去年更好。

general.en: Money can support a comfortable life, but it cannot guarantee happiness.
general.zh: 金錢可以支持舒適的生活，但無法保證幸福。

general.en: Money can't buy happiness. While it provides for our needs and removes certain stressors, it doesn't guarantee emotional fulfillment.
general.zh: 金錢買不到幸福，但有幫助。經濟安全對幸福感很重要，但它不是快樂人生的唯一決定因素。關鍵字是 guarantee（保證）：金錢可以支持舒適的生活方式，但無法保證幸福。

general.en: Money can't guarantee happiness.
general.zh: 金錢無法保證幸福。

words.definition: 從積雨雲落下的成串冰粒

general.en: Hail is rare in Taiwan, so many people were surprised.
general.zh: 冰雹在台灣很罕見，所以很多人感到驚訝。

general.en: The hail fell from the sky like small stones.
general.zh: 冰雹像小石頭一樣從天上掉下來。

general.en: Hail is uncountable; use hailstones for individual pieces.
general.zh: Hail 泛指時為不可數名詞；指一顆一顆的冰雹用可數的 hailstones。

general.en: It might hail tomorrow. / There is a chance of hail tomorrow.
general.zh: 明天可能會下冰雹。

general.en: What happened last night? — There was a heavy hailstorm. The hail broke a few car windows on our street.
general.zh: 昨晚發生了什麼事？——下了一場大冰雹。冰雹砸破了我們街上幾輛車的窗戶。

general.en: We encountered hail on the way home.
general.zh: 我們在回家的路上遇到了冰雹。

words.definition: 從天空落下的單顆冰粒，hail 的可數形式

general.en: The hail fell from the sky like small stones.
general.zh: 冰雹像小石頭一樣從天上掉下來。

general.en: Hail is uncountable; use hailstones for individual pieces.
general.zh: Hail 泛指時為不可數名詞；指一顆一顆的冰雹用可數的 hailstones。

words.definition: Calipers, micrometers, height gauges, feeler gauges, and thread gauges used for routine in-process checks.

qa.en: Please record the line speed and the hanging method for this model.
qa.zh: 請記錄這個機種的線速與上掛方式。

qa.en: We check the hardness with a hardness tester.
qa.zh: 我們用硬度計量硬度。

qa.en: Hardness is measured on the specified surface and compared against the drawing requirement.
qa.zh: 硬度在指定的面量，跟圖面要求比。

qa.en: Hardness testing is our verification of the heat treatment result for every incoming lot of heat-treated parts.
qa.zh: 每批熱處理件進來，我們都用硬度來驗熱處理有沒有做到位。

qa.en: Measure the case depth with the Vickers hardness tester.
qa.zh: 用維克氏硬度機量測硬化層深度。

qa.en: Test the shaft hardness on the Rockwell hardness tester.
qa.zh: 在洛氏硬度計上測試軸的硬度。

qa.en: Yes. We verify the heat treatment by hardness test. The specification is HRC 45 to 50, and we take three readings per part on the specified surface.
qa.zh: 有。熱處理我們用硬度來驗。規格 HRC 45～50，每件在指定的面量三點。

words.definition: A test that presses an indenter into the surface under a defined load to measure resistance to permanent deformation.

qa.en: Hardness testing is our verification of the heat treatment result for every incoming lot of heat-treated parts.
qa.zh: 每批熱處理件進來，我們都用硬度來驗熱處理有沒有做到位。

qa.en: Yes. We verify the heat treatment by hardness test. The specification is HRC 45 to 50, and we take three readings per part on the specified surface.
qa.zh: 有。熱處理我們用硬度來驗。規格 HRC 45～50，每件在指定的面量三點。

qa.en: Hardness testing is our verification of the heat treatment result for every incoming lot of heat-treated parts.
qa.zh: 每批熱處理件進來，我們都用硬度來驗熱處理有沒有做到位。

words.definition: the time when crops are collected from the fields.

general.en: Farmers are happy when the harvest is successful.
general.zh: 農夫在豐收時會很開心。

words.definition: to support and protect someone.

general.en: She always has my back.
general.zh: 她總是支持我。

words.definition: a pain in your head.

general.en: I've got a headache, a running nose and a cough.
general.zh: 我頭痛、流鼻水又咳嗽。

general.en: I took a painkiller to relieve my headache.
general.zh: 我吃了止痛藥來緩解頭痛。

general.en: This pain reliever can help with headaches and muscle pain.
general.zh: 這款止痛藥可以舒緩頭痛和肌肉痠痛。

general.en: It is hard to concentrate when you have a bad headache.
general.zh: 頭痛很嚴重時很難集中注意力。

general.en: Yesterday I was very tired. I had a headache and my throat hurt.
general.zh: 昨天我很累。我頭痛，喉嚨也很痛。

general.en: I had a headache.

words.definition: The quality of being hot; hot weather.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: The cave was the best place to avoid the heat in the summer.
general.zh: 洞穴是夏天躲避暑熱最好的地方。

general.en: I heat up the ready-to-drink milk tea in the microwave.
general.zh: （便利商店）我把即飲奶茶放進微波爐加熱。

general.en: The microwave oven heats leftovers quickly.
general.zh: 微波爐快速加熱剩菜。

general.en: He bought a meal and heated it in the microwave at the convenience store.
general.zh: 他買了一份餐點，在便利商店用微波爐加熱。

general.en: I'm just going to heat up some leftovers for dinner tonight.
general.zh: 我今晚打算把一些剩菜熱來吃就好。（可當形容詞 leftover bento meals，或名詞複數 leftovers）

qa.en: Is this part heat treated, and how do you verify it?
qa.zh: 這個零件有熱處理嗎？你們怎麼驗證？

qa.en: Hardness testing is our verification of the heat treatment result for every incoming lot of heat-treated parts.
qa.zh: 每批熱處理件進來，我們都用硬度來驗熱處理有沒有做到位。

qa.en: We use Rockwell for heat-treated steel parts and Shore for rubber and plastic parts. Three readings are taken and the average is recorded.
qa.zh: 熱處理鋼件用洛氏，橡膠跟塑膠件用蕭氏。量三點，記平均。

qa.en: Yes. We verify the heat treatment by hardness test. The specification is HRC 45 to 50, and we take three readings per part on the specified surface.
qa.zh: 有。熱處理我們用硬度來驗。規格 HRC 45～50，每件在指定的面量三點。

words.definition: a serious medical condition caused by becoming too hot; body cannot cool itself

general.en: Remember to drink plenty of water when cycling, or you might get heatstroke.
general.zh: 騎腳踏車時記得多喝水，否則可能會中暑。

general.en: Remember to drink plenty of water when you go cycling, or you might get heatstroke.
general.zh: 去騎腳踏車時記得多喝水，否則你可能會中暑。

words.definition: someone who is not easily woken up by noise or movement

general.en: I am a heavy sleeper; nothing can wake me up.
general.zh: 我是個睡得很沉的人，什麼都吵不醒我。

general.en: A person who is not easily awakened. Example: "I'm a heavy sleeper; nothing can wake me up."
general.zh: 指睡得很熟、不容易被叫醒的人。例句：「我睡得很沉，什麼都叫不醒我。」

general.en: He is a heavy sleeper.
general.zh: 他這人平時就很難被吵醒。

words.definition: full of activity in a way that makes you feel rushed or stressed.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: Not bad, just a bit hectic lately.
general.zh: 還不錯，只是最近有點忙亂。

words.definition: To give someone a job.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: The new hire would be expected to work weekends.
general.zh: 新進的人會被要求週末上班。

general.en: Two engineers will be hired for the quality team.
general.zh: 品保團隊要招聘兩位工程師。

general.en: We are still hiring more workers.
general.zh: 我們還在招募更多員工。

general.en: I hope to be hired by a company that can give me the opportunity to expand my global experience and get involved in international projects.
general.zh: 我希望能進入一家可以讓我拓展全球經驗、並參與國際專案的公司。

general.en: We are still hiring.
general.zh: 我們還在招募人員。

general.en: Last week I was invited to help with interviews at our factory. Two engineers will be hired for the quality team, and my manager wanted a second opinion. It was the first time I sat on the other side of the table.
general.zh: 上星期我受邀協助工廠的面試。品保團隊要招聘兩位工程師，而主管想要多一個人的意見。這是我第一次坐到面試桌的另一邊。

words.translation: 熱門作品（很成功、很受歡迎）
words.definition: Something very popular and successful, such as a TV series or song.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: Dr. House is the main character in the hit TV series.
general.zh: House 醫生是這部熱門影集的主角。

general.en: A tsunami hit the coast after the earthquake.
general.zh: 地震後，海嘯侵襲了海岸。

general.en: Let's go inside, I think a tornado might hit this area.
general.zh: 我們進去吧，我覺得龍捲風可能會襲擊這一帶。

general.en: The sandstorm will hit the city this afternoon.
general.zh: 沙塵暴今天下午將會襲擊這座城市。

general.en: The flights will be cancelled if the typhoon hits.
general.zh: 如果颱風登陸，班機將被取消。

general.en: House, M.D. is a hit TV series.
general.zh: 《怪醫豪斯》是一部很受歡迎的熱門影集。

qa.en: One. The motor temperature hit 78 degrees around three in the morning.
qa.zh: 有一次。凌晨三點左右馬達溫度到 78 度。

words.definition: To press the horn of a car to make a loud sound.

general.en: Cars in Vietnam constantly honk their horns.
general.zh: 越南的車經常按喇叭。

general.en: Cars in Vietnam constantly honk their horns, and the noise affects my sleep.
general.zh: 越南的車經常按喇叭，噪音影響我的睡眠。

general.en: The car horn is stuck and won't stop honking.
general.zh: 汽車喇叭卡住了，一直響不停。

general.en: The car horn got stuck, so it kept honking.
general.zh: 汽車喇叭卡住，所以一直按個不停。

words.definition: a feeling that something good will happen or be true in the future.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: People celebrate with traditions that bring hope and happiness.
general.zh: 假期間拜廟與探親，象徵希望與幸福。

general.en: I hope to explore even more of this fascinating city one day.
general.zh: 我希望有一天能進一步探索這座迷人的城市。

general.en: I'm hoping we can reschedule the interview.
general.zh: 我在想我們是否能重新安排面試時間。

general.en: I hope to be hired by a company that can give me the opportunity to expand my global experience and get involved in international projects.
general.zh: 我希望能進入一家可以讓我拓展全球經驗、並參與國際專案的公司。

general.en: Mia has taken this MRT line for three years, but she has never seen the platform so crowded. She hopes the signal problem is fixed again soon, so tomorrow's ride can be as easy as usual.
general.zh: Mia搭這條捷運線已經三年了，但她從沒看過月台這麼擁擠。她希望號誌問題能快點修好，這樣明天的通勤才能跟平常一樣輕鬆。

general.en: The good news is that the typhoon is expected to turn north tonight and move away from Taiwan by tomorrow afternoon. I have already rebooked my train ticket for Friday. For now, I am working from home and hoping the power does not go out.
general.zh: 好消息是颱風預計今晚會轉向北方，明天下午就會離開台灣。我已經把火車票改訂到週五了。現在我先在家工作，希望不要停電。

words.definition: Feeling that good things will happen.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: An optimist stays hopeful about the future.
general.zh: 樂觀的人對未來保持希望。

general.en: Exactly. You don't have to feel hopeful every morning to keep going.
general.zh: 沒錯。你不必每天早上都充滿希望，才能繼續前進。

general.en: The coach's words were encouraging — they made the team feel hopeful.
general.zh: 教練的話令人鼓舞——它們讓團隊感到充滿希望。

words.definition: Having no hope; feeling that things will not get better.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: A pessimist often feels hopeless about the future.
general.zh: 悲觀的人常對未來感到絕望。

words.definition: Friendly and welcoming to guests or visitors.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: Taiwanese people are very hospitable.
general.zh: 台灣人很好客。

words.definition: a trip to the hospital or clinic to see a doctor.

general.en: A simple hospital visit can cost hundreds or thousands of dollars without insurance.
general.zh: 如果沒有保險，一次簡單的就醫可能就要花費數百或數千美元。

general.en: Even with insurance, a simple hospital visit can cost hundreds of dollars. That is why many people in the USA worry about medical bills. Early treatment is important — but people sometimes wait because they are afraid of the cost.
general.zh: 即使有保險，一次簡單的就醫也可能花費數百美元。這就是為什麼許多美國人擔心醫療帳單。及早治療很重要——但有些人因為害怕費用而等待。

words.definition: containing a lot of water in the air; warm and wet

general.en: Sunday looks much better, but it will be very humid.
general.zh: 星期天看起來好多了，不過會非常潮濕。

general.en: Humid weather makes hiking so tiring. I start sweating after five minutes.
general.zh: 潮濕的天氣讓爬山特別累，我走五分鐘就開始流汗。

general.en: The clothes got moldy because of the humid weather.
general.zh: 描述空氣中含有高濃度的水蒸氣。

general.en: Taiwan has a humid and warm climate.
general.zh: 台灣氣候潮濕溫暖。

general.en: It pulls in humid air, removes water from air, collects the water in a tank (or drains it out), and releases drier air back into the room.
general.zh: 除濕四大核心步驟：吸入潮濕空氣 → 去除水分 → 收集在水箱（或排出）→ 釋放較乾燥的空氣。（pulls in 強調「施加力量」，與較被動的 take in 不同。）

words.definition: the amount of water vapor in the air

general.en: The humidity is very high in summer.
general.zh: 夏天濕度非常高。

qa.en: The test condition is 40 °C and 90 % relative humidity.
qa.zh: 測試條件為 40 °C、相對濕度 90%。

words.definition: a large, powerful tropical storm that forms over warm ocean water in the Americas

general.en: People are buying food and water before the hurricane arrives.
general.zh: 在颶風來臨之前，人們正在購買食物和飲用水。

general.en: The hurricane is projected to make landfall tomorrow morning.
general.zh: 颶風預計明天早上登陸。

general.en: They board up the windows before the hurricane arrives.
general.zh: 在颶風來臨前，他們用木板封住窗戶。

general.en: The hurricane disrupted flights. / messed up the flights.
general.zh: 颶風打亂了航班。（disrupted 中性／正式；messed up 非正式／口語。）

general.en: Hurricane Katrina caused widespread destruction in New Orleans.
general.zh: 卡崔娜颶風在紐奧良造成大規模破壞。

general.en: The hurricane destroyed entire neighborhoods.
general.zh: 那場颶風摧毀了整個社區。

words.definition: the need to do something or move quickly because there is little time.

general.en: I was in a hurry this morning, so I left my phone at home.
general.zh: 今天早上我很趕時間，所以把手機忘在家裡了。

general.en: I was in a hurry this morning and I left my phone at home.
general.zh: 今天早上我很趕時間，把手機忘在家裡了。

general.en: I'm not in a hurry. I don't mind waiting.
general.zh: 4. (wait) 我不趕時間，我不介意等。

general.en: Hurry up! I don't want to risk missing the train.
general.zh: 9. (miss) 快點！我不想冒錯過火車的風險。

general.en: Could you please let me through? I'm in a hurry.
general.zh: 可以請你讓我過一下嗎？我趕時間。

general.en: Excuse me, I'm in a bit of a hurry. May I get in, please?
general.zh: 不好意思，我有點趕時間，可以讓我進去嗎？

words.definition: to recognize and name what something is
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: The doctor was able to identify the cause of the pain.
general.zh: 醫生能夠找出疼痛的原因。

general.en: Sure. My main job is to identify problems before the product reaches the customer.
general.zh: 當然。我的主要工作是在產品送到客戶手上之前，先找出問題。

general.en: Can you identify the main problem in this report?
general.zh: 你能找出這份報告的主要問題嗎？

general.en: She tried to identify the person who called her last night.
general.zh: 她試著確認昨晚打電話給她的人。

general.en: Students must identify the correct answer from the list.
general.zh: 學生必須從清單中找出正確答案。

general.en: It's hard to identify fake news on social media.
general.zh: 在社群媒體上很難辨認假新聞。

qa.en: The procedure for identifying, segregating, and dispositioning product that does not meet the specification.
qa.zh: 不合規格的東西怎麼標、怎麼隔離、怎麼決定處理方式的程序。

qa.en: How do you identify the risks in this process?
qa.zh: 這個製程的風險你們怎麼抓？

qa.en: Action: identify what changed at the point the trend started — tool, batch, operator, torque driver calibration.
qa.zh: 行動：找出趨勢開始那時候換了什麼——刀具、批次、作業員、扭力起子有沒有校驗。

qa.en: Put the current lot on hold and identify which finished units contain the changed material.
qa.zh: 先把現有批次扣住，清查哪些成品機台已經用到改過的材料。

qa.en: We are identifying which product features rely on AI and whether any of them perform a safety function under the applicable rules.
qa.zh: 我們正在盤點哪些功能有用 AI，以及照規定看有沒有哪一個算安全功能。

qa.en: We are conducting a gap assessment to identify areas that may require updates before the transition, and we have already contacted our certification body about the transition schedule.
qa.zh: 我們正在做差距評估，找出轉版前要更新的地方，轉版時程也已經去問驗證機構了。

words.definition: the state of being sick, or a particular sickness that affects your body or mind.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: After her illness, she couldn't cope with the stress of work.
general.zh: 她生病之後，無法承受工作的壓力。

general.en: For serious illness or surgery, most of the cost is covered by the insurance.
general.zh: 對於嚴重的疾病或手術，大部分費用都由保險給付。

general.en: Older adults and people with chronic illness tend to be more vulnerable, especially if they haven't been vaccinated.
general.zh: 年長者和慢性病患者往往比較容易受影響，尤其是還沒接種疫苗的人。

general.en: She is off work due to illness.
general.zh: 她因病請假。

general.en: Most medical costs, especially for serious illnesses or surgeries, are covered by government insurance, so healthcare is relatively affordable.
general.zh: 對於重大疾病或手術，大部分醫療費用由保險支付，因此醫療費用相對便宜。

general.en: Free vaccines are available at most clinics and community health stations. A short visit now can prevent a much longer illness later.
general.zh: 大部分診所與社區健康站都還有免費疫苗。現在去一趟，可能就能避免之後一場更長的病。

words.definition: existing only in your mind, not real

general.en: The second conditional is used for imaginary situations.
general.zh: 第二條件句用於想像的情況。

general.en: So the second conditional is for imaginary situations, right? Not real ones.
general.zh: 所以第二條件句是用在想像的情況，對吧？不是真實的情況。

general.en: Perfect. And you don't speak fluently yet, so the sentence stays imaginary - that's why we use would.
general.zh: 完美。而且你還沒說得流利，所以這句話還停留在想像 - 這就是為什麼用 would。

words.definition: the ability to form new ideas or pictures in your mind that are not real

general.en: You need a little imagination to write a good story.
general.zh: 寫出好故事需要一點想像力。

general.en: Mia likes to plan her life, but she also enjoys imagining what could happen in a perfect world. She believes that with effort and a little imagination, anything is possible.
general.zh: Mia 喜歡規劃她的生活，但她也喜歡想像在一個完美的世界裡可能會發生什麼事。她相信，只要努力加上一點想像力，任何事情都是可能的。

words.definition: The process of checking people who enter a country.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: The immigration officer asked me a question.
general.zh: 移民官問了我一個問題。

general.en: The immigration officer asked to see my return ticket.
general.zh: 移民官要求查看我的回程票。

general.en: If the immigration officer finds something dangerous in my luggage, they will ask me to open it.
general.zh: 如果移民官在我的行李裡發現危險物品，他們會要求我打開行李。

general.en: The immigration officer checked my passport.
general.zh: 移民官檢查了我的護照。

general.en: If there are dangerous items in my luggage, the immigration officer will ask me to open it.
general.zh: 如果我的行李裡有危險物品，移民官會要求我打開行李。

words.definition: the official who checks passports and documents of people entering a country
words.lesson: 20260708 A Flight Problem 航班旅遊閱讀

general.en: The immigration officer asked to see my return ticket.
general.zh: 移民官要求查看我的回程票。

general.en: The immigration officer asked me a question.
general.zh: 移民官問了我一個問題。

general.en: If the immigration officer finds something dangerous in my luggage, they will ask me to open it.
general.zh: 如果移民官在我的行李裡發現危險物品，他們會要求我打開行李。

general.en: The immigration officer checked my passport.
general.zh: 移民官檢查了我的護照。

general.en: If there are dangerous items in my luggage, the immigration officer will ask me to open it.
general.zh: 如果我的行李裡有危險物品，移民官會要求我打開行李。

words.definition: to start using a plan or idea in a real situation.

general.en: Finally, we implement improvements and monitor the results.
general.zh: 最後我們執行改善並追蹤結果。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers to investigate the root causes and implement effective solutions.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，進行根本原因分析，並落實有效的解決方案。

general.en: Implement effective solutions to ensure alignment with our clients' requirements.
general.zh: 落實有效的解決方案，以確保與客戶需求保持一致。

qa.en: We identified the root cause and implemented a permanent corrective action with effectiveness verification.
qa.zh: 根因確認了，永久對策也上了，效果也驗證過了。

qa.en: When exactly did you implement this change?
qa.zh: 這個變更到底是什麼時候開始的？

qa.en: A supplier implemented a material change without approval. Containment is in place, re-qualification is running this week, and there is no confirmed impact to shipped units at this point. We will report the disposition decision by Friday.
qa.zh: 有供應商沒經過核准就改了材料。圍堵已經做了，重新驗證這週進行，目前沒有證據顯示已出貨的機台受影響。週五前會回報怎麼處理。

words.definition: A person or company that brings products into a country to sell.

general.en: The company works with an importer to bring fresh fruit from abroad.
general.zh: 這間公司與一位進口商合作，從國外引進新鮮水果。

words.definition: A change that makes something better than before.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: I see a big improvement in your English.
general.zh: 我看見你的英文有很大的進步。

general.en: She was dedicated to learning and self-improvement.
general.zh: 她很投入於學習與自我提升。

general.en: Teachers are responsible for learners' improvement.
general.zh: 教師負責學生的進步。

general.en: Finally, we implement improvements and monitor the results.
general.zh: 最後我們執行改善並追蹤結果。

general.en: After a month of practice, she saw a measurable improvement in her speaking.
general.zh: 練習一個月後，她的口說出現了可測量的進步。

general.en: These improvements had to be paid for by the tenants.
general.zh: 這些改善的費用必須由房客來分攤。

qa.en: Kaizen is not one big project; it is a small improvement on the line every day.
qa.zh: 持續改善不是一個大專案，而是產線上每天的小改善。

qa.en: A capability below the target triggers an improvement plan before the trend can produce out-of-specification product.
qa.zh: Cpk 低於目標就啟動改善計畫，趁還沒做出超規品之前先處理。

qa.en: First step, I will speak to the casting supplier and drive improvements in the casting process.
qa.zh: 第一步，我會先跟鑄造供應商談，推動鑄造製程的改善。

qa.en: Drive improvements in the casting process and build samples to verify.
qa.zh: 推動鑄造製程改善並做樣品驗證。

qa.en: The GR&R for this caliper check came out at 27%, above the 10% acceptance limit. The measurement system needs improvement before we can trust the data.
qa.zh: 這項卡尺量測的 GR&R 是 27%，超過 10% 的允收上限。量測系統要先改善，數據才能信。

qa.en: We chart the key characteristic with X-bar and R charts. Cpk above 1.33 is the target; below 1.33 requires a process improvement plan even when all parts are still within specification.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用 X-bar／R 管制圖盯。Cpk 目標 1.33 以上；低於 1.33，就算每件都在規格內，還是要提改善計畫。

qa.en: A capability below the target triggers an improvement plan before the trend can produce out-of-specification product.
qa.zh: Cpk 低於目標就啟動改善計畫，趁還沒做出超規品之前先處理。

qa.en: We chart the key characteristic with X-bar and R charts. Cpk above 1.33 is the target; below 1.33 requires a process improvement plan even when all parts are still within specification.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用 X-bar／R 管制圖盯。Cpk 目標 1.33 以上；低於 1.33，就算每件都在規格內，還是要提改善計畫。

words.translation: 在管制內 vs. 在規格內

words.definition: very quickly.

general.en: The technician fixed the machine in no time.
general.zh: 技師很快就修好了機器。

general.en: She finished the homework in no time.
general.zh: 她很快就完成了作業。

general.en: Because of her effective communication and constant effort, the team solved the problems efficiently. They finished the project in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 因為她有效的溝通和持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就完成了專案，並收到了老闆的正面回饋。

general.en: Thanks to Emma's effective communication and constant efforts, the team efficiently resolved the issues. They completed the project successfully in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 多虧了 Emma 有效的溝通與持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就順利完成專案，並得到老闆正面的回饋。

words.definition: during the time between two things.

general.en: In the meantime, I'm going to read and play computer games.
general.zh: 在這期間，我打算看書和玩電腦遊戲。

words.definition: unable to decide between two choices or opinions.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: I'm in two minds about whether to take the new job offer.
general.zh: 我對於是否要接受這份新工作邀約感到猶豫不決。

general.en: I'm in two minds.
general.zh: 我很猶豫／拿不定主意。

words.definition: Food served to passengers during a flight.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: A vegetarian does not eat meat. / A vegetarian in-flight meal is available.
general.zh: 素食者不吃肉。／有提供素食機上餐。

general.en: The in-flight meal was delicious.
general.zh: 飛機餐很好吃。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100 % inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺絲採抽樣檢驗，但跑步機馬達採全檢。

qa.en: Hardness testing is our verification of the heat treatment result for every incoming lot of heat-treated parts.
qa.zh: 每批熱處理件進來，我們都用硬度來驗熱處理有沒有做到位。

qa.en: Do you inspect every incoming part?
qa.zh: 你們每一件進料都檢驗嗎？

qa.en: Tensile testing is performed on every incoming material lot, and the mill certificate is cross-checked against our own test result.
qa.zh: 每批進料都做拉伸，材證跟我們自己測的結果會互相對。

qa.en: We run tensile tests on incoming steel tube and on welded joints. The specimen is prepared per the standard, and the result is compared against the material specification on the drawing.
qa.zh: 進料鋼管跟焊接接頭會做拉伸。試片照標準做，結果跟圖面的材質規格比。

qa.en: The tensile strength must meet the specification defined in the drawing. For this steel tube the requirement is a minimum of 370 megapascals, and our last incoming test result was 412 megapascals.
qa.zh: 抗拉強度要符合圖面規格。這支鋼管要求最少 370 MPa，上次進料測出來是 412 MPa。

qa.en: This weld shows incomplete fusion and must be reworked.
qa.zh: 這道焊接未熔合，必須重工。

words.definition: Not thinking about other people's feelings.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: He is inconsiderate because he talks loudly on the phone.
general.zh: 他很不體貼，因為他講電話很大聲。

general.en: Some passengers are inconsiderate because they recline their seats, leaving me with very little legroom.
general.zh: 有些乘客很不體貼，因為他們把椅背往後調，害我幾乎沒有腿部空間。

general.en: Some passengers are inconsiderate.
general.zh: 有些乘客很不體貼。

words.definition: Certain to happen; impossible to avoid.

general.en: Failure is an inevitable part of business.
general.zh: 失敗是做生意中無可避免的一部分。

words.definition: to give a disease to someone.

general.en: Researchers from Hong Kong warned that nomophobia is infecting everyone.
general.zh: 香港的研究人員警告，無手機恐懼症正在感染每一個人。

general.en: I could infect my mates.
general.zh: 我可能會傳染給同學。

words.definition: a condition in which a person finds it difficult to sleep

general.en: He suffers from insomnia and can't sleep without help.
general.zh: 他患有失眠症，沒有幫助就無法入睡。

general.en: Cancer, insomnia, and obesity are diseases.
general.zh: 癌症、失眠、肥胖都屬於 disease。

words.definition: To look at something carefully to check its condition.

general.en: The plumber promised to inspect everything carefully and repair all the issues.
general.zh: 水管工人承諾會仔細檢查所有東西並修復所有問題。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: Great. I'll come and inspect the ceiling myself while he's there.
general.zh: 太好了。他在的時候我也會過去親自檢查天花板。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材。

general.en: Q: How do you check product quality? I test the equipment and inspect the dimensions carefully. If I find a problem, I investigate the cause and discuss it with the team.
general.zh: Q: 你如何檢查產品品質？ 我會測試設備並仔細檢查尺寸。如果發現問題，我會調查原因並與團隊討論。

general.en: Finally, I became frustrated and had a face-to-face conversation with him. I told him that the apartment was unsafe... The landlord finally agreed to hire professionals to inspect and repair all the issues.
general.zh: 最後，我感到很挫折，便與他進行了面對面的談話。我告訴他這間公寓不安全……房東終於同意聘請專業人員來檢查並修復所有問題。

qa.en: Judging a whole lot by inspecting only a sample drawn from it, instead of checking every piece.
qa.zh: 只抽一部分來檢，用抽出來的結果判整批，不是每件都檢。

qa.en: The record showing what was inspected, the actual measured values, the judgement, and who signed it off.
qa.zh: 寫著檢了什麼、實測值多少、判定結果、誰簽的紀錄。

qa.en: Do you inspect every incoming part?
qa.zh: 你們每一件進料都檢驗嗎？

qa.en: Acceptance is decided strictly by the Ac / Re numbers of the sampling plan, so the judgement is consistent regardless of who inspects.
qa.zh: 收不收完全看抽樣計畫的 Ac／Re，所以不管誰檢，結果都一樣。

qa.en: Do you inspect every incoming bolt?
qa.zh: 每一支進料螺栓你們都檢驗嗎？

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

general.en: I need to concentrate on the quality inspection report today.
general.zh: 我今天需要專心處理品質檢驗報告。

general.en: Every taxi must pass a mechanical inspection once a year.
general.zh: 每輛計程車每年都必須通過一次機械檢查。

general.en: If we finish the FAI (First Article Inspection) today, we will start mass production tomorrow.
general.zh: 如果我們今天完成首件檢查，我們明天就會開始量產。

general.en: I'm a quality engineer at Rexon. I focus on product inspection, problem investigation, and communication with clients and engineers to ensure product quality.
general.zh: 我在 Rexon 擔任品質工程師，主要負責產品檢驗、問題調查，以及與客戶和工程師溝通，確保產品品質。

general.en: I initiated a comprehensive inspection protocol, personally tested the electronic components, and documented a dimensional discrepancy in the frame.
general.zh: 我啟動了一套完整的檢驗流程，親自測試電子零件，並記錄了車架的尺寸偏差。

general.en: I focus on product inspection.
general.zh: 我主要負責產品檢驗。

qa.en: The escape point is our final inspection — the noise test was not performed on this exercise bike model.
qa.zh: 流出點在我們的最終檢驗 —— 這個飛輪車機種沒有做噪音測試。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100 % inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺絲採抽樣檢驗，但跑步機馬達採全檢。

qa.en: For a lot of 1,200 units at general inspection level II, the sample size code letter is K.
qa.zh: 批量 1,200 台、一般檢驗水準 II 級，樣本大小代字是 K。

qa.en: We keep general inspection level II unless the customer asks for a tighter level.
qa.zh: 除非客戶要求更嚴的水準，我們維持一般檢驗水準 II 級。

qa.en: Two lots failed in a row, so we must switch from normal to tightened inspection.
qa.zh: 連續兩批不合格，我們必須從正常檢驗轉為加嚴檢驗。

qa.en: The sample size comes from the lot size and the inspection level; the accept/reject decision comes from the AQL table.
qa.zh: 抽幾件看批量跟檢驗水準；收不收，查 AQL 表。

qa.en: This is our inspection area, where we check every critical dimension.
qa.zh: 這裡是檢驗區，我們在這裡檢查所有關鍵尺寸。

qa.en: The first stop is the incoming inspection area.

words.definition: The setting that decides how large the sample is; general level II is the normal default.

qa.en: For a lot of 1,200 units at general inspection level II, the sample size code letter is K.
qa.zh: 批量 1,200 台、一般檢驗水準 II 級，樣本大小代字是 K。

qa.en: We keep general inspection level II unless the customer asks for a tighter level.
qa.zh: 除非客戶要求更嚴的水準，我們維持一般檢驗水準 II 級。

qa.en: The sample size comes from the lot size and the inspection level; the accept/reject decision comes from the AQL table.
qa.zh: 抽幾件看批量跟檢驗水準；收不收，查 AQL 表。

qa.en: We perform sampling inspection based on the applicable inspection level and AQL requirements.
qa.zh: 我們照適用的檢驗水準跟 AQL 要求做抽檢。

qa.en: Our sampling plan is determined according to the lot size, inspection level, and AQL requirements defined in ISO 2859-1.
qa.zh: 我們的抽樣計畫是照 ISO 2859-1 的批量、檢驗水準跟 AQL 要求來定的。

qa.en: We apply AQL 0.65 for major defects and AQL 2.5 for minor defects, under general inspection level II. Critical defects are zero acceptance.
qa.zh: 一般檢驗水準 II，主要缺點用 AQL 0.65、輕微缺點用 AQL 2.5；嚴重缺點一件都不能收。

words.definition: The record showing what was inspected, the actual measured values, the judgement, and who signed it off.

general.en: I need to concentrate on the quality inspection report today.
general.zh: 我今天需要專心處理品質檢驗報告。

qa.en: Can you send us the inspection report with the actual data?
qa.zh: 可以把含實測數據的檢驗報告寄給我們嗎？

qa.en: The inspection report records the specification, the actual value, and the judgement for every characteristic.
qa.zh: 檢驗報告每個特性都有規格、實測值跟判定。

qa.en: Can you send us the inspection report for this shipment?
qa.zh: 可以把這批出貨的檢驗報告寄給我們嗎？

qa.en: The first article inspection report covers all dimensions on the drawing and is retained as part of the production record for traceability.
qa.zh: 首件報告圖面上每個尺寸都有，會跟生產紀錄一起存，之後要追都追得到。

qa.en: Yes. I will send the inspection report with the actual measured values for each characteristic, together with the lot number and the calibration status of the instruments used.
qa.zh: 可以。我會把檢驗報告寄過去，每個特性都有實測值，也會附批號跟用到的儀器校驗狀態。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

words.definition: to put equipment somewhere so it is ready to use.

general.en: The carpenter repaired a broken door and installed new shelves.
general.zh: 木匠修理了一扇破掉的門並安裝了新的層架。

general.en: A security camera was installed at the entrance.
general.zh: 入口處裝了一台監視器。

general.en: A new system is expected to be installed next year, right?
general.zh: 新系統預計明年安裝，對吧？

general.en: The carpenter installed new shelves.
general.zh: 木工安裝了新層架。

words.definition: information that explains how to do something or what to do.

general.en: I followed the instructions, but the shirt shrank after the first wash.
general.zh: 我照著說明洗，但這件襯衫洗第一次就縮水了。

general.en: I followed the washing instructions, but it shrank after the first wash.
general.zh: 我照著洗滌說明洗，但洗第一次就縮水了。

general.en: The manager's instructions caused the team to work faster.
general.zh: 經理的指示促使團隊工作得更快。

general.en: Please refer to the instructions on the back of the box.
general.zh: 請參考箱子背面的說明。

general.en: She had difficulty understanding the instructions.
general.zh: 她很難理解那些指示。

general.en: The manager's instructions were clear.
general.zh: 經理的指示很清楚。

qa.en: Decide now whether you will ship digital instructions, and keep a paper option available on request.
qa.zh: 現在就決定要不要改電子版說明書，客戶要紙本還是要給得出來。

qa.en: This work instruction was revised to version 3.
qa.zh: 這份作業指導書已改為第 3 版。

qa.en: Update the work instruction to specify the correct oil by product name, application method, and coverage requirement for tube interiors.
qa.zh: 更新 SOP，寫清楚要用哪一支油、怎麼上、管子裡面要塗到什麼程度。

qa.en: We add a clear step to the work instruction.

words.definition: 提供財務保障以應對風險的系統

general.en: Health insurance helps cover medical costs.
general.zh: 健康保險幫助支付醫療費用。

general.en: The insurance company offered us compensation for the car accident.
general.zh: 保險公司為車禍事故提供我們賠償。

general.en: Monthly insurance premiums can be very high in the USA.
general.zh: 在美國，每月保費可能非常高昂。

general.en: You must pay the deductible before insurance covers the rest.
general.zh: 在保險支付之前，你必須先支付自負額。

general.en: In Taiwan, most people have National Health Insurance (NHI). This is a government program.
general.zh: 在台灣，大多數人都有全民健康保險 (NHI)。這是一項政府計畫。

general.en: For serious illness or surgery, most of the cost is covered by the insurance.
general.zh: 對於嚴重的疾病或手術，大部分費用都由保險給付。

words.definition: able to think and understand things well.

general.en: She is intelligent because she thinks carefully before taking action.
general.zh: 她很聰明，因為她在採取行動前會仔細思考。

general.en: Intelligent people learn from their mistakes.
general.zh: 聰明的人會從錯誤中學習。

general.en: Later, Emma's manager asked about her experience. She explained that success does not happen by luck. Intelligent people learn from their mistakes, understand the symptoms of problems, and take action before small issues become big ones.
general.zh: 後來，Emma 的主管詢問了她的經驗。她解釋說成功不是靠運氣。聰明的人從錯誤中學習，了解問題的症狀，並在小問題變成大問題之前採取行動。

words.definition: -ed adjective: how a person feels about something

general.en: She is interested in science. / The documentary was interesting.
general.zh: 她對科學有興趣。／這部紀錄片很有趣。

general.en: She is interested in learning English.
general.zh: 她對學英文感到有興趣。

general.en: She is interested in science.
general.zh: 她對科學有興趣。

words.definition: -ing adjective: describes what makes you feel interested

general.en: She's a very interesting person. I always enjoy talking to her.
general.zh: 1. 她是個很有趣的人，我總是很享受和她聊天。（課本範例）

general.en: You can find a lot of interesting and cheap drinks.
general.zh: 你可以找到很多有趣又便宜的飲料。（形容詞排列。）

general.en: She is interested in science. / The documentary was interesting.
general.zh: 她對科學有興趣。／這部紀錄片很有趣。

general.en: The documentary was interesting.
general.zh: 這部紀錄片很有趣。

general.en: This book is very interesting.
general.zh: 這本書非常有趣。

general.en: Visiting interesting places as a tourist.

qa.en: Decision: an incomplete submission is not approved. Record it as interim approval or rejected — never as approved.
qa.zh: 決定：資料不齊就不是核准。只能記暫准或退件，不能記核准。

qa.en: Action: if the shipment genuinely cannot wait, issue an interim approval with a quantity limit, an expiry date and a named owner.
qa.zh: 行動：出貨真的不能等，就開暫准——限數量、訂到期日、寫誰負責。

qa.en: Never let an interim approval roll over silently. Put the expiry date in the open-issues list.
qa.zh: 暫准不能放著自動延下去，到期日要放進未結項目清單追。

qa.en: We issued an interim approval limited to 500 pieces.
qa.zh: 我們開了一張限 500 件的暫准。

qa.en: We can issue an interim approval with a quantity limit and an expiry date.
qa.zh: 我們可以開暫准，但要限數量、訂到期日。

qa.en: The submission is therefore recorded as interim approval, limited to 500 pieces and expiring on 30 September 2026.
qa.zh: 所以這次我們先記為暫准，限 500 件，效期到 2026 年 9 月 30 日。

words.definition: 程度介於初學者和進階之間

general.en: At intermediate level, I made slower progress.
general.zh: 在中級階段，我的進步變慢了。

general.en: This task is suitable for intermediate learners.
general.zh: 這個任務適合中級學習者。

general.en: Learning an intermediate level language can be frustrating.
general.zh: 學習中級程度的語言有時會令人挫折。

general.en: I am currently studying English at intermediate level.
general.zh: 我目前正在學習中級程度的英文。

general.en: But at intermediate level, I made slower progress. There were so many new words and phrases, but also words that I could understand but couldn't use accurately. I think I was more aware of my mistakes, which was good – but also frustrating.
general.zh: 但在中級階段，我的進步變慢了。有好多新的單字和片語，也有很多我聽得懂卻無法準確使用的單字。我想我更加意識到自己的錯誤，這是件好事——但也令人感到挫折。

general.en: Although learning an intermediate level language can sometimes be frustrating, I stay motivated and enthusiastic because I want to express my basic ideas accurately and make progress.
general.zh: 雖然學習中級程度的語言有時會令人挫折，但我保持積極與熱情，因為我想準確地表達我的基本想法並取得進步。

words.definition: The way your voice rises and falls when you speak.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: Question intonation rises at the end.
general.zh: 疑問句的語調在句尾上揚。

words.definition: to look into something carefully in order to find out the truth
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: The police are investigating the accident.
general.zh: 警方正在調查這起事故。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers to investigate the root causes and implement effective solutions.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，進行根本原因分析，並落實有效的解決方案。

general.en: I frequently investigate appliance malfunctions and work with design engineers to correct dimensional inaccuracies.
general.zh: 我經常會調查設備異常，並與設計工程師合作修正尺寸不準確的問題。

general.en: I monitor potential issues early and investigate appliance problems.
general.zh: 我會及早監控潛在問題、調查設備異常。

general.en: The investigation revealed the cause of the accident.
general.zh: 調查揭露了事故的原因。

general.en: Q: How do you check product quality? I test the equipment and inspect the dimensions carefully. If I find a problem, I investigate the cause and discuss it with the team.
general.zh: Q: 你如何檢查產品品質？ 我會測試設備並仔細檢查尺寸。如果發現問題，我會調查原因並與團隊討論。

qa.en: Could you please investigate this issue?
qa.zh: 「check」太輕，也不知道要查什麼。investigate 就是要查出原因；再加上圍堵措施跟期限，才是 QA 真正要的東西。

qa.en: We are investigating how the defect escaped our outgoing inspection.
qa.zh: 我們正在查這個不良是怎麼從出貨檢驗漏出去的。

qa.en: "Operator carelessness" is where the investigation starts, not where it ends.
qa.zh: 「人員疏忽」是調查的起點，不是終點。

qa.en: The Cpk for the mounting-hole position dropped to 1.12 this week, below our 1.33 target. Please investigate the trend before it produces rejects.
qa.zh: 安裝孔位置度的 Cpk 這週掉到 1.12，低於 1.33 的目標。請在做出不良之前先查這個趨勢。

qa.en: After investigation, we believe the issue is that RP-210 is designed for open surfaces and does not provide adequate protection inside enclosed tube cavities where ventilation is poor and moisture accumulates.
qa.zh: 經調查，問題出在 RP-210 是給外面平面用的，管子裡面不通風、容易積水氣，這支油防護力不夠。

qa.en: Say what you have already done before you say what you do not know yet. Containment first, then investigation — that order is what makes you sound like you are in control.
qa.zh: 先講你已經做了什麼，再講你還不知道什麼。先圍堵、再調查 —— 照這個順序講，聽起來才像有掌控。

words.definition: Not able to be seen.

general.en: The small print was almost invisible without glasses.
general.zh: 沒有眼鏡的話，那些小字幾乎看不見。

general.en: The plane is virtually invisible to radar.
general.zh: 這架飛機對雷達來說幾乎是隱形的。

general.en: If I were invisible for a day, I would sneak into the office and rearrange everyone's desk so that nothing makes sense. By the end of the day, they'd all be wondering if the office was haunted.
general.zh: 如果我有一天是隱形，我會偷偷溜進辦公室，把每個人的桌子重新整理，弄到一切都亂七八糟、完全說不通。到了下班前，大家都會開始懷疑這間辦公室是不是鬧鬼了。

words.definition: feeling slightly angry or impatient, especially because of repeated annoyances

general.en: The manager was irritated by the repeated delays in the project.
general.zh: 經理對專案一再延遲感到很惱火。

general.en: The manager was irritated by the delay of the project.
general.zh: 經理對專案的延遲感到很惱火。

general.en: Smoke from the fire irritated our eyes and throat.
general.zh: 火災產生的煙霧刺激了我們的眼睛和喉嚨。

general.en: "I have a problem," the farmer said when he met the Wise Woman. "I am annoyed and irritated because my house is very small and we have so many noisy children."
general.zh: 「我遇到一個問題，」農夫見到智者時說。「我感到很煩躁且被激怒（irritated），因為我的房子很小，而且我們有太多吵鬧的孩子。」

qa.en: We have ISO 9001. I can show you the certificate.
qa.zh: 我們有 ISO 9001，我可以給您看證書。

qa.en: Our quality management system is certified to ISO 9001 and subject to annual surveillance audits.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 有 ISO 9001 認證，每年都有追查稽核。

qa.en: Keep the current ISO 9001:2015 certificate visible in customer documents — it stays valid through the transition.
qa.zh: 給客戶的文件上，現在的 ISO 9001:2015 證書照樣要放 —— 轉版期內它還是有效的。

qa.en: When will you be certified to ISO 9001:2026?
qa.zh: 你們什麼時候會拿到 ISO 9001:2026 的證書？

qa.en: Yes. We are ISO 9001 certified. Our last surveillance audit was in March this year with no major findings, and our internal audit is conducted twice a year.
qa.zh: 有，我們有 ISO 9001。最近一次追查稽核是今年三月，沒有重大缺失；內稽一年做兩次。

qa.en: All procedures referenced during this visit are controlled documents within our ISO 9001 system, and the records are retained for the period defined in our document control procedure.
qa.zh: 今天參訪提到的程序，都是 ISO 9001 系統裡的管制文件；紀錄照文件管制程序規定的年限保存。

words.definition: kept apart from other people.

general.en: That is what we call a systemic issue, not an isolated one.
general.zh: 這就是我們所說的『系統性問題』，而不是單一事件。

general.en: An isolated problem can be fixed by punishing one company.
general.zh: 單一事件只要處罰一家公司就能解決。

general.en: I have to stay isolated in my room.
general.zh: 我必須待在房間裡隔離。

words.definition: 正式地公布警報、命令或聲明

general.en: Take action before small issues escalate.
general.zh: 在小問題擴大之前先採取行動。

general.en: There were some miscommunication issues between team members.
general.zh: 團隊成員之間有溝通不良的問題。

general.en: The plumber promised to inspect everything carefully and repair all the issues.
general.zh: 水管工人承諾會仔細檢查所有東西並修復所有問題。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers by providing feedback on dimensional issues.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，提供尺寸相關的回饋。

general.en: One of the biggest challenges in my role is resolving quality issues within a limited time frame.
general.zh: 在我的工作中，最大的挑戰之一是需要在有限的時間內解決品質問題。

general.en: A tornado warning has been issued.
general.zh: 龍捲風警報已經發布。

qa.en: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.
qa.zh: 一套有步驟的解決問題流程：先圍堵、再找根因、最後讓它不要再發生。

qa.en: The document reporting the test conditions, the actual results, and the judgement, issued in-house or by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 寫著測試條件、實測結果跟判定的文件，廠內或有認證的實驗室出的。

qa.en: Please stop the line; we found a quality issue.
qa.zh: 請停線，我們發現品質問題。

qa.en: We take this issue seriously and have started containment immediately.
qa.zh: 這件事我們很重視，已經馬上開始圍堵了。

qa.en: We use general level II as the default, tighten to level III for a new supplier or after a quality issue, and use special levels S-1 to S-4 for destructive or costly tests.
qa.zh: 平常用一般水準 II；新供應商或出過問題就加嚴到 III；破壞性或很貴的測試改用特殊水準 S-1～S-4。

qa.en: The CMM program is version-controlled and the measurement report can be issued in your required format, including the actual value and the deviation for every characteristic.
qa.zh: 三次元程式有版本管制，報告可以照你們要的格式出，每個特性都有實測值跟偏差。

words.definition: The covered walkway from the gate to the plane door.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: We walked through the jet bridge to board the plane.
general.zh: 我們走過空橋登上了飛機。

general.en: After passing through the jet bridge, I found my seat.
general.zh: 通過空橋後，我找到了自己的座位。

general.en: Passengers board through the jet bridge.
general.zh: 乘客經由空橋登機。

words.definition: Making many small improvements every day instead of waiting for one big change.

qa.en: The document reporting the test conditions, the actual results, and the judgement, issued in-house or by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 寫著測試條件、實測結果跟判定的文件，廠內或有認證的實驗室出的。

qa.en: Routine testing is performed in-house; certification testing is performed by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內做，認證測試送有認證的實驗室。

qa.en: All test reports state the test standard, the conditions, the actual results, and the accreditation status of the laboratory.
qa.zh: 所有測試報告都寫清楚測試標準、條件、實測結果，還有實驗室的認證狀態。

qa.en: Routine tests are done in our own lab; certification tests such as EN 957 or EN ISO 20957 for fitness equipment are done by an accredited third-party laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內實驗室做；健身器材 EN 957／EN ISO 20957 這種認證測試，送有認證的第三方實驗室。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

words.definition: When a plane comes down to the ground.

general.en: Please keep your window shade open during landing.
general.zh: 降落時請保持遮光板打開。

general.en: Please keep your window shade open during takeoff and landing.
general.zh: 起飛和降落時請保持遮光板打開。

general.en: Sure. We'll start preparing for landing about 30 minutes before arrival.
general.zh: 好的。我們會在抵達前大約 30 分鐘開始準備降落。

general.en: We'll start preparing for landing about 30 minutes before arrival.
general.zh: 我們會在抵達前大約 30 分鐘開始準備降落。

general.en: Seats must be upright for landing.
general.zh: 降落時椅背必須直立。

qa.en: Ask sales for the shipping plan: any EU unit landing on or after 20 January 2027 must be built to the Regulation.
qa.zh: 跟業務要出貨計畫：2027 年 1 月 20 日當天或之後進歐盟的機台，都要照新法規做。

words.definition: A person who owns a property and rents it to other people.

general.en: The landlord kept delaying the repairs, saying he didn't have time.
general.zh: 房東一直拖延維修，總說他沒有時間。

general.en: They had a serious dispute with their landlord.
general.zh: 他們和房東發生了一場嚴重的爭執。

general.en: As a landlord, it was his responsibility to maintain the apartment properly.
general.zh: 作為房東，妥善維護公寓是他的責任。

general.en: I asked the landlord several times to arrange repairs.
general.zh: 我請房東安排維修好幾次了。

general.en: The government introduced a rent cap in 2024, but landlords found ways around it.
general.zh: 政府在 2024 年實施了租金上限，但房東找到了繞過去的方法。

general.en: A landlord who deducts for normal wear.
general.zh: 一個因為正常損耗就扣錢的房東。

words.definition: a mass of earth or rock sliding down a mountain slope

general.en: Heavy rain led to landslides in the mountains.
general.zh: 豪雨導致山區發生土石流。

general.en: It is. And when it pours for hours, there's often a landslide on the mountain road.
general.zh: 確實危險。而且雨連下好幾個小時的時候，山路常常會發生土石流。

general.en: Last summer a landslide closed the road for two days. Some drivers got stuck up there overnight.
general.zh: 去年夏天有一次土石流讓那條路封閉了兩天，有些駕駛在山上卡了一整晚。

general.en: Heavy rain led to rockfalls and landslides in the mountains.
general.zh: 豪雨導致山區發生落石和土石流。（lead to = 導致，後面接名詞，與 cause 用法類似。）

general.en: This led to rockfalls and landslides; the roads were covered with mud.
general.zh: 這導致山區落石和土石流，道路被泥土覆蓋。（描述直接後果）

general.en: The earthquake caused a massive landslide.

words.definition: Difficulty communicating because people speak different languages.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: The language barrier is a big challenge abroad.
general.zh: 語言隔閡在國外是一大挑戰。

general.en: The language barrier is a big challenge.
general.zh: 語言隔閡是一大挑戰。

general.en: Don't underestimate the language barrier.
general.zh: 不要低估語言隔閡。

words.definition: a light inside a container that has a handle for holding it or hanging it up.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: Some cities hold lantern festivals with beautiful shows.
general.zh: 許多城市會舉辦燈節，有精彩的表演。

general.en: People decorate their homes with red couplets, paper lanterns, and the word "Fu", which means good fortune.
general.zh: 之後用春聯、燈籠與「福」字裝飾家裡。

general.en: People decorate their homes with red couplets, paper lanterns, and the word "Fu".
general.zh: 之後用春聯、燈籠與「福」字裝飾家裡。

general.en: Taichung Park was decorated with lanterns to celebrate the Lantern Festival.
general.zh: 台中公園為了慶祝元宵節而掛滿燈籠。

general.en: Yes, with money inside for good luck. Families also decorate their doors with couplets and hang lanterns.
general.zh: 對，裡面放錢代表好運。家家戶戶也會在門上貼對聯、掛燈籠。

general.en: It is a significant time for family gatherings. People barbecue outdoors and share food with neighbors; Taiwanese people eat mooncakes; and children carry lanterns.
general.zh: 這是重要的家庭團聚時刻。人們會在戶外烤肉、和鄰居分享食物；台灣人吃月餅，孩子提燈籠。（barbecue outdoors 比 barbecue outside 更自然）

words.definition: to continue for all of someone's life.

general.en: I know that our friendship will last a lifetime.
general.zh: 我知道我們的友誼會持續一輩子。

words.definition: 持續很長時間，有長遠影響的

general.en: Good habits have lasting benefits for your health.
general.zh: 良好的習慣對健康有長期的好處。

general.en: Cooking dinner together, watching movies in the living room, or celebrating birthdays as a group can create lasting friendships.
general.zh: 一起做晚飯、在客廳看電影或一群人慶祝生日，可以建立持久的友誼。（三個動名詞片語共同作為句子的主詞。）

general.en: Celebrating birthdays as a group can create lasting friendships.
general.zh: 一群人慶祝生日可以建立持久的友誼。

general.en: The new policy brought a lasting change in the company.
general.zh: 新政策給公司帶來了長期的變化。

general.en: Regular exercise has lasting benefits for your body and mind.
general.zh: 定期運動對身心都有長期的好處。

general.en: It can create lasting friendships.
general.zh: 可以建立持久的友誼。

words.definition: The ability to guide or direct a group of people.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Good leadership is important for a team.
general.zh: 好的領導力對團隊很重要。

general.en: So who takes the leadership role? Somebody has to organize the volunteers.
general.zh: 那誰來擔任領導的角色？總得有人來組織志工。

words.definition: to go away from a place, or to accidentally let something stay in a place.

general.en: I was in a hurry this morning and I left my phone at home.
general.zh: 今天早上我很趕時間，把手機忘在家裡了。

general.en: Please make sure you have all your personal belongings before leaving the train.
general.zh: 下車前請確認你帶齊所有隨身物品。

general.en: Please be careful not to leave any belongings in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 請小心不要把任何隨身物品留在頭頂行李櫃裡。

general.en: In this case, leave has the same meaning as depart from.
general.zh: 在這種情況下，leave 的意思等同於 depart from（離開）。

general.en: Since that day, Daniel has kept one simple rule: he never answers the phone while he is getting ready to leave.
general.zh: 從那天起，Daniel 就守著一個簡單的規則：準備出門的時候，他絕不接電話。

general.en: He reached the platform at 7:42. The train was gone. A station worker told him that the next train would leave in fifty minutes. Daniel sat down, took a deep breath, and sent his manager a short message: "I am going to be late. I am sorry."
general.zh: 他 7 點 42 分抵達月台。火車已經開走了。一位站務人員告訴他，下一班車五十分鐘後才發車。Daniel 坐下來，深呼吸，並傳了一則簡短訊息給主管：「我會遲到，很抱歉。」

qa.en: If we cut the sample this week and the penetration theory holds, the earliest re-test completion is week 6 — that leaves two weeks of buffer, assuming a first-pass success.
qa.zh: 如果這週切片、熔深的假設成立，重測最快第 6 週完成——而且要一次過，才剩兩週緩衝。

qa.en: The leg length of this fillet weld is 5 mm, as the drawing requires.
qa.zh: 這道角焊的焊腳長是 5 mm，符合圖面要求。

words.definition: The space in front of your seat for your legs.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: They recline their seats, leaving me with very little legroom.
general.zh: 他們把椅背往後調，害我沒什麼腿部空間。

general.en: Some passengers are inconsiderate because they recline their seats, leaving me with very little legroom.
general.zh: 有些乘客很不體貼，因為他們把椅背往後調，害我幾乎沒有腿部空間。

general.en: He reclined his seat, so I didn't have enough legroom.
general.zh: 他把椅背往後躺，我沒有足夠的伸腿空間。

general.en: This seat has very little legroom.
general.zh: 這個座位的腿部空間很小。

qa.en: Lessons learned from the last programme were not brought into this review.
qa.zh: 上一個案子學到的教訓，沒有帶進這次審查。

words.definition: A special jacket that helps you float in water.

general.en: Passengers must wear life jackets before getting on the boat.
general.zh: 乘客上船前必須穿上救生衣。

general.en: Before getting on the boat, passengers must wear a life jacket.
general.zh: 上船前，乘客必須穿上救生衣。

general.en: Before getting on the boat, passengers must wear life jackets.
general.zh: 上船前，乘客必須穿上救生衣。（大眾運輸「上／下」用 get on / get off：公車、火車、飛機、船、捷運。）

general.en: The flight attendant demonstrated how to use a life jacket.
general.zh: 空服員示範如何使用救生衣。

words.definition: someone who wakes up very easily from small noises or movements
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: He is a light sleeper.
general.zh: 他睡眠很淺，一點風吹草動就會醒。

words.definition: a hard white or grey rock.
words.lesson: 20260728 越南寧平旅遊 Tam Coc Trip

general.en: There were rice fields and limestone mountains.
general.zh: 有稻田和石灰岩山。

general.en: There was beautiful scenery, including limestone mountains.
general.zh: 有美麗的風景，包括石灰岩山。

general.en: There was beautiful scenery, including rice fields and limestone mountains.
general.zh: 有美麗的風景，包括稻田和石灰岩山。

general.en: ...rice fields and limestone mountains.
general.zh: ……稻田和石灰岩山。

words.definition: A substance that flows freely, like water.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: If we carry any liquids, we need to empty them into a bottle.
general.zh: 如果我們攜帶任何液體，需要把它們倒進一個瓶子裡。

general.en: If we have any liquids, we need to put them into a small container.
general.zh: 如果我們有任何液體，需要把它們放進一個小容器裡。

general.en: The officer will ask us not to carry any liquids.
general.zh: 工作人員會要求我們不要攜帶任何液體。

general.en: Put the liquids into a small container.
general.zh: 把液體放進小容器裡。

general.en: We can't carry any liquids.
general.zh: 我們不能攜帶任何液體。

general.en: My luggage contains some liquids.
general.zh: 我的行李裡裝有一些液體。

words.definition: full of energy, activity, and excitement

general.en: The party became lively once the performances started.
general.zh: 表演一開始，派對就變得熱鬧起來。

general.en: At night, the market becomes bustling and lively.
general.zh: 夜晚時，市場變得繁忙且熱鬧。

general.en: Very lively. The whole company sits at big round tables and shares a set menu.
general.zh: 非常熱鬧。全公司坐在大圓桌旁，一起吃合菜套餐。

general.en: The atmosphere is lively and festive.
general.zh: 氣氛熱鬧又有節慶感。

general.en: At night, the market becomes bustling and lively. Though it can get crowded, many people still enjoy visiting because it makes them feel connected to their community.
general.zh: 夜晚時，市場變得繁忙且熱鬧。雖然可能會變得很擁擠，許多人仍然喜歡造訪，因為這讓他們感到與社區有所連結。

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year. The atmosphere is lively and festive. The boss gives a speech, and we all make a toast together. The lucky draw is the most exciting part, and everyone has a great time.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。氣氛非常熱鬧且充滿節慶感。老闆會上台致詞，然後我們大家一起敬酒。抽獎是最令人興奮的部分，每個人都玩得很開心。

words.definition: a large amount or number of something, used in informal speech
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: I know if I had loads of money I'd be pretty happy.
general.zh: 我知道如果我有很多錢，我會相當快樂。

general.en: Fair enough. But some companies make loads of money using slave labour. That feels pretty evil to me.
general.zh: 有道理。可是有些公司靠奴工賺了大把的錢。這在我看來就相當邪惡。

general.en: Another common saying in English is "money can't buy happiness". I'm not so sure about this one. I know if I had loads of money I'd be pretty happy.
general.zh: 另一句常見的英語諺語是「金錢買不到快樂」。我對這一點不太確定。我知道如果我有很多錢，我會相當快樂。

general.en: I have loads of friends.

words.definition: continuing for a long period of time into the future.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: My long-term goal is to become a senior quality manager, lead cross-functional teams, and run projects successfully.
general.zh: 我的長期目標是成為資深品管經理，領導跨部門團隊，並成功地完成專案。

words.definition: not firmly fixed in place.

general.en: The wood panel is loose.
general.zh: 木板是鬆的。

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: Use the 5 Whys — the loose bolt is a symptom, not the root cause.
qa.zh: 用五問法追下去——螺絲鬆動只是症狀，不是根本原因。

qa.en: The resistance knob on the exercise bike feels loose — please hold this unit.
qa.zh: 這台飛輪車的阻力旋鈕有鬆動感，請先扣住這台。

qa.en: The welding fixture was loose. We added a daily check as the corrective action.
qa.zh: 焊接治具鬆掉，對策是加每日點檢。

qa.en: Risk: an optimistic detection score hides a high-severity failure mode, and severity 7 with a loose fastener is a safety conversation.
qa.zh: 風險：偵測度給太樂觀，高嚴重度的故障模式就被藏起來了——嚴重度 7 加上螺栓鬆脫，那是安全問題。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

words.definition: A group of units of the same product made under the same conditions and inspected together.
a game where people buy tickets with numbers, hoping to win a large amount of money

general.en: If she won the lottery, she would buy a big house.
general.zh: 如果她中了彩券，她會買一棟大房子。

general.en: Okay, quick warm-up before we start. If you won the lottery tomorrow, what would you do first?
general.zh: 好，開始上課前先來個暖身。如果你明天中了樂透，你會先做什麼？

general.en: Honestly, though, fluency is less about the lottery and more about effort.
general.zh: 不過老實說，流利這件事跟中樂透沒什麼關係，比較是靠努力。

words.definition: good or bad things that happen to a person by chance, not because of effort.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: People believe this festival brings good luck, health, and happiness for the new year.
general.zh: 人們相信它會帶來新一年的好運、健康與幸福。

general.en: I put money in the red envelope and placed it under my pillow to bring good luck.
general.zh: 我把錢放進紅包裡，然後把它放在枕頭下以帶來好運。

general.en: People put red couplets on the door and pray for good luck.
general.zh: 人們把紅色春聯貼在門上並祈求好運。

general.en: Many superstitious people believe the number 4 brings bad luck.
general.zh: 許多迷信的人認為數字 4 會帶來厄運。

general.en: If this season has taught us anything, it is that preparation matters more than luck.
general.zh: 如果說這一季教會了我們什麼，那就是準備比運氣更重要。

general.en: Later, Emma's manager asked about her experience. She explained that success does not happen by luck. Intelligent people learn from their mistakes, understand the symptoms of problems, and take action before small issues become big ones.
general.zh: 後來，Emma 的主管詢問了她的經驗。她解釋說成功不是靠運氣。聰明的人從錯誤中學習，了解問題的症狀，並在小問題變成大問題之前採取行動。

words.definition: a game where winners are chosen randomly to receive prizes

general.en: The lucky draw is the most exciting part of the night.
general.zh: 抽獎是整晚最令人興奮的部分。

general.en: No, you just stand up and raise your glass. After dinner, the MC starts the lucky draw.
general.zh: 不用，你只要站起來舉杯就好。晚餐後，主持人就會開始抽獎。

general.en: The lucky draw is the most exciting part.
general.zh: 抽獎是最令人興奮的部分。

general.en: There are often performances, lucky draws, and prize giveaways, and sometimes the boss gives a short speech.
general.zh: 現場常有表演、抽獎和獎品發放，有時老闆也會上台簡單致詞。

general.en: Banquet activities may include performances like dancing or singing, and a lucky draw with gifts or money.
general.zh: 宴會活動可能包含唱歌或跳舞表演，以及有獎品或現金的抽獎活動。

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year. The atmosphere is lively and festive. The boss gives a speech, and we all make a toast together. The lucky draw is the most exciting part, and everyone has a great time.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。氣氛非常熱鬧且充滿節慶感。老闆會上台致詞，然後我們大家一起敬酒。抽獎是最令人興奮的部分，每個人都玩得很開心。

words.definition: Bags and cases that you carry when travelling.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: He weighed his luggage to make sure it wasn't over the weight limit.
general.zh: 他秤了行李，以確保沒有超重。

general.en: Let me check. Yes, I can give you an aisle seat near the front. Are you checking any luggage today?
general.zh: 我查一下。可以，我可以給您前面一點的靠走道座位。今天有要託運行李嗎？

general.en: He has just arrived and is looking for his luggage /ˈlʌɡ.ɪdʒ/.
general.zh: 他剛到，正在找他的行李。

general.en: I need a cart for my luggage.
general.zh: 我需要一台推車放行李。

general.en: Does this insurance cover lost luggage?
general.zh: 這份保險有理賠行李遺失嗎？

general.en: My luggage hasn't arrived.
general.zh: 我的行李還沒到。

general.en: The radiator helps reduce the machine temperature.
general.zh: 散熱器幫助降低機台溫度。

general.en: The technician fixed the machine in no time.
general.zh: 技師很快就修好了機器。

general.en: Your carry-on bags will pass through an X-ray machine.
general.zh: 你的隨身行李會通過 X 光機掃描。

general.en: The technician repaired the machine efficiently and saved time.
general.zh: 技師有效率地修理機器並節省時間。

general.en: I have some clothes to wash. Can you show me how to use the washing machine?
general.zh: 6. 我有些衣服要洗，你可以教我怎麼用洗衣機嗎？

general.en: They have been having problems with the machine all morning.
general.zh: 他們整個早上都一直不斷地在機台上遇到問題。（強調持續不斷經歷困難且感到折騰）

qa.en: Sorting 2,000 strength machine covers by hand is a real cost of poor quality.
qa.zh: 用人工挑選兩千個重訓機外殼是實實在在的劣質成本。

qa.en: A machine that measures a part in three axes with a touch probe and compares the result against the CAD model or drawing.
qa.zh: 用觸發式探針在 X、Y、Z 三軸量工件，再跟 CAD 或圖面比對的量測機。

qa.en: We can meet it with a machining operation, and that changes the cost.
qa.zh: 改機加工做得到，但成本會不一樣。

qa.en: We cannot make that tolerance with our machine now. We should ask the customer first.
qa.zh: 現在的機台做不到那個公差，我們應該先問客戶。

qa.en: Welders are qualified, welding parameters are locked in the machine, and we perform periodic destructive testing to verify penetration.
qa.zh: 焊工有考過資格，焊接參數鎖在機台上，定期做破壞測試看熔深。

qa.en: The prototype was machined and this lot is die-cast — different process, different first article. FAI follows the process, not the part number.
qa.zh: 原型是 CNC 加工，這批是壓鑄——製程不同就是不同的首件。FAI 跟著製程走，不是跟著料號走。

qa.en: We can meet it with a machining operation, and that changes the cost.
qa.zh: 改機加工做得到，但成本會不一樣。

qa.en: Deburr and clean the part after machining.
qa.zh: 加工後請去毛邊並清潔工件。

qa.en: Place the stylus perpendicular to the machining marks.
qa.zh: 探針方向須垂直於加工紋路。

qa.en: Turn on the magnetic V-block to hold the workpiece.
qa.zh: 開啟磁性 V 型枕以吸住工件。

words.definition: The most important person in a story, film or TV series.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: Dr. House is the main character in the hit TV series.
general.zh: House 醫生是這部熱門影集的主角。

general.en: The main character in that old medical series?
general.zh: 那部舊醫療影集的主角嗎？

general.en: Yes. He's the main character, and he's constantly telling everyone that the worst thing will happen.
general.zh: 對。他就是主角，而且他不斷地告訴所有人最糟的事一定會發生。

general.en: Dr. House is the main character in the TV series.
general.zh: House 醫生是這部影集的主角。

general.en: Dr. Gregory House, the main character in the hit TV series House, M.D., is famous for being a pessimist. But it is not only Dr. House who is a pessimist. Hugh Laurie, the actor who plays him, is a pessimist, too.
general.zh: 葛瑞格里·豪斯醫生是熱門影集《怪醫豪斯》的主角，以悲觀出名。但悲觀的不只是豪斯醫生，飾演他的演員休·羅利本人也是個悲觀者。

words.definition: To keep something in good condition by checking or repairing it regularly.

general.en: As a landlord, it was his responsibility to maintain the apartment properly.
general.zh: 作為房東，妥善維護公寓是他的責任。

general.en: She maintained a healthy diet throughout her pregnancy.
general.zh: 她在整個懷孕期間都保持健康的飲食。

general.en: The company has maintained the same safety standard for a decade.
general.zh: 這家公司十年來一直維持著同樣的安全標準。

general.en: Not at all. A tenant pays the rent; the landlord maintains the building.
general.zh: 完全不用。房客付房租，房東負責維護房子。

general.en: It is the landlord's duty to maintain the house.
general.zh: 保養房子是房東的責任。

general.en: Emma was a passionate employee who always dreamed of achieving career success. She was dedicated to learning and self-improvement, and her manager encouraged her to maintain a positive mindset and believe in her abilities.
general.zh: Emma 是一位充滿熱情的員工，一直夢想著在職涯上獲得成功。她很投入於學習與自我提升，而她的主管鼓勵她保持正面的心態，並相信自己的能力。

words.definition: A major defect is likely to cause failure or unsafe use; a minor one only affects appearance or feel.
to help to make something successful.

general.en: She made a useful contribution to the discussion.
general.zh: 她對討論做出了有用的貢獻。

words.definition: to raise your glass and say something nice before drinking, to celebrate someone or something

general.en: Let's raise our glasses and make a toast to our success.
general.zh: 讓我們舉杯，為我們的成功敬酒。

general.en: Exactly. At the beginning our manager always likes to make a toast to the whole team.
general.zh: 沒錯。一開始我們經理總是喜歡向全體同仁敬酒。

general.en: Our company holds an annual banquet every year. The atmosphere is lively and festive. The boss gives a speech, and we all make a toast together. The lucky draw is the most exciting part, and everyone has a great time.
general.zh: 我們公司每年都會舉辦年終宴會。氣氛非常熱鬧且充滿節慶感。老闆會上台致詞，然後我們大家一起敬酒。抽獎是最令人興奮的部分，每個人都玩得很開心。

words.definition: to try hard to do something.

general.en: Michael is really making an effort with his maths this term.
general.zh: Michael 這學期在數學上真的很努力。

words.definition: to give a reason so you do not have to do something.

general.en: I'm too tired to go out. Let's make an excuse and stay at home.
general.zh: 我太累了，不想出去。咱們找個藉口待在家吧。

words.definition: to plan and prepare for something.

general.en: The school can make arrangements for pupils with special needs.
general.zh: 學校可以為有特殊需求的學生做安排。

words.definition: to improve or move forward.

general.en: Holly is making progress with all her schoolwork.
general.zh: Holly 在所有學校作業上都有進步。

general.en: improve = make progress = get better：Do you think your English is improving? / getting better? / Are you making progress in English?
general.zh: 你覺得你的英文有在進步嗎？（現在進行式表示英文能力正在逐漸變好，強調「持續中的變化」。）

general.en: Although learning an intermediate level language can sometimes be frustrating, I stay motivated and enthusiastic because I want to express my basic ideas accurately and make progress.
general.zh: 雖然學習中級程度的語言有時會令人挫折，但我保持積極與熱情，因為我想準確地表達我的基本想法並取得進步。

general.en: I want to make progress.
He bought his wife flowers to make up for forgetting her birthday.
general.zh: 他買花來彌補忘記太太生日的錯誤。

general.en: The company gave customers a discount to make up for the delay.
general.zh: 公司給顧客折扣來補償延誤。

general.en: Nothing can make up for losing a loved one.
general.zh: 沒有任何東西可以彌補失去親人的痛苦。

general.en: I'll cook dinner to make up for being late.
general.zh: 我會煮晚餐來彌補遲到。

general.en: He worked overtime to make up for the lost time.
general.zh: 他加班來彌補失去的時間。

words.definition: to move out of the way so someone or something can pass.

general.en: Please make way and let the ambulance get past.
general.zh: 請讓路，讓救護車通過。

general.en: Please make way for the ambulance.
general.zh: 請讓路給救護車。

general.en: Make way! Hot soup coming through!
general.zh: 借過／讓路！熱湯來了！

words.definition: a failure of a machine or piece of equipment to work correctly.

general.en: I frequently investigate appliance malfunctions and work with design engineers to correct dimensional inaccuracies.
general.zh: 我經常會調查設備異常，並與設計工程師合作修正尺寸不準確的問題。

general.en: This event, typically held before a major holiday or at the close of the fiscal year, brings together employees from all levels of the organization—from staff to senior management—for a formal or semi-formal gathering.
general.zh: 這類活動通常在重要節日前或會計年度結束時舉行，讓公司各層級的員工——從一般職員到高階管理層——齊聚一堂，參加一場正式或半正式的聚會。

qa.en: Our quality management system is certified to ISO 9001 and subject to annual surveillance audits.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 有 ISO 9001 認證，每年都有追查稽核。

qa.en: We have not received a response after two follow-ups, so I am escalating this to your management.
qa.zh: 追了兩次都沒回音，所以我把這件事往你們主管那邊提了。

qa.en: I need a decision from management on whether we accept this risk.
qa.zh: 這個風險要不要吃，要請主管決定。
