qa.en: Give management a risk statement, not a yes/no: what we know, what we assume, and what the re-test will tell us.
qa.zh: 給主管的是風險說明，不是打包票：我們知道什麼、假設什麼、重測會告訴我們什麼。

qa.en: If management still wants a direct release, make it a documented deviation with a named approver — not a verbal favor.
qa.zh: 主管還是要直接放行的話，就走特採——有人具名簽核的那種，不是口頭人情。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

general.en: We evaluate potential risks before mass production.
general.zh: 我們在量產前會評估潛在風險。

general.en: If we finish the FAI (First Article Inspection) today, we will start mass production tomorrow.
general.zh: 如果我們今天完成首件檢查，我們明天就會開始量產。

general.en: As a result, we corrected the issue before mass production, preventing a costly recall and potential damage to our client relationship. This improved our production-line efficiency by 15% for that specific model.
general.zh: 結果我們在量產前修正了問題，避免了昂貴的召回與客戶關係受損。這也讓該款產品的生產線效率提升了 15%。

qa.en: A full dimensional and functional check of the first piece produced after a new setup, before mass production is released.
qa.zh: 換模或重新設定後，把第一件的尺寸跟功能整個檢一遍，過了才放量產。

qa.en: Mass production is released only after the first article inspection is approved.
qa.zh: 首件過了才放量產。

qa.en: The package of evidence submitted to the customer to prove the process can consistently make parts to specification before mass production is approved.
qa.zh: 量產核准前交給客戶的一整包資料，證明製程能穩定做出合規格的東西。

qa.en: Mass production will not start until we receive your written approval of the submission; any subsequent change requires a new submission.
qa.zh: 你們書面承認之前不會開量產；之後有任何變更都要重新送。

qa.en: Risk: if this report goes into the PPAP file, the finding surfaces later at a customer audit, and by then the parts are already in mass production.
qa.zh: 風險：這份報告一進 PPAP 檔案，缺失就會等到客戶稽核才爆出來，那時候零件早就量產了。

qa.en: We perform first article inspection whenever there is a new setup, a mold change, or a design change. Mass production is not released until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 只要重新設定、換模或設計變更，就做首件。品保沒簽首件，不放量產。

general.en: It was caused by weak controls over raw materials and not enough testing before products left the factory.
general.zh: 而是原料控管不足，加上產品出廠前檢驗不夠所造成的。

general.en: The delay in materials caused the production schedule to be disrupted.
general.zh: 材料延遲導致生產進度被打亂。

qa.en: The sample submission package includes dimensional, material, and performance evidence plus the process documents.
qa.zh: 樣品承認資料有尺寸、材質、性能的數據，還有製程文件。

qa.en: The controlled documents that define the required dimensions, tolerances, materials, and acceptance criteria of the product.
qa.zh: 定產品尺寸、公差、材質跟允收標準的管制文件。

qa.en: What is the tensile strength requirement for this material?
qa.zh: 這個材質的抗拉強度要求是多少？

qa.en: A typical submission includes the dimensional results, material and performance test reports, the control plan, the PFMEA, the process flow, and the sample parts.
qa.zh: 通常會交尺寸報告、材質跟性能測試報告、管制計畫、PFMEA、製程流程圖，再加樣品。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

qa.en: We run tensile tests on incoming steel tube and on welded joints. The specimen is prepared per the standard, and the result is compared against the material specification on the drawing.
qa.zh: 進料鋼管跟焊接接頭會做拉伸。試片照標準做，結果跟圖面的材質規格比。

qa.en: Please provide the material certification for the new grade.
qa.zh: 請提供新等級的材證。

qa.en: The PPAP package is missing the material certifications and the capability study for the critical dimensions. Please complete and resubmit before the run-at-rate.
qa.zh: PPAP 資料少了材證跟關鍵尺寸的能力分析。請在 run-at-rate 前補齊重交。

qa.en: Decide what re-qualification is needed — at minimum material certification, and possibly UV and impact testing for outdoor-exposed parts.
qa.zh: 決定要重新驗證哪些——至少要材證，外露件可能還要做 UV 跟衝擊測試。

qa.en: Please provide the following by Thursday: (1) the exact change date and affected lot numbers, (2) the material certification of the new grade, and (3) your comparison data between the old and new material.
qa.zh: 請在週四前提供：(1) 確切的變更日期跟受影響批號、(2) 新等級的材證、(3) 新舊材料的比對數據。

qa.en: The change date, the affected lot numbers, and the material certification of the new grade — in writing, by Thursday. Until re-qualification is done, the affected lots stay on hold.
qa.zh: 變更日期、受影響批號、新等級的材證——用書面給，週四前。重新驗證完成前，受影響的批次繼續扣著。

qa.en: The material thickness is 2.0 mm plus or minus 0.1 mm.
qa.zh: 板厚為 2.0 mm ± 0.1 mm。

words.definition: the person who introduces and guides the activities at an event (short for 'Master of Ceremonies'; also simply called the host).

general.en: The MC did a great job keeping everyone entertained.
general.zh: 主持人表現得很棒，讓大家都玩得很開心。

general.en: No, you just stand up and raise your glass. After dinner, the MC starts the lucky draw.
general.zh: 不用，你只要站起來舉杯就好。晚餐後，主持人就會開始抽獎。

words.definition: When food is served on the plane.

general.en: Meal service will begin shortly.
general.zh: 餐點服務即將開始。

words.definition: an illness that gives you red spots on your skin.

general.en: The doctor came and said that I had the measles.
general.zh: 醫生來了，說我得了麻疹。

qa.en: Before we trust the new thickness gauge, please run a measurement system analysis.
qa.zh: 在信任這台新膜厚計之前，請先做量測系統分析。

qa.en: How do you know your measurement itself is reliable?
qa.zh: 你們怎麼知道量出來的數字可信？

qa.en: The measurement system is validated by a Gage R&R study before the characteristic is released for routine inspection.
qa.zh: 這個特性排進例行檢驗之前，先用 GR&R 把量測系統驗過。

qa.en: Measurement system analysis is repeated whenever the gauge, the fixture, or the operator group changes.
qa.zh: 量具、治具或量的人換了，GR&R 就重做。

qa.en: The CMM program is version-controlled and the measurement report can be issued in your required format, including the actual value and the deviation for every characteristic.
qa.zh: 三次元程式有版本管制，報告可以照你們要的格式出，每個特性都有實測值跟偏差。

qa.en: Three operators measure ten parts three times each. Under 10% total variation is acceptable, 10–30% is conditionally acceptable, and over 30% means the measurement system must be improved.
qa.zh: 三個人各量十件、每件量三次。總變異 10% 以下 OK，10～30% 有條件接受，超過 30% 量測系統就要改。

words.definition: A study that checks whether the gauge and the operator can measure repeatably and reproducibly.
A person who repairs machines, especially cars and motorcycles.

general.en: The mechanic fixed my car within an hour.
general.zh: 技師在一小時內就修好了我的車。

general.en: The mechanic filled the tank with fuel.
general.zh: 技師把油箱加滿燃料。

words.definition: the amount of money that doctor visits, hospital stays, or medicine cost.

general.en: Even with insurance, medical costs can be very high in the USA.
general.zh: 即使有保險，在美國的醫療費用仍可能非常高昂。

general.en: Health insurance helps cover medical costs.
general.zh: 健康保險幫助支付醫療費用。

general.en: Most medical costs, especially for serious illnesses or surgeries, are covered by government insurance, so healthcare is relatively affordable.
general.zh: 對於重大疾病或手術，大部分醫療費用由保險支付，因此醫療費用相對便宜。

words.definition: the total money spent on healthcare, doctors, and medicine, often emphasizing the cost or spending.

general.en: Her health insurance covered all her medical expenses after the surgery.
general.zh: 她的健康保險支付了她手術後的所有醫療費用。

general.en: Without insurance, medical expenses can be very costly.
general.zh: 如果沒有保險，醫療費用可能會非常昂貴。

general.en: In my country, medical expenses can be really high. One night in the hospital costs a fortune.
general.zh: 在我的國家，醫療費用可能非常高。住院一晚就要花一大筆錢。

general.en: The money spent on healthcare and medicine — Her health insurance covered all her medical expenses after the surgery.
general.zh: 花費在醫療保健和藥物上的錢。註：和 Medical cost 意思非常相近，但 expenses 更常強調「花費、開銷」，通常用複數。（她的健康保險支付了她手術後的所有醫療費用。）

general.en: Patients often need to pay monthly premiums and deductibles before insurance covers costs, and medical expenses can be very expensive, especially without insurance.
general.zh: 病患通常需要支付每月保費與自付額，而且醫療費用通常非常高，尤其是沒有保險時。

words.definition: to meet someone at an arranged place.

general.en: They meet up at the end of their street and walk to town.
general.zh: 她們在街尾碰面，然後走路去城裡。

general.en: The two meetings clash, so we need to reschedule.
general.zh: 兩個會議時間衝突，需要重新安排。

general.en: Can we reschedule the meeting to Thursday?
general.zh: 我們可以把會議改到週四嗎？

general.en: The gist of the meeting was about product quality issues.
general.zh: 會議的主旨是關於產品品質問題。

general.en: I sent a meeting request to my manager.
general.zh: 我發了一個會議邀請給我的主管。

general.en: I dozed off during the long meeting.
general.zh: 我在冗長的會議中不小心睡著了。

general.en: The long meeting was tiring.
general.zh: 這場漫長的會議很累人。

qa.en: As discussed in today's meeting, the summary and action items are listed below.
qa.zh: 今天會議談的，重點跟待辦整理如下。

qa.en: Turn "everyone knows" items in meeting minutes into tracked open risks with owners and closure criteria.
qa.zh: 會議記錄裡「大家都知道」的事，要變成有人負責、有關閉條件的追蹤風險。

qa.en: The hinge supplier's sample was machined, but the production version would be die-cast to save cost. Everyone knew this, and it was written in the meeting minutes — as an FYI, not as an open risk.
qa.zh: 鉸鏈供應商送驗的樣品是 CNC 加工件，量產版為了省成本要改壓鑄。這件事大家都知道，也寫進會議記錄了——但是當成「知會一下」，不是當成「還沒關掉的風險」。

words.definition: Worth remembering; likely to be remembered for a long time.

general.en: It was my first time visiting Japan, and it was truly memorable.
general.zh: 這是我第一次訪問日本，真的令人難忘。

words.definition: to ruin or disrupt something

general.en: A typhoon often messes up flight schedules.
general.zh: 颱風常常打亂班機時刻表。

words.definition: to send someone a text message.

general.en: They talk on their phones or they message each other.
general.zh: 她們用電話聊天或互傳訊息。

general.en: A message was later sent to every tenant.
general.zh: 後來有一則訊息發給每位房客。

general.en: Did you message anyone about being late?
general.zh: 你有傳訊息跟誰說你會遲到嗎？

general.en: Yes, I sent a quick message to my manager. She said it was fine because other coworkers were late too.
general.zh: 有，我傳了簡短的訊息給主管。她說沒關係，因為其他同事也遲到了。

general.en: He reached the platform at 7:42. The train was gone. A station worker told him that the next train would leave in fifty minutes. Daniel sat down, took a deep breath, and sent his manager a short message: "I am going to be late. I am sorry."
general.zh: 他 7 點 42 分抵達月台。火車已經開走了。一位站務人員告訴他，下一班車五十分鐘後才發車。Daniel 坐下來，深呼吸，並傳了一則簡短訊息給主管：「我會遲到，很抱歉。」

general.en: Mia waited almost fifteen minutes before a train finally arrived. It was much slower than her usual train, so she sent a quick message to her manager. Her manager said it was fine because two other coworkers were also late.
general.zh: Mia等了快十五分鐘，列車才終於進站。它比她平常搭的班次慢了很多，所以她傳了一則簡短的訊息給主管。主管說沒關係，因為另外兩位同事也遲到了。

qa.en: Use the metallographic cutting machine to prepare the cross-section.
qa.zh: 用金相切割機製作剖面試片。

general.en: Now Tom practices every weekend at the same pool. He can swim about ten meters without stopping. There is a swimming competition for beginners in October.
general.zh: 現在Tom每個週末都在同一個泳池練習。他現在可以連續游大約十公尺不停。十月有一場給初學者的游泳比賽。

qa.en: Check the gloss with a gloss meter at three points.
qa.zh: 用光澤計在三個點量測光澤度。

qa.en: Use the vibration meter to check the vibration level of the motor.
qa.zh: 用振動儀檢查馬達的振動值。

qa.en: Clamp the meter around one wire to read the current.
qa.zh: 把鉤錶夾住單一條電線讀取電流。

qa.en: Verify the screwdriver setting with the torque meter.
qa.zh: 用扭力計確認起子的設定扭力。

words.definition: The seat between the window and the aisle.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: The middle seat is between the window and the aisle.
general.zh: 中間座位在靠窗和走道之間。

general.en: Nobody likes the middle seat.
general.zh: 沒有人喜歡中間座位。

words.definition: a very painful type of headache that can also cause nausea or sensitivity to light.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: I had a terrible migraine and couldn't focus on reviewing the new product designs.
general.zh: 我偏頭痛得很厲害，無法專心審查新產品設計。

general.en: She couldn't work today because of a bad illness / migraine.
general.zh: 她今天無法工作，因為嚴重的生病／偏頭痛。

general.en: The engineer suffered from a migraine yesterday.
general.zh: 這位工程師昨天偏頭痛發作了。（現在已經好轉。）

general.en: The engineer will suffer from a migraine if he doesn't sleep well.
general.zh: 如果這位工程師沒睡好，他將會引發偏頭痛。（預測或警告。）

general.en: Flu: feeling weak, feverish, tired; Migraine: headache with nausea or light sensitivity; Depression: mental illness causing sadness, fatigue.
general.zh: 流感：虛弱、發燒、疲倦；偏頭痛：頭痛伴隨噁心或畏光；憂鬱症：造成悲傷與疲勞的心理疾病。

general.en: The engineer suffers from a migraine.
general.zh: 這位工程師受偏頭痛所苦。（描述他長期的健康狀況或體質。）

qa.en: The mill certificate states the grade but not the recycled content.
qa.zh: 材證上有寫鋼種，但沒寫再生料含量。

qa.en: Tensile testing is performed on every incoming material lot, and the mill certificate is cross-checked against our own test result.
qa.zh: 每批進料都做拉伸，材證跟我們自己測的結果會互相對。

qa.en: The 30% figure came from a supplier email rather than from a document, so we are withdrawing it. We can provide the material grade and the mill certificates we hold today.
qa.zh: 30% 這個數字是從供應商 email 來的，不是文件，所以我們撤回。我們今天可以給的是鋼種和手上的材證。

words.definition: To copy the way someone speaks, moves, or behaves.

general.en: My little brother likes to mimic everything I say.
general.zh: 我弟弟很喜歡模仿我說的每一句話。

general.en: I'd follow my friends around and mimic their actions.
general.zh: 我會跟著朋友並模仿他們的動作。

general.en: The parrot can mimic human speech.
general.zh: 這隻鸚鵡會模仿人類說話。

words.definition: a way of thinking about things.

general.en: Her manager often encouraged her to keep a positive mindset.
general.zh: 她的主管經常鼓勵她保持正面心態。

general.en: a backup charger, a downloaded document, a flexible mindset about what "on time" really means.
general.zh: 備用充電器、事先下載好的文件、對「準時」這件事保有彈性的心態。

general.en: Is there a mindset shift that helps?
general.zh: 有什麼心態上的轉變有幫助嗎？

general.en: I have a positive mindset.
general.zh: 我有正面的心態。

general.en: Although the situation was an unexpected failure, the manager had a positive mindset. She was an optimist and believed that every problem could become an opportunity to improve.
general.zh: 儘管這次情況是一個意料之外的失敗，經理擁有正面的心態。她是個樂觀的人，相信每個問題都能成為進步的機會。

general.en: Emma always dreamed of achieving success in her career. She was a very passionate employee who loved learning new skills and improving herself. Her manager often encouraged her to keep a positive mindset and believe in her abilities.
general.zh: Emma 一直夢想在事業上取得成功。她是一位非常有熱忱的員工，熱愛學習新技能和提升自己。她的主管經常鼓勵她保持正面心態，相信自己的能力。

words.definition: Small in size, importance, or seriousness; not very serious.

general.en: It was just a minor problem, easy to fix.
general.zh: 這只是個小問題，很容易修好。

general.en: It was just a minor accident; no one was hurt.
general.zh: 那只是一件小意外，沒有人受傷。

general.en: The landlord argued that I should have fixed minor issues myself.
general.zh: 房東辯稱我應該自己修理那些小問題。

general.en: Take it easy; it's a minor mistake.
general.zh: 放輕鬆；這只是一個小錯誤。

qa.en: A cracked weld on the squat rack is a major defect; a small paint run is minor.
qa.zh: 深蹲架焊道裂痕是主要缺點；輕微流漆則是次要缺點。

qa.en: We apply different AQLs by defect class — tighter for critical and major defects, looser for minor cosmetic defects.
qa.zh: 不同缺點等級用不同 AQL：嚴重跟主要缺點抓緊一點，輕微外觀缺點放鬆一點。

qa.en: We apply AQL 0.65 for major defects and AQL 2.5 for minor defects, under general inspection level II. Critical defects are zero acceptance.
qa.zh: 一般檢驗水準 II，主要缺點用 AQL 0.65、輕微缺點用 AQL 2.5；嚴重缺點一件都不能收。

words.definition: a failure to communicate ideas or intentions clearly.

general.en: There were some miscommunication issues between team members.
general.zh: 團隊成員之間有溝通不良的問題。

general.en: There had been some miscommunication between the teams.
general.zh: 團隊之間出現了一些溝通不良。

general.en: Miscommunication issues among team members led to project delays.
general.zh: 團隊成員之間的溝通不良導致專案延誤。

general.en: One day, Emma's team faced a crisis during an important project. Miscommunication issues among team members led to project delays, creating extra work and stress. This communication failure became a significant obstacle.
general.zh: 有一天，Emma 的團隊在一個重要專案中遇到了危機。團隊成員之間的溝通不良導致專案延誤，製造了額外的工作與壓力。這次的溝通失敗成了一大阻礙。

words.definition: to regularly check something over a period of time in order to find out how it is changing.

general.en: I monitor potential issues early and investigate appliance problems.
general.zh: 我會及早監控潛在問題、調查設備異常。

general.en: Using two monitors is an efficient setup for engineers.
general.zh: 使用兩個螢幕對工程師來說是有效率的配置。

general.en: Finally, we implement improvements and monitor the results.
general.zh: 最後我們執行改善並追蹤結果。

general.en: Using two monitors is an efficient setup for engineers to deal with multiple tasks.
general.zh: 使用兩個螢幕對工程師來說是有效率的配置。

general.en: The doctor monitors her pregnancy carefully.
general.zh: 醫生仔細監控她的懷孕狀況。（描述目前的醫療常態或事實。）

general.en: I monitor potential issues early.
general.zh: 我會及早監控潛在問題。

qa.en: Monitoring a process with control charts and expressing how well it fits inside the specification limits.
qa.zh: 用管制圖盯製程，再用一個指數（Cpk）講製程落在規格內的程度。

qa.en: The key characteristic is monitored by control chart and the process capability index is reviewed monthly.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用管制圖盯，Cpk 每個月檢討。

qa.en: Tool life is controlled by piece count, and the key dimension is monitored on a control chart so that a wear trend is detected before it goes out of specification.
qa.zh: 刀具壽命用件數管，關鍵尺寸用管制圖盯，磨耗趨勢在超規之前就看得出來。

words.definition: an amount of money that you have to pay every month.

general.en: This is a government program. Everyone pays a small monthly fee.
general.zh: 這是一項政府計畫。每個人每個月繳納少量的費用。

general.en: Yes, everyone. You pay a small monthly fee, and your employer pays part of it too.
general.zh: 對，每個人都要。你每個月付一筆小額費用，你的雇主也會幫你負擔一部分。

general.en: Exactly. For most families, that monthly fee is definitely worth it.
general.zh: 沒錯。對大多數家庭來說，那筆每月費用絕對值得。

general.en: Everyone pays a small monthly fee.
general.zh: 每個人每個月繳納少量的費用。

words.definition: the feeling of nausea that some women have, especially in the early months of pregnancy.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: Many women experience morning sickness during the first few months of pregnancy.
general.zh: 許多女性在懷孕前幾個月會經歷晨吐。

general.en: The woman experienced morning sickness last month.
general.zh: 這位女士上個月經歷了孕吐。（可能現在進入懷孕中期，已經不吐了。）

general.en: The woman will experience morning sickness.
general.zh: 這位女士將會經歷孕吐。（醫生對她未來孕期狀況的預期或說明。）

general.en: The woman is experiencing morning sickness right now.
general.zh: 這位女士現在正經歷著孕吐。

general.en: The woman was experiencing morning sickness when she woke up.
general.zh: 當她起床的時候，這位女士當時正經歷著孕吐。

general.en: The woman experiences morning sickness.
general.zh: 這位女士經歷著孕吐。（描述她目前的孕期常態或事實。）

words.definition: the feeling of nausea you get from the movement of a car, boat, or plane.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: If you suffer from motion sickness, you should take medication before the boat trip.
general.zh: 如果你會暈船，你應該在搭船前吃藥。

general.en: I always feel nausea / motion sickness when I travel by boat.
general.zh: 當我搭船旅行時，我總是感到噁心／暈船。

general.en: She experiences motion sickness on the bus.
general.zh: 她在公車上會經歷暈車不適。（描述她容易暈車的體質或常態事實。）

general.en: She experienced motion sickness on the bus yesterday.
general.zh: 她昨天在公車上經歷了暈車不適。（現在已經下車沒事了。）

general.en: She will experience motion sickness on the bus if she reads her phone.
general.zh: 如果她在車上看手機，她將會經歷暈車不適。（善意警告。）

general.en: She is experiencing motion sickness on the bus right now.
general.zh: 她現在正在公車上經歷暈車不適。（可能需要馬上開窗透氣。）

words.definition: 有強烈的動機和意願

general.en: I am highly motivated to improve my English.
general.zh: 我非常有動力提升我的英文。

general.en: I feel motivated when I see progress in my English skills and I know my hard work is paying off.
general.zh: 當我看到自己的英文能力有進步，而且知道我的努力終於有了回報時，我感到很有動力。

general.en: He is very motivated to keep learning.
general.zh: 他很有動力持續學習。

general.en: Enthusiasm helps me stay motivated.
general.zh: 熱忱幫助我保持動力。（help + 受詞 + (to) V，可省略 to；stay + 形容詞 表示「保持…的狀態」。）

general.en: I stay motivated and enthusiastic.
general.zh: 我保持積極與熱情。

general.en: Although learning an intermediate level language can sometimes be frustrating, I stay motivated and enthusiastic because I want to express my basic ideas accurately and make progress.
general.zh: 雖然學習中級程度的語言有時會令人挫折，但我保持積極與熱情，因為我想準確地表達我的基本想法並取得進步。

general.en: The blender motor smells like it's burning.
general.zh: 果汁機的馬達聞起來像燒焦了。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100 % inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺絲採抽樣檢驗，但跑步機馬達採全檢。

qa.en: The FMEA rated motor overheating as the highest risk on the treadmill.
qa.zh: 失效模式與效應分析把馬達過熱列為跑步機的最高風險。

qa.en: Check the motor noise of every treadmill before packing.
qa.zh: 包裝前檢查每台跑步機的馬達噪音。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100% inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺栓抽檢，跑步機馬達全檢。

qa.en: We designated the motor mount torque as a special characteristic.
qa.zh: 我們把馬達座扭力指定為特殊特性。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

words.definition: 食物看起來或聞起來極其美味

general.en: The smell from the kitchen was mouth-watering.
general.zh: 廚房飄出的香味令人垂涎欲滴。

general.en: The mouth-watering smell gave me a big appetite.
general.zh: 那令人垂涎的香味讓我胃口大開。

general.en: If the food is mouth-watering, I gain appetite.
general.zh: 如果食物令人垂涎，我就會胃口大開。（mouth-watering 是形容詞：食物看起來或聞起來極其美味，讓「你的嘴巴開始流口水」——與中文「流口水」語境完全吻合。第一類條件句：If + 現在簡單式, 主句也用現在簡單式，表普遍規律。）

general.en: A mouth-watering dish can help you gain appetite.
general.zh: 誘人的菜餚可以刺激食慾（胃口變好）。

words.definition: wet, sticky earth

general.en: Mud flowed into the house after the heavy rain.
general.zh: 大雨過後，泥水流進了房子裡。

general.en: Cars would get stuck in the mud on the road.
general.zh: 車子會卡在路上的泥漿中動彈不得。

general.en: This led to rockfalls and landslides; the roads were covered with mud.
general.zh: 這導致山區落石和土石流，道路被泥土覆蓋。（描述直接後果）

general.en: Cars got stuck, mud flowed into houses, and the typhoon messed up flight schedules — many flights were cancelled.
general.zh: 車輛卡住動彈不得，泥水流進房屋，颱風也打亂了班機時刻表——許多班機被取消。（描述對人、基礎設施的影響）

general.en: My car got stuck in the mud.
general.zh: 我的車卡在泥巴裡了。

words.translation: 有霉味的、有陳腐氣味的
words.definition: smelling old, damp, and stale — often in poorly ventilated spaces

general.en: The clothes smell musty because the room is too damp.
general.zh: 衣服聞起來有一股霉味，因為房間太潮濕了。

general.en: The clothes smell musty. / The clothes have a moldy smell.
general.zh: 形容通風不良、潮濕空間所散發出的陳腐、發霉或潮濕的氣味。

qa.en: The test report is accepted under a mutual recognition arrangement.
qa.zh: 這份測試報告是靠相互承認協議被接受的。

words.definition: A person who takes care of children, usually in the family's home.

general.en: My nanny made sure my little brother ate his lunch.
general.zh: 我的保母確保我弟弟吃了午餐。

words.definition: Taiwan's government program that helps everyone pay for medical care.

general.en: In Taiwan, most people have National Health Insurance (NHI). This is a government program.
general.zh: 在台灣，大多數人都有全民健康保險 (NHI)。這是一項政府計畫。

general.en: Let me have a look. Ah, that one is for the National Health Insurance (NHI).
general.zh: 我看看。啊，那一筆是全民健康保險的費用。

words.definition: a day when most people in a country do not work.

general.en: Thanksgiving is a national holiday celebrated mainly in the United States and Canada.
general.zh: 感恩節是一個主要在美國和加拿大慶祝的國家節日。

general.en: It is an official holiday (national holiday); people do not have to go to work.
general.zh: 這是官方假日（國定假日），人們不用上班。（do not have to go to work 比 do not go to work 更自然，強調「不用上班」。老師課堂上糾正了 official /əˈfɪʃl/ 的發音。）

words.definition: someone who has spoken a language since they were a child.

general.en: Tom listens to native speakers and repeats what they say.
general.zh: Tom 聆聽母語人士說話，並重複他們說的內容。

words.definition: existing in a normal way and not changed or made artificial.

general.en: I would rather stay natural and look human.
general.zh: 我寧願保持自然，看起來像一個真正的人。

general.en: I prefer staying natural and looking human.
general.zh: 我比較喜歡保持自然、看起來像真正的人。（最常用）

general.en: I prefer to stay natural and (to) look human.
general.zh: 我比較喜歡保持自然、看起來像真正的人。

general.en: I would rather stay natural than change my appearance.
general.zh: 我寧願保持自然，也不要改變外表。

general.en: She prefers a natural look.
general.zh: 她比較喜歡自然的外表。

general.en: I would rather stay natural.
general.zh: 我寧願保持自然。

words.definition: the uncomfortable feeling in your stomach that makes you think you are going to vomit.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: She felt a wave of nausea after eating the spoiled food.
general.zh: 吃到壞掉的食物後，她感到一陣噁心。

general.en: You can, but only after eating something light. I'll also give you medicine to relieve the nausea.
general.zh: 可以，但一定要先吃點清淡的東西再吃。我也會開藥幫你緩解噁心的感覺。

general.en: I always feel nausea / motion sickness when I travel by boat.
general.zh: 當我搭船旅行時，我總是感到噁心／暈船。

general.en: He felt nausea during the long flight yesterday.
general.zh: 他昨天在長途飛行中感到了噁心。（現在已經落地且沒事了。）

general.en: Flu: feeling weak, feverish, tired; Migraine: headache with nausea or light sensitivity; Depression: mental illness causing sadness, fatigue.
general.zh: 流感：虛弱、發燒、疲倦；偏頭痛：頭痛伴隨噁心或畏光；憂鬱症：造成悲傷與疲勞的心理疾病。

general.en: He feels nausea during long flights.
general.zh: 他在長途飛行中會感到噁心。（💡 flight 加 s 變複數，表示「每一次長途飛行」，描述體質或常態。）

words.definition: feeling like you might vomit.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: I feel very nauseous after staying up too late last night.
general.zh: 昨晚熬夜太晚之後，我覺得非常噁心。

general.en: I also feel dizzy when I stand up, and I feel nauseous almost all the time.
general.zh: 我站起來的時候會頭暈，而且幾乎一直覺得噁心想吐。

general.en: I feel very nauseous / unwell after staying up too late last night.
general.zh: 昨晚熬夜太晚之後，我覺得非常噁心／不舒服。

general.en: After eating spoiled food, I felt nauseous and started vomiting.
general.zh: 吃了壞掉的食物後，我覺得噁心並開始嘔吐。

general.en: I feel dizzy. / I feel nauseous.
general.zh: 我覺得頭暈。／我覺得噁心想吐。

words.definition: 與他人討論以達成協議

general.en: He is trying to negotiate a higher salary.
general.zh: 他正試著協商更高的薪資。

general.en: He is trying to negotiate a higher salary before his business trip.
general.zh: 他在出差前正試著協商更高的薪資。

general.en: The manager negotiated a new contract with the client.
general.zh: 經理與客戶協商了一份新合約。

general.en: We need to negotiate the price before making a deal.
general.zh: 我們需要在成交前協商價格。

general.en: Roommates need to negotiate chores so everyone shares the work fairly.
general.zh: 室友們需要協商家事，以便每個人都能公平地分擔工作。

general.en: Negotiating these differences requires patience and clear communication.
general.zh: 協商這些分歧需要耐心和清晰的溝通。（動名詞片語當主詞視為單數，動詞加 s 變 requires。）

words.definition: An area of a town where people live.

general.en: The agent showed me several options and advised on good neighborhoods.
general.zh: 仲介向我展示了幾個選擇，並針對優質的社區提供了建議。

general.en: The estate agent showed me several apartments and advised on good neighborhoods.
general.zh: 房地產仲介帶我看了幾間公寓，並針對優質的社區提供建議。

general.en: I really like this neighborhood. Everything is close by.
general.zh: 我很喜歡這個社區，什麼都很近。

general.en: The hurricane destroyed entire neighborhoods.
general.zh: 那場颶風摧毀了整個社區。

general.en: Last year, I moved to a very crowded neighborhood in the city. The population is large, and the streets are always full of cars, especially during rush hour.
general.zh: 去年，我搬到了市裡一個非常擁擠的社區。這裡人口眾多，街道上總是擠滿了車，尤其是在交通尖峰時間。

words.definition: Feeling worried or afraid about something that is going to happen.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Last Saturday, Tom went to the pool for his first swimming lesson. He felt very nervous before the class began.
general.zh: 上週六，Tom去泳池上了他的第一堂游泳課。在課程開始前，他覺得非常緊張。

general.en: He felt very nervous before the class began.
general.zh: 在課程開始前，他覺得非常緊張。

general.en: Amy still gets nervous before every attempt.
general.zh: Amy在每次嘗試前還是會緊張。

general.en: I felt nervous before the test.
general.zh: 考試前我覺得很緊張。

general.en: My brain gets stuck when I'm nervous.
general.zh: 當我緊張的時候腦袋會卡住。

general.en: Yesterday evening, Amy's company announced a typhoon day off, because a strong storm approached the city. Amy has never experienced such a strong typhoon before, so she felt a little nervous.
general.zh: 昨天晚上，Amy的公司宣布放颱風假，因為一個強烈的暴風接近了這座城市。Amy從來沒經歷過這麼強的颱風，所以她覺得有點緊張。

qa.en: Corrosion resistance is verified by neutral salt spray testing per ASTM B117 for the specified duration.
qa.zh: 耐蝕性照 ASTM B117 做中性鹽霧，做到規定的小時數。

qa.en: FAI is required at new product introduction, after a mold or fixture change, after a design change, and at the start of each shift for critical processes.
qa.zh: 新產品導入、換模／換治具、設計變更，還有關鍵製程每班開線，都要做首件。

words.definition: a frightening or unpleasant dream

general.en: I had a nightmare that I was being chased.
general.zh: 我做了一個被追趕的惡夢。

words.definition: the fear of being without a mobile phone.

general.en: Nomophobia affects teenagers and adults alike.
general.zh: 無手機恐懼症同樣影響青少年和成人。

general.en: Words such as hurt and alone predicted higher levels of nomophobia.
general.zh: 「受傷」和「孤單」這類字眼預示著更高程度的無手機恐懼症。

general.en: Researchers from Hong Kong warned that nomophobia is infecting everyone.
general.zh: 香港的研究人員警告，無手機恐懼症正在感染每一個人。

words.definition: Checking a part without damaging it, e.g. ultrasonic or dye penetrant.
The procedure for identifying, segregating, and dispositioning product that does not meet the specification.

qa.en: Nonconforming product is segregated and dispositioned according to our nonconforming product control procedure.
qa.zh: 不合格品照不合格品管制程序隔離，再決定怎麼處理。

words.definition: Three severity settings: move to tightened after repeated failures, to reduced after a good record.
an informal way to describe an operation that changes the shape of someone's nose.

general.en: A nose job is one of the most common cosmetic operations.
general.zh: 隆鼻是最常見的整形手術之一。

general.en: The most common operation is called a nose job. People who are unhappy with their nose change its shape. Some people want to remove wrinkles so they can look younger. Others have surgery to make parts of their body bigger or smaller.
general.zh: 最常見的手術叫做「隆鼻手術」。對自己鼻子不滿意的人會改變鼻子的形狀。有些人想要消除皺紋，讓自己看起來更年輕。還有人透過手術，讓身體的某些部位變大或變小。

qa.en: Confirm with your notified body whether your product category moved on or off the notified-body list.
qa.zh: 跟公告機構確認我們的產品類別有沒有被加進或移出清單。

qa.en: An audit asks for objective evidence, not for a familiar-looking logo.
qa.zh: 稽核要的是客觀證據，不是一個看起來眼熟的 logo。

qa.en: The auditor asked for objective evidence behind the declared figure.
qa.zh: 稽核員要看填的那個數字背後的客觀證據。

qa.en: Please remove the obsolete drawing from the production line.
qa.zh: 失效的圖面請從產線收回來。

words.definition: Something that makes it hard to succeed.

general.en: This communication failure became a significant obstacle.
general.zh: 這次的溝通失敗成了一大阻礙。

general.en: One day, Emma's team faced a crisis during an important project. Miscommunication issues among team members led to project delays, creating extra work and stress. This communication failure became a significant obstacle.
general.zh: 有一天，Emma 的團隊在一個重要專案中遇到了危機。團隊成員之間的溝通不良導致專案延誤，製造了額外的工作與壓力。這次的溝通失敗成了一大阻礙。

words.definition: 很容易被看見或感受到的

general.en: It was obvious that I was getting better.
general.zh: 很明顯地我正在變得更好。

general.en: It was obvious that she was tired after the long trip.
general.zh: 很明顯地，長途旅行後她感到疲倦。

general.en: There is an obvious mistake in your sentence.
general.zh: 你的句子裡有一個明顯的錯誤。

general.en: It's obvious he doesn't like the new idea.
general.zh: 很明顯他不喜歡這個新點子。

general.en: It was obvious that I was getting better, and that was very encouraging.
general.zh: 很明顯地我正在變得更好，那非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: The attraction of a cheap policy is obvious: a lower monthly payment. What most buyers never examine is the list of exclusions printed on the final pages, and it is there that the true price is hidden.
general.zh: 便宜保單的吸引力很明顯：月付金額較低。但大多數購買者從不細看的，是印在最後幾頁的除外條款清單，而真正的代價就藏在那裡。

words.definition: things brought as gifts or tributes, especially in religious or cultural rituals

general.en: We burn paper money as offerings for our ancestors.
general.zh: 我們燒紙錢作為給祖先的祭品。

qa.en: As a containment action we sorted all treadmill frames in the warehouse and put the suspect lot on hold.
qa.zh: 作為圍堵措施，我們把倉庫裡所有跑步機機架全檢，並扣留可疑批次。

qa.en: The lot stays on hold until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 品保簽首件之前，這批繼續扣著。

qa.en: The line is stopped and the affected units are on hold. I will start the containment check right away.
qa.zh: 線停了，受影響的產品扣住了，我馬上開始圍堵檢查。

qa.en: The affected lots have been identified and placed on hold.
qa.zh: 有問題的批次已經查出來、先扣住了。

qa.en: If the corrective action is not confirmed by Friday, we will have to put the supplier on hold.
qa.zh: 週五前對策沒確認，我們就會先停掉這家供應商的供貨。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

general.en: Resigning themselves to a long wait, the passengers sat down on the floor.
general.zh: 乘客們認命接受要等很久的事實，就在地板上坐了下來。

qa.en: Drawings on the floor are controlled copies with a revision stamp. When a new revision is released, QA collects and destroys the superseded copies on the same day and records the exchange on the document control list.
qa.zh: 現場的圖面都是蓋版次章的管制副本。新版一發，品保當天就把舊版收回來銷毀，換版記在文件管制清單上。

words.definition: agreeing about something.

general.en: My colleague and I are on the same page about this problem.
general.zh: 我和同事對這個問題有共識。

general.en: We talk things out and make sure that we're on the same page.
general.zh: 我們把事情說開，確保彼此想法一致。

general.en: We are on the same page.
general.zh: 我們的認知一致。

words.definition: A ticket for a trip to a place without coming back.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: I'd like a one-way train ticket to Berlin.
general.zh: 我想要一張到柏林的單程火車票。

general.en: Great. Would a one-way ticket be cheaper, or should I take a return ticket?
general.zh: 太好了。單程票會比較便宜，還是我應該買來回票？

general.en: Then I'd just take the one-way ticket now and buy the second half later.
general.zh: 那我會建議你現在先買單程票，回程之後再買。

words.definition: a child with no brothers or sisters.

general.en: Chelsea is an only child.
general.zh: Chelsea 是獨生女。

qa.en: There are three open points left in the specification.
qa.zh: 規格書還有三條沒談定。

qa.en: One open point on the new coating supplier: the salt spray report is not covered by the lab's scope.
qa.zh: 新塗裝供應商有一個未結項目：鹽霧報告不在那家實驗室的認證範圍內。

qa.en: Turn "everyone knows" items in meeting minutes into tracked open risks with owners and closure criteria.
qa.zh: 會議記錄裡「大家都知道」的事，要變成有人負責、有關閉條件的追蹤風險。

qa.en: The process difference was recorded as information, not as an open risk.
qa.zh: 製程差異被當成知會事項記下來，不是當成還沒關掉的風險。

qa.en: The hinge supplier's sample was machined, but the production version would be die-cast to save cost. Everyone knew this, and it was written in the meeting minutes — as an FYI, not as an open risk.
qa.zh: 鉸鏈供應商送驗的樣品是 CNC 加工件，量產版為了省成本要改壓鑄。這件事大家都知道，也寫進會議記錄了——但是當成「知會一下」，不是當成「還沒關掉的風險」。

qa.en: This is a lesson about risk tracking, not testing: the process difference was known and minuted, but never owned. From now on, a known sample-versus-production difference is an open risk with a closure criterion, not an FYI.
qa.zh: 這一課的重點不是測試，是風險追蹤：製程差異大家都知道、也記下來了，卻沒有人負責關掉。從今以後，樣品跟量產有已知差異，就是「有關閉條件的未結風險」，不是知會事項。

qa.en: Use the open-end torque wrench for the hydraulic fitting.
qa.zh: 油壓接頭請用開口式扭力扳手。

words.definition: The short introduction that sets the route, the safety rules, and what the customer will see.
medical treatment in which a doctor cuts open part of a person's body to repair or remove something.

general.en: A nose job is one of the most common cosmetic operations.
general.zh: 隆鼻是最常見的整形手術之一。

general.en: The operation is arguably a form of treatment rather than a luxury.
general.zh: 這個手術可以說是一種治療，而非奢侈。

general.en: Some people have so many operations that they start to look unnatural, like plastic.
general.zh: 有些人做了太多手術，最後看起來不自然，像塑膠一樣。

general.en: The operation took two hours.
general.zh: 手術花了兩個小時。

general.en: The most common operation is called a nose job. People who are unhappy with their nose change its shape. Some people want to remove wrinkles so they can look younger. Others have surgery to make parts of their body bigger or smaller.
general.zh: 最常見的手術叫做「隆鼻手術」。對自己鼻子不滿意的人會改變鼻子的形狀。有些人想要消除皺紋，讓自己看起來更年輕。還有人透過手術，讓身體的某些部位變大或變小。

qa.en: We can meet it with a machining operation, and that changes the cost.
qa.zh: 改機加工做得到，但成本會不一樣。

general.en: The boat operator took me through several caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我穿過好幾個洞穴。

general.en: We effectively trained operators to reduce cosmetic defects.
general.zh: 我們有效地培訓作業員，以降低外觀缺陷。

general.en: The boat operator took me through the caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我穿過那些洞穴。

general.en: The boat operator took us through the caves.
general.zh: 船夫帶我們穿過洞穴。

general.en: We investigate. I pull the process data, talk to the operators, and try to find the root cause instead of just replacing the bad parts.
general.zh: 我們展開調查。我會調製程數據、跟線上作業員談，設法找出根本原因，而不是只把壞掉的零件換掉。

qa.en: Measurement system analysis is repeated whenever the gauge, the fixture, or the operator group changes.
qa.zh: 量具、治具或量的人換了，GR&R 就重做。

qa.en: Self-check by the operator and patrol inspection by QA are two independent layers, and both are recorded and retained.
qa.zh: 作業員自檢跟品保巡檢是兩道各自獨立的關卡，兩邊都有紀錄、都有存。

qa.en: Three operators measure ten parts three times each. Under 10% total variation is acceptable, 10–30% is conditionally acceptable, and over 30% means the measurement system must be improved.
qa.zh: 三個人各量十件、每件量三次。總變異 10% 以下 OK，10～30% 有條件接受，超過 30% 量測系統就要改。

qa.en: Operators use go/no-go gauges and calipers on the line; QA uses micrometers and height gauges for the patrol check. Every tool is zeroed before use and included in the calibration system.
qa.zh: 作業員在線上用通止規跟卡尺；品保巡檢用分厘卡跟高度規。每支量具用之前先歸零，全部都在校驗系統裡。

qa.en: The operator performs a self-check every hour with a go/no-go gauge, and QA performs a patrol inspection every two hours with a caliper and a micrometer. Both results are recorded on the process control sheet.
qa.zh: 作業員每小時用通止規自檢，品保每兩小時用卡尺跟分厘卡巡檢。兩邊的結果都記在製程管制表上。

qa.en: The torque wrench is set and calibrated daily, the operator marks each tightened bolt, and QA performs a torque audit on every unit for safety-critical joints. The result is recorded per serial number.
qa.zh: 扭力扳手每天設定跟校驗，作業員每鎖完一支螺栓就劃線，安全相關的鎖點品保一台一台驗扭力，結果照序號記。

words.definition: What you think about something.

general.en: After seeing the results, they changed their opinion.
general.zh: 看到成果後，他們改變了看法。

general.en: Thanks for joining us today. I wanted a second opinion on the two candidates.
general.zh: 謝謝你今天加入。這兩位應徵者我想聽聽第二意見。

general.en: Few subjects divide opinion so quickly.
general.zh: 很少有話題能這麼快就讓大家意見分歧。

general.en: Five years ago, working from home was unusual in Taiwan. Today it is a normal option in many companies, and employees have strong opinions about it on both sides.
general.zh: 五年前，在家工作在台灣還很少見。如今在許多公司這已是常見的選項，而員工對此的看法兩極。

general.en: Few subjects divide opinion as quickly as cosmetic surgery. Supporters argue that what a person does with their own body is nobody else's business, and that argument is difficult to dismiss.
general.zh: 很少有話題像整形手術一樣，能這麼快讓意見分裂。支持者主張，一個人如何對待自己的身體不干別人的事，而這個論點很難反駁。

general.en: Last week I was invited to help with interviews at our factory. Two engineers will be hired for the quality team, and my manager wanted a second opinion. It was the first time I sat on the other side of the table.
general.zh: 上星期我受邀協助工廠的面試。品保團隊要招聘兩位工程師，而主管想要多一個人的意見。這是我第一次坐到面試桌的另一邊。

qa.en: Risk: 'typically', 'around' and 'approximately' in a supplier email are not evidence — they are the supplier's opinion.
qa.zh: 風險：供應商 email 裡的「通常」「大概」「大約」不是證據，那只是供應商的看法。

words.definition: a chance to do something.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: I'm looking for a better job opportunity.
general.zh: 我正在尋找更好的工作機會。

general.en: Tom gave me the opportunity to attend this party tonight.
general.zh: Tom 給了我機會參加今晚的派對。

general.en: My short-term goal is to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience.
general.zh: 短期內，我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗的公司。

general.en: In the near future, I aim to join a company that offers opportunities to broaden my international experience and contribute to global projects.
general.zh: 短期內，我的目標是加入一家能提供機會讓我拓寬國際經驗、並為全球專案做出貢獻的公司。

general.en: Thank you for this opportunity.
general.zh: 謝謝你給我這個機會。

general.en: I hope to be hired by a company that can give me the opportunity to expand my global experience and get involved in international projects.
general.zh: 我希望能進入一家可以讓我拓展全球經驗、並參與國際專案的公司。

words.definition: A person who always expects good things to happen.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: I'm an optimist because I always try to see the positive side of things.
general.zh: 我是樂觀的人，因為我總是試著看事情正面的一面。

general.en: I'm an optimist because I believe most problems can be solved with effort, learning, and patience.
general.zh: 我是樂觀的人，因為我相信多數問題都能靠努力、學習和耐心解決。

general.en: An optimist stays hopeful about the future.
general.zh: 樂觀的人對未來保持希望。

general.en: Are you a pessimist or an optimist?
general.zh: 你是悲觀還是樂觀的人？

general.en: Emma remained an optimist and believed every challenge was an opportunity to grow. Her positive attitude and smart decisions helped her become a successful leader.
general.zh: Emma 保持樂觀，相信每個挑戰都是成長的機會。她的正面態度和聰明的決定幫助她成為一位成功的領導者。

general.en: Although the situation was an unexpected failure, the manager had a positive mindset. She was an optimist and believed that every problem could become an opportunity to improve.
general.zh: 儘管這次情況是一個意料之外的失敗，經理擁有正面的心態。她是個樂觀的人，相信每個問題都能成為進步的機會。

qa.en: There is orange peel on the surface; the spray pressure is too low.
qa.zh: 表面有橘皮，噴塗壓力太低。

qa.en: OK. The left one looks rough — lots of orange peel on the surface.
qa.zh: 好。左邊這個看起來很粗糙，表面很多橘皮紋。

qa.en: Right. The right-side sample is a normal production one; the texture is less orange peel.
qa.zh: 對。右邊這個是正常量產品，紋理的橘皮紋少很多。

qa.en: The texture is less orange peel.
qa.zh: 紋理的橘皮紋較少。

words.definition: sleeping so deeply that you do not notice anything around you
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: She is out cold.
general.zh: 她睡得不省人事。

qa.en: What if an instrument is found out of calibration?
qa.zh: 如果發現儀器逾期或超差怎麼辦？

qa.en: We treat a run as an out-of-control signal.
qa.zh: 連串我們就當失控訊號處理。

qa.en: Decision: a run of seven points is an out-of-control signal even when every point is in specification. Act on the signal, not on the reject count.
qa.zh: 決定：連續七點就是失控訊號，就算每一點都在規格內也一樣。要看的是訊號，不是不良數。

qa.en: The chart shows a run of seven points trending down. That is an out-of-control signal under our reaction plan, even though every reading is in specification.
qa.zh: 管制圖出現連續七點往下的連串。照我們的反應計畫，這就是失控訊號，就算每一點讀值都在規格內也一樣。

words.definition: covered with too many weeds or plants that have not been cut

general.en: After a year, the grass around the graves is overgrown.
general.zh: 過了一年，墳墓周圍的草長得太茂盛了。

general.en: After a year, the grass around the graves is overgrown, so it needs to be cleaned.
general.zh: 過了一年，墳墓周圍的草長得太茂盛，所以需要被清理。（needs to be cleaned 是典型的被動不定詞 need + to be p.p.——草無法自己清理，必須用被動。）

words.definition: the storage space above your seat on an airplane.

general.en: Please be careful not to leave any belongings in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 請小心不要把任何隨身物品留在頭頂行李櫃裡。

general.en: When I boarded the plane, I put my carry-on bag in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 當我登機時，我把隨身行李放進頭頂置物櫃。

general.en: Make sure you don't leave your belongings in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 請務必確認你沒有把隨身物品留在行李櫃中。

general.en: I put my bag in the overhead bin above my seat.
general.zh: 我把包包放進座位上方的頭頂置物櫃。

general.en: When I boarded the plane, I put my carry-on bag in the overhead bin above my seat.
general.zh: 當我登機時，我把隨身行李放進座位上方的頭頂置物櫃。

general.en: Put your bag in the overhead bin.
general.zh: 把包放進頭頂置物櫃。

words.definition: The storage space above your seat on a plane.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Please place your bag in the overhead compartment.
general.zh: 請把行李放進頭頂置物櫃。

general.en: Excuse me, could you put your bag in the overhead compartment, please?
general.zh: 不好意思，可以請您把包包放進頭頂置物櫃嗎？

general.en: Of course. Sorry, but the overhead compartment above my seat is already full.
general.zh: 當然。不好意思，我座位上方的頭頂置物櫃已經滿了。

general.en: Excuse me, could you help me put my carry-on bag in the overhead compartment?
general.zh: 不好意思，你可以幫我把隨身行李放進頭頂置物櫃嗎？

words.definition: weighing more than is healthy, said in a polite and neutral way.

general.en: Overweight is a more polite, neutral way to describe someone than calling them fat.
general.zh: 用 overweight 來形容一個人比用 fat 更中性、更有禮貌。

general.en: Overweight is a more polite word than fat.
general.zh: Overweight 是比 fat 更禮貌的說法。

words.translation: 止痛藥（較中性、正式的說法）
words.definition: a more neutral and formal word for a medicine that reduces pain, often seen on medicine packaging

general.en: This pain reliever can help with headaches and muscle pain.
general.zh: 這款止痛藥可以舒緩頭痛和肌肉痠痛。

words.definition: a medicine that reduces or stops pain in your body

general.en: I took a painkiller to relieve my headache.
general.zh: 我吃了止痛藥來緩解頭痛。

general.en: Can I take a painkiller for the stomach pain? I have some at home.
general.zh: 我可以吃止痛藥止肚子痛嗎？我家裡有一些。

general.en: I had a terrible migraine after work, so I took a painkiller and rested.
general.zh: 我下班後偏頭痛得很厲害，所以我吃了一顆止痛藥並休息了。

general.en: She took a painkiller to weaken the migraine.
general.zh: 她吃了一顆止痛藥來減緩偏頭痛。

words.definition: a public celebration where people walk through the streets.

general.en: We watched the parade on TV in the morning.
general.zh: 我們早上在電視上看遊行。

qa.en: Put the parallel blocks under the part before clamping.
qa.zh: 夾持前先把平行墊塊墊在工件下方。

words.definition: A bar chart that ranks problems from biggest to smallest — usually 80 % of trouble comes from 20 % of causes.

qa.en: The Pareto chart shows that paint defects account for 60 % of all rejects.
qa.zh: 柏拉圖顯示烤漆不良佔了所有拒收的 60%。

general.en: Failure is an inevitable part of business.
general.zh: 失敗是做生意中無可避免的一部分。

general.en: The lucky draw is the most exciting part of the night.
general.zh: 抽獎是整晚最令人興奮的部分。

general.en: Heavy rain caused flooding in several parts of the city.
general.zh: 大雨造成市區好幾個地方淹水。

general.en: It had destroyed part of a bridge.
general.zh: 它摧毀了一座橋的一部分。

general.en: The typhoon of 2023 changed that feeling. By the time the wind reached the city, it had already destroyed part of a bridge in the mountains. Our lights went out at nine in the evening, and they did not come back for two days.
general.zh: 2023 年的那場颱風改變了那種感覺。等到強風抵達城市時，它已經摧毀了山區一段橋樑。我們家的燈在晚上九點熄滅，而且兩天都沒恢復。

general.en: The interview itself has three parts. First, candidates are asked to describe a real problem that they solved. Then they are given a small task, which must be finished in thirty minutes. Finally, they meet the team that they will work with.
general.zh: 面試本身分成三個部分。首先，應徵者要描述一個他們實際解決過的問題。接著會拿到一個小任務，必須在三十分鐘內完成。最後，他們會見到未來一起工作的團隊。

qa.en: Adding a jig to the line is defect prevention; sorting bad parts is defect identification.
qa.zh: 在線上加治具是不良預防；挑出不良件是不良辨識。

qa.en: A machine that measures a part in three axes with a touch probe and compares the result against the CAD model or drawing.
qa.zh: 用觸發式探針在 X、Y、Z 三軸量工件，再跟 CAD 或圖面比對的量測機。

qa.en: Do you inspect every incoming part?
qa.zh: 你們每一件進料都檢驗嗎？

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

qa.en: The inspection level is part of the agreed inspection standard; we can tighten it for your product if you require additional confidence.
qa.zh: 檢驗水準是談好的檢驗標準的一部分；你們想要更保險，我們可以針對你們的產品加嚴。

qa.en: The first article inspection report covers all dimensions on the drawing and is retained as part of the production record for traceability.
qa.zh: 首件報告圖面上每個尺寸都有，會跟生產紀錄一起存，之後要追都追得到。

qa.en: Please define the pass criteria before we start the test.
qa.zh: 開始測試前請先定義合格基準。

words.definition: A person who is traveling in a vehicle but not driving it.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: A passenger is a person traveling in a vehicle who is not the driver or crew.
general.zh: 乘客是指搭乘交通工具、但不是駕駛或工作人員的人。

general.en: Passengers must wear life jackets before getting on the boat.
general.zh: 乘客上船前必須穿上救生衣。

general.en: Resigning themselves to a long wait, the passengers sat down on the floor.
general.zh: 乘客們認命接受要等很久的事實，就在地板上坐了下來。

general.en: Passengers will be charged extra fees if they cancel their trip a few minutes before the train's departure.
general.zh: 如果乘客在火車出發前幾分鐘取消行程，將會被收取額外費用。（will be + 過去分詞 未來被動語態 + if + 現在簡單式。）

general.en: Passengers will be charged extra fees before the train's departure.
general.zh: 火車出發前，乘客將被收取額外費用。

general.en: Some passengers are inconsiderate.
general.zh: 有些乘客很不體貼。

words.definition: Having very strong feelings about something you love.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: I am passionate about learning new languages.
general.zh: 我對學習新語言充滿熱忱。

general.en: He's passionate about music. He said acting paid the bills, but music kept him happy.
general.zh: 他對音樂充滿熱忱。他說演戲是為了生活，但音樂讓他保持快樂。

general.en: He is passionate about working out.
general.zh: 他對健身充滿熱忱。

general.en: Emma always dreamed of achieving success in her career. She was a very passionate employee who loved learning new skills and improving herself. Her manager often encouraged her to keep a positive mindset and believe in her abilities.
general.zh: Emma 一直夢想在事業上取得成功。她是一位非常有熱忱的員工，熱愛學習新技能和提升自己。她的主管經常鼓勵她保持正面心態，相信自己的能力。

general.en: Like Dr. House, Laurie is also a talented musician and is passionate about the blues. He recently went to New Orleans to record an album in which he plays 15 of his favorite songs. But of course, he doesn't think that people will like it.
general.zh: 和豪斯醫生一樣，羅利也是位才華洋溢的音樂家，並且熱愛藍調。他最近去了紐奧良錄製一張專輯，收錄了他最喜愛的 15 首歌。但他當然還是覺得大家不會喜歡。

general.en: Emma was a passionate employee who always dreamed of achieving career success. She was dedicated to learning and self-improvement, and her manager encouraged her to maintain a positive mindset and believe in her abilities.
general.zh: Emma 是一位充滿熱情的員工，一直夢想著在職涯上獲得成功。她很投入於學習與自我提升，而她的主管鼓勵她保持正面的心態，並相信自己的能力。

words.definition: 出國旅行所需的身分證明文件

general.en: I was terrified because I had lost my passport.
general.zh: 我嚇壞了，因為我弄丟了護照。

general.en: Good morning. May I see your passport? This is the check-in counter for Flight 725 to Tokyo.
general.zh: 早安，可以看一下您的護照嗎？這裡是飛往東京 725 班機的報到櫃檯。

general.en: The traveler left his passport on the check-in desk.
general.zh: 那位旅客把護照留在報到櫃檯。

general.en: I need to renew my passport.
general.zh: 我需要續辦護照。

general.en: My passport is no longer valid.
general.zh: 我的護照已經失效了。

general.en: My passport has expired.
general.zh: 我的護照過期了。

qa.en: The digital product passport will carry material composition data for the frame.
qa.zh: DPP 裡會放機架的材料組成資料。

words.definition: the ability to wait or deal with difficult situations without becoming upset

general.en: Living in a busy city taught me the value of patience.
general.zh: 住在繁忙城市讓我體會到耐心的價值。

general.en: I'm an optimist because I believe most problems can be solved with effort, learning, and patience.
general.zh: 我是樂觀的人，因為我相信多數問題都能靠努力、學習和耐心解決。

general.en: Learning a language takes a great deal of patience.
general.zh: 學一門語言需要大量的耐心。

general.en: Ha! Do it. It shows patience and planning — and those matter in quality work too.
general.zh: 哈！放啊。那代表耐心和規劃能力——這些在品保工作裡也很重要。

general.en: The season is beautiful in spring, and there are many shops that sell fashionable clothes. Living here helped me improve my skills, like communication and patience.
general.zh: 這裡春天的季節很美，而且有很多賣時尚衣服的商店。住在這裡幫助我提升了技能，像是溝通和耐心。

general.en: Now I know that learning a language takes time and patience. "My brain gets stuck sometimes," I admit. "But I just keep going."
general.zh: 現在我知道學習一門語言需要時間和耐心。「我的腦袋有時候會卡住，」我承認。「但我就是繼續前進。」

words.definition: Money you must pay as a punishment for breaking a rule.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: Will there be any extra charges or penalties?
general.zh: 會有額外的費用或罰款嗎？

qa.en: Confirm the failure mode first: cut and etch the weld, check penetration, and review the fracture surface.
qa.zh: 先確認失效模式：焊道切片酸蝕、看熔深、看斷面。

qa.en: The cross-section shows insufficient weld penetration.
qa.zh: 切片顯示熔深不足。

qa.en: The root cause is not confirmed yet — weld penetration is the leading hypothesis.
qa.zh: 根因還沒確認——熔深不足是目前最可能的假設。

qa.en: Welders are qualified, welding parameters are locked in the machine, and we perform periodic destructive testing to verify penetration.
qa.zh: 焊工有考過資格，焊接參數鎖在機台上，定期做破壞測試看熔深。

qa.en: Let me separate the facts from the assumptions. Confirmed: the frame cracked at 60,000 cycles. Suspected: insufficient weld penetration. Unverified: the gusset fix.
qa.zh: 我先把事實跟假設分開。確認的：車架在 6 萬次裂了。懷疑的：熔深不足。還沒驗證的：補強板對策。

qa.en: If we cut the sample this week and the penetration theory holds, the earliest re-test completion is week 6 — that leaves two weeks of buffer, assuming a first-pass success.
qa.zh: 如果這週切片、熔深的假設成立，重測最快第 6 週完成——而且要一次過，才剩兩週緩衝。

words.definition: How well a person does something, or a show in front of an audience.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: The party became lively once the performances started.
general.zh: 表演一開始，派對就變得熱鬧起來。

general.en: The wind blew away my hat. / I was blown away by her performance.
general.zh: 風把我的帽子吹走了。／她的表演讓我大開眼界。

general.en: They rated their own performance as normal.
general.zh: 他們卻認為自己的表現很正常。

general.en: The band gave an amazing performance.
general.zh: 樂團帶來了精彩的演出。

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems, functional defects, and performance-related issues.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題、功能性缺陷，以及性能相關問題。

general.en: There are performances and games.
general.zh: 現場有表演和遊戲。

qa.en: The sample submission package includes dimensional, material, and performance evidence plus the process documents.
qa.zh: 樣品承認資料有尺寸、材質、性能的數據，還有製程文件。

qa.en: We switched to a new resin grade last month. The performance is the same, so we didn't think it was necessary to inform you.
qa.zh: 我們上個月改用新的樹脂等級。性能一樣，所以想說不用特別通知。

qa.en: A typical submission includes the dimensional results, material and performance test reports, the control plan, the PFMEA, the process flow, and the sample parts.
qa.zh: 通常會交尺寸報告、材質跟性能測試報告、管制計畫、PFMEA、製程流程圖，再加樣品。

qa.en: Whether the performance is the same is our decision to make, not yours. Any change to an approved material requires our written approval first.
qa.zh: 性能一不一樣是我們判定，不是你們判定。承認過的材料，任何變更都要先拿到我們的書面核准。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

qa.en: We are assessing whether this failure mode creates a safety risk, not only a performance complaint.

words.definition: 容易腐壞、不能長期保存的食物

general.en: We shouldn't keep perishable food like fish in the car on a hot day.
general.zh: 我們不應該在炎熱天氣把易腐壞的食物放在車裡。

general.en: Milk and fresh vegetables are perishable foods.
general.zh: 牛奶和新鮮蔬菜都是易腐壞的食物。

general.en: Some foods are perishable, but good habits can last longer than any meal.
general.zh: 有些食物是易腐壞的，但良好的習慣能比任何一餐持續更久。

general.en: Perishable goods must be stored in the refrigerator immediately.
general.zh: 易腐壞的商品必須立刻放進冰箱保存。

general.en: Fish and meat are perishable foods.
general.zh: 魚和肉是易腐壞的食物。

general.en: When I finally took a bite, it was simple but satisfying. It made me full, and I realized that even spoiled days can improve with a little effort. Some foods are perishable, but good habits can last longer than any meal.
general.zh: 當我終於咬下一口時，味道很簡單卻令人滿足。它讓我飽足，而我也體會到，即便是糟糕的（被毀掉的）日子，只要付出一點努力就能好轉。有些食物是易腐壞的，但良好的習慣卻能比任何一餐持續得更久。（文法解說：使役結構 make + 受詞 + 形容詞——full 作受詞補語；spoiled 是 spoil 的過去分詞轉化為形容詞修飾 days。）

words.definition: The change that removes the root cause so the defect cannot come back.

qa.en: The permanent corrective action is a new fixture that makes the wrong crank orientation impossible.
qa.zh: 永久矯正措施是新的治具，讓曲柄不可能裝反。

qa.en: We identified the root cause and implemented a permanent corrective action with effectiveness verification.
qa.zh: 根因確認了，永久對策也上了，效果也驗證過了。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

words.definition: to continue to happen or exist for longer than usual, often despite difficulty.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: When the problems persist, I discuss them with design engineers.
general.zh: 當問題反覆發生時，我會與他們進行討論。

words.definition: A person who expects bad things to happen.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: Dr. House is famous for being a pessimist.
general.zh: House 醫生以悲觀出名。

general.en: A pessimist often feels hopeless about the future.
general.zh: 悲觀的人常對未來感到絕望。

general.en: Ben, be honest with me. Are you an optimist or a pessimist?
general.zh: Ben，老實跟我說。你是樂觀的人還是悲觀的人？

general.en: Are you a pessimist or an optimist?
general.zh: 你是悲觀還是樂觀的人？

general.en: Dr. Gregory House, the main character in the hit TV series House, M.D., is famous for being a pessimist. But it is not only Dr. House who is a pessimist. Hugh Laurie, the actor who plays him, is a pessimist, too.
general.zh: 葛瑞格里·豪斯醫生是熱門影集《怪醫豪斯》的主角，以悲觀出名。但悲觀的不只是豪斯醫生，飾演他的演員休·羅利本人也是個悲觀者。

general.en: When he was asked why he was so pessimistic about life, Laurie said it was because he is Scottish. Because of his reputation as a pessimist, complete strangers come up to him on the street and say, "Cheer up, it'll never happen!"
general.zh: 當他被問到為何對人生如此悲觀時，羅利說那是因為他是蘇格蘭人。因為他悲觀者的名聲，常有陌生人在街上走向他說：「振作點，壞事不會發生的！」

words.definition: a soft cushion that you rest your head on, usually in bed.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: I put money in the red envelope and placed it under my pillow to bring good luck.
general.zh: 我把錢放進紅包裡，然後把它放在枕頭下以帶來好運。

words.definition: A person who flies a plane.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Captain is the role; pilot is the profession.
general.zh: captain 是職務、pilot 是職業。

general.en: The pilot landed the plane smoothly.
general.zh: 飛行員平穩地降落了飛機。

qa.en: Compliance is decided by the date of placing on the market, not the build date.
qa.zh: 合規看的是投放市場的日期，不是生產日期。

qa.en: Connected fitness equipment is machinery. Placing on the market is decided by the date the unit enters the EU market, not the date it was designed — so units built in late 2026 for Q1 2027 shipment are already exposed.
qa.zh: 聯網健身器材就是機械。「投放市場」看的是機器進歐盟市場的日期，不是設計日期 —— 所以 2026 年底做、2027 年第一季出的機台，現在就已經中了。

words.definition: Knives, forks and spoons made of plastic.

general.en: Plastic cutlery is not good for hot food.
general.zh: 塑膠餐具不適合裝熱食。

general.en: The meal came with plastic cutlery.
general.zh: 餐點附了塑膠餐具。

words.definition: operations that repair or change a person's skin, body shape, or face.

general.en: He said he would never choose plastic surgery.
general.zh: 他說他永遠不會選擇整形手術。

general.en: Plastic surgery can significantly boost a person's confidence.
general.zh: 整形手術可以顯著提升一個人的自信。

general.en: I would never choose plastic surgery, even if it were free.
general.zh: 即使是免費的，我也永遠不會選擇整形手術。

general.en: I believe plastic surgery is a waste of money.
general.zh: 我認為整形手術是浪費錢。

general.en: Plastic surgery has both advantages and disadvantages.
general.zh: 整形手術同時具有優點和缺點。

general.en: First, plastic surgery can significantly boost a person's confidence. When people fix a feature that has always bothered them, they often feel much happier and more secure in themselves.
general.zh: 首先，整形手術可以顯著提升一個人的自信。當人們修復了長久以來困擾他們的特徵時，他們通常會感到更快樂，對自己更有安全感。

words.definition: The area beside the tracks at a train station where people wait for trains.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: The ticket counter is next to platform 3.
general.zh: 售票櫃檯在3號月台旁邊。

general.en: I could apply for a refund through the airline's online platform.
general.zh: 我可以透過航空公司的線上平台申請退款。

general.en: Please listen for the announcement about platform changes.
general.zh: 請留意有關月台變更的廣播。

general.en: He reached the platform at 7:42.
general.zh: 他七點四十二分才到月台。

general.en: He reached the platform at 7:42. The train was gone. A station worker told him that the next train would leave in fifty minutes. Daniel sat down, took a deep breath, and sent his manager a short message: "I am going to be late. I am sorry."
general.zh: 他 7 點 42 分抵達月台。火車已經開走了。一位站務人員告訴他，下一班車五十分鐘後才發車。Daniel 坐下來，深呼吸，並傳了一則簡短訊息給主管：「我會遲到，很抱歉。」

general.en: Mia takes the MRT to work every day. The ride usually takes twenty-five minutes, and the platform is not too crowded in the morning. She likes reading on the train because it helps her relax before work.
general.zh: Mia每天都搭捷運去上班。車程通常要二十五分鐘，早上月台也不會太擁擠。她喜歡在車上看書，因為這能幫助她在上班前放鬆。

words.definition: Nice, enjoyable, or friendly in a way that makes you feel good.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: It is a pleasant day.
general.zh: 今天天氣很舒適。

general.en: The Wise Woman said, "Coax your horse to come inside your house by talking to it in a pleasant and gentle way." The farmer thought this an odd suggestion, but he did as he was told.
general.zh: 智者說：「用愉快溫和的方式對你的馬說話，哄勸（Coax）牠進到你的房子裡。」農夫覺得這個建議很奇怪，但他還是照做了。

words.definition: A person who fixes water pipes, toilets, and bathrooms.

general.en: I immediately called a plumber to fix it.
general.zh: 我立刻打電話叫水管工人來修理。

general.en: The plumber promised to inspect everything carefully and repair all the issues.
general.zh: 水管工人承諾會仔細檢查所有東西並修復所有問題。

general.en: The toilet wasn't flushing properly, so we called a plumber.
general.zh: 馬桶沖水不順，所以我們叫了水管工人。

general.en: Please don't delay — call the plumber today.
general.zh: 請別拖延——今天就打給水管工人。

general.en: It was a long day, but I realized how important it is to have skilled professionals like plumbers, electricians, carpenters, and civil servants. They help solve problems efficiently and make life much easier.
general.zh: 這是漫長的一天，但我意識到擁有像水管工人、電工、木匠和公務員等熟練的專業人員有多麼重要。他們幫助有效率地解決問題，讓生活變得更輕鬆。

general.en: Mr. Lin, whose flat is on the ground floor, has lived in our building for thirty years. He was a plumber before he retired, and he keeps a wooden box of tools that is older than most of his neighbours.
general.zh: 林先生的公寓在一樓，他在我們這棟樓已經住了三十年。退休前他是水管工，他有一個木製工具箱，比大部分鄰居的年紀都大。

words.definition: Designing the jig, tool or process so that a wrong operation simply cannot be done.
Behaving in a kind and respectful way.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Overweight is a more polite, neutral way to describe someone than calling them fat.
general.zh: 用 overweight 來形容一個人比用 fat 更中性、更有禮貌。

general.en: Why are you being so polite? Did something happen?
general.zh: 你今天怎麼這麼客氣？發生什麼事了？

general.en: Overweight is a more polite word than fat.
general.zh: Overweight 是比 fat 更禮貌的說法。

general.en: She is always polite to the staff.
general.zh: 她對工作人員總是很有禮貌。

words.definition: 因髒污物質而變得不乾淨的

general.en: It seems the air is polluted because there are too many vehicles.
general.zh: 看起來空氣很髒，因為路上有太多車輛。

general.en: It seems the air is polluted because there are too many cars.
general.zh: 看起來空氣被污染了，因為車太多。

words.definition: 將頭髮綁在腦後成束的髮型

general.en: She has tied her hair in a ponytail.
general.zh: 她把頭髮綁成了馬尾。

qa.en: Poor adhesion usually means the surface was not cleaned well.
qa.zh: 附著力不良通常表示表面沒有清潔乾淨。

words.definition: all the people living in a particular area or country

general.en: The city has a large population and traffic is terrible.
general.zh: 這座城市人口眾多，交通非常糟糕。

general.en: The population in this city is growing every year.
general.zh: 這座城市的人口每年都在增長。

general.en: Last year, I moved to a very crowded neighborhood in the city. The population is large, and the streets are always full of cars, especially during rush hour.
general.zh: 去年，我搬到了市裡一個非常擁擠的社區。這裡人口眾多，街道上總是擠滿了車，尤其是在交通尖峰時間。

qa.en: X-ray inspection found porosity at the pivot bore.
qa.zh: X-ray 檢查在軸孔處發現氣孔。

qa.en: Porosity in the weld is caused by moisture or poor gas shielding.
qa.zh: 焊道氣孔是由水氣或遮護氣體不良造成的。

qa.en: The failed hinge showed porosity at the pivot bore — a die-casting defect the machined samples could never have shown. Verification had validated a part that was not the production part.
qa.zh: 壞掉的鉸鏈軸孔有氣孔——這是壓鑄才會有的缺陷，CNC 樣品根本不可能出現。驗證驗的，不是量產要用的那個零件。

qa.en: If reliability had been shortened to save schedule — which was discussed — the porosity would have reached the field inside folding treadmills used at home, around children.
qa.zh: 如果當時真的為了趕時程把可靠度測試砍短（確實有人提過），氣孔問題就會流到市場——出現在家裡、旁邊有小孩的折疊跑步機上。

qa.en: QA re-ran verification on die-cast parts, added a porosity X-ray check to the supplier's PPAP, and changed the rule: any process change on the part invalidates previous verification, same drawing or not.
qa.zh: QA 用壓鑄件重跑驗證、在供應商 PPAP 加了氣孔 X-ray 檢查，也改了規則：零件製程一改，之前的驗證就不算數——圖面一樣也一樣。

words.definition: a chance that something may happen or be true

general.en: The first conditional talks about real possibilities.
general.zh: 第一條件句討論的是真實的可能性。

general.en: And the first conditional is for a real possibility?
general.zh: 那第一條件句是用在真實的可能性嗎？

general.en: Right. If it rains tomorrow, we will stay inside. That's a genuine possibility.
general.zh: 對。If it rains tomorrow, we will stay inside. 那是真的有可能發生。

words.definition: possible but not yet certain or fully developed
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: This project has the potential to be very successful.
general.zh: 這個專案有潛力非常成功。

general.en: I monitor potential issues early and investigate appliance problems.
general.zh: 我會及早監控潛在問題、調查設備異常。

general.en: They are looking for potential customers.
general.zh: 他們正在尋找潛在客戶。

general.en: I identify potential problems and investigate the root cause.
general.zh: 我會找出潛在問題並調查根本原因。

general.en: She has great potential as a leader.
general.zh: 她作為領導者有很大的潛力。

general.en: There is a potential risk.
general.zh: 這裡存在潛在風險。

qa.en: A structured risk analysis that lists potential failure modes, their effects and causes, and scores them to set priorities.
qa.zh: 把可能出的失效、影響跟原因一條條列出來，打分數排優先順序的風險分析。

qa.en: We use a process FMEA. Each potential failure mode is rated for severity, occurrence, and detection. Anything above our action threshold must have a preventive or detection control added to the control plan.
qa.zh: 我們用製程 FMEA，每個可能的失效模式都打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。超過對策門檻的，一定要在管制計畫加預防或偵測的管制。

words.definition: to rain heavily; 'it is pouring' = it is raining very hard

general.en: It is. And when it pours for hours, there's often a landslide on the mountain road.
general.zh: 確實危險。而且雨連下好幾個小時的時候，山路常常會發生土石流。

general.en: Let's not cancel yet. The weather here is so changeable — it can be pouring at ten and sunny at noon.
general.zh: 先別急著取消。這裡的天氣很多變，可能十點還在下大雨，中午就出太陽了。

general.en: Take an umbrella; it is pouring!
general.zh: 帶傘，現在在下大雨！

general.en: It is pouring. / It is raining heavily.
Pour water into the bottle.
It is pouring (rain).

qa.en: This powder coating passes 48 hours of neutral salt spray with no red rust and with creepage from the scribe line under one millimeter, which meets the requirement in the specification.
qa.zh: 這個粉體塗裝過 48 小時中性鹽霧，沒有紅鏽，劃線處擴散小於 1 mm，符合規格。

words.definition: a period when the electricity supply is interrupted

general.en: The typhoon caused a major power outage across the region.
general.zh: 颱風導致該地區大範圍停電。

general.en: Several areas experienced a power outage during the typhoon.
general.zh: 颱風期間有幾個地區發生停電。

general.en: The typhoon caused a power outage that lasted two days.
general.zh: 颱風造成了長達兩天的停電。

general.en: Areas had a power outage / lost power.
general.zh: 地區停電。（兩種說法皆正確）

general.en: The typhoon resulted in a power outage.

qa.en: The samples all passed inspection. Why do you still need the full PPAP documents?
qa.zh: 樣品全部檢驗合格，為什麼還要完整 PPAP 文件？

qa.en: Risk: approving PPAP without capability data means the first process problem has no baseline to compare against.
qa.zh: 風險：沒有能力資料就核准 PPAP，等製程第一次出問題，你連基準都沒得比。

qa.en: Thank you for the PPAP submission for the motor bracket.
qa.zh: 謝謝您送來馬達支架的 PPAP。

qa.en: This PPAP is not complete. Please send the control plan, the MSA and the capability study.
qa.zh: 這份 PPAP 資料不齊，請補管制計畫、MSA 跟能力研究。

qa.en: The PPAP package is missing the material certifications and the capability study for the critical dimensions. Please complete and resubmit before the run-at-rate.
qa.zh: PPAP 資料少了材證跟關鍵尺寸的能力分析。請在 run-at-rate 前補齊重交。

qa.en: Samples prove these pieces are good. PPAP proves your process can keep making good pieces at production rate — that is what we are approving.
qa.zh: 樣品只證明「這幾件」是好的；PPAP 是證明你的製程用量產速度也能一直做出好件。我們承認的是後面這個。

words.translation: 生產件核准與樣品承認
words.definition: The package of evidence submitted to the customer to prove the process can consistently make parts to specification before mass production is approved.
to speak to God or a god, often asking for something good to happen.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: People put red couplets on the door and pray for good luck.
general.zh: 人們把紅色春聯貼在門上並祈求好運。

general.en: During the New Year holiday, people like to visit temples to pray for a good year.
general.zh: 人們會去寺廟祈福，並拜訪親友互道新年快樂。

words.definition: to say what you think will happen.

general.en: Words such as hurt and alone predicted higher levels of nomophobia.
general.zh: 「受傷」和「孤單」這類字眼預示著更高程度的無手機恐懼症。

general.en: The forecast predicts snow in the afternoon.
general.zh: 天氣預報預測下午會下雪。

general.en: A typhoon was predicted in the weather forecast a few days ago.
general.zh: 幾天前的天氣預報預測了颱風。（被動）

general.en: Natural disasters are hard to predict.
general.zh: 天然災害很難預測。

words.definition: the period of time when a woman is carrying a baby inside her body.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: She maintained a healthy diet throughout her pregnancy.
general.zh: 她在整個懷孕期間都保持健康的飲食。

general.en: Many women experience morning sickness during the first few months of pregnancy.
general.zh: 許多女性在懷孕前幾個月會經歷晨吐。

general.en: The first few months of her pregnancy made her feel sick every morning.
general.zh: 她懷孕的前幾個月讓她每天早上都覺得不舒服。

general.en: The doctor monitors her pregnancy carefully.
general.zh: 醫生仔細監控她的懷孕狀況。（描述目前的醫療常態或事實。）

general.en: The doctor monitored her pregnancy carefully last month.
general.zh: 醫生上個月仔細監控了她的懷孕狀況。

general.en: The doctor will monitor her pregnancy carefully.
general.zh: 醫生將會仔細監控她的懷孕狀況。

words.definition: having a baby growing inside your body.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: My sister is six months pregnant with her first child.
general.zh: 我姐姐懷第一胎六個月了。

general.en: He kindly shifted over to give the pregnant woman more space.
general.zh: 他好心地往旁邊挪了挪，給那位孕婦騰出更多空間。

general.en: She is pregnant and expecting her first child.
general.zh: 她懷孕了，正期待著她的第一個孩子。

general.en: She will be pregnant next year.
general.zh: 她明年打算／將會懷孕。

general.en: She has been pregnant since September.
general.zh: 她從九月開始懷孕，一直到現在。

general.en: She was pregnant last year.

words.definition: 定期繳交給保險公司的費用

general.en: Monthly insurance premiums can be very high in the USA.
general.zh: 在美國，每月保費可能非常高昂。

general.en: Our car insurance premium went up after the accident.
general.zh: 那次事故之後，我們的汽車保費上漲了。

general.en: Patients often need to pay monthly premiums and deductibles before insurance covers costs, and medical expenses can be very expensive, especially without insurance.
general.zh: 病患通常需要支付每月保費與自付額，而且醫療費用通常非常高，尤其是沒有保險時。

qa.en: 'Premium feel' is not verifiable as written.
qa.zh: 「premium 手感」這樣寫是驗證不了的。

words.definition: The force that a liquid or gas pushes against something with.

general.en: The shower head has low water pressure, making it hard to take a proper shower.
general.zh: 蓮蓬頭的水壓很低，讓人很難好好洗個澡。

general.en: The pipe burst due to high pressure, causing water damage.
general.zh: 水管因高壓而爆裂，造成水損。

general.en: The job demands calm thinking under pressure.
general.zh: 這份工作需要高壓下的冷靜思考。

general.en: To ease the pressure, some people now choose telemedicine, a video call with a doctor from home.
general.zh: 為了減輕負擔，有些人現在選擇遠距醫療，也就是在家透過視訊看診。

general.en: Does it? I think it makes perfect sense. Strategy games train fast decisions and calm thinking under pressure.
general.zh: 會嗎？我覺得非常有道理。策略遊戲訓練的就是快速決策和高壓下的冷靜思考。

general.en: It may be true that adults can decide for themselves, but few decisions are made without pressure.
general.zh: 成年人可以自己決定或許沒錯，但很少有決定是沒有壓力的。

qa.en: Skip-lot inspection is a defined program, not an ad-hoc decision under schedule pressure.
qa.zh: 跳批檢驗是一套定好的制度，不是被時程逼出來的臨時決定。

qa.en: There is orange peel on the surface; the spray pressure is too low.
qa.zh: 表面有橘皮，噴塗壓力太低。

qa.en: How much pressure should I use?
How do you control the pretreatment bath?
qa.zh: 前處理槽液你們怎麼管控？

qa.en: Poor pretreatment causes craters on the coated surface.
qa.zh: 前處理不良會造成塗裝表面縮孔。

qa.en: A thread locker is a prevention control, not a detection control.
qa.zh: 螺絲膠是預防管制，不是偵測管制。

qa.en: The rust-preventive oil we used is not suitable for tube interiors.
qa.zh: 我們用的防鏽油不適合管子內部。

qa.en: We use a process FMEA. Each potential failure mode is rated for severity, occurrence, and detection. Anything above our action threshold must have a preventive or detection control added to the control plan.
qa.zh: 我們用製程 FMEA，每個可能的失效模式都打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。超過對策門檻的，一定要在管制計畫加預防或偵測的管制。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: Action: work with the chemical supplier to select a vapor-phase corrosion inhibitor (VCI) oil or a rust preventive specifically rated for enclosed cavities. Validate the new product on sample tubes before switching production.
qa.zh: 行動：跟油品供應商要一支 VCI 防鏽油（揮發型的，管子裡面油碰不到的地方也能保護），拿樣品管先驗證再切換產線。

qa.en: During our in-process inspection today, we found rust forming on the inner surface of treadmill handrail tubes. The tubes were treated with your general-purpose rust-preventive oil (product code RP-210) after cutting.
qa.zh: 今天巡檢時發現跑步機扶手管裡面開始生鏽。切管後有用你們的通用型防鏽油（料號 RP-210）處理過。

qa.en: Could you recommend a VCI-type rust-preventive oil or a product specifically rated for enclosed cavities? We need the product data sheet and a sample for validation before switching.
qa.zh: 可否推薦 VCI 型（揮發型）防鏽油、或適合管子內部使用的產品？切換前我們需要 TDS 跟樣品來驗證。

qa.en: If the process includes a topcoat, the primer first article inspection may be waived.
qa.zh: 若製程包含面漆作業，可免進行底漆首件檢驗。

words.definition: to decide which tasks are most important and do them first.

general.en: I am good at managing my time and prioritizing tasks when deadlines are tight.
general.zh: 我也擅長在截止期限緊迫時做好時間管理，並優先處理重要任務。

general.en: Lack of an English-speaking environment in Taiwan makes progress risky or stagnant without regular usage. To reduce stress, speak English with colleagues. In real speaking contexts, prioritize fluency over grammar.
general.zh: 在台灣缺乏全英語環境，不常使用容易停滯；可以和同事說英文提升流利度；實際口語溝通中，流暢度優先於完美的文法（課堂上老師仍會糾正文法）。

words.definition: an insurance plan that a person buys themselves rather than getting from the government.

general.en: Many people get health insurance from their employer. Some people also buy private insurance by themselves.
general.zh: 許多人透過公司取得保險，也有人自行購買私人保險。

general.en: Do people still buy private insurance, then?
general.zh: 那大家還會買私人保險嗎？

general.en: Some do. Private insurance helps with things the NHI doesn't cover, like a single room or expensive cancer drugs.
general.zh: 有些人會。私人保險可以支付健保不給付的項目，像是單人病房或昂貴的癌症用藥。

general.en: I see. So the government plan is the base, and private insurance is the extra layer.
general.zh: 我懂了。所以政府的計畫是基礎，私人保險是額外的一層。

words.definition: Acting before a problem happens instead of waiting.

general.en: Emma decided to take proactive measures.
general.zh: Emma 決定採取主動積極的作為。

general.en: Send the replacement first, then reply. Being proactive is worth more than a perfect sentence.
general.zh: 先寄替換品，再回覆。主動出擊比一句完美的話還有價值。

words.definition: A short factual statement of what is wrong, on which part, since when, and how many.

qa.en: Your problem statement is too vague — say which model, which lot, and how many units.
qa.zh: 你的問題描述太籠統 —— 要寫清楚哪個機種、哪一批、幾台。

general.en: A new backup procedure has since been added to the factory's shipping checklist.
general.zh: 工廠的出貨檢查清單後來加入了一項新的備援流程。

general.en: The dentist lowered the dental chair before starting the procedure.
general.zh: 牙醫在開始療程前把診療椅放低。

general.en: All employees must follow the safety procedures when operating machines.
general.zh: 所有員工操作機器時都必須遵守安全操作規範。

general.en: The company provides safety procedure training for new workers.
general.zh: 公司為新員工提供安全流程訓練。

general.en: She also changed the company's procedures so that every product would be checked more effectively and efficiently before delivery. The company also extended its return period and made its refund policy clearer.
general.zh: 她也修改了公司的作業流程，以便每一項產品在交貨之前都能被更有效且更有效率地檢查。公司也延長了退貨期限，並讓退款政策更加清楚。

qa.en: The procedure for identifying, segregating, and dispositioning product that does not meet the specification.
qa.zh: 不合規格的東西怎麼標、怎麼隔離、怎麼決定處理方式的程序。

qa.en: Nonconforming product is segregated and dispositioned according to our nonconforming product control procedure.
qa.zh: 不合格品照不合格品管制程序隔離，再決定怎麼處理。

qa.en: The documented system of procedures, records, and responsibilities that controls quality across the whole company.
qa.zh: 用寫下來的程序、紀錄跟權責分工，管全公司品質的一套系統。

qa.en: Retention periods are defined in our document control procedure, and the records are traceable to the lot number and the inspector.
qa.zh: 保存年限照文件管制程序，紀錄追得到批號跟檢驗員。

qa.en: All procedures referenced during this visit are controlled documents within our ISO 9001 system, and the records are retained for the period defined in our document control procedure.
qa.zh: 今天參訪提到的程序，都是 ISO 9001 系統裡的管制文件；紀錄照文件管制程序規定的年限保存。

qa.en: Every report shows the specification, the actual value, and the judgement — not just OK/NG. Reports are traceable to the lot number and retained per the document control procedure.
qa.zh: 每份報告都有規格、實測值跟判定，不是只寫 OK／NG。報告追得到批號，照文件管制程序保存。

general.en: My manager suggested that everyone on the quality team complete a short certification in statistical process control.
general.zh: 我的主管建議品管團隊的每個人都去修一個統計製程管制的短期認證。

general.en: Exactly. That's why the whole process was redesigned. It's fairer now.
general.zh: 正是。所以整個流程才會重新設計。現在公平多了。

general.en: The process of beginning to sleep.
general.zh: 入睡，指從清醒狀態進入睡眠的過程。

general.en: We investigate. I pull the process data, talk to the operators, and try to find the root cause instead of just replacing the bad parts.
general.zh: 我們展開調查。我會調製程數據、跟線上作業員談，設法找出根本原因，而不是只把壞掉的零件換掉。

qa.en: The Cpk of the squat rack hole position is only 0.98, so the process is not capable yet.
qa.zh: 深蹲架孔位的製程能力指數只有 0.98，製程能力還不足。

qa.en: QA builds quality into the treadmill production process; QC checks the finished treadmills.
qa.zh: 品保把品質做進跑步機的製程裡；品管則檢查完成的跑步機。

qa.en: The worst process average defect level that is still treated as acceptable for the purpose of sampling inspection.
qa.zh: 抽檢的時候，製程平均不良率最差還能接受到哪裡，那條線就是 AQL。

qa.en: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.
qa.zh: 一套有步驟的解決問題流程：先圍堵、再找根因、最後讓它不要再發生。

qa.en: Calipers, micrometers, height gauges, feeler gauges, and thread gauges used for routine in-process checks.
qa.zh: 卡尺、分厘卡、高度規、厚薄規、螺紋規這些，製程中例行檢查用的量具。

qa.en: FAI is required at new product introduction, after a mold or fixture change, after a design change, and at the start of each shift for critical processes.
qa.zh: 新產品導入、換模／換治具、設計變更，還有關鍵製程每班開線，都要做首件。
