qa.en: What is the process capability for this dimension?
qa.zh: 這個尺寸的製程能力是多少？

qa.en: The key characteristic is monitored by control chart and the process capability index is reviewed monthly.
qa.zh: 關鍵特性用管制圖盯，Cpk 每個月檢討。

qa.en: Our process capability for this feature is about ±0.15 mm.
qa.zh: 這個特徵我們的製程能力大約是 ±0.15 mm。

words.definition: A number that compares process spread with the specification width; 1.33 or higher is the usual target.

qa.en: Process validation requires three consecutive runs of the same process.
qa.zh: 製程驗證要求同一製程連續三批。

words.definition: the time when a new product is first sold or introduced to the public.

general.en: Yes, especially during product launches. Sometimes I face tight deadlines, but I stay calm and focus on solving problems step by step.
general.zh: 有，尤其是在產品上市期間。有時候時程很緊，但我會保持冷靜，一步一步解決問題。

general.en: Investigators blamed weak oversight of production.
general.zh: 調查人員歸咎於生產流程的監督不夠嚴謹。

general.en: Never. It's cross-functional work. Production, engineering and purchasing all sit in the same meeting.
general.zh: 從來不是。那是跨部門的工作。生產、工程和採購都會坐在同一個會議裡。

general.en: The delay in materials caused the production schedule to be disrupted.
general.zh: 材料延遲導致生產進度被打亂。

general.en: We evaluate potential risks before mass production.
general.zh: 我們在量產前會評估潛在風險。

general.en: …and my task was to ensure that the first production batch met all quality standards before shipment to a key international client.
general.zh: ……我的任務是確保第一批生產的產品在出貨給重要國際客戶前符合所有品質標準。

general.en: As a result, we corrected the issue before mass production, preventing a costly recall and potential damage to our client relationship. This improved our production-line efficiency by 15% for that specific model.
general.zh: 結果我們在量產前修正了問題，避免了昂貴的召回與客戶關係受損。這也讓該款產品的生產線效率提升了 15%。

qa.en: QA builds quality into the treadmill production process; QC checks the finished treadmills.
qa.zh: 品保把品質做進跑步機的製程裡；品管則檢查完成的跑步機。

qa.en: A full dimensional and functional check of the first piece produced after a new setup, before mass production is released.
qa.zh: 換模或重新設定後，把第一件的尺寸跟功能整個檢一遍，過了才放量產。

qa.en: Mass production is released only after the first article inspection is approved.
qa.zh: 首件過了才放量產。

qa.en: What do you do when you find a defect during production?
qa.zh: 生產中發現不良你們怎麼處理？

qa.en: The first article inspection report covers all dimensions on the drawing and is retained as part of the production record for traceability.
qa.zh: 首件報告圖面上每個尺寸都有，會跟生產紀錄一起存，之後要追都追得到。

qa.en: We perform first article inspection whenever there is a new setup, a mold change, or a design change. Mass production is not released until the first article is approved and signed off by QA.
qa.zh: 只要重新設定、換模或設計變更，就做首件。品保沒簽首件，不放量產。

qa.en: Please remove the obsolete drawing from the production line.
qa.zh: 失效的圖面請從產線收回來。

qa.en: Verification must be run on production-representative samples.
qa.zh: 驗證一定要用量產代表性樣品。

words.definition: to say a word in a certain way.
words.lesson: 20250807 現在進行式與過去進行式

general.en: Some words are difficult to pronounce currently.
general.zh: 目前有些單字很難發音。（are difficult to + 原形 表達某件事做起來很困難；currently 目前。）

general.en: I need to pronounce this word clearly.
general.zh: 我需要清楚地唸出這個字。（to say a word correctly）

words.definition: 說出一個字或語言的方式和聲音

general.en: After a while, my pronunciation improved a lot.
general.zh: 過了一段時間，我的發音進步了很多。

general.en: You should always revise your pronunciation when learning new words.
general.zh: 學習新單字時，你應該總是修正（或檢視）你的發音。

general.en: I practice my pronunciation by listening and reading.
general.zh: 我藉由聽和閱讀來練習我的發音。（by + V-ing 表示「藉由…的方法／手段」。）

general.en: It's important to say words accurately because correct pronunciation helps people understand me better.
general.zh: 準確發音很重要，因為這能讓人更了解我。

general.en: It was obvious that I was making good progress in pronunciation.
general.zh: 很明顯地，我的發音取得了很好的進步。

general.en: My pronunciation is getting better every month.
general.zh: 我的發音每個月都在進步。

general.en: He is wearing a mask to protect himself from air pollution.
general.zh: 他戴著口罩來保護自己免受空氣污染。

general.en: I wore a mask to protect myself because of the sandstorm.
general.zh: 因為沙塵暴，我戴口罩保護自己。

general.en: People use sunscreen to protect their skin from UV rays.
general.zh: 人們用防曬乳保護皮膚免受紫外線傷害。

general.en: Apply or use sunscreen to protect your skin.
general.zh: 塗抹或使用防曬乳來保護皮膚。

general.en: That, she said, was the real skill of business travel: protecting what actually mattered.
general.zh: 她說，這才是商務出差真正的本事：守住真正重要的事。

general.en: We must protect the environment.
general.zh: 我們必須保護環境。

qa.en: A VCI oil protects even the surfaces that the oil does not touch directly.
qa.zh: VCI 油連油碰不到的地方也能保護。

qa.en: We need an oil that protects surfaces the applicator cannot reach directly.
qa.zh: 我們要一支油噴不到的地方也能保護的防鏽油。

qa.en: We need a VCI oil that protects surfaces the applicator cannot reach.
qa.zh: 我們要換一支 VCI 油，噴不到的地方也能保護。

qa.en: Protect the reliability test duration — it is the only test that catches time-dependent failures.
qa.zh: 可靠度測試的時間要守住——只有它抓得到跑久了才出現的失效。

qa.en: This rust-preventive oil is not suitable for tube interiors — we need a VCI-type product that protects surfaces the oil does not touch directly.
qa.zh: 「油不好、換掉」沒有技術依據。講清楚為什麼不適合（外面平面 vs. 管子裡面）、要什麼特性（揮發型，碰不到也能防鏽），供應商才知道推薦什麼產品。

qa.en: More of the wrong oil does not fix the problem. This oil is for open surfaces — inside a sealed tube, it does not coat evenly and it does not protect where it does not touch. We need a VCI oil that works by releasing vapor.
qa.zh: 用更多不對的油不會解決問題。這支油是給外面平面用的——管子裡面塗不均勻，碰不到的地方就不會保護。要換 VCI 油，靠揮發出來的成分保護裡面。

qa.en: We already did an FAI on the prototype. Do we really need another one?
qa.zh: 原型階段已經做過 FAI 了，真的還要再做一次嗎？

qa.en: The prototype was machined and this lot is die-cast — different process, different first article. FAI follows the process, not the part number.
qa.zh: 原型是 CNC 加工，這批是壓鑄——製程不同就是不同的首件。FAI 跟著製程走，不是跟著料號走。

words.definition: An official day off work for everyone.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: With fewer public holidays, there is significantly less time to relax.
general.zh: 由於國定假日較少，放鬆的時間明顯少了許多。

general.en: Does the MRT run on public holidays?
general.zh: 國定假日捷運有開嗎？

general.en: Taiwan has many public holidays.
general.zh: 台灣有很多國定假日。

words.definition: To buy something.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: Please keep your receipt as proof of purchase.
general.zh: 請保留收據作為購買證明。

general.en: Never. It's cross-functional work. Production, engineering and purchasing all sit in the same meeting.
general.zh: 從來不是。那是跨部門的工作。生產、工程和採購都會坐在同一個會議裡。

general.en: I am responsible for purchasing the test equipment.
general.zh: 我負責採購測試設備。

general.en: Before purchasing the equipment, I need to submit the invoices.
general.zh: 購買設備之前，我需要呈交發票。

general.en: Before purchasing the equipment, I need to submit the invoices to my boss to review and confirm them.
general.zh: 購買設備之前，我需要把發票呈交給老闆審核並確認。

general.en: Can I purchase extra baggage?
general.zh: 我可以加購行李額度嗎？

qa.en: I uploaded it to the system. I assumed purchasing would forward it.
qa.zh: 我上傳到系統了，我以為採購會轉發。

words.definition: The reason why you do something.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: What is the purpose of your trip?
general.zh: 你此行的目的是什麼？

general.en: The Purpose and Significance of Company Banquets — Why do companies invest significant resources in hosting large-scale parties? The reasons extend far beyond a simple meal.
general.zh: 公司宴會的目的與意義——為什麼公司願意投入大量資源來舉辦大型聚會？原因遠遠不只是吃一頓飯那麼簡單。

qa.en: The worst process average defect level that is still treated as acceptable for the purpose of sampling inspection.
qa.zh: 抽檢的時候，製程平均不良率最差還能接受到哪裡，那條線就是 AQL。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: During our in-process inspection today, we found rust forming on the inner surface of treadmill handrail tubes. The tubes were treated with your general-purpose rust-preventive oil (product code RP-210) after cutting.
qa.zh: 今天巡檢時發現跑步機扶手管裡面開始生鏽。切管後有用你們的通用型防鏽油（料號 RP-210）處理過。

qa.en: Please measure the pull-off force with the push-pull force gauge.
qa.zh: 請用推拉力計量測拉脫力。

qa.en: Welcome to our factory. I'm from the QA department.
qa.zh: 歡迎來到我們工廠，我是品保部門的人員。

general.en: Our customer expressed concern about the quality.
general.zh: 我們的客戶對品質表示擔憂。

general.en: I'm currently working as a quality engineer at Rexon, a fitness equipment company.
general.zh: 我目前在 Rexon 任職，擔任品質工程師，公司主要從事健身器材相關產品。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: One of the biggest challenges in my role is resolving quality issues within a limited time frame.
general.zh: 在我的工作中，最大的挑戰之一是需要在有限的時間內解決品質問題。

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題等。

general.en: The quality issues I deal with most often are cosmetic and dimensional problems, functional defects, and performance-related issues.
general.zh: 我最常處理的品質問題包括外觀缺陷、尺寸問題、功能性缺陷，以及性能相關問題。

qa.en: Our quality circle meets every Friday to review last week's defect data.
qa.zh: 我們的品管圈每週五開會檢討上週的不良數據。

qa.en: Sorting 2,000 strength machine covers by hand is a real cost of poor quality.
qa.zh: 用人工挑選兩千個重訓機外殼是實實在在的劣質成本。

qa.en: QA builds quality into the treadmill production process; QC checks the finished treadmills.
qa.zh: 品保把品質做進跑步機的製程裡；品管則檢查完成的跑步機。

qa.en: The customer will run a quality audit on our exercise bike line next month.
qa.zh: 客戶下個月會來稽核我們的飛輪車生產線。

qa.en: The running belt must meet the quality requirement of 100,000 cycles without cracking.
qa.zh: 跑帶必須符合十萬次循環不裂的品質要求。

qa.en: We use general level II as the default, tighten to level III for a new supplier or after a quality issue, and use special levels S-1 to S-4 for destructive or costly tests.
qa.zh: 平常用一般水準 II；新供應商或出過問題就加嚴到 III；破壞性或很貴的測試改用特殊水準 S-1～S-4。

words.definition: Process-oriented work that prevents defects from happening.
Inspecting a product or a factory to confirm a defined standard is met.

qa.en: The customer will run a quality audit on our exercise bike line next month.
qa.zh: 客戶下個月會來稽核我們的飛輪車生產線。

words.definition: A small team of operators who meet regularly to solve quality problems in their own area.

qa.en: Our quality circle meets every Friday to review last week's defect data.
qa.zh: 我們的品管圈每週五開會檢討上週的不良數據。

words.definition: Product-oriented work that finds defects in the product.

qa.en: We are strengthening our quality culture through regular shop-floor training.
qa.zh: 我們靠定期的現場教育訓練來加強品質文化。

words.definition: someone whose job is to make sure products meet certain standards before they are sold
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: I'm currently working as a quality engineer at Rexon, a fitness equipment company.
general.zh: 我目前在 Rexon 任職，擔任品質工程師，公司主要從事健身器材相關產品。

general.en: Anita has recently been enrolled in an online course that teaches statistical methods for quality engineers.
general.zh: Anita最近被安排參加了一門教品管工程師統計方法的線上課程。

general.en: Hi, this is Anita. I want to share a few thoughts about the recent cooking oil scandal, from a quality engineer's point of view.
general.zh: 嗨，我是Anita。我想以品質工程師的角度，分享一些對最近食用油事件的想法。

general.en: As a quality engineer, I read stories like this oil recall a little differently than most people.
general.zh: 身為品質工程師，我讀這類食用油回收的新聞時，角度跟大部分人不太一樣。

general.en: Thanks for coming in, David. Can you tell me what you actually do as a quality engineer?
general.zh: 謝謝你今天過來，David。可以說說你身為品質工程師實際上在做什麼嗎？

general.en: Q: Tell me about your job. / Can you walk me through your professional background? I work as a quality engineer at a fitness equipment company. I have worked there for ten years. My job is to check product quality and solve problems.
general.zh: Q: 跟我談談你的工作。/ 請你簡述一下你的職涯背景。 我在一家健身器材公司擔任品質工程師。我在那裡工作了十年。我的工作是檢查產品品質並解決問題。

words.definition: The documented system of procedures, records, and responsibilities that controls quality across the whole company.

qa.en: We keep all quality records for at least five years.
qa.zh: 所有品質記錄至少保存五年。

words.definition: What the customer and the standard ask the product to achieve.

qa.en: The running belt must meet the quality requirement of 100,000 cycles without cracking.
qa.zh: 跑帶必須符合十萬次循環不裂的品質要求。

words.definition: a device that gives out heat or cools a machine.

general.en: The radiator helps reduce the machine temperature.
general.zh: 散熱器幫助降低機台溫度。

words.definition: 下雨時穿在身上防水的外套

general.en: He decided not to wear a raincoat because it was only drizzling.
general.zh: 他決定不穿雨衣，因為只是毛毛雨。

general.en: Tom looks in his closet for a raincoat. He also finds his rain boots and an umbrella. He will wear these things tomorrow.
general.zh: Tom在衣櫃裡找雨衣。他也找到了雨鞋和一把傘。他明天會穿戴這些東西。

general.en: I checked the weather app yesterday, and then I found my raincoat and boots.
general.zh: 我昨天看了天氣App，然後找出了我的雨衣和雨鞋。

general.en: Tom looks in his closet for a raincoat.
general.zh: Tom在衣櫃裡找雨衣。

general.en: He does not wear a raincoat.

words.definition: 用來刮除鬍子或毛髮的工具

general.en: He bought a new razor for his beard.
general.zh: 他為了鬍子買了一支新的刮鬍刀。

qa.en: Based on the data, the defect rate is limited to lots produced between March 3rd and 7th.
qa.zh: 從數據看，不良只出在 3/3 到 3/7 生產的那幾批。

qa.en: The new resin grade requires re-qualification before we can accept it.
qa.zh: 新的樹脂等級要重新驗證過，我們才能允收。

qa.en: All affected lots are on hold until re-qualification is completed. Please treat this as urgent.
qa.zh: 重新驗證完成前，受影響的批次全部扣住。這件事請當急件處理。

qa.en: This is an unauthorized material change. The affected lots are on hold until re-qualification is completed.
qa.zh: 這是沒經過核准的材料變更。重新驗證完成前，受影響的批次先扣住。

qa.en: Decide what re-qualification is needed — at minimum material certification, and possibly UV and impact testing for outdoor-exposed parts.
qa.zh: 決定要重新驗證哪些——至少要材證，外露件可能還要做 UV 跟衝擊測試。

qa.en: The change date, the affected lot numbers, and the material certification of the new grade — in writing, by Thursday. Until re-qualification is done, the affected lots stay on hold.
qa.zh: 變更日期、受影響批號、新等級的材證——用書面給，週四前。重新驗證完成前，受影響的批次繼續扣著。

qa.en: We identified an unauthorized change to a customer-approved material. We have contained the affected lots, defined the re-qualification plan, and will review the disposition of in-process units once the comparison data is available.
qa.zh: 我們發現供應商改了客戶承認過的材料，沒經過核准。受影響批次已經圍堵、重新驗證的計畫也定了，比對數據出來後再決定在製品怎麼處理。

qa.en: The control plan defines the characteristic, method, sample size, frequency, and reaction plan for each controlled item.
qa.zh: 管制計畫把每個管制項的特性、方法、樣本數、頻率跟反應對策都定好。

qa.en: The control plan reaction plan tells the operator what to do.
qa.zh: 管制計畫的反應計畫會告訴作業員該怎麼做。

qa.en: A document listing every characteristic to be controlled, with its specification, measuring method, sample size, frequency, and reaction plan.
qa.zh: 把每個要管的特性列出來的文件：規格、怎麼量、抽幾件、多久量一次、出問題怎麼辦。

qa.en: The chart shows a run of seven points trending down. That is an out-of-control signal under our reaction plan, even though every reading is in specification.
qa.zh: 管制圖出現連續七點往下的連串。照我們的反應計畫，這就是失控訊號，就算每一點讀值都在規格內也一樣。

qa.en: Yes. The control plan lists each characteristic, the specification, the measuring instrument, the sample size and frequency, and the reaction plan when the result is out of specification.
qa.zh: 可以。管制計畫上面有每項特性、規格、用什麼儀器量、抽幾件、多久量一次，還有超規時怎麼處理。

words.definition: Applying the same fix to other parts, models or lines with the same risk.
To change the order or position of things.

general.en: We need to rearrange the furniture in this room.
general.zh: 我們需要重新安排這個房間的家具。

general.en: We need to rearrange the furniture.
general.zh: 我們需要重新擺放家具。

general.en: If I were invisible for a day, I would sneak into the office and rearrange everyone's desk so that nothing makes sense. By the end of the day, they'd all be wondering if the office was haunted.
general.zh: 如果我有一天是隱形，我會偷偷溜進辦公室，把每個人的桌子重新整理，弄到一切都亂七八糟、完全說不通。到了下班前，大家都會開始懷疑這間辦公室是不是鬧鬼了。

words.definition: to fix something back in its place.

general.en: The sink was reattached.
general.zh: 洗手台被重新固定。

words.definition: A piece of paper that proves you paid for something.

general.en: Please keep your receipt as proof of purchase.
general.zh: 請保留收據作為購買證明。

general.en: I know. But I didn't have a receipt for the other half, so I couldn't prove it.
general.zh: 我知道。但另一半我沒有收據，所以無法證明。

general.en: That's a tough lesson. I always keep every receipt now because of a similar thing.
general.zh: 這個教訓很痛。我現在都會保留每一張收據，因為以前也遇過類似的事。

general.en: An itemised receipt is required before any deduction can be accepted.
general.zh: 任何扣款在被接受前都需要逐項收據。

general.en: She asked for an itemised receipt.
general.zh: 她要求對方提供逐項列明的收據。

general.en: Do you have the receipt?

qa.en: The real corrective action is in our ECN process: the supplier must be on the distribution list and must confirm receipt.
qa.zh: 真正要矯正的是我們的 ECN 流程：供應商一定要在發行名單上，而且一定要回覆確認收到。

qa.en: Next build, provided the supplier confirms receipt of Rev C in writing first.
qa.zh: 下一次投產——前提是供應商先書面確認收到 C 版。

qa.en: The root cause is not the supplier — our ECN process failed to communicate the revision change. I will close the gap by requiring written confirmation of receipt for every drawing release.
qa.zh: 根因不在供應商，是我們的 ECN 流程沒把改版通知出去。我會把這個洞補起來：每次圖面發行都要對方書面回覆確認。

qa.en: The inspection failures were caused by a revision communication gap, not by supplier workmanship. Disposition is agreed, the Rev C cut-in is set for the next build, and the ECN process now requires supplier confirmation of receipt.
qa.zh: 檢驗判退是版次沒通知到造成的，不是供應商做工的問題。怎麼判已經有共識，C 版下一批投產切入，ECN 流程也加上供應商要回覆確認這一條。

words.definition: The person who greets visitors at a front desk.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: The receptionist greeted us at the front desk.
general.zh: 接待員在前台歡迎我們。

words.definition: To lean a seat backward.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: I couldn't eat because the seat in front of me was reclined.
general.zh: 我沒辦法吃東西，因為前面的椅背往後傾。

general.en: They recline their seats, leaving me with very little legroom.
general.zh: 他們把椅背往後調，害我沒什麼腿部空間。

general.en: Some passengers are inconsiderate because they recline their seats, leaving me with very little legroom.
general.zh: 有些乘客很不體貼，因為他們把椅背往後調，害我幾乎沒有腿部空間。

general.en: He reclined his seat, so I didn't have enough legroom.
general.zh: 他把椅背往後躺，我沒有足夠的伸腿空間。

general.en: Can I recline my seat?
general.zh: 我可以把椅背往後調嗎？

words.definition: to know who someone is or what something is when you see or hear it

general.en: At first, I couldn't recognize many new words in English texts.
general.zh: 起初，我無法認出英文文章裡的許多新單字。

general.en: I recognized the song as soon as I heard the first note.
general.zh: 我一聽到第一個音符就認出了這首歌。

general.en: She was wearing a mask, so I didn't recognize her at first.
general.zh: 她戴著口罩，所以我一開始沒認出她。

general.en: At first, I couldn't recognize many new words in texts.
general.zh: 起初，我無法認出文章裡的許多新單字。

general.en: I can recognize many English words now.
general.zh: 我現在能認出許多英文單字。（to know something because you've seen it before）

general.en: I started learning English seriously last year. At first, I found it difficult to recognize new words and understand texts. I often had to guess the meaning of words from the context, but sometimes I was wrong.
general.zh: 我去年開始認真學英文。起初，我發現很難認出新單字和理解文章。我經常必須從上下文猜測單字的意思，但有時候我會猜錯。（文法解說：find it difficult to + 動詞 是一個很實用的句型，表示「覺得做某件事很困難」。）

general.en: Fourteen tropical storms formed in July and August alone, matching the record for that two-month period.
general.zh: 光是七、八月就形成了十四個熱帶風暴，追平了同期紀錄。

general.en: This has been one of the wettest summers Taiwan has recorded in years.
general.zh: 這是台灣近年來記錄到最潮濕的夏天之一。

general.en: He plays the piano, he sings, and he even recorded a blues album.
general.zh: 他會彈鋼琴、會唱歌，甚至還錄過一張藍調專輯。

general.en: The band is recording a music album.
general.zh: 樂團正在錄製一張音樂專輯。

general.en: Like Dr. House, Laurie is also a talented musician and is passionate about the blues. He recently went to New Orleans to record an album in which he plays 15 of his favorite songs. But of course, he doesn't think that people will like it.
general.zh: 和豪斯醫生一樣，羅利也是位才華洋溢的音樂家，並且熱愛藍調。他最近去了紐奧良錄製一張專輯，收錄了他最喜愛的 15 首歌。但他當然還是覺得大家不會喜歡。

general.en: To improve, I decided to keep a record of all the new words I learned and make a note of important phrases. Every day, I repeat these words out loud and try to use them in a conversation with my friends.
general.zh: 為了進步，我決定把我學到的所有新單字記錄下來，並記下重要的片語。每天，我都會大聲朗讀這些單字，並試著在跟朋友的對話中使用它們。

qa.en: The documented system of procedures, records, and responsibilities that controls quality across the whole company.
qa.zh: 用寫下來的程序、紀錄跟權責分工，管全公司品質的一套系統。

qa.en: Comparing an instrument against a traceable reference standard at a defined interval and recording the result.
qa.zh: 照規定週期，拿儀器跟可追溯的標準件比對，把結果記下來。

qa.en: The first article inspection report covers all dimensions on the drawing and is retained as part of the production record for traceability.
qa.zh: 首件報告圖面上每個尺寸都有，會跟生產紀錄一起存，之後要追都追得到。

qa.en: The sampling plan for this lot is Ac 1 / Re 2. One defective is within the acceptance number, so the lot is accepted. We still record the defect and feed it back to the supplier.
qa.zh: 這批的抽樣計畫是 Ac 1／Re 2，1 件不良還在允收數內，所以收。不過這件不良我們還是會記下來，回饋給供應商。

qa.en: All procedures referenced during this visit are controlled documents within our ISO 9001 system, and the records are retained for the period defined in our document control procedure.
qa.zh: 今天參訪提到的程序，都是 ISO 9001 系統裡的管制文件；紀錄照文件管制程序規定的年限保存。

qa.en: The operator performs a self-check every hour with a go/no-go gauge, and QA performs a patrol inspection every two hours with a caliper and a micrometer. Both results are recorded on the process control sheet.
qa.zh: 作業員每小時用通止規自檢，品保每兩小時用卡尺跟分厘卡巡檢。兩邊的結果都記在製程管制表上。

qa.en: Do not state a recycled content percentage you cannot evidence from a supplier document.
qa.zh: 再生料比例沒有供應商文件可以證明的，不要寫出去。

qa.en: Can you provide material composition and recycled content data for the frame?
qa.zh: 機架的材料組成和再生料含量資料，你們拿得出來嗎？

qa.en: We have the material certificates from our steel supplier. I can send you what we have and ask them about recycled content.
qa.zh: 我們有鋼材供應商的材證，我可以先把手上的給您，再去問他們再生料的部分。

qa.en: We do not state a recycled content figure we cannot evidence.
qa.zh: 再生料含量的數字拿不出證據的，我們不會寫出去。

qa.en: Check whether your steel suppliers can already state grade, origin and recycled content — many cannot, and that is the long lead item.
qa.zh: 問問看鋼材供應商現在講不講得出鋼種、產地和再生料含量 —— 很多講不出來，這是最花時間的一項。

qa.en: We can provide material certificates covering grade and composition. Recycled content is not currently declared by all of our suppliers, so we are collecting that data now.
qa.zh: 鋼種和成分的材證我們拿得出來。再生料含量目前不是每家供應商都有申報，我們正在收這部分資料。

words.definition: a red paper packet containing money, given as a gift especially during Chinese New Year.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: Children often receive red envelopes with money from their parents or grandparents.
general.zh: 小孩會收到裝有錢的紅包。

general.en: I put money in the red envelope and placed it under my pillow to bring good luck.
general.zh: 我把錢放進紅包裡，然後把它放在枕頭下以帶來好運。

general.en: And that's when the children get a red envelope?
general.zh: 那也就是小孩子收到紅包的時候？

words.definition: Money that is given back to you.

general.en: The sponsor offered refunds to compensate the customers.
general.zh: 贊助商提供退款來補償顧客。

general.en: You can get a full refund within 30 days.
general.zh: 30天內你可以獲得全額退款。

general.en: I could apply for a refund through the airline's online platform.
general.zh: 我可以透過航空公司的線上平台申請退款。

general.en: The company made its refund policy more transparent.
general.zh: 公司讓退款政策更透明。

general.en: They want to get a refund.
general.zh: 他們想要拿到退款。

general.en: Could I ask for a refund?
general.zh: 我可以要求退款嗎？

words.definition: To say no to something.

general.en: She refused to sign the contract without reading it first.
general.zh: 她拒絕在沒看過合約的情況下簽字。

general.en: I'm not going anywhere! I refuse to move.
general.zh: 3. (move) 我哪裡都不去！我拒絕移動。

general.en: The politician refused to reveal the truth.
general.zh: 這位政治家拒絕揭露真相。（refuse to + V。）

general.en: The store refused to give me a refund.
general.zh: 商店拒絕退款給我。

general.en: She refused to tell him her name.
general.zh: 5. A: What's your name? B: I'm not going to tell you.／她拒絕告訴他自己的名字。

general.en: In fifteen minutes he had stopped the leak with a piece of rubber and a metal clip. He refused to take any money. "Get it repaired properly next week," he said, "but tonight you can sleep."
general.zh: 十五分鐘內，他用一塊橡膠和一個金屬夾就止住了漏水。他不肯收任何錢。「下週還是要請人好好修，」他說，「但今晚你可以安心睡了。」

words.definition: to let built-up stress out of your body through active or physical things, such as exercise

general.en: Working out is a great way to release stress.
general.zh: 運動是釋放壓力的好方法。

qa.en: Any design change (gusset) restarts the reliability clock: plan the re-test time into the schedule honestly.
qa.zh: 只要改設計（加補強板），可靠度測試就要重新起算：重測的時間要老實排進時程。

qa.en: A design change means the reliability test starts over.
qa.zh: 只要改設計，可靠度測試就要重新來過。

qa.en: Verification proves it works; reliability proves it keeps working.
qa.zh: 驗證證明它「會動」；可靠度證明它「一直會動」。

qa.en: Could we see the reliability lab?
qa.zh: 我們可以看一下可靠度實驗室嗎？

qa.en: The reliability test failed at 60% of the target life. Root cause analysis is in progress, and any design change will require a verification re-test.
qa.zh: 可靠度測試跑到目標壽命 60% 就失效了。根因分析進行中，只要改設計就要重新驗證。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

words.definition: to make an unpleasant feeling or situation less severe

general.en: I drink tea to relieve stress after a long day at work.
general.zh: 我在漫長的工作後喝茶來緩解壓力。

general.en: A warm bath can help relieve muscle pain.
general.zh: 熱水澡可以幫助緩解肌肉疼痛。

general.en: Reading a book is a good way to relieve anxiety.
general.zh: 看書是緩解焦慮的好方法。

general.en: I felt relieved and thanked all the professionals for their hard work.
general.zh: 我感到如釋重負，並感謝所有專業人員的辛勤工作。

general.en: I took a painkiller to relieve my headache.
general.zh: 我吃了止痛藥來緩解頭痛。

general.en: I drink tea to relieve stress after work.
general.zh: 下班後我喝茶來緩解壓力。

words.definition: to make tense or stressful feelings calmer through quiet, relaxing activities

general.en: I drink tea to relieve stress after work.
general.zh: 下班後我喝茶來緩解壓力。

general.en: I drink tea to relieve stress after a long day at work.
general.zh: 我在漫長的工作後喝茶來緩解壓力。

words.definition: Feeling glad and relaxed because a problem has been solved or worry has gone away.

general.en: I felt relieved and thanked all the professionals for their hard work.
general.zh: 我感到如釋重負，並感謝所有專業人員的辛勤工作。

general.en: Now she feels much better, and Anita feels relieved and happy.
general.zh: 現在她感覺好多了，Anita也鬆了一口氣、很開心。

general.en: Honestly, I feel so relieved. I was worried I'd have to pay for all of it.
general.zh: 老實說我鬆了一口氣。我本來很擔心要自己付全部的費用。

general.en: I was relieved to hear that she arrived safely.
general.zh: 聽到她平安抵達我就放心了。

general.en: Anna usually feels stressed at work, but today she feels relieved. Her manager gave her good feedback, so she is happy.
general.zh: Anna 通常在工作時感到壓力很大，但今天她感到如釋重負。她的經理給了她很好的回饋，所以她很高興。

general.en: Anita told her mother to see a doctor as soon as possible. Her mother has already seen a doctor and has started taking some medicine. Now she feels much better, and Anita feels relieved and happy.
general.zh: Anita叫媽媽儘快去看醫生。媽媽已經看過醫生了，也開始吃一些藥。現在她感覺好多了，Anita也鬆了一口氣、很開心。

words.definition: To get a new version of something that has expired.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: The tenancy agreement runs for twelve months and can be renewed.
general.zh: 這份租約為期十二個月，可以續約。

general.en: My passport is expired. / My passport has expired. / I need to renew my passport because it is no longer valid.
general.zh: 我的護照過期了（形容詞）。／我的護照已經過期（現在完成式）。／我需要續辦護照，因為它已失效（正式）。

general.en: I need to renew my passport.
general.zh: 我需要續辦護照。

words.definition: money paid to use something, or used for renting.

general.en: The company provides rental equipment for short-term projects.
general.zh: 這家公司為短期專案提供租賃設備。

general.en: Rental prices doubled in certain districts between 2020 and 2025.
general.zh: 特定區域在 2020 到 2025 年間租金翻了一倍。

general.en: Limits on short-term rentals help.
general.zh: 限制短期出租是有幫助的。

qa.en: Flag to R&D that repairability and spare-parts availability are being treated as product requirements, not as service topics.
qa.zh: 提醒研發：可修復性和備品供應現在算產品要求了，不再只是售服的事。

qa.en: Repairability is now treated as a product requirement, not a service topic.
qa.zh: 可修復性現在算產品要求，不再只是售服的事。

qa.en: If the result is doubtful, repeat the test with another sample.
qa.zh: 若結果有疑慮，請換另一個樣品重測。

general.en: I need to concentrate on the quality inspection report today.
general.zh: 我今天需要專心處理品質檢驗報告。

general.en: The company reported a modest increase in sales this quarter.
general.zh: 公司本季銷售出現小幅成長。

general.en: I will finish the report tonight and send it before nine tomorrow morning. My daughter will stay home for one more day.
general.zh: 我今晚會完成報告，明天早上九點前寄出。我女兒會再待在家一天。

general.en: She has already finished today's report.
general.zh: 她已經寫完今天的報告了。

general.en: I will finish the report tonight.
general.zh: 我今天晚上會把報告完成。

general.en: Now Amy thinks the early start is a good thing. The office is quiet when she arrives, so she finishes her hardest work before nine. She has already finished today's report, and it is only eight thirty.
general.zh: 現在Amy覺得早起是件好事。她到公司時辦公室很安靜，所以九點前就能做完最難的工作。她已經寫完今天的報告了，現在才八點半。

qa.en: The supplier must submit an 8D report for the cracked squat rack welds within ten working days.
qa.zh: 供應商必須在十個工作天內提出深蹲架焊道龜裂的 8D 報告。

qa.en: Don't judge from the report only — go to the gemba and watch the assembly.
qa.zh: 不要只看報告判斷，到現場實際看組裝過程。

qa.en: What is the root cause, and when can you send us the 8D report?
qa.zh: 根本原因是什麼？8D 報告什麼時候可以給我們？

qa.en: The first article inspection report covers all dimensions on the drawing and is retained as part of the production record for traceability.
qa.zh: 首件報告圖面上每個尺寸都有，會跟生產紀錄一起存，之後要追都追得到。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

qa.en: The CMM program is version-controlled and the measurement report can be issued in your required format, including the actual value and the deviation for every characteristic.
qa.zh: 三次元程式有版本管制，報告可以照你們要的格式出，每個特性都有實測值跟偏差。

words.definition: A person who speaks or acts for someone else or for a company.

general.en: A sales representative called to explain the new service plan.
general.zh: 一位業務代表打電話來說明新的服務方案。

qa.en: When samples and production parts differ in process, treat verification as NOT done until production-representative parts pass.
qa.zh: 樣品跟量產件製程不一樣時，量產代表性零件沒過之前，驗證就當作還沒做完。

qa.en: Verification must be run on production-representative samples.
qa.zh: 驗證一定要用量產代表性樣品。

qa.en: The verification results are not valid for the die-cast version. We need to repeat verification on production-representative parts.
qa.zh: 驗證結果對壓鑄版本不算數。我們要用量產代表性零件重做驗證。

words.definition: When you politely ask for something.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: I want to cancel my ticket and request a refund.
general.zh: 我想要取消我的票並要求退款。

general.en: If the amount is not refunded by 30 June, mediation will be requested.
general.zh: 若款項未於 6 月 30 日前退還，將申請調解。

general.en: I would request professional repairs as soon as possible.
general.zh: 我會請求盡快安排專業維修。

general.en: If I request a refund, will there be any extra charges or penalties?
general.zh: 如果我要求退款，會有額外的費用或罰款嗎？（原句 "will the staff charge me extra or penalize me" 是中文直翻；英文詢問政策時更常用非人稱的 there be 句型，把焦點放在「是否會產生費用」。站務員：Yes, there is a small cancellation fee. 是的，有一筆小額的取消手續費。）

general.en: I sent a meeting request to my manager.
general.zh: 我發了一個會議邀請給我的主管。

general.en: I sent a meeting request.
general.zh: 我發出了一個會議邀請。

qa.en: Send the supplier the element checklist for the level you requested, with the missing items ticked — not a general complaint.
qa.zh: 把你要求那個等級的 PPAP 清單寄給供應商，缺的項目直接勾出來——不要只寫一句「資料不齊」。

qa.en: We requested submission level 3 for this part.
qa.zh: 這個零件我們要求送件等級 3。

qa.en: The submission is incomplete for the level we requested.
qa.zh: 照我們要求的等級，這份 PPAP 資料不齊。

qa.en: We requested submission level 3. The package received contains the part submission warrant and the dimensional report only.
qa.zh: 我們要求的是 Level 3，但收到的只有 PSW 跟尺寸報告。

qa.en: Decide now whether you will ship digital instructions, and keep a paper option available on request.
qa.zh: 現在就決定要不要改電子版說明書，客戶要紙本還是要給得出來。

qa.en: We requested level 3, and four elements are missing. I can record this as interim approval with a quantity limit so the shipment is not blocked, but I cannot record it as approved.
qa.zh: 我們要的是 Level 3，現在缺四項。我可以記成限量暫准，出貨不會卡住，但不能記成核准。

general.en: Implement effective solutions to ensure alignment with our clients' requirements.
general.zh: 落實有效的解決方案，以確保與客戶需求保持一致。

qa.en: The running belt must meet the quality requirement of 100,000 cycles without cracking.
qa.zh: 跑帶必須符合十萬次循環不裂的品質要求。

qa.en: We perform sampling inspection based on the applicable inspection level and AQL requirements.
qa.zh: 我們照適用的檢驗水準跟 AQL 要求做抽檢。

qa.en: Our sampling plan is determined according to the lot size, inspection level, and AQL requirements defined in ISO 2859-1.
qa.zh: 我們的抽樣計畫是照 ISO 2859-1 的批量、檢驗水準跟 AQL 要求來定的。

qa.en: What is the tensile strength requirement for this material?
qa.zh: 這個材質的抗拉強度要求是多少？

qa.en: The tensile strength must meet the specification defined in the drawing. For this steel tube the requirement is a minimum of 370 megapascals, and our last incoming test result was 412 megapascals.
qa.zh: 抗拉強度要符合圖面規格。這支鋼管要求最少 370 MPa，上次進料測出來是 412 MPa。

qa.en: This powder coating passes 48 hours of neutral salt spray with no red rust and with creepage from the scribe line under one millimeter, which meets the requirement in the specification.
qa.zh: 這個粉體塗裝過 48 小時中性鹽霧，沒有紅鏽，劃線處擴散小於 1 mm，符合規格。

words.definition: 改變已計劃的時間，比 change 更正式

general.en: Can we reschedule the meeting to Thursday?
general.zh: 我們可以把會議改到週四嗎？

general.en: The two meetings clash, so we need to reschedule.
general.zh: 兩個會議時間衝突，需要重新安排。

general.en: I'm hoping we can reschedule the interview.
general.zh: 我在想我們是否能重新安排面試時間。

words.definition: a person whose job is to save people in dangerous situations

general.en: Rescue workers searched for survivors all night.
general.zh: 救援人員整夜搜尋倖存者。

general.en: Rescue workers assembled outside the collapsed building.
general.zh: 救援人員在倒塌的建築物外集合。

words.definition: a person who studies a subject carefully.

general.en: Researchers from Hong Kong warned that nomophobia is infecting everyone.
general.zh: 香港的研究人員警告，無手機恐懼症正在感染每一個人。

general.en: Losing an hour of sleep sounds harmless. Repeated for a week, however, it produces a measurable drop in attention, and the person affected is usually the last to notice it. Researchers call this accumulated shortage "sleep debt".
general.zh: 少睡一個小時聽起來無傷大雅。然而，連續一週如此，就會造成注意力可測量的下降，而受影響的人通常是最後才察覺的。研究者把這種累積的不足稱為「睡眠負債」。

qa.en: The old oil left a residue that trapped moisture.
qa.zh: 舊的油留下一層殘留，反而把水氣悶在裡面。

words.definition: to find a satisfactory way of dealing with a problem.

general.en: One of the biggest challenges in my role is resolving quality issues within a limited time frame.
general.zh: 在我的工作中，最大的挑戰之一是需要在有限的時間內解決品質問題。

general.en: Resolving quality issues within a limited time frame.
general.zh: 在有限的時間內解決品質問題。

general.en: Thanks to Emma's effective communication and constant efforts, the team efficiently resolved the issues. They completed the project successfully in no time and received positive feedback from their boss.
general.zh: 多虧了 Emma 有效的溝通與持續的努力，團隊有效率地解決了問題。他們很快就順利完成專案，並得到老闆正面的回饋。

words.definition: A duty or job that you are expected to do.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: It is your responsibility to finish the work.
general.zh: 完成工作是你的責任。

general.en: As a landlord, it was his responsibility to maintain the apartment properly.
general.zh: 作為房東，妥善維護公寓是他的責任。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: Never in public. Accountability means we take responsibility outside and sort out the details inside.
general.zh: 公開場合絕對不行。當責的意思是我們對外承擔責任，細節在內部處理。

general.en: Honestly, that's a lot of responsibility. I've never managed a team before.
general.zh: 老實說，那是很大的責任。我沒有帶過團隊。

general.en: It's your responsibility to keep your room clean.
general.zh: 保持房間整潔是你的責任。

qa.en: The documented system of procedures, records, and responsibilities that controls quality across the whole company.
qa.zh: 用寫下來的程序、紀錄跟權責分工，管全公司品質的一套系統。

words.definition: having the duty of doing something and making sure it is done correctly.

general.en: The experience taught me to be more responsible.
general.zh: 這次經驗教會我更負責任。

general.en: Teachers are responsible for learners' improvement.
general.zh: 教師負責學生的進步。

general.en: Anita, who is responsible for coordinating with overseas clients, has already emailed the customer to explain the delay.
general.zh: 負責和海外客戶協調的Anita，已經寫信告知客戶延誤的狀況。

general.en: No, I'll arrange one. As the landlord, I'm responsible for repairs like this.
general.zh: 不用，我會安排。身為房東，這類維修是我的責任。

general.en: I am responsible for purchasing the test equipment.
general.zh: 我負責採購測試設備。

general.en: I am responsible for the test room equipment.
general.zh: 我負責測試室的設備。

qa.en: The supplier is responsible for the sorting cost.
qa.zh: 挑選費用由供應商負責。

qa.en: QA personnel are responsible for inspecting every step on the coating line.
qa.zh: 塗裝線每個步驟都由品保人員負責檢核。

words.definition: The time you can return something you bought.

general.en: And what if she's already outside the return period?
general.zh: 那如果她已經超過退貨期限了呢？

general.en: The company extended its return period.
general.zh: 公司延長了退貨期限。

general.en: The return period had expired.
general.zh: 退貨期限已經過了。

general.en: She also changed the company's procedures so that every product would be checked more effectively and efficiently before delivery. The company also extended its return period and made its refund policy clearer.
general.zh: 她也修改了公司的作業流程，以便每一項產品在交貨之前都能被更有效且更有效率地檢查。公司也延長了退貨期限，並讓退款政策更加清楚。

words.definition: A ticket for a trip to a place and back again.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: The immigration officer asked to see my return ticket.
general.zh: 移民官要求查看我的回程票。

general.en: Great. Would a one-way ticket be cheaper, or should I take a return ticket?
general.zh: 太好了。單程票會比較便宜，還是我應該買來回票？

general.en: If you know when you're coming back, the return ticket saves you about twenty percent.
general.zh: 如果你知道自己什麼時候回來，來回票可以幫你省大約兩成。

general.en: Can I get a return ticket to Munich?
general.zh: 我可以買一張到慕尼黑的來回票嗎？

words.definition: a special meal where family members come together, especially on New Year's Eve.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: On New Year's Eve, families get together for a big dinner. This meal is called the reunion dinner.
general.zh: 家人團聚吃年夜飯，這頓飯被稱為團圓飯。

general.en: It comes just before it. A week later, most people go home for the reunion dinner with their family.
general.zh: 它就在過年前。一週後，大部分的人會回家和家人吃年夜飯。

words.definition: to make something known that was secret or hidden

general.en: The investigation revealed the cause of the accident.
general.zh: 調查揭露了事故的原因。

general.en: The politician refused to reveal the truth.
general.zh: 這位政治家拒絕揭露真相。（refuse to + V。）

general.en: The investigation revealed the truth about the accident.
general.zh: 調查揭露了這起意外的真相。

general.en: "I apologize," he said. "I am sorry. My house is back to normal and now it seems peaceful. You have revealed to me a truth about life. People should learn to be content with their lives."
general.zh: 「我道歉（apologize），」他說。「對不起。我的房子恢復正常了，現在感覺很平靜。妳向我揭示（revealed）了一個關於生活的事實。人們應該學會滿足於自己的生活。」

words.definition: to change or correct something; also to review notes before an exam

general.en: I revise my English notes regularly to remember vocabulary.
general.zh: 我定期複習英文筆記以記住單字。

general.en: Before a test, I revise my notes to remember the vocabulary.
general.zh: 考試前，我會複習我的筆記來記住單字。

general.en: He revised the design after the meeting.
general.zh: 他在會議後修改了設計。（revised 是 revise 的過去式；after 是介係詞「在…之後」。）

general.en: You should always revise your pronunciation when learning new words.
general.zh: 學習新單字時，你應該總是修正（或檢視）你的發音。

general.en: I revise my notes every day.
general.zh: 我每天複習筆記。（to study again）

general.en: I also like to experiment with different learning methods. Sometimes I watch foreign films, sometimes I read English articles, and sometimes I listen to podcasts. I also revise my notes regularly to make sure I remember the words.
general.zh: 我也喜歡嘗試不同的學習方法。有時候我看外語片，有時候我讀英文文章，有時候我聽 Podcast。我也會定期複習我的筆記，以確保我記住了這些單字。

qa.en: How do you make sure the line is using the latest drawing revision?
qa.zh: 你們怎麼確定現場用的是最新版圖面？

qa.en: Please confirm whether the attached specification reflects the latest revision.
qa.zh: 請確認一下，附件的規格是不是最新版。

qa.en: Which drawing revision are you inspecting against?
qa.zh: 你是照哪一版圖面在檢驗？

qa.en: The FMEA is a living document — it is revised after any design change, process change, or customer complaint, and the revision history is retained.
qa.zh: FMEA 是活的文件，設計改、製程改或有客訴就修訂，改版紀錄都留著。

qa.en: Only the current revision on the shop floor is valid. Superseded drawings are removed immediately, and any change requires an engineering change notice before production may use it.
qa.zh: 現場只有現行版有效。舊版圖面馬上收掉，要改一定要先發 ECN 才能用在生產。

qa.en: Drawings on the floor are controlled copies with a revision stamp. When a new revision is released, QA collects and destroys the superseded copies on the same day and records the exchange on the document control list.
qa.zh: 現場的圖面都是蓋版次章的管制副本。新版一發，品保當天就把舊版收回來銷毀，換版記在文件管制清單上。

qa.en: How do you make sure the line is using the latest drawing revision?
qa.zh: 你們怎麼確定現場用的是最新版圖面？

qa.en: Drawings are controlled documents; superseded revisions are withdrawn from the point of use.
qa.zh: 圖面是管制文件，舊版會從使用現場收掉。

qa.en: Please confirm whether the attached specification reflects the latest revision.
qa.zh: 請確認一下，附件的規格是不是最新版。

qa.en: The FMEA is a living document — it is revised after any design change, process change, or customer complaint, and the revision history is retained.
qa.zh: FMEA 是活的文件，設計改、製程改或有客訴就修訂，改版紀錄都留著。

qa.en: Only the current revision on the shop floor is valid. Superseded drawings are removed immediately, and any change requires an engineering change notice before production may use it.
qa.zh: 現場只有現行版有效。舊版圖面馬上收掉，要改一定要先發 ECN 才能用在生產。

qa.en: Drawings on the floor are controlled copies with a revision stamp. When a new revision is released, QA collects and destroys the superseded copies on the same day and records the exchange on the document control list.
qa.zh: 現場的圖面都是蓋版次章的管制副本。新版一發，品保當天就把舊版收回來銷毀，換版記在文件管制清單上。

qa.en: These parts need rework; please do not ship them.
qa.zh: 這些零件需要重工，請勿出貨。

qa.en: This weld shows incomplete fusion and must be reworked.
qa.zh: 這道焊接未熔合，必須重工。

qa.en: Nonconforming product is tagged with a red HOLD tag, moved to the quarantine area, and dispositioned by the MRB as rework, repair, use-as-is (with customer concession), or scrap.
qa.zh: 不合格品貼紅色 HOLD 標籤、移到隔離區，MRB 決定要重工、修理、特採（客戶要同意）還是報廢。

general.en: To some extent, I agree with you, but the plan still has risks.
general.zh: 某種程度上我同意你，但這個計畫仍有風險。

general.en: The risk transfer moves from the company to you.
general.zh: 風險就從保險公司轉移到了你身上。

general.en: A guest who states a preference risks creating work for the host.
general.zh: 表達偏好的客人可能給主人添麻煩。

general.en: If you gamble, you risk losing your money.
general.zh: 如果你賭博，你就有輸錢的風險。

general.en: Hurry up! I don't want to risk missing the train.
general.zh: 9. (miss) 快點！我不想冒錯過火車的風險。

general.en: Who is most at risk this season?
general.zh: 這一季誰的風險最高？

qa.en: The FMEA rated motor overheating as the highest risk on the treadmill.
qa.zh: 失效模式與效應分析把馬達過熱列為跑步機的最高風險。

qa.en: A structured risk analysis that lists potential failure modes, their effects and causes, and scores them to set priorities.
qa.zh: 把可能出的失效、影響跟原因一條條列出來，打分數排優先順序的風險分析。

qa.en: How do you identify the risks in this process?
qa.zh: 這個製程的風險你們怎麼抓？

qa.en: Process risks are assessed in the PFMEA and the resulting controls are transferred into the control plan.
qa.zh: 製程風險在 PFMEA 評估，評出來的管制項再轉進管制計畫。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

qa.en: We score severity, occurrence, and detection. High-risk items must have an additional control in the control plan, and the FMEA is reviewed after every customer complaint.
qa.zh: 打嚴重度、發生度、偵測度。高風險的項目要在管制計畫追加管制；每次客訴後都要回頭看 FMEA。

qa.en: Risk acceptance needs a name and a signature, not a phone call.
qa.zh: 要吃風險就要有人具名簽字，不是一通電話。

qa.en: A structured risk analysis that lists potential failure modes, their effects and causes, and scores them to set priorities.
qa.zh: 把可能出的失效、影響跟原因一條條列出來，打分數排優先順序的風險分析。

words.definition: To cook food in an oven or over a fire.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: I wrapped the sweet potato in aluminum foil and roasted it.
general.zh: 我用鋁箔紙把地瓜包起來然後烤。

general.en: I roasted the sweet potato in the oven.
general.zh: 我在烤箱裡烤地瓜。

words.definition: pieces of rock that fall from a mountain or cliff

general.en: Heavy rain led to rockfalls on the mountain road.
general.zh: 豪雨導致山路上發生落石。

general.en: Heavy rain led to rockfalls and landslides in the mountains.
general.zh: 豪雨導致山區發生落石和土石流。（lead to = 導致，後面接名詞，與 cause 用法類似。）

general.en: This led to rockfalls and landslides; the roads were covered with mud.
general.zh: 這導致山區落石和土石流，道路被泥土覆蓋。（描述直接後果）

general.en: The earthquake caused landslides and rockfalls.
general.zh: 地震引發山崩和落石。

qa.en: Test the shaft hardness on the Rockwell hardness tester.
qa.zh: 在洛氏硬度計上測試軸的硬度。

words.definition: the real reason something bad or unexpected happens, not just a surface-level reason.

general.en: I work closely with design engineers to investigate the root causes and implement effective solutions.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，進行根本原因分析，並落實有效的解決方案。

general.en: Right, and then the same issue comes back three months later. If you don't fix the root cause, you're only cleaning up.
general.zh: 對，然後同樣的問題三個月後又回來。如果不修正根本原因，你只是在善後而已。

general.en: I identify potential problems and investigate the root cause.
general.zh: 我會找出潛在問題並調查根本原因。

general.en: I work closely with design engineers to investigate the root causes.
general.zh: 我與設計工程師密切合作，調查根本原因。

general.en: We investigate. I pull the process data, talk to the operators, and try to find the root cause instead of just replacing the bad parts.
general.zh: 我們展開調查。我會調製程數據、跟線上作業員談，設法找出根本原因，而不是只把壞掉的零件換掉。

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: Use the 5 Whys — the loose bolt is a symptom, not the root cause.
qa.zh: 用五問法追下去——螺絲鬆動只是症狀，不是根本原因。

qa.en: A structured problem-solving process that contains the issue, finds the root cause, and prevents recurrence.
qa.zh: 一套有步驟的解決問題流程：先圍堵、再找根因、最後讓它不要再發生。

qa.en: What is the root cause, and when can you send us the 8D report?
qa.zh: 根本原因是什麼？8D 報告什麼時候可以給我們？

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

qa.en: Could you provide the root cause analysis and corrective action by Friday?
qa.zh: 根因分析跟對策，週五前給我們。

qa.en: The root cause analysis stops at the operator level, which is not acceptable.
qa.zh: 根因分析停在人員這一層，這樣不能接受。

qa.en: Right, sorry — we're still doing the root cause analysis.
qa.zh: 對，抱歉，我們還在做根本原因分析。

qa.en: The root cause analysis in D4 stops at the operator level. Please continue the why-why analysis to the process level and resubmit by Friday.
qa.zh: D4 的根因分析停在人的層級。請把 why-why 往下做到製程層級，週五前重交。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

qa.en: The reliability test failed at 60% of the target life. Root cause analysis is in progress, and any design change will require a verification re-test.
qa.zh: 可靠度測試跑到目標壽命 60% 就失效了。根因分析進行中，只要改設計就要重新驗證。

words.definition: a saying used to describe something believed to be the main cause of bad things
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: They also say that money is the root of all evil.
general.zh: 人們也說金錢是萬惡之源。

general.en: Tom, do you know the expression “money is the root of all evil”?
general.zh: Tom，你知道那句話嗎：「金錢是萬惡之源」？

general.en: Right. So the expression is wrong. Money isn't the root of all evil. It's a mirror.
general.zh: 沒錯。所以那句話是錯的。金錢不是萬惡之源，它是一面鏡子。

general.en: They also say that "money is the root of all evil". I think this is so true.
general.zh: 人們也說「金錢是萬惡之源」。我認為這非常真實。

general.en: Greed is the root of all evil.
general.zh: 貪婪是萬惡之源。

general.en: Money is the root of all evil.
general.zh: 金錢是萬惡之源。貪婪（greed）導致了殺人、偷竊、勒索（blackmail）、貪污（corruption）和奴役（slave labour）。

words.translation: 腐爛的 (比 spoiled 嚴重)
words.definition: 已高度腐壞分解，通常有惡臭和霉菌

general.en: The food was rotten — there was green mold on it.
general.zh: 食物已經腐爛，上面長了綠色的黴菌。

general.en: The food was rotten. The sauce had turned sour and there was green mold on the cheese.
general.zh: 食物已經腐壞了。醬汁變酸了，而且起司上長了綠色的黴菌。

general.en: That evening, instead of risking food poisoning, Kevin ordered a hot bowl of soup from a nearby restaurant. It tasted much better than rotten pasta.
general.zh: 那天晚上，為了不冒險導致食物中毒，凱文從附近的餐廳點了一碗熱騰騰的湯。這碗湯的味道比那盒腐爛的義大利麵要好上太多了。（文法：Avoiding the risk... 分詞構句——省略連接詞與相同主詞，使銜接更流暢精煉。）

general.en: The food was rotten.
general.zh: 這盒食物已經腐爛了。

words.definition: a circular table, often used at banquets so guests can share food easily

general.en: Very lively. The whole company sits at big round tables and shares a set menu.
general.zh: 非常熱鬧。全公司坐在大圓桌旁，一起吃合菜套餐。

general.en: The event is usually held in a large restaurant or banquet hall, with round tables and many shared dishes.
general.zh: 活動通常在大型餐廳或宴會廳舉行，使用圓桌，大家一起分享多道菜餚。

general.en: We sat around big round tables to eat.
general.zh: 我們坐在大圓桌旁用餐。

general.en: We sit around big round tables.
general.zh: 我們圍坐在大圓桌旁。

general.en: The event is usually held in a large restaurant or banquet hall, with round tables and many shared dishes.
general.zh: 活動通常在大型餐廳或宴會廳舉行，使用圓桌，大家一起分享多道菜餚。

words.definition: the usual series of things you do regularly, in the same order, as part of your daily life.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: She has changed her routine because of the longer trip.
general.zh: 因為通勤變長，她改變了作息。

general.en: Ha! Maybe. I've changed my whole morning routine since I moved.
general.zh: 哈！也許吧。搬家之後我把整套晨間作息都改了。

general.en: Frequent travelers tend to build small routines — a backup charger, offline documents, that sort of thing.
general.zh: 常出差的人往往會建立一些小習慣——備用充電器、離線的文件，諸如此類。

general.en: Not a lot, just the usual routine.
general.zh: 沒什麼特別，就是日常作息。

general.en: So what is your daily routine like?
general.zh: 那你每天的作息大概是怎樣？

general.en: She has changed her routine because of the longer trip. She gets up at six, not seven. She prepares her clothes and her bag the night before, so she saves time in the morning.
general.zh: 因為通勤變長，她改變了作息。她現在六點起床，而不是七點。她前一天晚上就把衣服和包包準備好，所以早上省下不少時間。

qa.en: The measurement system is validated by a Gage R&R study before the characteristic is released for routine inspection.
qa.zh: 這個特性排進例行檢驗之前，先用 GR&R 把量測系統驗過。

qa.en: Calipers, micrometers, height gauges, feeler gauges, and thread gauges used for routine in-process checks.
qa.zh: 卡尺、分厘卡、高度規、厚薄規、螺紋規這些，製程中例行檢查用的量具。

qa.en: Routine testing is performed in-house; certification testing is performed by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內做，認證測試送有認證的實驗室。

qa.en: Routine tests are done in our own lab; certification tests such as EN 957 or EN ISO 20957 for fitness equipment are done by an accredited third-party laboratory.
qa.zh: 例行測試廠內實驗室做；健身器材 EN 957／EN ISO 20957 這種認證測試，送有認證的第三方實驗室。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

words.definition: to have a body temperature that is higher than normal because you are sick.
words.lesson: 20260310 英文八大時態與健康症狀 Tenses & Symptoms

general.en: The manager is running a high fever right now.
general.zh: 經理現在正發著高燒。

words.definition: when liquid comes out of your nose.

general.en: I've got a headache, a running nose and a cough.
general.zh: 我頭痛、流鼻水又咳嗽。

qa.en: The runout of this shaft is 0.02 mm, within specification.
qa.zh: 這根軸的偏擺是 0.02 mm，在規格內。

qa.en: Check the shaft runout on the runout tester.
qa.zh: 在偏擺檢測儀上檢查軸的偏擺。

qa.en: The total indicator runout is 0.02 mm.
qa.zh: 總偏擺量為 0.02 mm。

qa.en: This coating passes 48 hours of salt spray with no red rust.
qa.zh: 這個塗裝過 48 小時鹽霧，沒有紅鏽。

qa.en: This oil was made for open surfaces — inside a sealed tube it cannot coat every spot, so the tube rusts anyway.
qa.zh: 這支防鏽油是給外面平面用的——管子裡面塗不到的地方，照樣鏽。

qa.en: Contain first: sort all in-process and in-stock handrail tubes and check for internal rust. Mark and segregate any affected lots.
qa.zh: 先圍堵：在製品跟庫存的扶手管全部翻出來，看裡面有沒有鏽。有問題的批次標起來隔開。

qa.en: We run 48 hours for powder-coated parts and 96 hours for e-coated parts. After the test we check for red rust, blistering, and creepage from the scribe line.
qa.zh: 粉體件做 48 小時、電著件做 96 小時。做完看有沒有紅鏽、起泡，還有劃線處鏽有沒有擴出去。

qa.en: This powder coating passes 48 hours of neutral salt spray with no red rust and with creepage from the scribe line under one millimeter, which meets the requirement in the specification.
qa.zh: 這個粉體塗裝過 48 小時中性鹽霧，沒有紅鏽，劃線處擴散小於 1 mm，符合規格。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: The rust-preventive oil we used is not suitable for tube interiors.
qa.zh: 我們用的防鏽油不適合管子內部。

qa.en: This rust-preventive oil is not suitable for tube interiors — we need a VCI-type product that protects surfaces the oil does not touch directly.
qa.zh: 「油不好、換掉」沒有技術依據。講清楚為什麼不適合（外面平面 vs. 管子裡面）、要什麼特性（揮發型，碰不到也能防鏽），供應商才知道推薦什麼產品。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: During our in-process inspection today, we found rust forming on the inner surface of treadmill handrail tubes. The tubes were treated with your general-purpose rust-preventive oil (product code RP-210) after cutting.
qa.zh: 今天巡檢時發現跑步機扶手管裡面開始生鏽。切管後有用你們的通用型防鏽油（料號 RP-210）處理過。

qa.en: Could you recommend a VCI-type rust-preventive oil or a product specifically rated for enclosed cavities? We need the product data sheet and a sample for validation before switching.
qa.zh: 可否推薦 VCI 型（揮發型）防鏽油、或適合管子內部使用的產品？切換前我們需要 TDS 跟樣品來驗證。

general.en: We need to adjust the design to meet foreign safety standards.
general.zh: 我們需要調整設計，以符合國外的安全標準。

general.en: Central Union was fined NT$165.2 million, the largest such penalty in Taiwanese food safety history.
general.zh: Central Union被裁罰新台幣1億6,520萬元，是台灣食安史上金額最高的一筆罰款。

general.en: The company has maintained the same safety standard for a decade.
general.zh: 這家公司十年來一直維持著同樣的安全標準。

general.en: All employees must follow the safety procedures when operating machines.
general.zh: 所有員工操作機器時都必須遵守安全操作規範。

general.en: Many schools were closed for safety.
general.zh: 許多學校基於安全考量停課。

general.en: One common reason is confusion about dates. Many products are labelled "best before", which is about quality, not safety. Food that is past this date is often still perfectly good, but people throw it away because they are worried.
general.zh: 一個常見的原因是對日期的誤解。許多產品標示「best before（最佳風味期限）」，那指的是品質，而不是安全。過了這個日期的食物通常還是完全可以吃，但人們因為擔心而把它丟掉。

qa.en: How do you control the tightening torque on safety-critical bolts?
qa.zh: 安全關鍵螺栓的鎖付扭力你們怎麼管控？

qa.en: For safety-critical joints we apply 100% torque audit with traceability to the serial number.
qa.zh: 安全相關的鎖點 100% 驗扭力，追得到產品序號。

qa.en: We test it here, and the safety test is done outside.
qa.zh: 這個我們自己測，安全測試送外面做。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

qa.en: The torque wrench is set and calibrated daily, the operator marks each tightened bolt, and QA performs a torque audit on every unit for safety-critical joints. The result is recorded per serial number.
qa.zh: 扭力扳手每天設定跟校驗，作業員每鎖完一支螺栓就劃線，安全相關的鎖點品保一台一台驗扭力，結果照序號記。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

qa.en: Ask R&D which product features use AI and whether any of them perform a safety function.
qa.zh: 問研發哪些功能有用 AI，有沒有哪一個是做安全功能的。

qa.en: We are identifying which product features rely on AI and whether any of them perform a safety function under the applicable rules.
qa.zh: 我們正在盤點哪些功能有用 AI，以及照規定看有沒有哪一個算安全功能。

qa.en: This sensor performs a safety function, so it is treated as a critical component.
qa.zh: 這個感測器是做安全功能的，所以算關鍵零件。

words.definition: An accelerated corrosion test in which the sample is exposed to a salt fog for a defined number of hours.

qa.en: Corrosion resistance is verified by neutral salt spray testing per ASTM B117 for the specified duration.
qa.zh: 耐蝕性照 ASTM B117 做中性鹽霧，做到規定的小時數。

qa.en: Which test method and revision was used for this salt spray test?
qa.zh: 這次鹽霧測試用的是哪個方法、哪一版？

qa.en: The plating must pass a 48-hour salt spray test.
qa.zh: 電鍍層必須通過 48 小時鹽霧測試。

qa.en: We run the salt spray test at least once a month.
qa.zh: 我們至少每月執行一次鹽霧測試。

qa.en: This part passed 500 hours of salt spray testing.
qa.zh: 這個零件通過 500 小時鹽霧試驗。

qa.en: Salt spray testing is performed on every production lot of coated parts, and the chamber conditions are recorded and retained with the test report.
qa.zh: 塗裝件每批量產都做鹽霧，鹽霧箱的條件也跟報告一起記下來存。

words.definition: tasting of salt; containing a lot of salt

general.en: I took a bite and realized the soup was too salty.
general.zh: 我吃了一口才發現那湯太鹹了。

general.en: The French fries are a bit too salty; I should have asked for less salt.
general.zh: 這薯條有點太鹹了，我剛剛應該要求少鹽的。

general.en: I took a bite and realized it was too salty.
general.zh: 我吃了一口才發現太鹹了。

general.en: Inspectors collected samples to check whether other batches were affected.
general.zh: 稽查人員採樣確認其他批次是否也受影響。

general.en: Employers should give more weight to work samples and digital portfolios.
general.zh: 雇主應該把更多權重放在工作實例與數位作品集上。

general.en: Exactly. And Taiwan is moving the same way. Companies now want work samples and real tasks, not just certificates.
general.zh: 沒錯。而且台灣也在往同一個方向走。企業現在要的是工作實例和實作任務，不只是證書。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100 % inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺絲採抽樣檢驗，但跑步機馬達採全檢。

qa.en: The lot size is 1,200 treadmills, so please pull the sample from three different pallets.
qa.zh: 這批批量是 1,200 台跑步機，請從三個不同棧板抽樣。

qa.en: For a lot of 1,200 units at general inspection level II, the sample size code letter is K.
qa.zh: 批量 1,200 台、一般檢驗水準 II 級，樣本大小代字是 K。

qa.en: Judging a whole lot by inspecting only a sample drawn from it, instead of checking every piece.
qa.zh: 只抽一部分來檢，用抽出來的結果判整批，不是每件都檢。

qa.en: The sample size comes from the lot size and the inspection level; the accept/reject decision comes from the AQL table.
qa.zh: 抽幾件看批量跟檢驗水準；收不收，查 AQL 表。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

words.definition: A letter from the standard table that tells you how many pieces to pull from the lot.

qa.en: For a lot of 1,200 units at general inspection level II, the sample size code letter is K.
qa.zh: 批量 1,200 台、一般檢驗水準 II 級，樣本大小代字是 K。

qa.en: The sample size code letter is derived from the lot size and inspection level per ISO 2859-1 Table 1.
qa.zh: 樣本大小代字是照 ISO 2859-1 表 1，用批量跟檢驗水準查出來的。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100 % inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺絲採抽樣檢驗，但跑步機馬達採全檢。

qa.en: We perform sampling inspection based on the applicable inspection level and AQL requirements.
qa.zh: 我們照適用的檢驗水準跟 AQL 要求做抽檢。

qa.en: Our sampling plan is determined according to the lot size, inspection level, and AQL requirements defined in ISO 2859-1.
qa.zh: 我們的抽樣計畫是照 ISO 2859-1 的批量、檢驗水準跟 AQL 要求來定的。

qa.en: The worst process average defect level that is still treated as acceptable for the purpose of sampling inspection.
qa.zh: 抽檢的時候，製程平均不良率最差還能接受到哪裡，那條線就是 AQL。

qa.en: The AQL defines the acceptance criteria for each defect class in the sampling plan.
qa.zh: AQL 就是抽樣計畫裡每個缺點等級收不收的標準。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

words.definition: Checking only a small sample drawn from a lot instead of inspecting every single piece.

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100 % inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺絲採抽樣檢驗，但跑步機馬達採全檢。

qa.en: We perform sampling inspection based on the applicable inspection level and AQL requirements.
qa.zh: 我們照適用的檢驗水準跟 AQL 要求做抽檢。

qa.en: The worst process average defect level that is still treated as acceptable for the purpose of sampling inspection.
qa.zh: 抽檢的時候，製程平均不良率最差還能接受到哪裡，那條線就是 AQL。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100% inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺栓抽檢，跑步機馬達全檢。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

words.definition: 強風挾帶大量沙塵形成的風暴

general.en: The sandstorm will hit the city this afternoon.
general.zh: 沙塵暴今天下午將會襲擊這座城市。

general.en: I wore a mask to protect myself because of the sandstorm.
general.zh: 因為沙塵暴，我戴口罩保護自己。

general.en: There is a strong sandstorm.
general.zh: 有一場強烈的沙塵暴。

words.definition: make someone feel frightened or worried

general.en: They were scared when the elevator stopped suddenly.
general.zh: 當電梯突然停住時，他們感到害怕。

general.en: A strange sound from the basement scared me.
general.zh: 來自地下室的奇怪聲音嚇到了我。

general.en: She was scared to death during the thunderstorm.
general.zh: 打雷下雨時，她被嚇得要死。

general.en: Don't be scared — the dog is friendly.
general.zh: 不要害怕——那隻狗很友善。

general.en: Thunderstorms always scare me.
general.zh: 雷雨總是嚇到我。

general.en: I am scared of snakes.

words.translation: 感到害怕的 (描述人的感受)
words.definition: feeling frightened — use to describe how a person feels

general.en: She was scared to death during the thunderstorm.
general.zh: 打雷下雨時，她被嚇得要死。

general.en: They were scared when the elevator stopped suddenly.
general.zh: 當電梯突然停住時，他們感到害怕。

general.en: A strange sound from the basement scared me.
general.zh: 來自地下室的奇怪聲音嚇到了我。

general.en: Don't be scared — the dog is friendly.
general.zh: 不要害怕——那隻狗很友善。

general.en: The loud noise scared me.
general.zh: 那個巨大的聲音嚇到我。

general.en: I am scared of snakes.
general.zh: 我很怕蛇。

words.translation: 令人害怕的 (描述事物本身)
words.definition: making someone feel frightened — use to describe things

general.en: The snake looks scary, but it is completely harmless.
general.zh: 那條蛇看起來很嚇人，但其實完全無害。

general.en: No, I haven't. This is actually a bit scary for me.
general.zh: 沒有，這對我來說其實有點可怕。

general.en: It's a bit scary, but at least these problems are being found and reported.
general.zh: 雖然有點嚇人，但至少這些問題有被發現、被報導出來。

general.en: Ghost is scary. / Thunderstorm is scary.
general.zh: 鬼很可怕。／雷雨很可怕。

general.en: The road became scary during the heavy rain.
general.zh: 在大雨期間，這條路變得令人害怕。

general.en: Walking alone at midnight is scary.
general.zh: 半夜一個人走路很可怕。

words.definition: the natural features of an area such as mountains and fields.

general.en: There was beautiful scenery, including rice fields and limestone mountains.
general.zh: 有美麗的風景，包括稻田和石灰岩山。

general.en: She loves the food and the scenery in Italy.
general.zh: 她喜歡義大利的美食和風景。

general.en: There was beautiful scenery, including limestone mountains.
general.zh: 有美麗的風景，包括石灰岩山。

general.en: Really? I would keep working. I'd just move somewhere with better scenery.
general.zh: 真的嗎？我會繼續工作。我只會搬去風景比較好的地方。

general.en: Tam Coc is famous for its beautiful scenery / views.
general.zh: 寧平以美麗的風景聞名。

general.en: I am planning to visit Japan for my next vacation. I really want to enjoy the beautiful scenery and eat delicious local food. It will be a great way to relax after working so hard as an engineer.
general.zh: 我計畫下次去日本度假。我真的很想欣賞美麗的風景和吃當地美食。這會是工程師努力工作後一個很棒的放鬆方式。

qa.en: The re-test adds four weeks of schedule risk.
qa.zh: 重測會多出四週的時程風險。

qa.en: Confirm by HS code, not by product name, which of your parts are still in scope after the scope revision.
qa.zh: 用 HS code（不是用品名）確認範圍調整後，我們哪些零件還在範圍內。

qa.en: Keep supplier origin records even for parts now out of scope — customers keep asking for them contractually.
qa.zh: 移出範圍的零件，供應商產地紀錄也照樣留著 —— 客戶合約上通常還是會要。

qa.en: Please confirm that this test is inside your laboratory's scope of accreditation.
qa.zh: 請確認這項測試在你們實驗室的認證範圍內。

qa.en: Action: either add one more run on the current configuration so you have three consecutive runs of the same process, or re-scope the report to the new configuration and state it.
qa.zh: 行動：要嘛用現在的條件再跑一批，湊足同一製程連續三批；要嘛把報告範圍改成新條件，並且寫清楚。

qa.en: The merger changes the international accreditation body, not the accreditation of individual laboratories. Our laboratory remains accredited to ISO/IEC 17025 and its scope is unchanged.
qa.zh: 這次合併改的是國際認證組織，不是個別實驗室的認證。我們的實驗室還是 ISO/IEC 17025 認證，範圍沒變。

qa.en: We have identified which of our components fall within the commodity scope and we retain supplier origin records for them. We can supply the data in whatever format your due diligence system requires.
qa.zh: 我們已經確認哪些零組件在範圍內，也留著它們的供應商產地紀錄。你們盡職調查系統要什麼格式，我們都可以配合。

qa.en: Please confirm that this test is inside your laboratory's scope of accreditation.
qa.zh: 請確認這項測試在你們實驗室的認證範圍內。

qa.en: The lab is accredited, but this specific test is outside its scope of accreditation.
qa.zh: 實驗室是有認證的，但這一項測試不在它的認證範圍內。

qa.en: Please confirm that salt spray is inside your lab's scope of accreditation.
qa.zh: 請確認鹽霧測試在你們實驗室的認證範圍內。

qa.en: Could you send us your laboratory's current scope of accreditation?
qa.zh: 可以請你們給我們實驗室現在的認證範圍文件嗎？

qa.en: The laboratory is accredited, but this test method is not within its scope of accreditation, so we cannot accept the report as accredited evidence.
qa.zh: 實驗室是有認證，但這個測試方法不在它的認證範圍內，所以我們沒辦法把報告當認證證據收。

qa.en: The report carries an accreditation mark, but the salt spray method is not listed in the scope of accreditation we retrieved from the accreditation body's website.
qa.zh: 報告上有認證標誌，但我們從認證機構網站查到的認證範圍裡，沒有鹽霧這個方法。

qa.en: Nonconforming product is tagged with a red HOLD tag, moved to the quarantine area, and dispositioned by the MRB as rework, repair, use-as-is (with customer concession), or scrap.
qa.zh: 不合格品貼紅色 HOLD 標籤、移到隔離區，MRB 決定要重工、修理、特採（客戶要同意）還是報廢。

general.en: I look at whether it's cosmetic or a functional defect. A small scratch is one thing. A part that stops working is completely different.
general.zh: 我會看它是外觀問題還是功能性缺陷。一道小刮痕是一回事，零件不能運作就完全是另一回事。

qa.en: Ac is 5 and Re is 6, so six scratched frames means we reject the whole lot.
qa.zh: Ac 是 5、Re 是 6，所以出現六件刮傷機架就要拒收整批。

qa.en: The scratches are under the protective film, which is applied before final inspection.
qa.zh: 刮傷在保護膜底下，而保護膜在終檢之前就貼上了。

qa.en: This is basic visual inspection. How did three scratched units get through?
qa.zh: 這是最基本的外觀檢驗，三台刮傷的機台是怎麼放過去的？

qa.en: You are right to ask. The scratches are under the protective film, and the film is applied before final inspection — so the check could not see them. That is a gap in our process, and we own it.
qa.zh: 您問得對。刮傷在保護膜底下，而貼膜在終檢之前——檢驗的時候看不到。這是我們流程的洞，我們承認。

qa.en: Two things: the bezel is now inspected before the film goes on, and the film application itself is being checked as a possible scratch source. The 8D with evidence will reach you within five working days.
qa.zh: 兩件事：儀表框改成貼膜前先驗；貼膜這道工序本身也在查，看是不是刮傷就是它造成的。附證據的 8D 五個工作天內給您。

qa.en: The defect escaped because the detection point was after the film application — the inspection could not physically see it. We have moved the detection point and are verifying whether the film process itself created the scratches.
qa.zh: 不良會流出去，是因為檢出點在貼膜之後——檢驗根本看不到刮傷。我們已經把檢出點往前移，也在確認貼膜這道工序是不是刮傷的來源。

words.definition: A strap that keeps you safe in your seat.

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請繫好安全帶。

general.en: Yes, please, and fasten your seat belt. We'll be taking off in about ten minutes.
general.zh: 是的，麻煩您，並且繫好安全帶。我們大約十分鐘後起飛。

general.en: Certainly. I'll bring one once the seat belt sign is off.
general.zh: 沒問題。安全帶指示燈熄滅後我就拿一條給您。

general.en: Try to stay relaxed and keep your seat belt fastened. Many passengers find that listening to music or watching a movie helps.
general.zh: 試著保持放鬆並繫好安全帶。很多乘客發現聽音樂或看電影會有幫助。

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt.
general.zh: 請繫上安全帶。

words.definition: Where staff check you and your bags for safety.

general.en: About fifteen minutes on foot after the security check. Have a good flight!
general.zh: 過了安檢之後大約走十五分鐘。祝您旅途愉快！

general.en: We need to pour out any liquids over the limit before the security check.
general.zh: 安檢前，超過規定的液體都要倒掉。（隨身液體通常須裝在 100ml 以下的容器中；pour out = 把液體倒掉；over the limit = 超過限制。）

general.en: We went through the security check.
general.zh: 我們通過了安檢。

general.en: It seems the air is polluted because there are too many vehicles.
general.zh: 看起來空氣很髒，因為路上有太多車輛。

general.en: Delays seem to be part of business travel these days. What's your best advice for staying productive?
general.zh: 現在出差好像很難避免延誤。你給大家保持效率的最佳建議是什麼？

general.en: Just remember, if the problem seems serious, you should still go in person.
general.zh: 但要記得，如果問題看起來很嚴重，還是應該親自去一趟。

general.en: It seems like it's going to rain soon.
general.zh: 看起來快要下雨了。

general.en: It seems that the typhoon has passed.
general.zh: 看起來颱風已經過去了。

general.en: The pain seems to get worse at night.
general.zh: 疼痛似乎在晚上會加劇。

words.definition: almost never.

general.en: I seldom get sick.
general.zh: 我很少生病。

words.definition: one of the periods that a school year is divided into.

general.en: Michael is really making an effort with his maths this term.
general.zh: Michael 這學期在數學上真的很努力。

words.definition: a feeling of satisfaction you get from doing something difficult well.

general.en: Cleaning my room gave me a sense of achievement.
general.zh: 打掃房間給了我成就感。

general.en: This experience gave me a strong sense of achievement.
general.zh: 這次經驗讓我更有成就感。

general.en: My mom made me clean my room because it was messy. I didn't want to at first, but she insisted. Afterward, I felt a sense of achievement. It taught me to be more responsible.
general.zh: 我媽逼我打掃房間，因為太亂了。起初我不想，但她很堅持。之後，我感到一種成就感。這教會我要更負責任。

words.definition: a sickness that is very dangerous or difficult to treat.

general.en: For serious illness or surgery, most of the cost is covered by the insurance.
general.zh: 對於嚴重的疾病或手術，大部分費用都由保險給付。

general.en: Most medical costs, especially for serious illnesses or surgeries, are covered by government insurance, so healthcare is relatively affordable.
general.zh: 對於重大疾病或手術，大部分醫療費用由保險支付，因此醫療費用相對便宜。

words.definition: a fixed group of dishes that a restaurant offers together for one price

general.en: The restaurant offers a special set menu.
general.zh: 餐廳提供特別的套餐。

general.en: Very lively. The whole company sits at big round tables and shares a set menu.
general.zh: 非常熱鬧。全公司坐在大圓桌旁，一起吃合菜套餐。

words.definition: A problem that delays or stops progress.

general.en: We use mistakes and setbacks as learning experiences.
general.zh: 我們把錯誤與挫折當成學習經驗。

words.definition: an area sheltered from direct sunlight; use 'in the shade' (with 'the')

general.en: I like to stand in the shade when it is hot.
general.zh: 天氣熱的時候我喜歡站在陰涼處。

general.en: Please keep your window shade open during landing.
general.zh: 降落時請保持遮光板打開。

general.en: Then let's start early and rest in the shade when it gets hot.
general.zh: 那我們就早點出發，熱起來的時候在陰涼處休息。

general.en: Please keep your window shade open during takeoff and landing.
general.zh: 起飛和降落時請保持遮光板打開。

general.en: Please close your window shade before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請關上遮陽板。

words.definition: to move quickly from side to side or up and down

general.en: The ground began to shake as the earthquake struck.
general.zh: 地震來襲時，地面開始搖晃。

words.definition: to divide something among a group of people so everyone gets a part
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: I think if all the world's money was shared out, the world would go round more happily.
general.zh: 我認為如果全世界的錢都被分配出去，世界運轉起來會更快樂。

general.en: Because we never share out anything fairly. A small group holds most of it.
general.zh: 因為我們從來沒有公平地分配過任何東西。一小群人握著大部分的錢。

general.en: So the real question is how we share out what we already have.
general.zh: 所以真正的問題是，我們怎麼分配已經有的東西。

general.en: Let's share out the cake.
general.zh: 我們把蛋糕分一分吧。

general.en: I think if all the world's money was shared out, the world would go round more happily, and there would be less evil and more happiness.
general.zh: 我認為如果全世界的錢都被分配出去（共享），世界運轉起來會更快樂，邪惡會減少，快樂會更多。

words.definition: 用刮鬍刀把鬍子或毛髮刮除乾淨

general.en: He shaves every morning.
general.zh: 他每天早上刮鬍子。

words.definition: A place that provides cover or protection from danger or bad weather.

general.en: The gym was used as a shelter during the flood.
general.zh: 體育館在洪水期間被用作避難所。

general.en: Survivors were taken to a nearby shelter.
general.zh: 倖存者被帶到附近的避難所。

general.en: The siren went off, so everyone ran to shelter from the tornado.
general.zh: 警報響了，大家都跑去躲避龍捲風。

general.en: A tornado warning has been issued — let's take shelter immediately.
general.zh: 龍捲風警報已發布——我們立刻去避難吧。

general.en: Anita has gone to the shelter.
general.zh: Anita去避難所了（現在還在那裡）。

general.en: Anita has been to that shelter before.
general.zh: Anita以前去過那個避難所（現在已經回來了）。

general.en: Something shifted around week five, when a genuine workplace problem was assigned as a group project.
general.zh: 大概到了第五週，事情有了轉變——課堂指派了一個真實的職場問題當作小組專題。

general.en: Something has shifted in how the team approaches testing.
general.zh: 這個團隊處理測試的方式，已經有了轉變。

general.en: It's a small shift, but it has changed how I approach almost everything new.
general.zh: 這是個小小的轉變，但它改變了我面對幾乎所有新事物的方式。

general.en: He kindly shifted over to give the pregnant woman more space.
general.zh: 他好心地往旁邊挪了挪，給那位孕婦騰出更多空間。

general.en: Is there a mindset shift that helps?
general.zh: 有什麼心態上的轉變有幫助嗎？

qa.en: Adhesion is checked on the first article of each color change and once per shift during the run.
qa.zh: 每次換色的首件要測附著力，量產中每班再測一次。

qa.en: Risk: by the time the trend crosses the specification limit you have a whole shift of suspect product, not one hour.
qa.zh: 風險：等趨勢跨過規格界限，你要面對的是一整班的可疑品，不是一小時的量。

qa.en: Then we have lost twenty minutes. If I am right and we wait, we sort a full shift.
qa.zh: 那就損失二十分鐘。但如果我是對的、我們又等下去，要挑的就是一整班的產品。

qa.en: All the points are still OK, but they keep going down. I want to check the torque driver before the next shift.
qa.zh: 點都還在範圍內，但一直往下走。我想在下一班之前先查扭力起子。

qa.en: Both curing temperature and film thickness shift the final color.
qa.zh: 烘烤溫度跟膜厚都會讓最後的顏色跑掉。

qa.en: FAI is required at new product introduction, after a mold or fixture change, after a design change, and at the start of each shift for critical processes.
qa.zh: 新產品導入、換模／換治具、設計變更，還有關鍵製程每班開線，都要做首件。

words.translation: 陣雨（短暫且可能很大的雨）
words.definition: a short period of rain that may be heavy

general.en: There is usually a shower at noon in the summer.
general.zh: 夏天中午通常有一場陣雨。

general.en: The shower head has low water pressure, making it hard to take a proper shower.
general.zh: 蓮蓬頭的水壓很低，讓人很難好好洗個澡。

general.en: Expect scattered showers in the afternoon, so bring an umbrella.
general.zh: 下午會有零星陣雨，記得帶傘。

general.en: The water pressure in the shower is too low.
general.zh: 淋浴間的水壓太低了。

general.en: She was taking a shower when her family arrived.
general.zh: 她正在洗澡時，她的家人到了。

general.en: After this lesson, I will review the notes we just discussed. Then, I am going to take a hot shower to relax my muscles. Finally, I will go to bed early to prepare for work tomorrow morning.
general.zh: 下課後，我會複習我們剛才討論的筆記。然後，我打算洗個熱水澡放鬆肌肉。最後，我會早點睡覺為明早的工作做準備。

words.definition: To become smaller, often after washing in hot water.

general.en: I followed the instructions, but the shirt shrank after the first wash.
general.zh: 我照著說明洗，但這件襯衫洗第一次就縮水了。

general.en: Wool sweaters tend to shrink in hot water.
general.zh: 羊毛衣在熱水中容易縮水。

qa.en: That's my assumption — the area shrinks too much after it has cooled.
qa.zh: 我是這樣推測的，那個區域冷卻後收縮量太大。

qa.en: The area shrinks too much after it has cooled.
qa.zh: 該區域冷卻後收縮量過大。

words.definition: Visiting famous or interesting places as a tourist.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: I'm here for sightseeing.
general.zh: 我是來觀光的。

words.definition: A fixed basin in a kitchen or bathroom with taps for water.

general.en: The sink fell off the wall because the glue wasn't applied properly.
general.zh: 水槽從牆上掉下來了，因為黏膠沒有塗好。

general.en: The pipe under the sink started leaking.
general.zh: 水槽下面的水管開始漏水了。

general.en: My husband has not finished the kitchen yet. There are still some dishes in the sink.
general.zh: 我先生還沒把廚房弄完。水槽裡還有一些碗盤。

general.en: The sink was reattached.
general.zh: 洗手台被重新固定。

general.en: Last winter, the pipe under my kitchen sink started leaking. I called a company which promised to send someone within two days, but the water was already dripping onto the floor. My neighbour heard the noise and knocked on my door.
general.zh: 去年冬天，我廚房水槽下的水管開始漏水。我打電話給一家公司，他們承諾兩天內派人來，但水已經滴到地板上了。我的鄰居聽到聲音，來敲我的門。

general.en: There are dishes in the sink.

qa.en: Those are sink marks. Look closely — the sink marks align with the locations of the ribs.
qa.zh: 那些是縮水痕。你仔細看，縮水痕的位置正好對應肋位。

qa.en: The sink marks align with the locations of the ribs.
qa.zh: 縮水痕位置與肋位對應。

words.definition: 用於戶外公共警示的高頻警報聲

general.en: The siren went off, so everyone ran to shelter from the tornado.
general.zh: 警報響了，大家都跑去躲避龍捲風。

general.en: The sirens went off when a tornado was approaching the city.
general.zh: 當龍捲風接近城市時，警報聲響起。

general.en: The sirens went off, so everyone ran to shelter from the tornado.
general.zh: 警報響了，大家都跑去躲避龍捲風。

general.en: The siren went off. vs. The alarm clock went off.
