general.zh: 警報響了 vs. 鬧鐘響了。（Siren 戶外公共防災警報；Alarm 室內火災警報或鬧鐘；「響了」用 went off。）

general.en: The siren went off.
general.zh: 警報響了。（Siren 通常指戶外的公共防災警報聲；「響了」用 went off，不是 turns off。）

general.en: The sound is like a siren.

words.definition: to not do something you usually do.
words.lesson: 20250807 現在進行式與過去進行式

general.en: Don't skip your class at the last minute.
general.zh: 不要在最後一刻翹課。

qa.en: Skip-lot inspection is a defined program, not an ad-hoc decision under schedule pressure.
qa.zh: 跳批檢驗是一套定好的制度，不是被時程逼出來的臨時決定。

qa.en: I propose a reduced critical-items check as a compromise. A full skip requires a documented deviation with management approval.
qa.zh: 我建議折衷，只驗關鍵項目。要完全跳過檢驗，就要主管核准的書面特採。

qa.en: Skip-lot inspection is a defined program, not an ad-hoc decision under schedule pressure.
qa.zh: 跳批檢驗是一套定好的制度，不是被時程逼出來的臨時決定。

words.definition: work that people are forced to do for little or no pay
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and much more.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: Fair enough. But some companies make loads of money using slave labour. That feels pretty evil to me.
general.zh: 有道理。可是有些公司靠奴工賺了大把的錢。這在我看來就相當邪惡。

general.en: Greed means there are things like blackmail, corruption, slave labour and more terrible things in the world.
general.zh: 貪婪意味著世界上存在著像勒索、貪污、奴工以及更多可怕的事情。

general.en: We must stop slave labour.
general.zh: 我們必須停止奴工。

words.definition: to sleep very deeply and not wake up easily

general.en: I was so tired that I slept like a log all night.
general.zh: 我太累了，整晚睡得像木頭一樣沉。

general.en: You're such a smart cookie! You learn so fast.
general.zh: 你真是個聰明的傢伙！你學得好快。

general.en: Don't underestimate him—he's a smart cookie.
general.zh: 別低估他，他很聰明。

general.en: She figured out the answer immediately. She's a smart cookie.
general.zh: 她馬上就想出了答案，真是個聰明的人。

words.definition: without any problems or sudden changes
words.lesson: 20260122 Money Makes the World Go Round

general.en: If you don't have money, the world might not go round so smoothly.
general.zh: 如果你沒有錢，世界運轉起來可能就不會那麼順利。

general.en: If you don't have money, the world might not go round so smoothly.
general.zh: 如果你沒有錢，世界運轉起來可能就不會那麼順利。

general.en: I hope that in the new year, everything goes smoothly.
general.zh: 我希望新的一年一切順利。

general.en: I hope that in the new year, everything goes smoothly and my English skills continue to improve.
general.zh: 我希望新的一年一切順利，我的英文能力也能繼續進步。

general.en: The pilot landed the plane smoothly.
general.zh: 飛行員平穩地降落了飛機。

general.en: The project is running smoothly.
general.zh: 這個專案進行得很順利。

words.definition: to suddenly push air out through your nose and mouth in a way you cannot control, often because of dust or a cold.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: After a cold, I keep sneezing and my nose is runny.
general.zh: 感冒後，我一直打噴嚏而且流鼻水。

general.en: The colleague sneezes continuously in the office.
general.zh: 同事在辦公室裡連續打噴嚏。（描述他的過敏體質或辦公室目前的常態。）

general.en: The colleague sneezed continuously in the office yesterday.
general.zh: 同事昨天在辦公室裡連續打噴嚏。（明確指出昨天發生的狀況，現在可能戴上口罩或是吃藥好轉了。）

general.en: The colleague will sneeze continuously in the office if the AC is dusty.
general.zh: 如果冷氣很多灰塵，同事在辦公室裡將會連續打噴嚏。（對未來狀況的預測。）

general.en: The colleague is sneezing continuously in the office right now.
general.zh: 同事現在正在辦公室裡連續打噴嚏。（強調此時此刻正在發生的動作，非常有畫面感。）

general.en: The dust in the factory made me sneeze.
general.zh: 工廠裡的灰塵讓我打噴嚏。

words.definition: to make a loud noise through your nose and mouth while sleeping

general.en: I don't snore unless I am extremely exhausted.
general.zh: 除非我極度疲憊，否則我不會打呼。

general.en: My husband snores loudly when he is tired.
general.zh: 我先生累的時候打呼很大聲。

general.en: Unlike my husband, I snore when I am tired.
general.zh: 我不像我先生，我累的時候會打呼。

general.en: Tom tends to snore when he's exhausted.
general.zh: 湯姆精疲力竭時傾向於打呼。

words.definition: 用雪揉捏成的球狀物

general.en: The children made a snowball and threw it at each other.
general.zh: 孩子們做了一顆雪球並互相丟擲。

general.en: The children made snowballs.
general.zh: 孩子們做了雪球。

words.definition: friendly and enjoying being with other people.

general.en: His communication skills are very good. He is a sociable person.
general.zh: 他的溝通能力很好。他是個善於交際的人。

words.definition: A device on a wall that you plug an electrical device into.

general.en: The electrician made sure that all the lights and sockets were safe.
general.zh: 電工確保所有的燈和插座都是安全的。

general.en: Thank you. There's one more thing — the socket next to the sink stopped working last week.
general.zh: 謝謝您。還有一件事，洗手台旁邊的插座上星期就不能用了。

general.en: A faulty socket near water isn't safe at all. Please don't use it.
general.zh: 靠近水的插座故障非常不安全，請千萬不要用它。

words.definition: A cold drink with no alcohol.

general.en: Would you like a soft drink?
general.zh: 你想要一杯汽水嗎？

words.definition: a way of solving a problem.

general.en: I work closely with design engineers to investigate the root causes and implement effective solutions.
general.zh: 我會與設計工程師密切合作，進行根本原因分析，並落實有效的解決方案。

general.en: Her manager was impressed, and her solution has since been shared with the whole department.
general.zh: 她的主管印象深刻，她的解決方案後來也被分享給了整個部門。

general.en: Her solution has since been shared with the whole department.
general.zh: 她的解決方案後來也被分享給了整個部門。

general.en: Yes, she was. My solution has since been shared with the whole department.
general.zh: 對，她很開心。我的解決方案後來也被分享給了整個部門。

general.en: Implement effective solutions to ensure alignment with our clients' requirements.
general.zh: 落實有效的解決方案，以確保與客戶需求保持一致。

general.en: This is only a temporary solution.
general.zh: 這只是暫時的解決辦法。

qa.en: We expect an error-proofing solution, not a reminder to be careful.
qa.zh: 我們要的是防呆對策，不是提醒人員小心。

qa.en: Check the total alkalinity of the degreasing solution.
qa.zh: 請檢查脫脂劑的全鹼度濃度。

qa.en: Action: offer options — a different process, a tolerance query to the customer, or a quotation that includes the sorting cost.
qa.zh: 行動：給幾個選項——換製程、跟客戶問公差能不能放寬、或把挑選成本算進報價。

qa.en: The sorting cost was never included in the quotation.
qa.zh: 挑選的成本從來沒算進報價。

qa.en: The supplier is responsible for the sorting cost.
qa.zh: 挑選費用由供應商負責。

qa.en: There are three ways forward: change the process, query the tolerance, or quote the sorting cost. I recommend querying it first — it is free.
qa.zh: 有三條路：換製程、問客戶公差能不能放寬、或把挑選成本報進去。我建議先問——問不用錢。

words.translation: 酸的 (變質或本身的酸味)
words.definition: having an acidic, sharp taste — also used when food has gone bad

general.en: The milk tasted sour because I forgot to put it in the fridge.
general.zh: 牛奶喝起來酸酸的，因為我忘記放進冰箱。

general.en: The food was rotten. The sauce had turned sour and there was green mold on the cheese.
general.zh: 食物已經腐壞了。醬汁變酸了，而且起司上長了綠色的黴菌。

general.en: I love adding a squeeze of lemon to make the soup taste sour.
general.zh: 我喜歡擠一點檸檬讓湯喝起來酸酸的。

general.en: The sauce had turned sour.

qa.en: There is too much spatter around the joint. Please grind it off.
qa.zh: 接合處飛濺太多，請磨掉。

words.translation: 統計製程管制與製程能力
words.definition: Monitoring a process with control charts and expressing how well it fits inside the specification limits.

qa.en: We designated the motor mount torque as a special characteristic.
qa.zh: 我們把馬達座扭力指定為特殊特性。

qa.en: The capability study on the special characteristics is still missing.
qa.zh: 特殊特性的能力研究還缺著。

qa.en: The following are missing: control plan, measurement system analysis, capability study for the designated special characteristics, and the material certificate.
qa.zh: 缺的項目有：管制計畫、MSA、特殊特性的能力研究、還有材證。

words.definition: A meal for special diets, such as vegetarian.

general.en: I ordered a vegetarian special meal.
general.zh: 我預訂了素食特別餐。

general.en: It's ridiculous to change the specifications at the last minute.
general.zh: 在最後一刻才改規格實在很荒謬。

qa.en: The procedure for identifying, segregating, and dispositioning product that does not meet the specification.
qa.zh: 不合規格的東西怎麼標、怎麼隔離、怎麼決定處理方式的程序。

qa.en: The inspection report records the specification, the actual value, and the judgement for every characteristic.
qa.zh: 檢驗報告每個特性都有規格、實測值跟判定。

qa.en: A document listing every characteristic to be controlled, with its specification, measuring method, sample size, frequency, and reaction plan.
qa.zh: 把每個要管的特性列出來的文件：規格、怎麼量、抽幾件、多久量一次、出問題怎麼辦。

qa.en: The package of evidence submitted to the customer to prove the process can consistently make parts to specification before mass production is approved.
qa.zh: 量產核准前交給客戶的一整包資料，證明製程能穩定做出合規格的東西。

qa.en: Yes. The control plan lists each characteristic, the specification, the measuring instrument, the sample size and frequency, and the reaction plan when the result is out of specification.
qa.zh: 可以。管制計畫上面有每項特性、規格、用什麼儀器量、抽幾件、多久量一次，還有超規時怎麼處理。

qa.en: Every report shows the specification, the actual value, and the judgement — not just OK/NG. Reports are traceable to the lot number and retained per the document control procedure.
qa.zh: 每份報告都有規格、實測值跟判定，不是只寫 OK／NG。報告追得到批號，照文件管制程序保存。

qa.en: We hold a specification review before sales signs anything.
qa.zh: 業務簽任何東西之前，我們都先做規格審查。

qa.en: We measured three points per part with a calibrated spectrophotometer.
qa.zh: 我們用校正過的分光色差儀，每件量三點。

qa.en: Calibrate the spectrophotometer with the white tile first.
qa.zh: 先用白板校正色差計。

words.definition: 食物因放置過久而變質損壞

general.en: The food became spoiled after the power went out.
general.zh: 停電之後食物變質了。

general.en: Some of the food inside had probably spoiled.
general.zh: 裡面的某些食物可能已經變質了。

general.en: She felt a wave of nausea after eating the spoiled food.
general.zh: 吃到壞掉的食物後，她感到一陣噁心。

general.en: Diarrhea is often caused by a stomach virus or eating spoiled food.
general.zh: 腹瀉通常是由胃病毒或吃到變質食物造成的。

general.en: Even spoiled days can improve with a little effort.
general.zh: no longer good/fresh（不再良好／新鮮的）

general.en: When I finally took a bite, it was simple but satisfying. It made me full, and I realized that even spoiled days can improve with a little effort. Some foods are perishable, but good habits can last longer than any meal.
general.zh: 當我終於咬下一口時，味道很簡單卻令人滿足。它讓我飽足，而我也體會到，即便是糟糕的（被毀掉的）日子，只要付出一點努力就能好轉。有些食物是易腐壞的，但良好的習慣卻能比任何一餐持續得更久。（文法解說：使役結構 make + 受詞 + 形容詞——full 作受詞補語；spoiled 是 spoil 的過去分詞轉化為形容詞修飾 days。）

words.definition: 食物不再新鮮安全

general.en: Some of the food inside had probably spoiled.
general.zh: 裡面的某些食物可能已經變質了。

general.en: The food became spoiled after the power went out.
general.zh: 停電之後食物變質了。

general.en: She felt a wave of nausea after eating the spoiled food.
general.zh: 吃到壞掉的食物後，她感到一陣噁心。

general.en: Diarrhea is often caused by a stomach virus or eating spoiled food.
general.zh: 腹瀉通常是由胃病毒或吃到變質食物造成的。

general.en: Even spoiled days can improve with a little effort.
general.zh: no longer good/fresh（不再良好／新鮮的）

general.en: When I finally took a bite, it was simple but satisfying. It made me full, and I realized that even spoiled days can improve with a little effort. Some foods are perishable, but good habits can last longer than any meal.
general.zh: 當我終於咬下一口時，味道很簡單卻令人滿足。它讓我飽足，而我也體會到，即便是糟糕的（被毀掉的）日子，只要付出一點努力就能好轉。有些食物是易腐壞的，但良好的習慣卻能比任何一餐持續得更久。（文法解說：使役結構 make + 受詞 + 形容詞——full 作受詞補語；spoiled 是 spoil 的過去分詞轉化為形容詞修飾 days。）

words.definition: food that has gone bad and is no longer safe or good to eat.
words.lesson: 20260310 英文八大時態與健康症狀 Tenses & Symptoms

general.en: Diarrhea is often caused by a stomach virus or eating spoiled food.
general.zh: 腹瀉通常是由胃病毒或吃到變質食物造成的。

general.en: She felt a wave of nausea after eating the spoiled food.
general.zh: 吃到壞掉的食物後，她感到一陣噁心。

general.en: After eating spoiled food, I felt nauseous and started vomiting.
general.zh: 吃了壞掉的食物後，我覺得噁心並開始嘔吐。

words.definition: To pay for an event or show to advertise.

general.en: The sponsor offered refunds to compensate the customers.
general.zh: 贊助商提供退款來補償顧客。

general.en: The brand sponsors the TV show because it wants more exposure.
general.zh: 該品牌贊助電視節目，因為它想要更多曝光。

general.en: Sponsoring the show gave the brand more exposure.
general.zh: 贊助這個節目讓品牌獲得更多曝光。

general.en: The concert was canceled because of the typhoon, so the sponsor offered refunds.
general.zh: 演唱會因颱風取消，贊助商提供退款。

general.en: The concert was canceled because of the typhoon, so the sponsor offered refunds to compensate the customers.
general.zh: 演唱會因颱風取消，贊助商提供退款來補償顧客。

general.en: The brand sponsors the TV show.
general.zh: 該品牌贊助這個電視節目。

qa.en: How many hours of salt spray does this coating pass?
qa.zh: 這個塗裝可以通過幾小時鹽霧？

qa.en: We put the part in the salt spray chamber for 48 hours.
qa.zh: 我們把零件放進鹽霧箱 48 小時。

qa.en: Corrosion resistance is verified by neutral salt spray testing per ASTM B117 for the specified duration.
qa.zh: 耐蝕性照 ASTM B117 做中性鹽霧，做到規定的小時數。

qa.en: This coating passes 48 hours of salt spray with no red rust.
qa.zh: 這個塗裝過 48 小時鹽霧，沒有紅鏽。

qa.en: Salt spray testing is performed on every production lot of coated parts, and the chamber conditions are recorded and retained with the test report.
qa.zh: 塗裝件每批量產都做鹽霧，鹽霧箱的條件也跟報告一起記下來存。

qa.en: This powder coating passes 48 hours of neutral salt spray with no red rust and with creepage from the scribe line under one millimeter, which meets the requirement in the specification.
qa.zh: 這個粉體塗裝過 48 小時中性鹽霧，沒有紅鏽，劃線處擴散小於 1 mm，符合規格。

qa.en: Springback made the bending angle 2 degrees off.
qa.zh: 回彈造成折彎角度偏差 2 度。

words.definition: 小雨零星地落下，或灑水的動作

general.en: It is drizzling. / It is sprinkling.
general.zh: 正在下毛毛雨。／正在飄雨。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: We need to adjust the design to meet foreign safety standards.
general.zh: 我們需要調整設計，以符合國外的安全標準。

general.en: The company has maintained the same safety standard for a decade.
general.zh: 這家公司十年來一直維持著同樣的安全標準。

general.en: Inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: …and my task was to ensure that the first production batch met all quality standards before shipment to a key international client.
general.zh: ……我的任務是確保第一批生產的產品在出貨給重要國際客戶前符合所有品質標準。

general.en: It meets quality standards.

qa.en: The AQL levels are agreed with the customer and documented in the inspection standard; any change requires customer approval.
qa.zh: AQL 是跟客戶談好、寫進檢驗標準的，要改要客戶點頭。

qa.en: A letter from the standard table that converts the lot size and inspection level into the number of pieces to be drawn.
qa.zh: 標準表裡的一個英文字母，把「批量＋檢驗水準」換成要抽幾件。

qa.en: Comparing an instrument against a traceable reference standard at a defined interval and recording the result.
qa.zh: 照規定週期，拿儀器跟可追溯的標準件比對，把結果記下來。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for standard parts, and 100% inspection for safety-related and high-risk parts such as treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 一般零件抽檢；跟安全有關、風險高的件（像跑步機馬達）就全檢。

qa.en: The inspection level is part of the agreed inspection standard; we can tighten it for your product if you require additional confidence.
qa.zh: 檢驗水準是談好的檢驗標準的一部分；你們想要更保險，我們可以針對你們的產品加嚴。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

words.definition: Documenting the current best way to do a job so everyone does it the same way.

qa.en: After the trial, please update the standardized work sheet for the squat rack station.
qa.zh: 試做完成後，請更新深蹲架工作站的標準化作業表。

words.definition: Using statistics on real production data to keep a process stable and catch drift early.
to keep your body at a comfortable temperature, especially in cold weather

general.en: Remember to stay warm during cold weather.
general.zh: 天冷時要記得注意保暖。

general.en: Stay warm; the weather is cold today.
general.zh: 注意保暖，今天天氣很冷。

words.definition: a pain in the area of your stomach.

general.en: I think I have food poisoning because I have stomach pain and diarrhea.
general.zh: 我覺得我食物中毒了，因為我肚子痛又拉肚子。

general.en: Yes, quite a lot. The stomach pain started after dinner last night.
general.zh: 有，滿嚴重的。肚子痛是昨天晚餐之後開始的。

general.en: Can I take a painkiller for the stomach pain? I have some at home.
general.zh: 我可以吃止痛藥止肚子痛嗎？我家裡有一些。

general.en: Do you have any stomach pain?

words.definition: To make something stronger or more solid.
words.lesson: 20251209 一個度過美好時光的好地方

general.en: Hot pot is a great way to strengthen family bonds.
general.zh: 火鍋是增進家庭感情的好方式。

general.en: These events help to strengthen teamwork and morale.
general.zh: 這些活動有助於強化團隊合作與士氣。

general.en: Traditional Taiwanese dishes, like ginger duck or hot pot, are a great way to bring family members together and strengthen family bonds.
general.zh: 像薑母鴨或火鍋這樣的台灣傳統料理，是讓家人聚在一起、增進家庭感情的好方式。

general.en: In the corporate world, events serve as crucial milestones for celebrating achievements, fostering team spirit, and strengthening company culture.
general.zh: 在企業世界中，各種活動扮演著重要的里程碑角色，用來慶祝成就、培養團隊精神，以及強化公司文化。

general.en: Milk can strengthen your bones.
general.zh: 牛奶能強化骨骼。

qa.en: We are strengthening our quality culture through regular shop-floor training.
qa.zh: 我們靠定期的現場教育訓練來加強品質文化。

words.definition: feeling a lot of stress or anxiety

general.en: I am completely stressed out about the final exam.
general.zh: 我對期末考感到壓力大到快崩潰。

general.en: She felt stressed out before the exam. / This week has been stressful.
general.zh: 考試前她壓力很大。／這一週充滿壓力。

general.en: She felt stressed out before the exam.
general.zh: 考試前她壓力很大。

words.translation: 充滿壓力的（事物的特質）
words.definition: -ing type adjective: describes a situation or event that causes stress

general.en: Whenever a task at work feels unfamiliar or slightly stressful, I now ask myself a different question.
general.zh: 每當工作上的一項任務讓我覺得陌生或有點有壓力，我現在會問自己一個不一樣的問題。

general.en: I'm okay, but my morning was a little stressful.
general.zh: 我還好，但今天早上有點有壓力。

general.en: Moving to a new city can be a stressful experience.
general.zh: 搬到一個新城市可能是一次令人倍感壓力的經歷。

general.en: She felt stressed out before the exam. / This week has been stressful.
general.zh: 考試前她壓力很大。／這一週充滿壓力。

general.en: This week has been stressful.
general.zh: 這一週充滿壓力。

general.en: For workers like Mia, who rely on the MRT every day, even a short delay can turn a calm morning into a stressful rush to the office.
general.zh: 對像Mia這樣每天仰賴捷運的上班族來說，就算只是小小的延誤，也可能讓平靜的早晨變成趕著進辦公室的壓力時刻。

words.definition: 猛烈地擊中或侵襲某地

general.en: Let's go inside, I think a tornado might hit this area.
general.zh: 我們進去吧，我覺得龍捲風可能會襲擊這一帶。

general.en: The impact on individual cities has been striking.
general.zh: 對各城市造成的影響相當顯著。

general.en: Describing storms, the most common verbs are hit, strike, or affect.
general.zh: 描述風暴襲擊最常用 hit、strike 或 affect。（寫作建議：避免用 attack 形容天氣。）

words.definition: to try very hard to achieve something difficult.

general.en: I work carefully and always strive to improve product quality.
general.zh: 我做事仔細，並持續努力提升產品品質。

words.definition: 無法移動、前進或解決問題的狀態

general.en: Sometimes I get stuck when I try to speak English.
general.zh: 有時候我嘗試說英文時會卡卡的。

general.en: She got stuck while writing her essay and couldn't continue.
general.zh: 她寫論文時卡關了，無法繼續。

general.en: The car horn is stuck and won't stop honking.
general.zh: 汽車喇叭卡住了，一直響不停。

general.en: Cars would get stuck in the mud on the road.
general.zh: 車子會卡在路上的泥漿中動彈不得。

general.en: The car horn got stuck, so it kept honking.
general.zh: 汽車喇叭卡住，所以一直按個不停。

general.en: My brain gets stuck when I'm nervous.
general.zh: 當我緊張的時候腦袋會卡住。

qa.en: The sample submission package includes dimensional, material, and performance evidence plus the process documents.
qa.zh: 樣品承認資料有尺寸、材質、性能的數據，還有製程文件。

qa.en: The warrant is the cover sheet, not the submission.
qa.zh: PSW 只是封面，不等於整份 PPAP。

qa.en: Decision: an incomplete submission is not approved. Record it as interim approval or rejected — never as approved.
qa.zh: 決定：資料不齊就不是核准。只能記暫准或退件，不能記核准。

qa.en: The warrant was signed, but the submission was incomplete.
qa.zh: PSW 簽了，但資料不齊。

qa.en: A typical submission includes the dimensional results, material and performance test reports, the control plan, the PFMEA, the process flow, and the sample parts.
qa.zh: 通常會交尺寸報告、材質跟性能測試報告、管制計畫、PFMEA、製程流程圖，再加樣品。

qa.en: Mass production will not start until we receive your written approval of the submission; any subsequent change requires a new submission.
qa.zh: 你們書面承認之前不會開量產；之後有任何變更都要重新送。

qa.en: We requested submission level 3 for this part.
qa.zh: 這個零件我們要求送件等級 3。

qa.en: We requested submission level 3. The package received contains the part submission warrant and the dimensional report only.
qa.zh: 我們要求的是 Level 3，但收到的只有 PSW 跟尺寸報告。

qa.en: A defect that could create a substantial product hazard must be reported immediately.
qa.zh: 可能造成重大產品危害的缺陷，要馬上通報。

words.definition: To achieve something you have been trying to do.

general.en: Her determination helped her succeed against all odds.
general.zh: 她的決心幫助她克服一切困難，取得成功。

general.en: Most problems can be solved if you keep trying to succeed.
general.zh: 只要持續努力，多數問題都能解決。

general.en: success (n.) / succeed (v.) / successful (adj.)
general.zh: 成功（名詞）／成功（動詞）／成功的（形容詞）

general.en: Keep trying to succeed.
general.zh: 持續努力以獲得成功。

words.definition: When something does very well or reaches a good result.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: He never thought the show would be a success.
general.zh: 他從沒想過這部劇會成功。

general.en: Let's raise our glasses and make a toast to our success.
general.zh: 讓我們舉杯，為我們的成功敬酒。

general.en: Many families eat fish, dumplings, and rice cakes because these foods mean wealth and success.
general.zh: 常見食物有魚、餃子和年糕，象徵財富與成功。

general.en: Success is not a matter of luck.
general.zh: 成功不是運氣的問題。

general.en: Emma always dreamed of achieving success in her career. She was a very passionate employee who loved learning new skills and improving herself. Her manager often encouraged her to keep a positive mindset and believe in her abilities.
general.zh: Emma 一直夢想在事業上取得成功。她是一位非常有熱忱的員工，熱愛學習新技能和提升自己。她的主管經常鼓勵她保持正面心態，相信自己的能力。

general.en: Later, Emma's manager asked about her experience. She explained that success does not happen by luck. Intelligent people learn from their mistakes, understand the symptoms of problems, and take action before small issues become big ones.
general.zh: 後來，Emma 的主管詢問了她的經驗。她解釋說成功不是靠運氣。聰明的人從錯誤中學習，了解問題的症狀，並在小問題變成大問題之前採取行動。

qa.en: If we cut the sample this week and the penetration theory holds, the earliest re-test completion is week 6 — that leaves two weeks of buffer, assuming a first-pass success.
qa.zh: 如果這週切片、熔深的假設成立，重測最快第 6 週完成——而且要一次過，才剩兩週緩衝。

words.definition: Achieving what you wanted to achieve.

general.en: Farmers are happy when the harvest is successful.
general.zh: 農夫在豐收時會很開心。

general.en: This project has the potential to be very successful.
general.zh: 這個專案有潛力非常成功。

general.en: Good preparation is the key to a successful interview.
general.zh: 充分的準備是面試成功的關鍵。

general.en: The show was very successful.
general.zh: 這部劇非常成功。

general.en: Emma remained an optimist and believed every challenge was an opportunity to grow. Her positive attitude and smart decisions helped her become a successful leader.
general.zh: Emma 保持樂觀，相信每個挑戰都是成長的機會。她的正面態度和聰明的決定幫助她成為一位成功的領導者。

general.en: Emma remained an optimist, viewing every challenge as an opportunity for growth. Her positive attitude and smart decision-making were the cornerstones that helped her become a successful leader.
general.zh: Emma 始終保持樂觀，把每個挑戰都視為成長的機會。她正面的態度與聰明的決策，正是幫助她成為一位成功領導者的基石。

words.definition: 在沒有預警的情況下迅速發生

general.en: They were scared when the elevator stopped suddenly.
general.zh: 當電梯突然停住時，他們感到害怕。

general.en: Yesterday, a tropical storm, which had formed over the South China Sea days earlier, suddenly turned toward the coast.
general.zh: 昨天，一個原本在南海形成已經好幾天的熱帶風暴，突然轉向朝海岸而來。

general.en: Anita was cooking dinner in her rented studio last Tuesday evening when the lights suddenly went out.
general.zh: 上週二晚上Anita正在她租的套房裡煮晚餐，這時燈突然熄了。

general.en: Suddenly everybody stopped talking. There was silence.
general.zh: 突然大家都停止說話，一片寂靜。

general.en: The smoke alarm suddenly went off.
general.zh: 煙霧警報器突然響了。

general.en: Lily offered to help, so the two of them worked together in the kitchen. Amy was frying the chicken when the smoke alarm suddenly went off, and both women laughed loudly. The chicken was a little more burnt than usual, but nobody minded.
general.zh: Lily主動說要幫忙，於是兩人一起在廚房裡忙。Amy正在炸雞的時候，煙霧警報器突然響了，兩個人都笑得很大聲。雞肉比平常燒焦了一點，但沒有人介意。

words.definition: red, sore skin caused by too much sun.
words.lesson: 20260728 越南寧平旅遊 Tam Coc Trip

general.en: Use sunscreen to prevent sunburn.
general.zh: 使用防曬乳來防止曬傷。

words.definition: light that comes from the sun

general.en: They looked for a place with no strong sunlight.
general.zh: 他們尋找沒有強烈陽光的地方。

general.en: Because it is very hot in summer, all motorcyclists waiting at the traffic light look for a place where there is no strong sunlight.
general.zh: 因為夏天非常熱，所有等紅燈的機車騎士都在找沒有強烈陽光的地方。（waiting at the traffic light 分詞片語修飾 motorcyclists；a place where... 關係子句。）

words.definition: A cream you put on your skin to protect it from the sun.

general.en: Apply or use sunscreen to protect your skin.
general.zh: 塗抹或使用防曬乳來保護皮膚。

general.en: People use sunscreen to protect their skin from UV rays.
general.zh: 人們用防曬乳保護皮膚免受紫外線傷害。

general.en: It is important to apply sunscreen on cloudy days.
general.zh: 陰天擦防曬乳很重要。

general.en: Apply sunscreen to protect your skin.
general.zh: 塗防曬乳來保護皮膚。

general.en: Use sunscreen to prevent sunburn.
general.zh: 使用防曬乳來防止曬傷。

words.definition: believing in things that cannot be explained by reason or science

general.en: Many superstitious people believe the number 4 brings bad luck.
general.zh: 許多迷信的人認為數字 4 會帶來厄運。

general.en: Some people are superstitious about numbers.
general.zh: 有些人對數字很迷信。

qa.en: We will hold the lot with a red HOLD tag and inform the supervisor.
qa.zh: 這批我們會貼紅色 HOLD 標籤扣住，然後通知主管。

qa.en: Please hold the lot and put a red HOLD tag on it. I will inform the supervisor.
qa.zh: 請扣留該批並貼上紅色扣留標籤，我會通知主管。

qa.en: Her supervisor gives her a tour.

general.en: We're meeting the supplier at 2 p.m. tomorrow.
general.zh: 我們明天下午兩點要見供應商。

general.en: She is meeting a supplier tomorrow to discuss quality issues.
general.zh: 她明天要和供應商開會討論品質問題。（預定好的近未來行動，用現在進行式）

qa.en: The supplier must submit an 8D report for the cracked squat rack welds within ten working days.
qa.zh: 供應商必須在十個工作天內提出深蹲架焊道龜裂的 8D 報告。

qa.en: If the corrective action is not confirmed by Friday, we will have to put the supplier on hold.
qa.zh: 週五前對策沒確認，我們就會先停掉這家供應商的供貨。

qa.en: Our QMS covers document control, internal audit, management review, supplier control, calibration, nonconforming product, and corrective action.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 包含文件管制、內稽、管理審查、供應商管理、儀器校驗、不合格品跟矯正措施。

qa.en: We use general level II as the default, tighten to level III for a new supplier or after a quality issue, and use special levels S-1 to S-4 for destructive or costly tests.
qa.zh: 平常用一般水準 II；新供應商或出過問題就加嚴到 III；破壞性或很貴的測試改用特殊水準 S-1～S-4。

qa.en: The sampling plan for this lot is Ac 1 / Re 2. One defective is within the acceptance number, so the lot is accepted. We still record the defect and feed it back to the supplier.
qa.zh: 這批的抽樣計畫是 Ac 1／Re 2，1 件不良還在允收數內，所以收。不過這件不良我們還是會記下來，回饋給供應商。

qa.en: Action: work with the chemical supplier to select a vapor-phase corrosion inhibitor (VCI) oil or a rust preventive specifically rated for enclosed cavities. Validate the new product on sample tubes before switching production.
qa.zh: 行動：跟油品供應商要一支 VCI 防鏽油（揮發型的，管子裡面油碰不到的地方也能保護），拿樣品管先驗證再切換產線。

words.definition: To help or encourage someone, or to agree with their idea.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: We are grateful for the support from the rescue team.
general.zh: 我們非常感謝救援團隊的支持。

general.en: Money can support a comfortable life, but it cannot guarantee happiness.
general.zh: 金錢可以支持舒適的生活，但無法保證幸福。

general.en: Supporting communication between clients and internal teams.
general.zh: 協助客戶與內部團隊之間的溝通。

general.en: My family always supports me.
general.zh: 我的家人總是支持我。

qa.en: I need the data before I can support this decision.
qa.zh: 要有數據我才能支持這個決定。

qa.en: Which line in the control plan supports that detection score?
qa.zh: 這個偵測度分數，對到管制計畫上的哪一行？

qa.en: I can support the schedule only if the re-test passes on the first attempt.
qa.zh: 只有重測一次通過，我才能支持這個時程。

qa.en: I can support a documented risk decision — I cannot support silently skipping a control.
qa.zh: 風險決策有留紀錄我可以支持，默默跳過管制我不能支持。

qa.en: Do not sign a customer declaration that states more than your supplier records can support.
qa.zh: 客戶的聲明書，寫的東西超過供應商紀錄能證明的範圍，不要簽。

qa.en: Will you be ready to support our EUDR due diligence before the end of the year?
qa.zh: 年底前你們能配合我們的 EUDR 盡職調查嗎？

qa.en: A test that presses an indenter into the surface under a defined load to measure resistance to permanent deformation.
qa.zh: 用規定的力把壓頭壓進表面，看材料多耐壓、會不會凹的測試。

qa.en: Hardness is measured on the specified surface and compared against the drawing requirement.
qa.zh: 硬度在指定的面量，跟圖面要求比。

qa.en: May I confirm your acceptance criteria for this surface?
qa.zh: 想跟您確認一下，這個面的允收標準是什麼？

qa.en: This oil was made for open surfaces — inside a sealed tube it cannot coat every spot, so the tube rusts anyway.
qa.zh: 這支防鏽油是給外面平面用的——管子裡面塗不到的地方，照樣鏽。

qa.en: Yes. We verify the heat treatment by hardness test. The specification is HRC 45 to 50, and we take three readings per part on the specified surface.
qa.zh: 有。熱處理我們用硬度來驗。規格 HRC 45～50，每件在指定的面量三點。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

words.definition: 醫療操作，需要切開身體進行治療

general.en: Most surgery costs are covered by Taiwan's NHI.
general.zh: 大多數手術費用由台灣全民健保支付。

general.en: My colleague had abdominal surgery and lost 20 kg.
general.zh: 我的同事做了腹部手術，瘦了 20 公斤。

general.en: Cosmetic surgery is becoming more common these days.
general.zh: 現在整形手術越來越普遍。

general.en: He said he would never choose plastic surgery.
general.zh: 他說他永遠不會選擇整形手術。

general.en: Too much surgery can make a person look unnatural.
general.zh: 太多手術會讓人看起來不自然。

general.en: He thinks cosmetic surgery is a waste of money.
general.zh: 他認為整形手術是浪費錢。

qa.en: Our quality management system is certified to ISO 9001 and subject to annual surveillance audits.
qa.zh: 我們的 QMS 有 ISO 9001 認證，每年都有追查稽核。

qa.en: Our last surveillance audit closed with no major findings.
qa.zh: 我們上一次追蹤稽核沒有開出重大缺失。

qa.en: Yes. We are ISO 9001 certified. Our last surveillance audit was in March this year with no major findings, and our internal audit is conducted twice a year.
qa.zh: 有，我們有 ISO 9001。最近一次追查稽核是今年三月，沒有重大缺失；內稽一年做兩次。

words.definition: A person who continues to live after a dangerous or difficult event.

general.en: Survivors were taken to a nearby shelter.
general.zh: 倖存者被帶到附近的避難所。

general.en: Rescue workers searched for survivors all night.
general.zh: 救援人員整夜搜尋倖存者。

qa.en: The customer's sustainability team sent a supplier questionnaire with about forty questions. Most were procedural. One asked for the recycled content of the main structural steel, as a percentage. There was no field for 'not known'.
qa.zh: 客戶永續團隊寄來一份大概四十題的供應商問卷。大部分是問流程，其中一題問主結構鋼的再生料含量百分比，而且沒有「不知道」這個選項。

words.definition: to give something and get something else.

general.en: Sometimes they swap clothes.
general.zh: 有時她們會交換衣服穿。

words.definition: a sign that you have an illness.

general.en: Can you describe your symptoms in more detail?
general.zh: 你可以更詳細地描述你的症狀嗎？

general.en: That's a very common symptom pattern after greasy street food. I think you have food poisoning.
general.zh: 吃完油膩的路邊小吃之後，這是很常見的症狀組合。我認為你是食物中毒。

general.en: A lot of people stop at the symptom.
general.zh: 很多人只處理到表面症狀就停了。

general.en: Describe your symptoms clearly.
general.zh: 把你的症狀說清楚。

general.en: They also pointed to a worrying pattern: more than ninety percent of people who developed severe symptoms this season had not received this year's updated vaccine.
general.zh: 他們也指出一個令人擔憂的現象：這一季出現重症症狀的人當中，超過九成都還沒接種今年更新版的疫苗。

general.en: Later, Emma's manager asked about her experience. She explained that success does not happen by luck. Intelligent people learn from their mistakes, understand the symptoms of problems, and take action before small issues become big ones.
general.zh: 後來，Emma 的主管詢問了她的經驗。她解釋說成功不是靠運氣。聰明的人從錯誤中學習，了解問題的症狀，並在小問題變成大問題之前採取行動。

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: Use the 5 Whys — the loose bolt is a symptom, not the root cause.
qa.zh: 用五問法追下去——螺絲鬆動只是症狀，不是根本原因。

qa.en: D4: "Operator carelessness" is a symptom, not a root cause. Please continue the why-why: why was the wrong bolt available at the station, and why did the final check not detect it?
qa.zh: D4：「人員疏忽」是表象，不是根因。請繼續 why-why：錯的螺栓為什麼會出現在工作站？終檢為什麼沒攔下來？

qa.en: Why-why analysis should reach the systemic cause behind the operator error.
qa.zh: why-why 要追到人員疏失背後的系統性原因。

qa.en: Measure the spindle speed with the tachometer.
qa.zh: 用轉速計量測主軸轉速。

words.definition: The moment a plane leaves the ground.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Please fasten your seat belt before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請繫好安全帶。

general.en: Please put your seat in the upright position for takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛時請把椅背調到直立位置。

general.en: Please fold up your tray table before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請將小桌板收起。

general.en: No problem, I'll find space a few rows back. Also, please close your tray table before takeoff.
general.zh: 沒問題，我幫您找後面幾排的空位。另外，起飛前請把小桌板收起來。

general.en: Got it. Could I have a blanket after takeoff? It's a bit cold in the cabin.
general.zh: 了解。起飛後可以給我一條毯子嗎？客艙裡有點冷。

general.en: Please keep your window shade open during takeoff and landing.
general.zh: 起飛和降落時請保持遮光板打開。

words.definition: Natural skill or ability.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: Our company's banquet always includes a fun talent show where employees can sing or dance.
general.zh: 我們公司的尾牙總是有一個有趣的才藝表演，讓員工可以唱歌或跳舞。

general.en: Sometimes. But the actor is nothing like him. Hugh Laurie is incredibly talented.
general.zh: 有時候啦。不過演員本人跟他完全不一樣。Hugh Laurie 非常有才華。

general.en: Talented how? I only know him from the show.
general.zh: 哪方面有才華？我只從那部戲認識他。

general.en: He has a great talent for music.
general.zh: 他很有音樂天賦。

general.en: Laurie is also a talented musician.
general.zh: 羅利也是位有才華的音樂家。

general.en: Like Dr. House, Laurie is also a talented musician and is passionate about the blues. He recently went to New Orleans to record an album in which he plays 15 of his favorite songs. But of course, he doesn't think that people will like it.
general.zh: 和豪斯醫生一樣，羅利也是位才華洋溢的音樂家，並且熱愛藍調。他最近去了紐奧良錄製一張專輯，收錄了他最喜愛的 15 首歌。但他當然還是覺得大家不會喜歡。

words.definition: an event where people perform skills like singing or dancing in front of an audience
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: Our company's banquet always includes a fun talent show where employees can sing or dance.
general.zh: 我們公司的尾牙總是有一個有趣的才藝表演，讓員工可以唱歌或跳舞。

words.definition: Very good at doing something.
words.lesson: 20260730 作業複習、樂觀悲觀與 Hugh Laurie

general.en: Sometimes. But the actor is nothing like him. Hugh Laurie is incredibly talented.
general.zh: 有時候啦。不過演員本人跟他完全不一樣。Hugh Laurie 非常有才華。

general.en: Talented how? I only know him from the show.
general.zh: 哪方面有才華？我只從那部戲認識他。

general.en: Laurie is also a talented musician.
general.zh: 羅利也是位有才華的音樂家。

general.en: You are talented and smart.
general.zh: 你很有才華而且聰明。

general.en: Like Dr. House, Laurie is also a talented musician and is passionate about the blues. He recently went to New Orleans to record an album in which he plays 15 of his favorite songs. But of course, he doesn't think that people will like it.
general.zh: 和豪斯醫生一樣，羅利也是位才華洋溢的音樂家，並且熱愛藍調。他最近去了紐奧良錄製一張專輯，收錄了他最喜愛的 15 首歌。但他當然還是覺得大家不會喜歡。

words.definition: to discuss a problem completely to find a solution.

general.en: We talk things out and make sure that we're on the same page.
general.zh: 我們把事情說開，確保彼此想法一致。

words.definition: The hard ground where planes park.

general.en: We walked on the tarmac to board the plane.
general.zh: 我們走過停機坪登機。

words.definition: a building where people go to pray to a god or gods.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: During the New Year holiday, people like to visit temples to pray for a good year.
general.zh: 人們會去寺廟祈福，並拜訪親友互道新年快樂。

words.definition: A person who pays rent to live in a building owned by someone else.

general.en: The tenant must give one month's notice before moving out.
general.zh: 房客必須在搬出前一個月通知房東。

general.en: A message was later sent to every tenant.
general.zh: 後來有一則訊息發給每位房客。

general.en: These improvements had to be paid for by the tenants.
general.zh: 這些改善的費用必須由房客來分攤。

general.en: I don't want a dispute with a good tenant. If I delay, the damage only gets worse.
general.zh: 我不想和好房客起糾紛。我要是拖延，損害只會更嚴重。

general.en: Not at all. A tenant pays the rent; the landlord maintains the building.
general.zh: 完全不用。房客付房租，房東負責維護房子。

general.en: Most tenants never look at it again.
general.zh: 大多數房客再也不會去看它一眼。

words.definition: to often do a certain thing or behave in a certain way
words.lesson: 20260203 面試與尾牙總結 Interview & Banquet

general.en: Patients tend to leave out their current medicines.
general.zh: 病人往往會漏講自己目前在吃的藥。

general.en: Older adults tend to be more vulnerable to seasonal viruses.
general.zh: 年長者往往比較容易受到季節性病毒影響。

general.en: Frequent travelers tend to build small routines — a backup charger, offline documents, that sort of thing.
general.zh: 常出差的人往往會建立一些小習慣——備用充電器、離線的文件，諸如此類。

general.en: Older adults and people with chronic illness tend to be more vulnerable, especially if they haven't been vaccinated.
general.zh: 年長者和慢性病患者往往比較容易受影響，尤其是還沒接種疫苗的人。

general.en: Wool sweaters tend to shrink in hot water.
general.zh: 羊毛衣在熱水中容易縮水。

general.en: Tom tends to snore when he's exhausted.
general.zh: 湯姆精疲力竭時傾向於/容易打呼。

words.definition: A destructive test that pulls a specimen until it breaks, to measure tensile strength, yield strength, and elongation.

qa.en: The requirement is a minimum of 370 megapascals, verified by tensile test on every incoming material lot.
qa.zh: 要求最少 370 MPa，每批進料都做拉伸試驗。

qa.en: Tensile testing is performed on every incoming material lot, and the mill certificate is cross-checked against our own test result.
qa.zh: 每批進料都做拉伸，材證跟我們自己測的結果會互相對。

qa.en: We run tensile tests on incoming steel tube and on welded joints. The specimen is prepared per the standard, and the result is compared against the material specification on the drawing.
qa.zh: 進料鋼管跟焊接接頭會做拉伸。試片照標準做，結果跟圖面的材質規格比。

words.definition: extremely frightened — much stronger than scared; don't say 'very terrified'

general.en: I was terrified of lizards before I knew they were safe.
general.zh: 在我知道壁虎是無害的之前，我非常怕牠們。

general.en: I was terrified because I had lost my passport.
general.zh: 我嚇壞了，因為我弄丟了護照。

general.en: I was terrified of home lizards before I learned they are safe.
general.zh: 在我知道壁虎（居家蜥蜴）是安全無害的之前，我非常怕牠們。（💡 home lizard 指非毒性的居家小蜥蜴；標準英文中壁虎最常被稱為 house gecko /ˈhaʊs ˈɡɛko/。）

general.en: I passed the test, which was very encouraging.
general.zh: 我通過了測驗，這非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: I passed the English test, which was very encouraging.
general.zh: 我通過了英文測驗，這非常令人鼓舞。

general.en: One of its own products had failed an internal carcinogen test.
general.zh: 公司一項產品未通過內部的致癌物檢測。

general.en: I felt nervous before the test.
general.zh: 考試前我覺得很緊張。

general.en: Q: How do you check product quality? I test the equipment and inspect the dimensions carefully. If I find a problem, I investigate the cause and discuss it with the team.
general.zh: Q: 你如何檢查產品品質？ 我會測試設備並仔細檢查尺寸。如果發現問題，我會調查原因並與團隊討論。

qa.en: The escape point is our final inspection — the noise test was not performed on this exercise bike model.
qa.zh: 流出點在我們的最終檢驗 —— 這個飛輪車機種沒有做噪音測試。

qa.en: We use dye penetrant testing on the welded frame — it is a non-destructive test.
qa.zh: 我們對焊接車架做滲透探傷，這是非破壞性檢測。

qa.en: The squat rack passed the static load test at 300 kilograms.
qa.zh: 深蹲架通過 300 公斤靜態負載測試。

qa.en: Why is the sample size for this test so small?
qa.zh: 這個試驗的樣本數為什麼這麼少？

qa.en: This is a destructive test, so we use a special inspection level, S-2. The sample size is smaller, but we still test every lot.
qa.zh: 這是破壞性測試，所以用特殊檢驗水準 S-2。件數比較少，但每批都做。

qa.en: We use general level II as the default, tighten to level III for a new supplier or after a quality issue, and use special levels S-1 to S-4 for destructive or costly tests.
qa.zh: 平常用一般水準 II；新供應商或出過問題就加嚴到 III；破壞性或很貴的測試改用特殊水準 S-1～S-4。

qa.en: The document reporting the test conditions, the actual results, and the judgement, issued in-house or by an accredited laboratory.
qa.zh: 寫著測試條件、實測結果跟判定的文件，廠內或有認證的實驗室出的。

qa.en: The test condition is 40 °C and 90 % relative humidity.
qa.zh: 測試條件為 40 °C、相對濕度 90%。

qa.en: Each requirement needs a test method and an acceptance criterion.
qa.zh: 每一條要求都要有測法跟允收基準。

qa.en: We would like to propose a test method for your approval.
qa.zh: 我們想提一個測試方法給您確認。

qa.en: Which test method and revision was used for this salt spray test?
qa.zh: 這次鹽霧測試用的是哪個方法、哪一版？

qa.en: The laboratory is accredited, but this test method is not within its scope of accreditation, so we cannot accept the report as accredited evidence.
qa.zh: 實驗室是有認證，但這個測試方法不在它的認證範圍內，所以我們沒辦法把報告當認證證據收。

qa.en: This requirement does not have a test method or an acceptance criterion yet, so we cannot confirm compliance. May we propose one for your approval?
qa.zh: 這條目前沒有測試方法跟允收基準，我們沒辦法確認做不做得到。可以由我們提一個方案給您確認嗎？

qa.en: We have reviewed it line by line. Most requirements are clear. Three lines do not yet have a test method or an acceptance criterion, so we cannot confirm compliance against them.
qa.zh: 我們已經一條一條看過了。大部分都很清楚，但有三條還沒有測試方法跟允收基準，這樣我們沒辦法確認做不做得到。

general.en: I need to submit my test report to my clients.
general.zh: 我需要把測試報告交給客戶。

general.en: Her goal is to finish the test report by today.
general.zh: 她的目標是在今天之內完成測試報告。

qa.en: All test reports state the test standard, the conditions, the actual results, and the accreditation status of the laboratory.
qa.zh: 所有測試報告都寫清楚測試標準、條件、實測結果，還有實驗室的認證狀態。

qa.en: A typical submission includes the dimensional results, material and performance test reports, the control plan, the PFMEA, the process flow, and the sample parts.
qa.zh: 通常會交尺寸報告、材質跟性能測試報告、管制計畫、PFMEA、製程流程圖，再加樣品。

qa.en: Salt spray testing is performed on every production lot of coated parts, and the chamber conditions are recorded and retained with the test report.
qa.zh: 塗裝件每批量產都做鹽霧，鹽霧箱的條件也跟報告一起記下來存。

qa.en: If an accreditation mark on an incoming test report changes, ask the supplier for a written explanation and file it with the report.
qa.zh: 進來的測試報告上認證標誌變了，就跟供應商要一份書面說明，跟報告放一起歸檔。

qa.en: We will submit the dimensional inspection report covering all drawing dimensions, the material certificate, the performance test reports, the process flow chart, the PFMEA, and the control plan, together with three sample parts.
qa.zh: 我們會交圖面全尺寸的檢驗報告、材質證明、性能測試報告、製程流程圖、PFMEA 跟管制計畫，再附三件樣品。

qa.en: The routine durability test is done in our own reliability lab. The safety certification test is done by an accredited third-party laboratory, and I can provide the test report with the laboratory accreditation number.
qa.zh: 例行耐久測試我們自己的可靠度實驗室做；安全認證測試送有認證的第三方實驗室，報告上有實驗室認證編號，我可以提供。

qa.en: We check the hardness with a hardness tester.
qa.zh: 我們用硬度計量硬度。

qa.en: Measure the case depth with the Vickers hardness tester.
qa.zh: 用維克氏硬度機量測硬化層深度。

qa.en: Test the shaft hardness on the Rockwell hardness tester.
qa.zh: 在洛氏硬度計上測試軸的硬度。

qa.en: Check the shaft runout on the runout tester.
qa.zh: 在偏擺檢測儀上檢查軸的偏擺。

qa.en: Put the sample in the UV aging tester for 72 hours.
qa.zh: 將樣品放入耐黃變試驗機 72 小時。

qa.en: Torque wrenches on the line are calibrated daily with a torque tester. QA re-checks critical fasteners with a marked-line audit — the mark must not move under the specified check torque.
qa.zh: 線上的扭力扳手每天用扭力計校。關鍵螺栓品保用劃線複檢：用規定的複檢扭力去帶，線不能動。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

general.en: Testing found a concentration well above the legal ceiling of 2 micrograms.
general.zh: 檢測發現濃度遠超過每公斤2微克的法定上限。

general.en: Something has shifted in how the team approaches testing.
general.zh: 這個團隊處理測試的方式，已經有了轉變。

general.en: It was caused by weak controls over raw materials and not enough testing before products left the factory.
general.zh: 而是原料控管不足，加上產品出廠前檢驗不夠所造成的。

general.en: My main responsibilities include inspecting and testing fitness equipment.
general.zh: 我的主要職責包括檢查與測試健身器材。

general.en: Inspecting and testing fitness equipment to ensure it meets quality standards.
general.zh: 檢查與測試健身器材，以確保產品符合品質標準。

qa.en: We use dye penetrant testing on the welded frame — it is a non-destructive test.
qa.zh: 我們對焊接車架做滲透探傷，這是非破壞性檢測。

qa.en: Corrosion resistance is verified by neutral salt spray testing per ASTM B117 for the specified duration.
qa.zh: 耐蝕性照 ASTM B117 做中性鹽霧，做到規定的小時數。

qa.en: Coating adhesion is verified by cross-hatch testing with a class 5B acceptance criterion.
qa.zh: 附著力用百格驗，允收標準 5B。

qa.en: Hardness testing is our verification of the heat treatment result for every incoming lot of heat-treated parts.
qa.zh: 每批熱處理件進來，我們都用硬度來驗熱處理有沒有做到位。

qa.en: Tensile testing is performed on every incoming material lot, and the mill certificate is cross-checked against our own test result.
qa.zh: 每批進料都做拉伸，材證跟我們自己測的結果會互相對。

qa.en: Salt spray testing is performed on every production lot of coated parts, and the chamber conditions are recorded and retained with the test report.
qa.zh: 塗裝件每批量產都做鹽霧，鹽霧箱的條件也跟報告一起記下來存。

qa.en: The thermal shock test runs from -40 °C to 85 °C.
qa.zh: 熱衝擊測試由 -40 °C 到 85 °C。

qa.en: Before we trust the new thickness gauge, please run a measurement system analysis.
qa.zh: 在信任這台新膜厚計之前，請先做量測系統分析。

qa.en: The thickness of the cured coating film, measured on the finished part in microns.
qa.zh: 成品上塗膜烤乾後的厚度，用微米量。

qa.en: What is the coating thickness, and where do you measure it?
qa.zh: 膜厚是多少？你們在哪裡量？

qa.en: We measure the paint thickness with a thickness gauge.
qa.zh: 我們用膜厚計量塗裝厚度。

qa.en: Dry film thickness is measured at defined positions and recorded on the process control sheet.
qa.zh: 乾膜厚在指定位置量，記在製程管制表上。

qa.en: The specified dry film thickness is 60 to 100 microns. We measure five fixed points per part, including the inside corners, and every single point must meet the minimum.
qa.zh: 規格乾膜厚 60～100 微米。每件量五個固定點，內角也算，每一點都要到最小值。

qa.en: Use the fillet weld gauge to check the throat thickness.
qa.zh: 用角焊規檢查焊喉厚度。

qa.en: The inner surface has low film thickness because of poor throwing power.
qa.zh: 內部表面膜厚不足，是因為泳透力不佳。

words.definition: 伴隨雷電的強烈暴風雨

general.en: Because of the thunderstorm, the power went out for hours.
general.zh: 因為雷雨的關係，停電了好幾個小時。

general.en: She was scared to death during the thunderstorm.
general.zh: 打雷下雨時，她被嚇得要死。

general.en: I checked it this morning. The forecast says heavy rain, with a thunderstorm in the afternoon.
general.zh: 我今天早上看過了。預報說會下大雨，下午還有雷雨。

general.en: A thunderstorm in the mountains sounds dangerous.
general.zh: 在山上遇到雷雨聽起來很危險。

general.en: Agreed. If there's a thunderstorm warning, we'll go to the museum instead.
general.zh: 同意。如果有雷雨警報，我們就改去博物館。

general.en: Thunderstorms always scare me.
general.zh: 雷雨總是嚇到我。

general.en: I'd like a one-way train ticket to Berlin.
general.zh: 我想要一張到柏林的單程火車票。

general.en: I'd like a single business class ticket.
general.zh: 我想要一張單程商務艙機票。

general.en: The ticket counter is next to platform 3.
general.zh: 售票櫃檯在3號月台旁邊。

general.en: Can I get a return ticket to Munich?
general.zh: 我可以買一張到慕尼黑的來回票嗎？

general.en: One ticket to Berlin, please.
general.zh: 請給我一張到柏林的票。

general.en: Where is the ticket counter?
general.zh: 售票櫃檯在哪裡？

words.definition: The place at a station or airport where you buy tickets.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: The ticket counter is next to platform 3.
general.zh: 售票櫃檯在3號月台旁邊。

general.en: Excuse me, is this the ticket counter for the express trains?
general.zh: 不好意思，這裡是快車的售票櫃檯嗎？

general.en: It is. You're at the right ticket counter. Where are you going today?
general.zh: 是的，你找對售票櫃檯了。你今天要去哪裡？

general.en: I'd like to book a ticket, please. Where is the ticket counter?
general.zh: 我想要訂一張票，請問售票櫃檯在哪裡？

general.en: The ticket counter is over there, next to platform 3.
general.zh: 售票櫃檯在那邊，在 3 號月台旁邊。

general.en: Where is the ticket counter?
general.zh: 售票櫃檯在哪裡？

words.definition: a time limit that does not give you much time to finish your work.

general.en: Sometimes I face tight deadlines, but I stay calm and focus on solving problems step by step.
general.zh: 有時候時程很緊，但我會保持冷靜，一步一步解決問題。

general.en: Yes, especially during product launches. Sometimes I face tight deadlines, but I stay calm and focus on solving problems step by step.
general.zh: 有，尤其是在產品上市期間。有時候時程很緊，但我會保持冷靜，一步一步解決問題。

words.definition: A flat, hard piece used to cover floors, walls, or roofs.

general.en: What would you do if a ceiling tile fell off at your home?
general.zh: 如果你家的天花板磁磚掉下來，你會怎麼做？

general.en: One of the ceiling tiles came off in my apartment.
general.zh: 我公寓裡的一片天花板磁磚掉落了。

general.en: We need to replace the cracked tiles on the wall.
general.zh: 我們需要更換牆上裂開的磁磚。

general.en: Some of the wall tiles were cracked.
general.zh: 有些牆壁磁磚已經裂開了。

qa.en: Calibrate the spectrophotometer with the white tile first.
qa.zh: 先用白板校正色差計。

qa.en: Protect the reliability test duration — it is the only test that catches time-dependent failures.
qa.zh: 可靠度測試的時間要守住——只有它抓得到跑久了才出現的失效。

qa.en: Hinge wear is a time-dependent failure that verification cannot catch.
qa.zh: 鉸鏈磨耗是跑久了才出現的失效，驗證測試抓不到。

words.definition: A list showing when trains, buses, or planes arrive and leave.
words.lesson: 20260701 假設語氣與火車購票英文

general.en: Munich. I looked at the timetable online, but I couldn't tell which train is fastest.
general.zh: 慕尼黑。我在網路上看過時刻表，但我看不出來哪一班最快。

general.en: The timetable changed on Monday, so that's normal. The 9:40 gets you there in three hours.
general.zh: 時刻表星期一改過了，所以這很正常。九點四十那班三個小時就到。

general.en: Excuse me, what time is the next train? I need the train timetable.
general.zh: 不好意思，下一班火車是幾點？我需要火車時刻表。

general.en: I checked the flight timetable carefully.
general.zh: a schedule showing flight times（顯示航班時間的時刻表）

general.en: Before buying the ticket, I checked the flight timetable carefully to make sure the departure and arrival times matched my travel schedule.
general.zh: 在買票之前，我仔細查看了航班時刻表，以確保起飛和抵達的時間符合我的旅行行程。

general.en: I need the train timetable.
general.zh: 我需要火車時刻表。

words.definition: -ed adjective: describes how a person feels

general.en: I'm too tired to go out. Let's make an excuse and stay at home.
general.zh: 我太累了，不想出去。咱們找個藉口待在家吧。

general.en: I was so tired that I slept like a log all night.
general.zh: 我太累了，整晚睡得像木頭一樣沉。

general.en: It was obvious that she was tired after the long trip.
general.zh: 很明顯地，長途旅行後她感到疲倦。

general.en: Yesterday I was very tired. I had a headache and my throat hurt.
general.zh: 昨天我很累。我頭痛，喉嚨也很痛。

general.en: Mei works in an office and spends about nine hours a day in front of a screen. She often feels tired by three o'clock, and her eyes usually hurt at the end of the day.
general.zh: Mei 在辦公室工作，每天大約有九個小時面對螢幕。她常常到三點就覺得累，眼睛通常在一天結束時會不舒服。

general.en: I feel tired after work.
general.zh: 下班後我覺得很疲憊。

words.translation: 令人疲憊的（事物的特質）
words.definition: -ing adjective: describes what makes you feel tired

general.en: Humid weather makes hiking so tiring. I start sweating after five minutes.
general.zh: 潮濕的天氣讓爬山特別累，我走五分鐘就開始流汗。

general.en: On the one hand, household chores are tiring; on the other hand, they keep the home clean and comfortable.
general.zh: 一方面，做家務很累；另一方面，它們能保持家裡整潔舒適。

general.en: It was tiring because there were many people.
general.zh: 因為那裡人很多，所以很累。（存在句型：描述「有」多少人時，一定要用 There is/are；原句 they were 會變成「他們是很多人」，語意不通。）

general.en: Taking care of a baby is a tiring job.
general.zh: 照顧嬰兒是一份令人疲勞的工作。

general.en: The long meeting was tiring.
general.zh: 這場漫長的會議很累人。

general.en: Joining many meetings is tiring.
general.zh: 參加很多會議是很累人的。

words.translation: （颱風、颶風）登陸（較正式的說法）
words.definition: 暴風系統從海上移動到陸地

general.en: The hurricane is projected to make landfall tomorrow morning.
general.zh: 颶風預計明天早上登陸。

general.en: It was not expected to make landfall in Taiwan.
general.zh: 預計不會在台灣登陸。

qa.en: How do you measure the geometric tolerances on this frame?
qa.zh: 這個機架的幾何公差你們怎麼量？

qa.en: Geometric tolerances are verified on the CMM against the datum scheme specified on the drawing.
qa.zh: 幾何公差用三次元、照圖面指定的基準來驗。

qa.en: The controlled documents that define the required dimensions, tolerances, materials, and acceptance criteria of the product.
qa.zh: 定產品尺寸、公差、材質跟允收標準的管制文件。

qa.en: If an instrument is found out of tolerance at calibration, we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured with it since the previous calibration.
qa.zh: 如果校驗時發現儀器超差，上次校驗之後用它量過的產品，我們會全部回頭追。

qa.en: Is this dimension within tolerance?
qa.zh: 這個尺寸在公差內嗎？

qa.en: We use the CMM for first article inspection, for geometric tolerances such as flatness, position and profile, and for any dimension that cannot be measured reliably with hand tools.
qa.zh: 首件、平面度／位置度／輪廓度這些幾何公差，還有手工量具量不準的尺寸，都上三次元。

qa.en: Action: offer options — a different process, a tolerance query to the customer, or a quotation that includes the sorting cost.
qa.zh: 行動：給幾個選項——換製程、跟客戶問公差能不能放寬、或把挑選成本算進報價。

qa.en: We raised a tolerance query on the hole position before quoting.
qa.zh: 報價之前我們先問了客戶孔位公差能不能放寬。

qa.en: Tool wear made the diameter drift out of tolerance.
qa.zh: 刀具磨耗造成直徑漂移超出公差。

qa.en: How do you control tool wear?
qa.zh: 刀具磨耗你們怎麼管控？

qa.en: If the process includes a topcoat, the primer first article inspection may be waived.
qa.zh: 若製程包含面漆作業，可免進行底漆首件檢驗。

words.definition: to fall or cause something to fall over

general.en: Strong winds caused trees to topple during the storm.
general.zh: 強風導致樹木在暴風中傾倒。

general.en: The storm could topple the bridge if it becomes stronger.
general.zh: To fall over or make something fall over.（失去平衡倒下）

general.en: Strong winds toppled many trees during the typhoon.
general.zh: 颱風期間強風吹倒了許多樹木。

general.en: Trees and statues toppled.
general.zh: 樹木和雕像傾倒。

words.definition: a fast-rotating column of air that extends from a storm cloud to the ground

general.en: A tornado warning has been issued — let's take shelter immediately.
general.zh: 龍捲風警報已發布——我們立刻去避難吧。

general.en: The sirens went off when a tornado was approaching the city.
general.zh: 當龍捲風接近城市時，警報聲響起。

general.en: A tornado is a fast-rotating column of air from the cloud to the ground.
general.zh: 龍捲風是一個從雲層到地面的快速旋轉空氣柱。

general.en: Let's go inside, I think a tornado might hit this area.
general.zh: 我們進去吧，我覺得龍捲風可能會襲擊這一帶。

general.en: The siren went off, so everyone ran to shelter from the tornado.
general.zh: 警報響了，大家都跑去躲避龍捲風。

general.en: A tornado warning has been issued.
general.zh: 龍捲風警報已經發布。

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: Verifying that a threaded joint is tightened to the specified torque value.
qa.zh: 確認螺絲有沒有鎖到規定的扭力。

qa.en: How do you control the tightening torque on safety-critical bolts?
qa.zh: 安全關鍵螺栓的鎖付扭力你們怎麼管控？

qa.en: We check the bolts with a torque wrench.
qa.zh: 我們用扭力扳手檢查螺栓。

qa.en: Torque wrenches on the line are calibrated daily with a torque tester. QA re-checks critical fasteners with a marked-line audit — the mark must not move under the specified check torque.
qa.zh: 線上的扭力扳手每天用扭力計校。關鍵螺栓品保用劃線複檢：用規定的複檢扭力去帶，線不能動。

qa.en: The torque wrench is set and calibrated daily, the operator marks each tightened bolt, and QA performs a torque audit on every unit for safety-critical joints. The result is recorded per serial number.
qa.zh: 扭力扳手每天設定跟校驗，作業員每鎖完一支螺栓就劃線，安全相關的鎖點品保一台一台驗扭力，結果照序號記。

words.definition: Verifying that a threaded joint is tightened to the specified torque value.

qa.en: A loose bolt is the symptom; the root cause is that the torque wrench had not been calibrated.
qa.zh: 螺絲鬆是現象；根本原因是扭力扳手沒有校驗。

qa.en: We check the bolts with a torque wrench.
qa.zh: 我們用扭力扳手檢查螺栓。

qa.en: Tighten the bolt to 25 N·m with the torque wrench.
qa.zh: 用扭力扳手將螺栓鎖至 25 N·m。

qa.en: Release the torque wrench to its lowest setting after use.
qa.zh: 使用後將扭力扳手歸到最低刻度。

qa.en: Torque wrenches on the line are calibrated daily with a torque tester. QA re-checks critical fasteners with a marked-line audit — the mark must not move under the specified check torque.
qa.zh: 線上的扭力扳手每天用扭力計校。關鍵螺栓品保用劃線複檢：用規定的複檢扭力去帶，線不能動。

qa.en: The torque wrench is set and calibrated daily, the operator marks each tightened bolt, and QA performs a torque audit on every unit for safety-critical joints. The result is recorded per serial number.
qa.zh: 扭力扳手每天設定跟校驗，作業員每鎖完一支螺栓就劃線，安全相關的鎖點品保一台一台驗扭力，結果照序號記。

words.definition: to keep turning your body in bed because you cannot sleep

general.en: I tossed and turned all night and still didn't fall asleep.
general.zh: 我整晚翻來覆去還是睡不著。

qa.en: Check the total alkalinity of the degreasing solution.
qa.zh: 請檢查脫脂劑的全鹼度濃度。

qa.en: For safety-critical joints we apply 100% torque audit with traceability to the serial number.
qa.zh: 安全相關的鎖點 100% 驗扭力，追得到產品序號。

qa.en: We need full traceability of which lots used the new material.
qa.zh: 我們要能完整追到哪些批次用了新材料。

qa.en: Add a downstream protection: flag the lot for first-article check at the line and traceability marking.
qa.zh: 後面再加一道保護：這批上線做首件確認，批次也標起來方便追溯。

qa.en: The first article inspection report covers all dimensions on the drawing and is retained as part of the production record for traceability.
qa.zh: 首件報告圖面上每個尺寸都有，會跟生產紀錄一起存，之後要追都追得到。

qa.en: The instrument is withdrawn from use and we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured since its previous valid calibration.
qa.zh: 儀器馬上收起來不用，上次有效校驗之後量過的產品全部回頭追。

qa.en: If an instrument is found out of tolerance at calibration, we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured with it since the previous calibration.
qa.zh: 如果校驗時發現儀器超差，上次校驗之後用它量過的產品，我們會全部回頭追。

qa.en: Comparing an instrument against a traceable reference standard at a defined interval and recording the result.
qa.zh: 照規定週期，拿儀器跟可追溯的標準件比對，把結果記下來。

qa.en: Measuring instruments are calibrated at defined intervals with results traceable to national standards.
qa.zh: 量測儀器照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。

qa.en: Reports are traceable to the lot number, the inspector, and the instrument used, so any result can be reconstructed if needed.
qa.zh: 報告追得到批號、檢驗員跟用的儀器，任何一筆結果要查都查得回來。

qa.en: Calibration intervals are defined by instrument type and usage frequency, and all results are traceable to national standards.
qa.zh: 校驗週期看儀器種類跟用多頻繁，結果都可追溯到國家標準。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

qa.en: Every report shows the specification, the actual value, and the judgement — not just OK/NG. Reports are traceable to the lot number and retained per the document control procedure.
qa.zh: 每份報告都有規格、實測值跟判定，不是只寫 OK／NG。報告追得到批號，照文件管制程序保存。

qa.en: Measuring instruments are calibrated at defined intervals with results traceable to national standards.
qa.zh: 量測儀器照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。

qa.en: Reports are traceable to the lot number, the inspector, and the instrument used, so any result can be reconstructed if needed.
qa.zh: 報告追得到批號、檢驗員跟用的儀器，任何一筆結果要查都查得回來。

qa.en: Calibration intervals are defined by instrument type and usage frequency, and all results are traceable to national standards.
qa.zh: 校驗週期看儀器種類跟用多頻繁，結果都可追溯到國家標準。

qa.en: Retention periods are defined in our document control procedure, and the records are traceable to the lot number and the inspector.
qa.zh: 保存年限照文件管制程序，紀錄追得到批號跟檢驗員。

qa.en: All measuring instruments are calibrated at a defined interval by an accredited external laboratory, and the results are traceable to national standards. Each instrument carries a calibration label showing its status and due date.
qa.zh: 所有量測儀器都送有認證的外部實驗室，照週期校驗，結果可追溯到國家標準。每台都貼標籤，看得到校驗狀態跟到期日。

qa.en: Every report shows the specification, the actual value, and the judgement — not just OK/NG. Reports are traceable to the lot number and retained per the document control procedure.
qa.zh: 每份報告都有規格、實測值跟判定，不是只寫 OK／NG。報告追得到批號，照文件管制程序保存。

words.definition: A custom or belief passed down from older to younger generations.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: It is a family tradition to eat together on Sundays.
general.zh: 週日一起吃飯是家裡的傳統。

general.en: People celebrate with traditions that bring hope and happiness.
general.zh: 假期間拜廟與探親，象徵希望與幸福。

general.en: It's similar to a company Christmas party, but with Chinese food and Lunar New Year traditions.
general.zh: （給外國同事最好理解的一句）有點像公司的聖誕派對，但吃的是中式料理，並帶有農曆新年的傳統。

general.en: A tradition is something people do for a long time.
general.zh: 傳統是人們長期以來一直在做的事。

general.en: It's a tradition in Taiwan.
general.zh: 這是台灣的傳統。

general.en: The festival takes place in spring, so some families also enjoy the nice weather and go for a walk in the countryside. It is a meaningful tradition that helps people stay connected to their family and culture.
general.zh: 這個節日發生在春天，所以有些家庭也會享受好天氣，並到鄉下散步。這是一個有意義的傳統，能幫助人們與他們的家人和文化保持聯繫。

words.definition: to teach a person or animal a particular skill through regular practice.
words.lesson: 20260224 面試與未來目標 Interview & Future Goals

general.en: We effectively trained operators to reduce cosmetic defects.
general.zh: 我們有效地培訓作業員，以降低外觀缺陷。

general.en: I'd like a one-way train ticket to Berlin.
general.zh: 我想要一張到柏林的單程火車票。

general.en: Please make sure you have all your personal belongings before leaving the train.
general.zh: 下車前請確認你帶齊所有隨身物品。

general.en: I need the train timetable.
general.zh: 我需要火車時刻表。

general.en: Daniel had an important meeting in Taichung, so he booked a ticket for the 7:40 train. He usually arrives early, but that morning everything went wrong.
general.zh: Daniel 在台中有一場重要的會議，所以他訂了 7 點 40 分的火車票。他平常都會提早到，但那天早上一切都出錯了。

general.en: He reached the platform at 7:42. The train was gone. A station worker told him that the next train would leave in fifty minutes. Daniel sat down, took a deep breath, and sent his manager a short message: "I am going to be late. I am sorry."
general.zh: 他 7 點 42 分抵達月台。火車已經開走了。一位站務人員告訴他，下一班車五十分鐘後才發車。Daniel 坐下來，深呼吸，並傳了一則簡短訊息給主管：「我會遲到，很抱歉。」

qa.en: Training addresses the person, not the process. What physical control prevents the next operator from making the same mistake?
qa.zh: 訓練處理的是人，不是製程。有什麼實體的管制，能擋住下一個人犯一樣的錯？

qa.en: Re-training is not a corrective action for a mixing error; error-proofing is.
qa.zh: 混料問題，訓練不是矯正措施，防呆才是。

qa.en: This answer is not enough. Training people is not a real fix for a mixing problem.
qa.zh: 這個答案不夠。混料問題靠訓練解決不了。

qa.en: We are strengthening our quality culture through regular shop-floor training.
qa.zh: 我們靠定期的現場教育訓練來加強品質文化。

qa.en: D5: Re-training does not prevent recurrence for a mixing error. We expect an error-proofing action, such as dedicated bins for each bolt length and a weight count-check before sealing.
qa.zh: D5：混料問題，重新訓練防不了再發。我們要的是防呆對策，例如每種長度的螺栓用專用料盒、封箱前秤重點數。

qa.en: Connected fitness equipment increasingly ships with AI features — form detection, adaptive training, camera-based safety stops. If a feature is safety-related, it can pull the whole product into the high-risk category.
qa.zh: 聯網健身器材越來越常帶 AI 功能：姿勢辨識、自適應訓練、鏡頭安全停機。只要功能跟安全有關，就可能把整台機器拉進高風險那一類。

general.en: Every new employee gets two days of training.
general.zh: 每位新員工都會接受兩天的訓練。

general.en: The company provides safety procedure training for new workers.
general.zh: 公司為新員工提供安全流程訓練。

qa.en: Training addresses the person, not the process. What physical control prevents the next operator from making the same mistake?
qa.zh: 訓練處理的是人，不是製程。有什麼實體的管制，能擋住下一個人犯一樣的錯？

qa.en: Re-training is not a corrective action for a mixing error; error-proofing is.
qa.zh: 混料問題，訓練不是矯正措施，防呆才是。

qa.en: This answer is not enough. Training people is not a real fix for a mixing problem.
qa.zh: 這個答案不夠。混料問題靠訓練解決不了。

qa.en: We are strengthening our quality culture through regular shop-floor training.
qa.zh: 我們靠定期的現場教育訓練來加強品質文化。

qa.en: D5: Re-training does not prevent recurrence for a mixing error. We expect an error-proofing action, such as dedicated bins for each bolt length and a weight count-check before sealing.
qa.zh: D5：混料問題，重新訓練防不了再發。我們要的是防呆對策，例如每種長度的螺栓用專用料盒、封箱前秤重點數。

qa.en: Connected fitness equipment increasingly ships with AI features — form detection, adaptive training, camera-based safety stops. If a feature is safety-related, it can pull the whole product into the high-risk category.
qa.zh: 聯網健身器材越來越常帶 AI 功能：姿勢辨識、自適應訓練、鏡頭安全停機。只要功能跟安全有關，就可能把整台機器拉進高風險那一類。

qa.en: Keep the current ISO 9001:2015 certificate visible in customer documents — it stays valid through the transition.
qa.zh: 給客戶的文件上，現在的 ISO 9001:2015 證書照樣要放 —— 轉版期內它還是有效的。

qa.en: Our current certificate stays valid throughout the transition period.
qa.zh: 我們現在的證書整個轉版期都有效。

qa.en: Ask your certification body now for their transition schedule and audit availability — slots fill up from the publication date onwards.
qa.zh: 現在就去問驗證機構轉版時程和稽核檔期 —— 發布日一到，檔期就會開始被搶。

qa.en: The standard publishes on 16 September. Our current certificate stays valid, and we are waiting for the official transition arrangements before we commit to a date.
qa.zh: 時程題不要用「可能明年」回。講流程（已經問了誰、下一步做什麼、什麼時候書面回覆），不要承諾你控制不了的日期。

qa.en: Every certified factory will eventually have to transition. Customers and auditors usually start asking about readiness months before the transition deadline is even announced.
qa.zh: 有證書的工廠最後都要轉版。客戶和稽核員通常在轉版期限公布前幾個月，就會開始問你準備得怎樣了。

qa.en: The standard is scheduled for publication on 16 September. Our current certificate remains valid, and we are waiting for the official transition arrangements before we commit to a date.
qa.zh: 標準預計 9 月 16 日發布。我們現在的證書還是有效的，正式的轉版安排出來之前，我們不會先承諾日期。

qa.en: Our current certificate stays valid throughout the transition period.
qa.zh: 我們現在的證書整個轉版期都有效。

words.definition: Open and easy for people to understand.

general.en: The company made its refund policy more transparent.
general.zh: 公司讓退款政策更透明。

general.en: No, it makes us look transparent. Customers forgive mistakes. They don't forgive hiding.
general.zh: 不會，那會讓我們顯得公開透明。顧客可以原諒犯錯，但不會原諒隱瞞。

general.en: The company made its refund policy clearer and more transparent.
general.zh: 公司讓退款政策更清楚、更透明。

words.definition: to carry people or goods from one place to another

general.en: Food and supplies were transported to the disaster zone.
general.zh: 食物和物資被運送到災區。

general.en: Yes, a backup route has been suggested by the transport company.
general.zh: 有，運輸公司建議了一條替代路線。

general.en: Rent, transport, food, everything. I realized I spent almost sixty percent of my salary just on rent and daily costs in Taipei.
general.zh: 房租、交通、伙食、全部。我發現光是房租和台北的日常開銷就花掉我薪水的將近六成。

general.en: The company will transport goods from China to Europe.
general.zh: 這間公司將把貨物從中國運輸到歐洲。（transport... from A to B。）

general.en: A backup route through a nearby town has been suggested by the transport company, although it will add several hours to the journey.
general.zh: 運輸公司建議走附近一個小鎮的替代路線，雖然這會讓路程多花好幾個小時。

general.en: Around the world, roughly a third of the food that is produced every year is never eaten. Some of it is lost on farms, some is damaged during transport, and a surprising amount is simply thrown away in ordinary kitchens.
general.zh: 在全世界，每年生產的食物大約有三分之一從未被吃掉。有些在農場就損失了，有些在運送過程中受損，而令人意外的是，還有相當多是在普通家庭的廚房裡被直接丟掉。

qa.en: Run the vibration test for 60 minutes to simulate transport.
qa.zh: 執行 60 分鐘振動測試模擬運輸。

words.definition: unable to escape from a dangerous situation

general.en: Several residents were trapped inside buildings after the earthquake.
general.zh: 地震後，幾名居民被困在建築物內。

general.en: Firefighters went to search and rescue the trapped people.
general.zh: 消防員前去搜索並救出受困者。

general.en: Firefighters worked to rescue trapped people from the collapsed buildings.
general.zh: 消防員努力從倒塌建築物中救出受困者。

general.en: They rescued trapped people from under the collapsed building.
general.zh: 他們從倒塌的建築物下方救出受困者。（rescue + 受詞 + from under）

qa.en: The old oil left a residue that trapped moisture.
qa.zh: 舊的油留下一層殘留，反而把水氣悶在裡面。

words.definition: A person who helps people plan trips and buy tickets for travel.

general.en: A travel agent called to help me plan a short holiday.
general.zh: 一位旅行社代辦打電話來幫我計畫一個短暫的假期。

words.definition: The small folding table on the back of the seat in front of you.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Please fold up your tray table before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請將小桌板收起。

general.en: My tray table is broken; I can't unfold it.
general.zh: 我的小桌板壞了，打不開。

general.en: No problem, I'll find space a few rows back. Also, please close your tray table before takeoff.
general.zh: 沒問題，我幫您找後面幾排的空位。另外，起飛前請把小桌板收起來。

general.en: I've closed the tray table. Do I need to keep my seat upright too?
general.zh: 我已經收好小桌板了。椅背也需要保持直立嗎？

general.en: The tray table folds down from the seatback.
general.zh: 小桌板從前座椅背往下打開。

qa.en: As a containment action we sorted all treadmill frames in the warehouse and put the suspect lot on hold.
qa.zh: 作為圍堵措施，我們把倉庫裡所有跑步機機架全檢，並扣留可疑批次。

qa.en: We did a read-across and found the same bearing is used on two other treadmill models.
qa.zh: 我們做了水平展開，發現另外兩個跑步機機種也用同一顆軸承。

qa.en: We use sampling inspection for incoming bolts, but 100 % inspection for treadmill motors.
qa.zh: 進料螺絲採抽樣檢驗，但跑步機馬達採全檢。

qa.en: The lot size is 1,200 treadmills, so please pull the sample from three different pallets.
qa.zh: 這批批量是 1,200 台跑步機，請從三個不同棧板抽樣。

qa.en: We will run a PDCA cycle on the treadmill belt alignment problem this week.
qa.zh: 本週我們會針對跑帶偏移問題跑一輪 PDCA 循環。

qa.en: The first pass yield of the treadmill assembly line dropped from 96 % to 88 % last week.
qa.zh: 上週跑步機組裝線的一次通過率從 96% 掉到 88%。

words.definition: 為了治癒疾病或傷害而採取的醫療措施

general.en: Early treatment can help you recover faster.
general.zh: 及早治療可以幫助你更快康復。

general.en: It is arguably a form of medical treatment.
general.zh: 可以說它是一種醫療。

general.en: The operation is arguably a form of treatment rather than a luxury.
general.zh: 這個手術可以說是一種治療，而非奢侈。

general.en: Not a luxury but a treatment.
general.zh: 這不是奢侈的享受，而是一種治療。

general.en: Even with insurance, a simple hospital visit can cost hundreds of dollars. That is why many people in the USA worry about medical bills. Early treatment is important — but people sometimes wait because they are afraid of the cost.
general.zh: 即使有保險，一次簡單的就醫也可能花費數百美元。這就是為什麼許多美國人擔心醫療帳單。及早治療很重要——但有些人因為害怕費用而等待。

general.en: I got a Botox treatment.
general.zh: 我做了肉毒桿菌注射治療。

qa.en: Hardness testing is our verification of the heat treatment result for every incoming lot of heat-treated parts.
qa.zh: 每批熱處理件進來，我們都用硬度來驗熱處理有沒有做到位。

qa.en: All coating pre-treatment processes must follow the control parameters.
qa.zh: 塗裝前處理各項目必須依照管控參數執行。

qa.en: Please record the time interval from pre-treatment to spraying.
qa.zh: 請記錄前處理到噴塗的間隔時間。

qa.en: Yes. We verify the heat treatment by hardness test. The specification is HRC 45 to 50, and we take three readings per part on the specified surface.
qa.zh: 有。熱處理我們用硬度來驗。規格 HRC 45～50，每件在指定的面量三點。

qa.en: We plot the measurements on a chart to watch the trend.
qa.zh: 我們把量測值畫在圖上看趨勢。

qa.en: A capability below the target triggers an improvement plan before the trend can produce out-of-specification product.
qa.zh: Cpk 低於目標就啟動改善計畫，趁還沒做出超規品之前先處理。

qa.en: In spec today, but the trend says out of spec next week. SPC exists so we act on the trend, not on the rejects.
qa.zh: 今天在規格內，但趨勢看起來下週就會超規。SPC 就是要看趨勢動手，不是等不良品出來。

qa.en: I see your point, but the data shows a different trend.
qa.zh: 我懂你的意思，但數據看起來不是這樣。

qa.en: The Cpk for the mounting-hole position dropped to 1.12 this week, below our 1.33 target. Please investigate the trend before it produces rejects.
qa.zh: 安裝孔位置度的 Cpk 這週掉到 1.12，低於 1.33 的目標。請在做出不良之前先查這個趨勢。

qa.en: Tool life is controlled by piece count, and the key dimension is monitored on a control chart so that a wear trend is detected before it goes out of specification.
qa.zh: 刀具壽命用件數管，關鍵尺寸用管制圖盯，磨耗趨勢在超規之前就看得出來。

qa.en: We run a trend analysis on complaint data every month.
qa.zh: 我們每個月都會對客訴資料做趨勢分析。

qa.en: What gets penalised is usually not that the product failed, but that you knew and never joined the dots. A high case-closure rate without trend analysis is not control — it just looks like it.
qa.zh: 被罰的通常不是「產品出問題」，而是「你早就知道，卻沒把點連成線」。結案率再高，沒做趨勢分析就不算掌控，只是看起來像而已。

words.definition: 把某物剪短或修整整齊

general.en: He trims his beard every week.
general.zh: 他每週修剪鬍子。

words.definition: A cart with wheels for carrying bags.

general.en: I put my bags on a trolley at the airport.
general.zh: 我把行李放在機場的行李推車上。

general.en: Could I get a trolley for my luggage, please?
general.zh: 可以給我一台行李推車嗎？

general.en: I need a luggage trolley.
general.zh: 我需要一台行李推車。

words.definition: A series of large ocean waves caused by an underwater earthquake or explosion.

general.en: A tsunami hit the coast after the earthquake.
general.zh: 地震後，海嘯侵襲了海岸。

general.en: The tsunami caused massive flooding along the coast.
general.zh: 海嘯在沿岸造成大規模淹水。

qa.en: This oil was made for open surfaces — inside a sealed tube it cannot coat every spot, so the tube rusts anyway.
qa.zh: 這支防鏽油是給外面平面用的——管子裡面塗不到的地方，照樣鏽。

qa.en: Contain first: sort all in-process and in-stock handrail tubes and check for internal rust. Mark and segregate any affected lots.
qa.zh: 先圍堵：在製品跟庫存的扶手管全部翻出來，看裡面有沒有鏽。有問題的批次標起來隔開。

qa.en: We run tensile tests on incoming steel tube and on welded joints. The specimen is prepared per the standard, and the result is compared against the material specification on the drawing.
qa.zh: 進料鋼管跟焊接接頭會做拉伸。試片照標準做，結果跟圖面的材質規格比。

qa.en: The tensile strength must meet the specification defined in the drawing. For this steel tube the requirement is a minimum of 370 megapascals, and our last incoming test result was 412 megapascals.
qa.zh: 抗拉強度要符合圖面規格。這支鋼管要求最少 370 MPa，上次進料測出來是 412 MPa。

qa.en: Decision: stop using a rust-preventive oil that is not designed for the application. A general-purpose oil on an open surface is not the same as corrosion protection inside a sealed tube.
qa.zh: 決定：這支油不適合管子裡面，要停用。噴在外面平面的油，不代表管子裡面也能防鏽。

qa.en: Risk: internal rust may not be visible after assembly, but it weakens the tube wall over time and can cause rust stains to bleed through the outer coating after the product reaches the customer.
qa.zh: 風險：組裝完看不到裡面的鏽，但時間久了管壁會變薄，鏽漬還可能從烤漆面滲出來，到客戶那邊才出事。

words.definition: Sudden strong movements of air that shake a plane.
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: I felt like vomiting because of the turbulence.
general.zh: 因為亂流，我覺得想吐。

general.en: He was feeling nausea during the long flight when the turbulence hit.
general.zh: 遇到亂流時，他當時在長途飛行中正感到噁心。

general.en: It will take approximately three and a half hours. We expect some turbulence during the first hour, but it shouldn't be serious.
general.zh: 大約需要三個半小時。我們預期第一個小時會有一些亂流，但應該不嚴重。

general.en: I see. I'm a little nervous about flying. Do you have any advice for dealing with turbulence?
general.zh: 我明白了。我對搭飛機有點緊張。你有沒有應對亂流的建議？

general.en: We expect some turbulence during the first hour.
general.zh: 我們預期第一個小時會有一些亂流。

general.en: The turbulence made me feel sick.
general.zh: 亂流讓我覺得不舒服。

general.en: I turn on the air conditioner every day. / I've been turning it on every day.
general.zh: 我每天都開冷氣／我最近每天一直都有開冷氣。（現在簡單式表習慣；現在完成進行式 have/has been + V-ing 表「從近期某過去時間點持續到現在」的常態。）

general.en: She kept tossing and turning all night.
general.zh: 她整晚翻來覆去。（I tossed and turned all night and still didn't fall asleep. 我整晚翻來覆去還是睡不著。）

words.definition: a large, powerful tropical storm that forms over warm ocean water in Asia

general.en: The school is closed today because of the typhoon.
general.zh: 因為颱風的關係，學校今天停課。

general.en: The roads are flooded after the typhoon.
general.zh: 颱風過後道路被淹沒了。

general.en: A typhoon often messes up flight schedules.
general.zh: 颱風常常打亂班機時刻表。

general.en: The flights will be cancelled if the typhoon hits.
general.zh: 如果颱風登陸，班機將被取消。

general.en: The typhoon affected the factory plan.
general.zh: 颱風影響了工廠的計畫。

general.en: A typhoon can be a terrible disaster.
general.zh: 颱風可能是一場可怕的災難。

qa.en: This is an unauthorized change to an approved material.
qa.zh: 這是改承認過的材料，而且沒經過核准。

qa.en: We identified an unauthorized change to a customer-approved material. We have contained the affected lots, defined the re-qualification plan, and will review the disposition of in-process units once the comparison data is available.
qa.zh: 我們發現供應商改了客戶承認過的材料，沒經過核准。受影響批次已經圍堵、重新驗證的計畫也定了，比對數據出來後再決定在製品怎麼處理。

qa.en: We found undercut along the weld bead; please repair it.
qa.zh: 焊道旁發現咬邊，請補焊修整。

words.definition: to think something is smaller or less important than it really is
words.lesson: 20260721 作業複習與機場旅遊英文

general.en: Don't underestimate him—he's a smart cookie.
general.zh: 別低估他，他很聰明。

general.en: Don't underestimate the language barrier.
general.zh: 不要低估語言隔閡。

words.definition: To open something that was folded.

general.en: My tray table is broken; I can't unfold it.
general.zh: 我的小桌板壞了，打不開。

words.definition: 與眾不同、世上獨一無二的

general.en: Every snowflake has a unique shape.
general.zh: 每片雪花都有獨特的形狀。

words.definition: Joined together and working as one toward the same goal.
words.lesson: 20251016 社區教育計畫 Community Project

general.en: Thanksgiving is a national holiday celebrated mainly in the United States and Canada.
general.zh: 感恩節是一個主要在美國和加拿大慶祝的國家節日。

general.en: A united team can achieve anything.
general.zh: 團結的隊伍可以達成任何事。

words.definition: different from what is normal, in a way that does not seem real.

general.en: Too much surgery can make a person look unnatural.
general.zh: 太多手術會讓人看起來不自然。

general.en: Some people have so many operations that they start to look unnatural, like plastic.
general.zh: 有些人做了太多手術，最後看起來不自然，像塑膠一樣。

general.en: Too much surgery can make people look unnatural.
general.zh: 太多手術會讓人看起來不自然。

words.definition: not able to be predicted; un- (negative prefix) + predictable

general.en: The weather is unpredictable in summer.
general.zh: 夏天的天氣難以預測。

words.definition: sick, or not feeling healthy.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: He feels very unwell after working all day without rest.
general.zh: 工作一整天都沒休息後，他覺得非常不舒服。

general.en: I've been feeling unwell since yesterday evening. I think I have a fever.
general.zh: 我從昨天傍晚就一直不太舒服。我覺得我在發燒。

general.en: He feels very weak / unwell after working all day without rest.
general.zh: 工作一整天都沒休息後，他覺得非常虛弱／不舒服。

general.en: I feel very nauseous / unwell after staying up too late last night.
general.zh: 昨晚熬夜太晚之後，我覺得非常噁心／不舒服。

words.definition: Straight up, not leaning back.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Please put your seat in the upright position for takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛時請把椅背調到直立位置。

general.en: I've closed the tray table. Do I need to keep my seat upright too?
general.zh: 我已經收好小桌板了。椅背也需要保持直立嗎？

general.en: Could you put your seat upright, please?
general.zh: 請把椅背調回直立，好嗎？

general.en: Seats must be upright for landing.
general.zh: 降落時椅背必須直立。

general.en: Could you please put your seat upright?
general.zh: 可以請你把椅背調直嗎？

qa.en: Thank you for sending the salt spray report for the squat rack uprights.
qa.zh: 謝謝你們送來深蹲架立柱的鹽霧報告。

words.definition: good times and bad times.

general.en: Everyone has ups and downs in their lives.
general.zh: 每個人一生中都有起起落落。

general.en: I used to stay up late often, but I don't anymore.
general.zh: 我以前常常熬夜，但現在不再了。
