general.en: There used to be four distinct seasons in Taiwan.
general.zh: 台灣以前有四季之分。

general.en: I used to live in Taiwan.
general.zh: 我以前住在台灣。

general.en: The first two months were more difficult than she expected. She missed going to her favourite coffee shop after work. But after a while she got used to cooking at home.
general.zh: 最初那兩個月比她預想的還難。她懷念下班後去最喜歡的咖啡店。但過了一陣子，她就習慣在家煮飯了。

general.en: At first the change was hard. She felt tired in the afternoon and drank too much coffee. But after two weeks, her body got used to the new schedule.
general.zh: 一開始這個改變很辛苦。她下午覺得累，咖啡也喝太多。但兩個星期之後，身體就習慣了新的時間表。

general.en: We used to think that a typhoon meant a free day at home. When I was a child, my mother would buy instant noodles and candles, and my brother and I would sit by the window watching the trees bend. It felt like an adventure.
general.zh: 我們以前總覺得颱風就代表在家放一天假。我小時候，媽媽會去買泡麵和蠟燭，我和弟弟則會坐在窗邊看樹被吹彎。那感覺像一場冒險。

qa.en: We are not questioning your result — we are questioning what the report can be used to prove.
qa.zh: 我們不是質疑你們的結果，是在確認這份報告能拿來證明什麼。

words.translation: 燈泡式耐黃變／老化試驗機

qa.en: The V-block keeps the round part from rolling.
qa.zh: V 型枕可防止圓形工件滾動。

qa.en: Turn on the magnetic V-block to hold the workpiece.
qa.zh: 開啟磁性 V 型枕以吸住工件。

qa.en: Support the shaft on two V-blocks.
qa.zh: 用兩個 V 型枕支撐軸件。

words.definition: Officially acceptable and able to be used.
words.lesson: 20260709 機場旅遊英文 Airport & Travel English

general.en: My passport is expired. / My passport has expired. / I need to renew my passport because it is no longer valid.
general.zh: 我的護照過期了（形容詞）。／我的護照已經過期（現在完成式）。／我需要續辦護照，因為它已失效（正式）。

general.en: My passport is no longer valid.
general.zh: 我的護照已經失效了。

qa.en: Disposition the rejected lots against the revision that was valid when they were made.
qa.zh: 被判退的批次，照「生產當時有效的版次」重新判。

qa.en: Check whether the test setup itself is valid — load, frequency, fixture — before blaming the design.
qa.zh: 先確認測試條件本身沒問題——負載、頻率、治具——再來談設計。

qa.en: The instrument is withdrawn from use and we perform a reverse traceability review of all product measured since its previous valid calibration.
qa.zh: 儀器馬上收起來不用，上次有效校驗之後量過的產品全部回頭追。

qa.en: There is a revision mismatch — the parts were built to Rev B but inspected against Rev C. We will disposition the lots against the revision valid at the time of build.
qa.zh: 版次對不起來——零件照 B 版做，卻照 C 版驗。我們會照生產當時有效的版次重新判。

qa.en: Only the current revision on the shop floor is valid. Superseded drawings are removed immediately, and any change requires an engineering change notice before production may use it.
qa.zh: 現場只有現行版有效。舊版圖面馬上收掉，要改一定要先發 ECN 才能用在生產。

qa.en: Confirm the measurement is valid before you reject anything: calibrate the instrument, measure at least three points per part, and keep the same illuminant and geometry (D65/10°).
qa.zh: 判退之前先確認量測是對的：儀器校正過、每件至少量三點、光源跟角度都一樣（D65/10°）。

qa.en: Risk: if you sign it as-is, the validated state on paper is a process that was only ever run once.
qa.zh: 風險：照原樣簽下去，紙上寫「已驗證」的，其實是一個只跑過一批的製程。

qa.en: A process change takes the line out of its validated state.
qa.zh: 製程一改，產線就不算已驗證了。

qa.en: If the process changed during validation, the validation covers the new process only.
qa.zh: 驗證跑到一半製程改了，那份驗證就只算改過之後的製程。

qa.en: Decision: do not sign three runs as one validation when they were not the same process.
qa.zh: 決定：三批不是同一個製程，就不要當成一份驗證簽下去。

qa.en: Process validation requires three consecutive runs of the same process.
qa.zh: 製程驗證要求同一製程連續三批。

qa.en: The fixture change means the validation only covers the new configuration.
qa.zh: 夾具換了，這份驗證就只算新組態。

qa.en: Action: ask that the carry-over be approved with a condition — either a design change or a specific validation test for that failure mode.
qa.zh: 行動：要求沿用改成「有條件核准」——要嘛改設計，要嘛針對這個故障模式安排專門的驗證。

qa.en: Could you recommend a VCI-type rust-preventive oil or a product specifically rated for enclosed cavities? We need the product data sheet and a sample for validation before switching.
qa.zh: 可否推薦 VCI 型（揮發型）防鏽油、或適合管子內部使用的產品？切換前我們需要 TDS 跟樣品來驗證。

words.definition: A person who does not eat meat.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: A vegetarian does not eat meat. / A vegetarian in-flight meal is available.
general.zh: 素食者不吃肉。／有提供素食機上餐。

general.en: A vegetarian does not eat meat.
general.zh: 素食者不吃肉。

general.en: I ordered a vegetarian special meal.
general.zh: 我預訂了素食特別餐。

words.definition: 汽車、機車等交通工具的總稱

general.en: There are too many vehicles on the road.
general.zh: 路上有太多車輛。

general.en: A passenger is a person traveling in a vehicle who is not the driver or crew.
general.zh: 乘客是指搭乘交通工具、但不是駕駛或工作人員的人。

general.en: It seems the air is polluted because there are too many vehicles.
general.zh: 看起來空氣很髒，因為路上有太多車輛。

qa.en: 'Premium feel' is not verifiable as written.
qa.zh: 「premium 手感」這樣寫是驗證不了的。

qa.en: Please send the verification of effectiveness after three consecutive good lots.
qa.zh: 連續三批合格後，請提出有效性驗證資料。

qa.en: We identified the root cause and implemented a permanent corrective action with effectiveness verification.
qa.zh: 根因確認了，永久對策也上了，效果也驗證過了。

qa.en: Hardness testing is our verification of the heat treatment result for every incoming lot of heat-treated parts.
qa.zh: 每批熱處理件進來，我們都用硬度來驗熱處理有沒有做到位。

qa.en: This change invalidates the previous verification results.
qa.zh: 改了這個，之前驗證的結果就不算數了。

qa.en: We will submit the interim report today with the containment evidence, and the full 8D including effectiveness verification by Friday.
qa.zh: 今天先給暫行報告，附圍堵的證據；完整 8D 含效果確認，週五前給。

qa.en: Containment within 24 hours, root cause analysis with 5-Why and fishbone, permanent corrective action, then effectiveness verification and horizontal deployment to similar products.
qa.zh: 24 小時內先圍堵，用 5 Why 跟魚骨圖找根因，上永久對策，再確認效果、水平展開到類似產品。

words.definition: Evidence collected after the fix showing the defect really stopped.

qa.en: Please send the verification of effectiveness after three consecutive good lots.
qa.zh: 連續三批合格後，請提出有效性驗證資料。

qa.en: The gusset design requires a full verification re-test.
qa.zh: 加了補強板的設計，要完整重新驗證一次。

qa.en: The reliability test failed at 60% of the target life. Root cause analysis is in progress, and any design change will require a verification re-test.
qa.zh: 可靠度測試跑到目標壽命 60% 就失效了。根因分析進行中，只要改設計就要重新驗證。

qa.en: Is this part heat treated, and how do you verify it?
qa.zh: 這個零件有熱處理嗎？你們怎麼驗證？

qa.en: Verifying that a threaded joint is tightened to the specified torque value.
qa.zh: 確認螺絲有沒有鎖到規定的扭力。

qa.en: How did you verify that this is the root cause?
qa.zh: 你們怎麼確認這就是根因？

qa.en: How would you like us to verify that requirement?
qa.zh: 這一條，您希望我們怎麼驗證？

qa.en: Welders are qualified, welding parameters are locked in the machine, and we perform periodic destructive testing to verify penetration.
qa.zh: 焊工有考過資格，焊接參數鎖在機台上，定期做破壞測試看熔深。

qa.en: Yes. We verify the heat treatment by hardness test. The specification is HRC 45 to 50, and we take three readings per part on the specified surface.
qa.zh: 有。熱處理我們用硬度來驗。規格 HRC 45～50，每件在指定的面量三點。

qa.en: Use the vibration meter to check the vibration level of the motor.
qa.zh: 用振動儀檢查馬達的振動值。

qa.en: Run the vibration test for 60 minutes to simulate transport.
qa.zh: 執行 60 分鐘振動測試模擬運輸。

qa.en: Measure the case depth with the Vickers hardness tester.
qa.zh: 用維克氏硬度機量測硬化層深度。

words.definition: The number of times a video is watched.

general.en: One of their videos went viral, receiving thousands of views.
general.zh: 他們的一支影片爆紅，獲得數千次觀看。

general.en: Emma, we've got a problem. A customer posted a video about a damaged package, and it already has fifty thousand views.
general.zh: Emma，我們有麻煩了。有位顧客把破損的包裹拍成影片放上網，現在已經五萬次觀看了。

general.en: Views are a metric; exposure is the goal.
general.zh: views 是可以數的指標，exposure 是策略目標

general.en: The video on Instagram got two million views.
general.zh: 這支 Instagram 影片有 200 萬次觀看。

general.en: The video got 2 million views.
general.zh: 這部影片有 200 萬次觀看。

general.en: Reinforcing Company Culture — The style of the party—be it a lavish formal dinner or a casual get-together—reflects the company's values and culture. It's a tangible demonstration of how the organization views its people.
general.zh: 鞏固公司文化——宴會的形式——無論是豪華的正式晚宴，或是輕鬆的聚會——都反映了公司的價值觀與文化。這是一種具體展現公司如何看待員工的方式。

qa.en: This is basic visual inspection. How did three scratched units get through?
qa.zh: 這是最基本的外觀檢驗，三台刮傷的機台是怎麼放過去的？

words.definition: an event when a volcano sends out lava, ash, and gas

general.en: The volcanic eruption forced thousands of people to evacuate.
general.zh: 火山爆發迫使數千人撤離。

general.en: The volcanic eruption covered the village in ash.
general.zh: 火山爆發讓村莊覆蓋在火山灰下。

general.en: Natural disasters are powerful events that can cause serious damage to people, buildings, and the environment. Some common natural disasters include earthquakes, typhoons, floods, droughts, wildfires, and volcanic eruptions.
general.zh: 天然災害是能對人類、建築物與環境造成嚴重破壞的強大事件。常見的天然災害包括地震、颱風、洪水、乾旱、野火和火山爆發。

words.definition: to offer to do something without being paid.

general.en: Some students volunteer to help the elderly.
general.zh: 有些學生會去當志工幫助老人。

general.en: Many volunteers helped clean up after the flood.
general.zh: 許多志工在洪水過後協助清理。

general.en: So who takes the leadership role? Somebody has to organize the volunteers.
general.zh: 那誰來擔任領導的角色？總得有人來組織志工。

general.en: Many volunteers joined the rescue team after the earthquake.
general.zh: 地震後許多義工加入了救援隊伍。

words.definition: to bring up food from your stomach and out through your mouth because you feel sick.
words.lesson: 20260305 問候與健康詞彙 Greetings & Health

general.en: The strong chemical smell made him want to vomit.
general.zh: 刺鼻的化學氣味讓他想吐。

general.en: I felt like vomiting because of the turbulence.
general.zh: 因為亂流，我覺得想吐。

general.en: Eating bad sushi caused food poisoning and vomiting last night.
general.zh: 昨晚吃到壞掉的壽司導致了食物中毒和嘔吐。

general.en: The patient vomits after taking the medicine.
general.zh: 病患吃藥後會嘔吐。（描述這款藥物常態的副作用或病患的體質反應。）

general.en: The patient vomited after taking the medicine yesterday.
general.zh: 病患昨天吃完藥後嘔吐了。

general.en: The patient will vomit after taking the medicine.
general.zh: 病患吃藥後將會嘔吐。（醫生或護理師對副作用的預測與警告。）

words.definition: something that is not worth the money you spend on it.

general.en: He thinks cosmetic surgery is a waste of money.
general.zh: 他認為整形手術是浪費錢。

general.en: I believe plastic surgery is a waste of money.
general.zh: 我認為整形手術是浪費錢。

words.definition: to make something or someone less strong

general.en: The typhoon weakened as it moved inland.
general.zh: 颱風在移入內陸時逐漸減弱。

general.en: Stress can weaken your health over time.
general.zh: To lose strength.（-en 結尾代表「使…變成…」）

general.en: She took a painkiller to weaken the migraine.
general.zh: 她吃了一顆止痛藥來減緩偏頭痛。

general.en: The typhoon weakened before it hit the coast.
general.zh: 颱風在登陸前減弱了。

qa.en: Risk: internal rust may not be visible after assembly, but it weakens the tube wall over time and can cause rust stains to bleed through the outer coating after the product reaches the customer.
qa.zh: 風險：組裝完看不到裡面的鏽，但時間久了管壁會變薄，鏽漬還可能從烤漆面滲出來，到客戶那邊才出事。

words.definition: a large amount of money or valuable things that a person or place has.
words.lesson: 20260212 農曆新年 Chinese New Year

general.en: Many families eat fish, dumplings, and rice cakes because these foods mean wealth and success.
general.zh: 常見食物有魚、餃子和年糕，象徵財富與成功。

words.definition: To measure how heavy something is.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: He weighed his luggage to make sure it wasn't over the weight limit.
general.zh: 他秤了行李，以確保沒有超重。

general.en: It was. I looked at the data, I weighed the options, and I decided. No emotion, just numbers.
general.zh: 的確是。我看了數據，權衡了選項，然後做了決定。沒有情緒，只看數字。

general.en: I want to weigh this cup.
general.zh: 我想秤一下這個杯子的重量。

general.en: I want to weigh the cup.
general.zh: 我想秤一下這個杯子的重量。

general.en: Let's weigh this package.
general.zh: 我們來秤這個包裹的重量。

qa.en: Weigh the sample on the electronic scale and record the weight.
qa.zh: 在電子磅秤上秤重並記錄重量。

qa.en: Tare the scale before weighing.
qa.zh: 秤重前先扣除皮重。

qa.en: The supplier must submit an 8D report for the cracked squat rack welds within ten working days.
qa.zh: 供應商必須在十個工作天內提出深蹲架焊道龜裂的 8D 報告。

qa.en: A cracked weld on the squat rack is a major defect; a small paint run is minor.
qa.zh: 深蹲架焊道裂痕是主要缺點；輕微流漆則是次要缺點。

qa.en: We plot the frame welding gap on a control chart every two hours.
qa.zh: 我們每兩小時把車架焊接間隙點在管制圖上。

qa.en: We use dye penetrant testing on the welded frame — it is a non-destructive test.
qa.zh: 我們對焊接車架做滲透探傷，這是非破壞性檢測。

qa.en: The containment action is already in place — all affected lots are on hold and re-inspected. The root cause is a loose welding fixture. We will submit the interim report today and the full 8D report by Friday.
qa.zh: 圍堵已經做了，受影響的批次全部扣住重檢。根因是焊接治具鬆掉。今天先給暫行報告，完整 8D 週五前給。

qa.en: We run tensile tests on incoming steel tube and on welded joints. The specimen is prepared per the standard, and the result is compared against the material specification on the drawing.
qa.zh: 進料鋼管跟焊接接頭會做拉伸。試片照標準做，結果跟圖面的材質規格比。

qa.en: We found undercut along the weld bead; please repair it.
qa.zh: 焊道旁發現咬邊，請補焊修整。

qa.en: The cross-section shows insufficient weld penetration.
qa.zh: 切片顯示熔深不足。

qa.en: The root cause is not confirmed yet — weld penetration is the leading hypothesis.
qa.zh: 根因還沒確認——熔深不足是目前最可能的假設。

qa.en: Let me separate the facts from the assumptions. Confirmed: the frame cracked at 60,000 cycles. Suspected: insufficient weld penetration. Unverified: the gusset fix.
qa.zh: 我先把事實跟假設分開。確認的：車架在 6 萬次裂了。懷疑的：熔深不足。還沒驗證的：補強板對策。

qa.en: How do you control welding quality?
qa.zh: 焊接品質你們怎麼管控？

words.definition: completely awake, not at all sleepy

general.en: I was wide awake last night until 4:00 a.m.
general.zh: 我昨晚一直清醒到凌晨四點。

words.definition: a fire that spreads very quickly over a large area of land

general.en: The wildfire spread quickly across the dry hills.
general.zh: 野火迅速蔓延至乾燥的山丘。

general.en: Wildfires spread quickly in dry weather.
general.zh: 野火在乾燥天氣中蔓延迅速。

general.en: The wildfire spread quickly in dry weather.
general.zh: 野火在乾燥天氣中迅速蔓延。

general.en: Natural disasters are powerful events that can cause serious damage to people, buildings, and the environment. Some common natural disasters include earthquakes, typhoons, floods, droughts, wildfires, and volcanic eruptions.
general.zh: 天然災害是能對人類、建築物與環境造成嚴重破壞的強大事件。常見的天然災害包括地震、颱風、洪水、乾旱、野火和火山爆發。

words.definition: A cover for a window at home.

general.en: She pulled down the window blind at home.
general.zh: 她在家把百葉窗拉下來。

words.definition: A seat next to the window.
words.lesson: 20260716 搭機英文 On the Plane

general.en: Yes, that's correct. Is this a window seat?
general.zh: 是的，沒錯。這是靠窗座位嗎？

general.en: She chose a window seat for the view.
general.zh: 她選了靠窗座位欣賞風景。

words.definition: The cover you pull down over a plane window.

general.en: Please keep your window shade open during landing.
general.zh: 降落時請保持遮光板打開。

general.en: Please keep your window shade open during takeoff and landing.
general.zh: 起飛和降落時請保持遮光板打開。

general.en: Please close your window shade before takeoff.
general.zh: 起飛前請關上遮陽板。

qa.en: The actual value is 25.03 against a nominal of 25.00 plus or minus 0.05, so it is within tolerance with sufficient margin.
The reading is 10.05 mm, which is within tolerance.
qa.zh: 讀值 10.05 mm，在公差內。

qa.en: The needle moved 0.03 mm, which is within tolerance.
qa.zh: 指針移動 0.03 mm，在公差內。

qa.en: Is this dimension within tolerance?
qa.zh: 這個尺寸在公差內嗎？

general.en: If I had a Mercedes Benz, I would never take it on a road trip.
general.zh: 如果我有一台賓士車，我絕對不會開它去長途旅行。

general.en: If I were in Taiwan now, I would visit my students.
general.zh: 如果我現在在台灣，我會去看我的學生。

general.en: If I have a thousand dollars, I would like to fly to Japan in business class.
general.zh: 如果我有一千美金，我想要搭商務艙去日本。

general.en: He never thought the show would be a success.
general.zh: 他從沒想過這部劇會成功。

general.en: Certainly. Would you like anything else?
general.zh: 當然。您還需要別的嗎？

general.en: Would you like a soft drink?
general.zh: 你想要一杯汽水嗎？

qa.en: I would like to confirm the details with the process owner before I answer, to make sure the information I give you is accurate.
qa.zh: 我想先跟製程負責人確認細節再回您，確保講的是對的。

qa.en: We would appreciate your reply by Wednesday, as the production schedule depends on it.
qa.zh: 生產排程要看這個，麻煩週三前回覆。

qa.en: How would you like us to verify that requirement?
qa.zh: 這一條，您希望我們怎麼驗證？

qa.en: We would like to propose a test method for your approval.
qa.zh: 我們想提一個測試方法給您確認。

qa.en: A limit sample would close this faster than another round of wording.
qa.zh: 用限度樣品，會比再改一輪文字快結案。

qa.en: For the frame, we propose the static and endurance tests of EN ISO 20957-1 at the declared maximum user mass, and we would like to confirm the value with you.
qa.zh: 機架的部分，我們建議用 EN ISO 20957-1 的靜態跟耐久測試、以標示的最大使用者體重來做，這個數值想跟您確認一下。

words.definition: used to say what someone prefers to do in a certain situation.

general.en: I would rather stay natural and look human.
general.zh: 我寧願保持自然，看起來像一個真正的人。

general.en: I would rather stay natural than change my appearance.
general.zh: 我寧願保持自然，也不要改變外表。

general.en: I would rather stay natural.
general.zh: 我寧願保持自然。

general.en: I would rather stay home.

qa.en: I would rather have a high action priority now than a warranty claim later.
qa.zh: 我寧可現在行動優先度高一點，也不要以後多一件保固客訴。

qa.en: We would rather give you a figure we can evidence than one we cannot.
qa.zh: 我們寧可給您一個拿得出證據的數字，也不給一個拿不出證據的。

words.definition: a small line that appears in the skin, especially on the face, as a person grows older.

general.en: Some people want to remove wrinkles so they can look younger.
general.zh: 有些人想消除皺紋讓自己看起來更年輕。

general.en: Some people want to remove wrinkles to look younger.
general.zh: 有些人想消除皺紋讓自己看起來更年輕。

general.en: Tom doesn't like ironing his pants, so he wears wrinkled pants.
general.zh: Tom 不喜歡燙褲子，所以他穿著皺巴巴的褲子。（動名詞受詞：like 後接 V-ing；wrinkled 是形容詞，描述衣服「皺巴巴的」狀態。）

general.en: The iron removes wrinkles from clothes.
general.zh: 熨斗去除衣服的皺褶。

general.en: The most common operation is called a nose job. People who are unhappy with their nose change its shape. Some people want to remove wrinkles so they can look younger. Others have surgery to make parts of their body bigger or smaller.
general.zh: 最常見的手術叫做「隆鼻手術」。對自己鼻子不滿意的人會改變鼻子的形狀。有些人想要消除皺紋，讓自己看起來更年輕。還有人透過手術，讓身體的某些部位變大或變小。

qa.en: Wrinkles appear when the blank holder force is too low.
qa.zh: 壓料力太低時會出現皺褶。

words.definition: A machine that scans bags at security.

general.en: Your carry-on bags will pass through an X-ray machine.
general.zh: 你的隨身行李會通過 X 光機掃描。

words.definition: a popular animated movie made by Disney about a city full of animals

general.en: Zootopia is a popular animated movie made by Disney.
general.zh: 《動物方城市》是一部很受歡迎的迪士尼動畫。
